admission_regulation.title: Satzung zum Eignungsverfahren für Masterstudiengänge an der Technischen Universität Nürnberg (Mastereignungssatzung - MEigS), Anlage M.Sc. „Artificial Intelligence and Robotics“
admission_regulation.version: MEigS vom 11.04.2023 in der Fassung der 2. Änderungssatzung (cover: 'vom 01.03.2025'; footer: 'Zuletzt geändert durch die 2. Änderungssatzung vom 20.02.2025'); 1. Änderungssatzung vom 14.03.2024 (in force 01.03.2024) incorporated, not opened separately. Dates inside the document are inconsistent (see notes). No later amendment found. Framework: ASPO vom 07.05.2024, zuletzt geändert durch Satzung vom 13.03.2025 (in force 26.05.2025) — contains no admission rules.

accepted_degree_fields.note: MEigS Anlage AI and Robotics Nr. 1: successful completion of a qualifying degree in Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik (Electrical Engineering), Informatik (Computer Sciences), Maschinenbau (Mechanical Engineering), Mathematik or Physik; § 1 (1): ein erster berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss oder ein gleichwertiger Abschluss aus dem Inland oder Ausland. Program page: 'Bachelor of Science (B.Sc. or equivalent) in Computer Science or related fields such as Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics.'

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade. The final grade only modifies the pre-selection score (Anlage Nr. 3; see subsequent_selection_criteria_display). Foreign grades are converted with the Bavarian formula ('über die bayerische Formel umgerechnet', § 4 Abs. 4).

items.raw_label: informatische Bezüge im Umfang von insgesamt mindestens 24 ECTS-Punkten: Einführung in die Informatik, Einführung in die Programmierung, Einführung in Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen, und einem weiteren der folgenden Fächer: Einführung in die Theoretische Informatik, Einführung in Rechnerarchitektur oder Rechnernetze oder Einführung in die Softwaretechnik

mathematische Bezüge in Analysis und linearer Algebra, mindestens 18 ECTS (program page: 'Mathematical references in analysis and linear algebra (at least 18 ECTS or equivalent)'; MEigS Anlage Nr. 2: 'z. B. im Umfang von insgesamt mindestens 18 ECTS-Punkten')

subject_credit_requirements.note: MEigS Anlage AI and Robotics Nr. 2. Mathematics: the regulation requires mathematical content in Analysis and linear algebra ('muss mathematische Bezüge in den folgenden Bereichen'); the 18 ECTS figure is introduced with 'z. B.' (for example). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording; Koushik's decision 15.10.2026): stored as one 18 ECTS item over Analysis + linear algebra (added up, engine rule D3), because the official program page states 'at least 18 ECTS or equivalent'. This is stricter than the regulation's 'z. B.' wording. Nr. 2 also names programming competencies in Algorithms and Data Structures (simple data structures, complexity analysis, sorting, search, hashing) as 'Grundvoraussetzungen für die Eignung zum Studiengang' — no credit figure. Under § 4 Abs. 3 these qualifications are scored 0-3 points in pre-selection (0 points = qualification not met and no subject aptitude expected); the regulation does not state a separate exclusion rule for applicants below 24/18 ECTS.

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: MEigS Anlage AI and Robotics Nr. 6 (weitere Anforderungen) reads 'Keine'; no Auflagen/bridging modules are provided for this program (the 12-ECTS Foundation Modules rule exists only for Human and Artificial Intelligence).

descriptive_notes: Aptitude procedure (Eignungsverfahren): pre-selection score from academic qualifications (0-3 points, § 4 Abs. 3), final grade modifier and statement-of-purpose modifier.
Grade modifier (Anlage Nr. 3): better than 1.3 = +1 point; 1.3 to 2.0 = no change; worse than 2.0 up to 3.0 = -1 point; worse than 3.0 = -2 points.
Statement of purpose: exceptional suitability +1 point, low suitability -1 point (§ 4 Abs. 5).
Total 0 or fewer points: unsuitable; 1-2 points: selection interview; at least 3 points: admitted directly (§ 4 Abs. 6).
Selection interview (§ 5): usually 10-15 minutes, in English, solving a task set during the interview; suitability established if the examiners unanimously vote 'geeignet'.
A failed aptitude procedure can be repeated once for the same program (§ 10 Abs. 1).

allowed_exemptions: German Abitur with proof of English (program page)
Bachelor's program conducted entirely in English (program page)
further proofs can be recognised by the UTN School of StaRs (§ 2 Abs. 4)
language_english.note: MEigS § 2 Abs. 4: valid English test; accepted: TOEFL internet based min. 90, TOEFL Paper min. 577, IELTS min. 6.5, Cambridge Language Assessment C1 (Advanced). The regulation names no CEFR level and no explicit exemption; the exemptions are from the program page. Program page: test result no more than two years old.

language_german.required_level: A2 (official language examination) or German-language university entrance qualification
language_german.due: by registration of the final thesis (program page: beginning of the 4th semester)

aps_certificate.note: MEigS § 2 Abs. 6: APS certificate required if the degree was obtained in India, China or Vietnam.

other_requirements: statement of purpose in English, max. 600 words (program page: explanatory letter)
complete, chronological, tabular CV in English
relevant qualifications form
certificate of university entrance qualification
transcript of records or overview of courses
application before graduation possible with at least 140 ECTS on the transcript; degree certificate due five weeks after semester start (§ 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 3)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 31 May (application period 1 March - 31 May 2026)

admission_regulation.title: Zulassungssatzung 2026 des Master-Studiengangs AI and Advanced Information Technologies der Hochschule RheinMain (together with the Rahmenzulassungssatzung der Masterstudiengänge (RZuSa Master) 2025.1)
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Mitteilungen Nr. 1028, published and in force 07.05.2026 (Fachbereichsrat 20.03.2026, Senat 28.04.2026, Präsidium 05.05.2026); embedded RZuSa Master 2025.1 (Senat 21.10.2025, Präsidium 29.10.2025, in force 01.11.2025). No amendment found. The examination regulation (Prüfungsordnung, PO 2026) of the program was not found.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Zulassungssatzung § 2 (1): admission requires proof that the listed competences were acquired in the preceding first professional degree; they can also have been acquired 'in Kombination eines ingenieurwissenschaftlichen oder vergleichbaren Studiums mit einer entsprechenden fachlichen Ausbildung oder Berufstätigkeit'. No disciplines are named in the regulation. Program page: 'first professional degree in Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related discipline obtained from a university or a university of applied sciences.'

grade_requirement.note: RZuSa § 3 (1) only allows ('kann') a program statute to set a minimum grade of 2.5 (with optional interview for 2.5-3.0); the program-specific Zulassungssatzung 2026 of this program sets none. The program page states no grade limit.

items.raw_label: Fachkompetenz Medientechnik: 'Die Bewerber:innen sind in der Lage, Theorien, Prinzipien und Methoden des Faches in der Praxis anzuwenden und in Bezug auf konkrete Anwendungsfälle aus dem Bereich Medientechnik kritisch zu beurteilen.'

Fachkompetenz Künstliche Intelligenz: 'Die Bewerber:innen sind in der Lage, Verfahren der Künstlichen Intelligenz in der Medientechnik zu beurteilen und innovative Lösungen für die Verarbeitung und Analyse audiovisueller Daten zu entwickeln.'

Fachkompetenz Netzwerktechnologien: 'Die Bewerber:innen sind in der Lage, moderne Netzwerktechnologien und Protokolle auszuwählen und anzuwenden, um Audio- und Videodaten über Netzwerke zu übertragen, wie z. B. Streaming-Technologien zu optimieren.'

subject_credit_requirements.note: Zulassungssatzung § 2 (1) defines a competence catalogue without credit figures. Fachkompetenzen: Medientechnik, Künstliche Intelligenz, Schnittstellenkompetenz (audio and video signals at interfaces between disciplines), Netzwerktechnologien; plus Methoden-, Sozial- and Selbstkompetenzen. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): Medientechnik is checked as presence-only using the closest CS category (graphics_visual_computing), because the whole competence catalogue is media-technology oriented; Künstliche Intelligenz and Netzwerktechnologien are checked with their matching categories; Schnittstellenkompetenz (audio/video signals at interfaces between disciplines) has no fitting CS category and is shown only as a note. RZuSa § 2 (1): requirements are met if the degree shows 'keinen wesentlichen Unterschied' with respect to these competences. The official PDF (AM Nr. 1028) prints the framework statute (RZuSa Master 2025.1) and the program-specific rules side by side; where a paragraph number appears twice (§ 1 (2), § 2 (1), § 5 (1)), the second wording is the program-specific rule (checked against Koushik's copy, 11.10.2026).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen for missing competences. § 10 'Zulassung unter Vorbehalt' only covers proofs (§ 2, § 3 (1), § 4) that cannot be submitted by the decision date. § 2 (2) RZuSa: applicants whose degree plus the master leads to fewer than 300 CP are admitted and may, on application, make up the missing CP through a research project or internship (Zusatzleistung).

descriptive_notes: The admission committee (two teaching staff, at least one professor) decides on the basis of the application documents and any interview held (§ 9 (1)); no ranking or points scheme is set out in the statute.
Program page lists the program 'with restricted admission (numerus clausus)'; the statute itself does not state a Zulassungsbeschränkung for this program.

Interface competence (§ 2 (1) 'Schnittstellenkompetenz'): you should be able to handle technical tasks involving audio and video signals across disciplines; the admission committee judges this from your degree.

allowed_exemptions: first professional degree completed demonstrably entirely in English (§ 5 (1))
language_english.note: Zulassungssatzung § 5 (1): English at level B2+ CEFR, proof with enrollment through a recognised language test; list of recognised tests on the HSRM website. Scores TOEFL iBT min. 88 and IELTS Academic min. 6.5 are from the HSRM 'English Master's programs' page (marked preliminary, status August 2025); the HSRM English-level page refers to a PDF table that was not read. School transcripts not accepted (same page).

aps_certificate.note: RheinMain APS page: 'Do you have a university (entrance) certificate from China, India or Vietnam? Then you must undergo the APS procedure.' https://www.hs-rm.de/en/studium/before-your-studies/application-and-enrollment/bewerbung-mit-auslaendischen-zeugnissen/the-aps-procedure

other_requirements: application in due time and form according to the HSRM application rules (§ 7)
application via uni-assist for foreign transcripts (HSRM pages)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung über die Zugangsvoraussetzungen und über die Zulassung für den konsekutiven Master-Studiengang „Angewandte Informatik“
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Mitteilungen I Nr. 19/2011 (01.12.2011), as last amended by AM I 20/14.04.2021 (4th amendment; earlier amendments AM I 5/2014, AM I 61/2015, AM I 48/2019); the only version listed on the program's regulations page, no later amendment found. Consolidated reading version (Lesefassung) on the university site used.

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 2 (1): technically relevant ('fachlich einschlägig') Bachelor's degree with a regular period of six semesters and at least 180 ECTS, or an equivalent degree, in Angewandte Informatik or a closely related subject; the Auswahlkommission decides on relevance (§ 2 (3)). Program page: 'A bachelor's degree in Applied Computer Science, Computer Science, or a closely related subject with at least 180 ECTS is required.'

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in § 2; the Bachelor grade is used for ranking only (§ 6: up to 51 points). Applicants not yet graduated (at least 150 credits) are ranked by the average of the examinations passed (§ 2 (2)).

items.raw_label: wenigstens 60 Anrechnungspunkte in der Informatik und Angewandten Informatik
wenigstens 15 Anrechnungspunkte in den mathematischen und naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Grundlagen

subject_credit_requirements.note: § 2 (3): the 60 credits (Informatik and Angewandte Informatik) and 15 credits (mathematical and natural-science/technical foundations) are part of the 90. The program page lists the fields more broadly (Applied Computer Science, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, Mathematics, Natural Sciences, or Engineering); Business Information Systems and Engineering are not in the regulation's wording. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'technische Grundlagen' has no matching category in the CS taxonomy, so such credits are not counted in the 90 and 15 checks (stricter than the regulation; the committee decides). Non-EU applicants must additionally prove relevance through an aptitude test (§ 2 (4), § 3). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording; Koushik's decision 15.10.2026): the overall 90-credit total of § 2 (3) is not checked as a separate item; only its two parts (60 Informatik, 15 mathematical/natural-science foundations, the latter added up across maths, physics and chemistry) are checked. This is more lenient than the regulation: a student with 60 + 15 = 75 relevant credits passes although § 2 (3) requires 90.

conditional_admission.mechanism: § 2 (3): 'Sofern sich weniger Personen bewerben' (fewer applicants than places), the Auswahlkommission may allow missing achievements to be made up 'innerhalb von zwei Semestern'; excluded if the missing amount is 'mehr als 15 Anrechnungspunkte'.

descriptive_notes: Selection only if more qualified applicants than places (§ 1); ranking out of 80 points: Bachelor grade up to 51 points (1.0-1.2 = 51 ... 4.0 = 0), special qualifications up to 5 points (scholarship, semester abroad, internship of at least 8 weeks, vocational training, research assistant job, committee work), interview up to 24 points (§ 6, § 7). Ties: Bachelor result, then lot.

Online aptitude test (multiple choice, English) for applicants without a German or EU/EEA Bachelor's degree; pass mark 60 % of questions or points, or not more than 10 % below the participants' average (§ 3).

Special quota of 30 % of places for foreign nationals and stateless persons without equivalent status; their applications are ranked separately with aptitude-test points (up to 20) and up to 9 extra points from the Auswahlkommission (§ 9a).
Program page: faculty study consultation before application necessary.

Conditions (making up up to 15 credits within two semesters) are only possible if there are fewer applicants than places, and the selection committee decides (§ 2 (3) 'Sofern sich weniger Personen bewerben', 'kann').

allowed_exemptions: native speakers of English (§ 2 (7))

at least one year of study or work in an English-speaking country, or school English average of at least 8 points in the two years before the university entrance qualification (B2 alternatives, § 2 (6))

C1 proof via at least two years of relevant study or work in an English-speaking country within the last three years, or completion of a degree programme of at least two years taught in English (§ 2 (7))
language_english.note: § 2 (6): B2 CEFR, e.g. UNIcert II, Cambridge English Scale 160, IELTS Academic band 5.5, TOEFL iBT 81, Pearson Academic 59; not older than two years before the application. § 2 (7): C1 (e.g. IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 95, Pearson Academic 76, Cambridge English Scale 180, UNIcert III) replaces the German proof under § 2 (5). Program page: 'English proficiency at CEFR C1' or 'English proficiency at CEFR B2 and German language skills corresponding to DSH level 2'.

language_german.required_level: DSH-2 (or e.g. TestDaF 4x TDN 4) for non-native speakers without German entrance qualification or German degree (§ 2 (5)); not needed with English C1 (§ 2 (7))
language_german.due: at application

other_requirements: tabellarischer Lebenslauf mit Lichtbild
statement in German or English (up to 300 words) (§ 4 (2) f)
declaration whether the applicant has been enrolled in a closely related master's programme
selection interview for shortlisted applicants
online aptitude test for applicants from non-EU countries
application with at least 150 credits before graduation; Bachelor's degree to be proven by 15.11. (winter) / 15.05. (summer), extendable (§ 2 (2), (8))

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 April
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 October

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Applied Research in Computer Science an der Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften Hof (Studien- und Prüfungsordnung Master Applied Research in Computer Science – SPO-ARC)
admission_regulation.version: vom 17. Juli 2026 (Senat 15.07.2026, Bekanntmachung 17.07.2026), in force 01.10.2026; replaces the SPO vom 10. Januar 2019. No amendment listed. Framework: Allgemeine Studien- und Prüfungsordnung (ASPO) vom 17.07.2026, in force 01.10.2026 (replaces ASPO vom 16.07.2024 as amended 24.01.2025).

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO-ARC § 5 (1): 'Abschluss eines Hochschulstudiums der Informatik oder in einem interdisziplinären Studiengang wie Wirtschafts-, Verwaltungs- oder Medieninformatik, das zum Erwerb von 210 Leistungspunkten geführt hat'; or a relevant ('einschlägiges') degree with 180 LP plus 30 further LP under § 9. Program page: computer science, media informatics, mobile computing, business information systems or comparable programs from an accredited university (anabin status H+); graduates of mechanical engineering, civil engineering, electronics and communications engineering, or math/physics are not eligible (program page only).

grade_requirement.note: SPO-ARC sets no limit on the overall grade. § 5 (3): the four modules of § 5 (2) must have been completed 'im Durchschnitt mindestens mit der Note 2,5' or an equivalent grade; equivalence by conversion under § 14 Abs. 1 Satz 2 ff. ASPO (linear formula x = 1 + 3 (Nmax - Ne)/(Nmax - Nmin), 'in der Regel'). Program page states 'minimum grade 2,5' (75%) without saying it is a module average — see CONFLICT in notes.

items.raw_label: Module gemäß § 5 Abs. 2 SPO-ARC (Kompetenzen nicht wesentlich verschieden von den Lernzielen der Module der Bachelorstudiengänge Wirtschafts- und Medieninformatik an der Hochschule Hof): Grundlagen der Programmierung

Module gemäß § 5 Abs. 2 SPO-ARC (Kompetenzen nicht wesentlich verschieden von den Lernzielen der Module der Bachelorstudiengänge Wirtschafts- und Medieninformatik an der Hochschule Hof): Software Engineering
Module gemäß § 5 Abs. 2 SPO-ARC (Kompetenzen nicht wesentlich verschieden von den Lernzielen der Module der Bachelorstudiengänge Wirtschafts- und Medieninformatik an der Hochschule Hof): Datenbanken
Module gemäß § 5 Abs. 2 SPO-ARC (Kompetenzen nicht wesentlich verschieden von den Lernzielen der Module der Bachelorstudiengänge Wirtschafts- und Medieninformatik an der Hochschule Hof): Rechnernetze

subject_credit_requirements.note: No credit figures. § 5 (3): these four modules must average at least 2.5 (German scale) — a grade condition on the modules, not a credit check. Program page wording: above-average grades in object-oriented programming, software engineering, computer networks and databases.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions for missing subject competences in the SPO-ARC. Total-credit rule (Nachqualifikation, § 5 Abs. 1 Satz 2, § 9 SPO-ARC): applicants with a relevant 180-LP degree meet the access requirement once 30 further LP are earned — a 30-LP internship (20 weeks full-time) if no practical semester was completed, otherwise modules set by the Prüfungskommission.

descriptive_notes: Module grade rule (§ 5 (3)): the four modules Grundlagen der Programmierung, Software Engineering, Datenbanken and Rechnernetze must have been completed with an average of at least 2,5 (or an equivalent grade). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): the engine does not yet check module averages, so check your grades in these four modules yourself.
Aptitude examination (Prüfung zur abschließenden Feststellung der studiengangspezifischen Eignung, §§ 6-8) is an access requirement (§ 5 (4)).

Part A: self-written scientific paper (German or English), meaningful certificate of practical activities (German or English), self-written scientific essay of about two A4 pages in English; grade = arithmetic mean; at least 2.3 needed for Part B.
Part B: case study from the research activity of the iisys institute and a 30-minute oral examination in English; at least 2.3 required in each part to pass (§ 8 (3)).
Program page: Part A internship/practical work certificate of at least 18 weeks in the computer industry; topic chosen from the research groups with a two-page literature review.

language_english.note: Not regulated in SPO-ARC or ASPO. Program page: TOEFL minimum 90, or IELTS 6.5 or above. Application page: 'IELTS academic 6.5' (or TOEFL iBT 90) for English-taught programs; certificates submitted within the application period, not older than two years.

language_german.due: at application

aps_certificate.note: Hof application and admission page: 'applicants from those countries cannot be admitted without the required APS certificate' (APS countries incl. India; link to APS India).

other_requirements: self-written scientific paper (e.g. Bachelor's thesis or seminar paper)
certificate of practical activities (program page: at least 18 weeks in the computer industry)
two-page scientific essay / literature review in English
oral examination of 30 minutes in English with case study
current CV
copy of ID or passport
degree accredited in anabin with status H+ (program page)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 April - 31 May
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 5 - 30 November

admission_regulation.title: Fachspezifische Prüfungs- und Studienordnung für den Master-Studiengang Artificial Intelligence
admission_regulation.version: vom 15. August 2022 (AMbl. 13/2022, 17.08.2022, ab S. 8; in force WS 2022/23), as amended by the Erste Änderungssatzung vom 05.06.2024 (AMbl. 09/2024, 06.06.2024). Framework: RahmenO-MA as amended (latest listed: Sechste Änderungssatzung, AMbl. 38/2026, 16.09.2026). § 4 checked against the German original of 15.08.2022 (10.10.2026); the 2024 amendment was read only in BTU's official English translation

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 4 PStO (English translation): 'The primary admission requirement is a first qualifying degree (at least bachelor's degree)' in a subject-related programme; close in content if the programme 'in Computer Science, Mathematics, and Ethics is comparable in scope' to the BTU Bachelor Artificial Intelligence. The examination board decides on applicants without a Bachelor in AI. FAQ: computer science, computer engineering, or mathematics with a CS minor are often, but not always, considered closely related.

grade_requirement.note: FAQ: 'There is no minimum GPA requirement in AI study programme.' No grade requirement in the PStO translation.

items.raw_label: Computer Science (comparable in scope to the BTU Bachelor Artificial Intelligence)
Mathematics (comparable in scope to the BTU Bachelor Artificial Intelligence)

subject_credit_requirements.note: No LP figures in the regulation. The regulation also names Ethics as a comparability area; there is no taxonomy category for ethics, so it is not stored as an item. FAQ (program page) names: theoretical computer science; mathematics (especially probability theory, also discrete mathematics, number theory, analysis, linear algebra); machine learning; software engineering; programming. Regulation wins; FAQ list is informative.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Admission with conditions regarding completion of modules of the basic courses of the BTU Bachelor AI (§ 4 Abs. 2 PStO); supplementary modules must not exceed 18 credit points and cannot be credited towards the master's degree

descriptive_notes: Committee check: the examination board decides whether your degree is comparable in scope to BTU's own bachelor program and may require additional modules.
No selection procedure: program page states 'Without admission limits'.
FAQ: work experience and certificate courses do not affect admission; final-semester bachelor's students may apply if they graduate before enrolling.

allowed_exemptions: higher education entrance qualification from Australia, Canada (except Quebec and New Brunswick), Ireland, New Zealand, Great Britain incl. Northern Ireland or USA

admission_regulation.title: Fachstudien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Artificial Intelligence an der Technischen Fakultät der Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FPOMScAI), §§ 42, 42a, together with the Allgemeine Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Masterstudiengänge und die sonstigen Studien der Technischen Fakultät (ABMPO/TF) § 33
admission_regulation.version: FPOMScAI vom 28.03.2024 as amended by the Erste Änderungssatzung vom 13.02.2026 (consolidated version i.d.F. 13.02.2026). The amendment is in force from 01.04.2026 and applies to all applications for a study start from WS 2026/27; it changes admission (grade limits now 1,5 / 2,5 instead of 1,75 / 3,0; § 42 (1) Nr. 4-6 reworded/added incl. Bachelor's thesis 12 ECTS; new § 42a anabin H+ and GRE/GATE). ABMPO/TF vom 28.03.2024 (read from an FAU institute copy; amendments to it not located).

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPOMScAI § 42 (1): 'Einschlägiger Abschluss im Sinne des § 33 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 ABMPO/TF ist der Abschluss des Bachelorstudiengangs Informatik' (official English translation: Bachelor's in computer science or equivalent); the degree must include the six competence areas listed as subject items. Programme (department) page: 'Applications based on degrees from related fields may also be successful, but applicants have to demonstrate familiarity with the material'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: FPOMScAI § 42 (3) (as amended 13.02.2026): average 1,5 or better = direct admission; 'zwischen 1,51 und 2,5' = online test; '2,51 oder schlechter' = deemed unsuitable (not admitted). Applies to the overall grade of the relevant degree or, before graduation (§ 33 Abs. 3 ABMPO/TF), the average of achievements so far. FPOMScAI states no conversion method for foreign grades; ABMPO/TF § 15 (3) gives the formula x = 1 + 3 (Nmax - Nd)/(Nmax - Nmin) in the context of recognition of achievements.

items.raw_label: Programmierung und Algorithmik im Umfang von 20 ECTS-Punkten
Theoretische Informatik und Logik im Umfang von 15 ECTS-Punkten
Datenbanken und Konzeptionelle Modellierung im Umfang von 5 ECTS Punkten
Mathematik in der Informatik (Grundlagen der Analysis, Lineare Algebra, Stochastik) im Umfang von mindestens 20 ECTS-Punkten
Software-Engineering im Umfang von mindestens 10 ECTS-Punkten

subject_credit_requirements.note: FPOMScAI § 42 (1) Satz 1 Nr. 1-6 (as amended 13.02.2026). Larger gaps than the compensable 5 ECTS per area are treated as essential differences and lead to rejection. Application page asks for 'Your university's module descriptions of the required courses'. Pooled items (Programmierung und Algorithmik; Theoretische Informatik und Logik) are added up across their listed categories (engine rule D3). Koushik's decision 15.10.2026: a discrete maths/logic course may count both for 'Theoretische Informatik und Logik' and for 'Mathematik in der Informatik' (no one-course-one-requirement restriction for this record). Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: eine Bachelorarbeit oder vergleichbare wissenschaftliche Arbeit im Umfang von 12 ECTS-Punkten

conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflagen (FPOMScAI § 42 (1); ABMPO/TF § 33 (2)): conditions of at most 5 ECTS PER AREA and at most 20 ECTS IN TOTAL, to be proven within one year. max_ects stores the total cap 20 (Koushik's decision 15.10.2026). NOTE: a gap of more than 5 ECTS in any single area is an essential difference and leads to rejection; the engine does not yet check the 5-per-area limit (engine to-do E8), so a student shown 'eligible with conditions' must check that no single area is short by more than 5 ECTS.

descriptive_notes: Qualification assessment (FPOMScAI § 42 (3)): direct admission if the average is 1,5 or better (or the average of separately proven competences is 1,5 or better); averages between 1,51 and 2,5 lead to an online test.

Online test (FPOMScAI § 42 (4)): open-book, 60 minutes, tasks from programming, algorithmics, theoretical computer science, logic, databases/modelling, software engineering and mathematics in computer science (analysis, linear algebra, ODE, stochastics); passed with 'gut' or better.

Department admission-test FAQ: 'All new applicants for the AI Program starting with Winter Semester 2023/24 need to take the admissions test'; the application page also says all applicants (external and internal) take an online screening test. This differs from the direct-admission rule in § 42 (3).
FPOMScAI § 42 (5): the qualification assessment must be repeated if more than two semesters have passed since the original admission decision.

FPOMScAI § 40 (2): applications for the summer semester are as a rule only possible for students and graduates of the FAU Bachelor's programme Informatik; the Zugangskommission decides on justified exceptions.

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or first degree acquired in English
language_english.note: FPOMScAI § 42 (2): English at least B2 (CEFR); no proof needed if the Hochschulzugangsberechtigung or first degree was acquired in English. TOEFL 80/120 is from the department application page ('TOEFL score of at least 80/120 or equivalent qualification'; 'If your Bachelor degree was taught exclusively in English, a confirmation of the university (MOI) is sufficient'; Duolingo not sufficient). fau.eu programme page says 'TOEFL score of at least 560 or equivalent qualification'.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants whose nationality is not a signatory state of the Lisbon Convention and who have no exception under Art. 13 Abs. 3 Satz 2 BayHIG (FPOMScAI § 42a (1))
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE with FAU as 'designated recipient', or a comparable test published by the Zugangskommission, e.g. GATE for applicants from India; for the GRE the threshold is at least 60% ('Percentile Rank (% Below)'), the committee may set stricter requirements. Department page (WS 2026/27): GRE 'General Test' and additionally 'GRE Subject Test Mathematics', percentile > 60%; GATE papers 'Computer Science & Information Technology (CS)', 'Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (DA)' (primary), and, as an alternative ('can also be submitted'), 'Mathematics (MA)' and 'Statistics (ST)' (no GATE score stated on the page).

aps_certificate.note: Department application page: 'APS certificate (required for India, Vietnam and China).' Not in FPOMScAI.

online test (see selection notes)

processing fee of 100 euros per application for non-EU applicants (from WS 2026/27, department page)
application before graduation possible with at least 140 ECTS (ABMPO/TF § 33 Abs. 3)

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO AIR § 2 (1) Nr. 1: completed first degree of at least 210 credits or equivalent '(a) in einem Informatik-Studiengang oder (b) in einem ingenieur- oder naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang, der ein für das Studium im Masterstudiengang Artificial Intelligence and Robotics ausreichendes informationstechnisches Grundlagenwissen vermittelt hat'. Module descriptions must be enclosed. § 2 (3): the requirement is also met if a missing module ('eines der darin genannten Module') is passed before the start of studies. admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Vollzeit-Masterstudiengang und den Teilzeit-Masterstudiengang Artificial Intelligence for Industrial Applications an der Ostbayerischen Technischen Hochschule Amberg-Weiden, §§ 5, 6, together with the Satzung über das Immatrikulations-, Beurlaubungs-, Rückmelde- und Exmatrikulationsverfahren § 3
admission_regulation.version: SPO vom 16.02.2023 in der Fassung der Ersten Änderungssatzung vom 26.06.2025 (consolidated version 'Stand 25.06.2025'; amendment published 26.06.2025, applies to students starting from SS 2026). The amendment changes admission only in § 5 (2) (procedure for 180-209 ECTS) and § 5 (5) (English proof now via Immatrikulationssatzung § 3 Abs. 6; TOEIC/Cambridge wording removed); grade rule and aptitude procedure unchanged in substance. ASPO vom 27.05.2020 i.d.F. 4. Änderungssatzung 10.10.2024 and 5. Änderungssatzung 24.03.2026 (no admission changes); Immatrikulationssatzung vom 08.04.2013 i.d.F. 7. Änderungssatzung 24.03.2026.

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 5 (1) Nr. 1: 'Als einschlägig gelten neben den Studiengängen der Informatik, Elektro- und Informationstechnik, Mechatronik und digitale Automation, der technischen Informatik auch vergleichbare Informatikstudiengängen mit technischer Ausrichtung. Über die Einschlägigkeit entscheidet die Prüfungskommission.' Programme page names 'computer science, computer engineering and variants', 'data science, data analytics' and 'technical oriented mathematics'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: SPO § 5 (3): degree completed 'mit einer Gesamtprüfungsleistung von „gut“ oder besser' (Vorauswahl); grades from other systems converted with the 'modifizierten bayerischen Formel' (ASPO § 5 Abs. 5: x = 1 + 3 (Nmax - Nd)/(Nmax - Nmin), one decimal, further digits dropped). Numeric value: the same SPO glosses 'gut' as '„gut“ (2,5)' in § 6 (5); the former RaPO § 11 (3) defined 'gut' as 1,6 to 2,5 (RaPO expired 30.09.2023; the current ASPO has no average-to-word mapping). Programme page: 'equal to a grade of 2.5 or better in the German system'.

subject_credit_requirements.note: The SPO sets no subject-credit minimums. Mathematics and computer science knowledge are assessed in the aptitude procedure (§ 6 (4) c, d: 15 % each, graded by the selection committee from CV and certificates). Programme page: 'In mathematics, calculus, linear algebra, discrete mathematics and statistics are particularly relevant'; 'In computer science, the focus is on imperative and object-oriented programming in Python.'

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions (Auflagen) stated in the sources read — stored as not allowed (structure fix 24.10.2026; same engine result as before).

descriptive_notes: Aptitude procedure (SPO § 6 (4)): 50 % grade of the first degree (modified Bavarian formula if needed), 20 % online Moodle test (mathematics and computer science in equal parts; passed with at least 50 of 100 points in both areas), 15 % mathematics knowledge and 15 % computer science knowledge assessed by the selection committee from CV and certificates.
SPO § 6 (5): aptitude established if the procedure is rated at least 'gut' (2,5) overall.
SPO § 6 (8): aptitude counts as proven for applicants whose relevant first degree grade is 'besser als 1,3' or who demonstrably belong to the best 10 % of their programme's graduates.
SPO § 6 (9): a failed procedure can be repeated once; a third application is excluded.
Programme page test windows: winter intake July 01 - July 14; summer intake December 21 - January 04, second run January 17 - February 05.

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or first degree acquired in English

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Master-Studiengang Automotive Software Engineering an der Technischen Hochschule Deggendorf
admission_regulation.version: vom 08. Mai 2024 (bekanntgemacht 17.09.2024), in Kraft 08.05.2024, gilt für Studienbeginn ab Sommersemester 2025; full text checked against Koushik's copy from the THD regulations page (11.10.2026), no newer version shown there. General APO: 1. Änderungssatzung vom 26.11.2025 (in force 01.12.2025) opened; it does not change admission.

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 2 (1) names no degree field: 'Der erfolgreiche Abschluss eines grundständigen Bachelorstudiengangs, im Umfang von mindestens 210 ECTS-Punkten, in dem die Grundlagen der Informatik (Programmierung) und Mathematik vermittelt wurden.' Program page: 'Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical and information technology, or a related field.' primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade for access. A grade better than 2.5 (national degrees) plus above-average knowledge in computer science, programming and software engineering only allows the selection committee to waive the aptitude procedure (SPO § 5 (9) a). No conversion method for foreign grades stated.

items.raw_label: Grundlagen der Informatik (Programmierung) (SPO § 2 (1))
Grundlagen der ... Mathematik (SPO § 2 (1))

subject_credit_requirements.note: SPO § 2 (1) requires that the basics of computer science (programming) and mathematics were taught in the Bachelor's programme; no credit amounts are stated. Program page lists as prerequisite: 'Fundamentals in C/C++ and/or Python'.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions for missing subject knowledge in the SPO. Total-credit rule (SPO § 4): applicants with a degree of at least 180 but fewer than 210 ECTS are admitted; the missing ECTS must be proven by the start of the 3rd semester through relevant university courses agreed with the study advisor; 'Maximal sind 30 ECTS-Punkte im parallel zum Masterstudium zugelassen.' If the 180 ECTS were a purely theoretical programme without at least one year of relevant professional experience, a relevant internship of at least 20 weeks is required.

descriptive_notes: Aptitude procedure (SPO § 5): written or online test of 90 minutes, passed with at least 45 of 90 points, and a selection interview of max. 20 minutes (may be online), passed with at least 10 of 20 points (motivation max. 10, expectations max. 5, relevance to future profession max. 5). Aptitude is proven when both parts are passed 'mit Erfolg'.
The aptitude procedure is held once a year in the winter semester for the following summer semester (SPO § 5 (7)).
A failed applicant may take the test again at the following date; in justified cases at a later date; no further repetition (SPO § 5 (8)).

Waiver (SPO § 5 (9)): the selection committee may waive the procedure (a) for above-average knowledge, in particular national degrees with a grade better than 2.5 and above-average knowledge in computer science, programming and software engineering, or (b) on a GRE (general) with at least VR 158 / QR 160 / AW 4.0 or GATE 60.
Program page: the entrance test is fee-based, held in November, no alternative dates; invitations by email.

allowed_exemptions: English native language (SPO § 2 (3))
German university entrance qualification with English as a graduating subject (B2 level only, THD language requirements PDF)
language_english.note: SPO § 2 (3): English B2 (CEFR) unless native language; proof per THD Rahmenprüfungsordnung for foreign languages. THD Deggendorf language requirements PDF, row Automotive Software Engineering (M.Eng.): TOEFL iBT 72-94, IELTS 'In jedem Teilbereich sind 5,5 - 6,5 Punkte zu erreichen', PTE Academic 59-75, TOEIC listening 400-485 / reading 385-450 (B2 bands; stored minima are the lower band limits). Only TOEFL iBT (Test Date Score, no MyBest, no Home Edition); IELTS Academic or General (not IELTS Indicator); no home editions; certificates not older than 2 years. Medium of instruction certificate not mentioned.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: optional; may lead to waiver of the aptitude procedure
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE (general) minimum VR 158 / QR 160 / AW 4.0 (SPO § 5 (9) b)

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: optional; may lead to waiver of the aptitude procedure
standardized_test_requirements.details: GATE score 60 (SPO § 5 (9) b)

admission_regulation.title: Fachstudien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang International Information Systems (IIS) (FPOIIS), § 3, together with the Rahmenprüfungsordnung für die Masterstudiengänge im Fachbereich Wirtschafts- und Sozialwissenschaften der Rechts- und Wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Fakultät der Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU) – MPOWISO – § 26 and Anlage
admission_regulation.version: FPOIIS vom 29.02.2024, geändert durch Satzung vom 11.07.2025 (consolidated version i.d.F. 20250711; § 3 checked against the text supplied by Koushik from the official PDF on 11.10.2026). General regulation: MPOWISO i.d.F. 07.08.2024.

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPOIIS i.d.F. 11.07.2025, § 3 (1): relevant degrees in the sense of § 32 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 MPOWISO are in particular Bachelor's degrees in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Technik or Informatik (e.g. FAU Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, International Business Studies, Informatik, Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, and comparable programmes elsewhere, e.g. Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Business Administration, Information Systems or Computer Science). MPOWISO § 32 (1)-(2): fachspezifischer, fachverwandter or einschlägiger degree whose qualification profile does not differ substantially. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade as an access condition. The grade of the relevant first degree gives up to 40 points in stage 1 of the qualification assessment (FPOIIS § 3 (3), Table 1: 1,0 = 40 points down to 3,6 = 1 point; 3,7 or worse = 0). No conversion method for foreign grades stated in FPOIIS.

subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject-credit minimums. FPOIIS § 3 (3): relevant prior knowledge only gives points (half the ECTS earned per area; caps: Wirtschaftswissenschaften max. 30 points, Informatik max. 40, Wirtschaftsinformatik max. 20; total max. 45).

conditional_admission.mechanism: Zugang unter Bedingung (MPOWISO i.d.F. 07.08.2024, § 32 Abs. 2): if compensable differences exist, the Zugangskommission may grant access on condition of additional work of up to 20 ECTS, to be proven within one year of starting the Master's (discretionary). No subject items are stored for this program, so this cap does not affect the verdict.

descriptive_notes: Qualification assessment (FPOIIS i.d.F. 11.07.2025, § 3 (3)), max. 100 points: grade of the relevant first degree max. 40 (table: 1.0 = 40, 2.0 = 25, 2.5 = 17.5, 3.0 = 10, 3.6 = 1, 3.7 or worse = 0); relevant prior knowledge max. 45 (half the ECTS earned in each area, capped at 30 for economics, 40 for computer science, 20 for business informatics); relevant practical experience or stays abroad max. 10 (1.7 points per month full-time, 0.85 per month part-time); a further foreign language max. 5 (C1 or higher 5, B2 4, B1 3, A2 2, A1 1).
At least 65 points: qualification confirmed; fewer than 65 points: rejected (§ 3 (3) Satz 4). The 2025 version has no second stage (presentation/interview).

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification obtained in the USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland or the United Kingdom
language_english.note: FPOIIS i.d.F. 11.07.2025, § 3 (2) Nr. 1: English at least C1 (CEFR); applicants whose university entrance qualification was not obtained in the USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland or the United Kingdom must prove it with one of the listed tests: TOEFL (min. 100 points in a single test, 'MyBest' score not accepted), IELTS (min. 7.0), UNICERT III, Cambridge Main Suite esp. CAE, or CPE. (The 2024 original version required TOEFL 95; the 2025 amendment raised it to 100.) Only the listed tests are accepted as proof.

aps_certificate.note: Program page: applicants from China, India, Vietnam and Mongolia must include APS certification; without it the application will not reach the admission committee.

other_requirements: tabular CV in English
copy of university entrance qualification with official translation
optional: proof of relevant stays abroad, relevant practical work, and a further foreign language (not English or first language) with CEFR level (FPOIIS § 3 (2) Nr. 2; gives points)
international applicants: final Bachelor's degree required when applying, or university confirmation of completion before the winter semester (program page)

early access in exceptional cases with at least 135 / 162 / 189 ECTS for 6- / 7- / 8-semester Bachelor's, under reservation, degree proof within one year (MPOWISO i.d.F. 07.08.2024, § 32 Abs. 3); program page: applicants from Germany need min. 135 ECTS when applying
application processing fee 100 euros for non-EU applicants from WS 2026/27 (iis.study.fau.eu)

admission_regulation.title: Neufassung der Besonderen Ordnung über den Zugang und die Zulassung für den konsekutiven Masterstudiengang Computational Sciences in Engineering der Technischen Universität Braunschweig
admission_regulation.version: Neufassung adopted by the Gemeinsame Kommission on 05.11.2025, in force 01.02.2026, applies for the first time to the admission procedure for WS 2026/27 (§ 8); replaces the Ordnung of 19.12.2024 (TU-Verkündungsblatt Nr. 1622), which still applies to higher-semester admission for SS 2026. The PDF on the programme downloads page carries no new Verkündungsblatt number. No amendment to the 2026 Neufassung found on the programme downloads page (the TU-wide Verkündungsblatt listing could not be located). Official English translation (service only, German binding) also published.

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 2 Abs. 1 a): Bachelor's degree or equivalent 'in einem fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen Studiengang der Ingenieurwissenschaften, Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik, Informatik oder in einem fachlich geeigneten Studiengang' (engineering, natural sciences, mathematics, computer science or another subject-suitable programme); for foreign degrees equivalence is determined by the anabin assessment proposals. § 2 Abs. 2: the Auswahlkommission decides whether the previous study is subject-suitable. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the regulation. The final or average grade is only a selection criterion (up to 51 of 100 points, § 4 Abs. 4-5; 1,0 = 51 points, 2,5 = 21, 3,0 = 11, 4,0 = 1, worse than 4,0 = 0). No conversion method for foreign grades is stated.

items.raw_label: Kenntnisse und Kompetenzen aus dem Bereich Mathematik (§ 2 Abs. 2 b: 'Computational Sciences, Mathematik, Mechanik und Informationstechnik'; no credit number)
Kenntnisse und Kompetenzen aus dem Bereich Mechanik (§ 2 Abs. 2 b; no credit number)
Kenntnisse und Kompetenzen aus dem Bereich Informationstechnik (§ 2 Abs. 2 b; no credit number)

subject_credit_requirements.note: § 2 Abs. 2: 'Zur Feststellung der fachlichen Eignung sind folgende Kenntnisse und Kompetenzen aus den nachfolgenden Bereichen nachzuweisen': a. ability to work scientifically / in a fundamentals- and method-oriented way; b. Computational Sciences, Mathematik, Mechanik und Informationstechnik (proven through a degree and/or other meaningful documents); c. previous experience with the interdisciplinary offering in engineering, mathematics and scientific computing. No credit numbers or grades are stated; the Auswahlkommission decides. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): Mechanik mapped to general_physics as closest category (presence only); 'Computational Sciences' (no matching category) and items a. and c. are not stored as checks. Programme page: applicants 'Must show that they have at least good in-depth knowledge of the major basic subjects for the degree programme'.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions (Auflagen) for admission to the first semester. § 7 Abs. 2 allows the Auswahlkommission to require that missing knowledge and competences be made up within two Fachsemester only for admission to higher semesters.

descriptive_notes: If admission is restricted, applicants are ranked by points (§ 4): final or average grade up to 51 points plus 'Spezielle fachliche Eignung' up to 49 points (based on written evidence of scientific working ability, previous experience in Computational Sciences, mathematics, mechanics and information technology, and interdisciplinary experience); maximum 100 points.
Quota (§ 4): a preliminary quota of 75 percent of the places is set aside for foreign nationals and stateless persons who are not treated equally with German citizens.
Ties are decided first by the aptitude points, then by lot; remaining places may be allocated by lottery on application via TUconnect (§ 6).

§ 2 Abs. 2 b also requires knowledge in 'Computational Sciences', and § 2 Abs. 2 a requires scientific working ability (interdisciplinary experience is a ranking criterion, § 4 Abs. 5 c); GPU-R cannot check these, the committee decides.

allowed_exemptions: Studienqualifikation (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung or Bachelor's degree) acquired at an English-language institution
on request: successful completion of a programme of at least two years taught exclusively in English
language_english.note: § 2 Abs. 5: TOEFL iBT 88 points; IELTS band 6,5 or higher; English Language Proficiency Report of the TU Braunschweig Sprachenzentrum with at least two skills at B2 and two at C1; equivalent certificates may be recognised after review. The test must not be older than three years at receipt of the application. § 2 Abs. 6: proofs by enrolment, but if both German and English proof are required, one of them must be submitted with the application. Programme 'How to apply' page also lists 'DAAD language certificate'.

language_german.due: at enrollment (if English proof is also required, one of the two proofs must be submitted with the application)

accepted_degree_fields.note: SO § 3 Abs. 1 / EFO § 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 1: 'ein erster in Deutschland anerkannter berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss oder ein Abschluss einer staatlichen oder staatlich anerkannten Berufsakademie in Informatik, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Ingenieurwissenschaften' (computer science, mathematics, natural sciences, economics/business or engineering). grade_requirement.note: Neither the Studienordnung nor the Eignungsfeststellungsordnung sets a grade limit; the aptitude decision is pass/fail based on demonstrated knowledge.

items.raw_label: sequentielle Computerprogramme in einer übersetzten Hochsprache selbstständig implementiert, getestet und angewendet werden können (EFO § 5 Abs. 1; no credit number)

Grundlagen der Wahrscheinlichkeitsrechnung (Verteilungen, Axiome, Wahrscheinlichkeiten), Bachelorniveau (EFO § 5 Abs. 1; no credit number)
Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen (Arrays, Listen, Such- und Sortieralgorithmen, Konzept der Komplexität), Bachelorniveau (EFO § 5 Abs. 1; no credit number)

subject_credit_requirements.note: EFO § 5 Abs. 1: the special aptitude is fulfilled if independently applicable knowledge in computer programming and mathematical and scientific fundamentals is demonstrated; the five areas above plus 'Bachelor-level knowledge in the application area of the chosen track' (not stored as a check: the area depends on the track; no taxonomy category). No credit numbers are stated anywhere. The Zugangsausschuss assesses the documents (module descriptions required) and holds an interview if no decision can be made from the documents (EFO § 5 Abs. 2, § 6).

conditional_admission.mechanism: None stated: neither SO § 3 nor the EFO provides for conditions (Auflagen); aptitude is either proven or not.

descriptive_notes: Aptitude assessment (EFO § 5 Abs. 2): the Zugangsausschuss assesses aptitude from the documents, only if the degree and English requirements are met; if it cannot decide from the documents, an aptitude interview (Eignungsgespräch) follows.

Interview (EFO § 6): thematically uniform, at most 30 minutes, written invitation at least two weeks in advance; no right to a replacement date if absent; if aptitude is not shown after the interview, a repeat can be requested the following year within the application deadline.
Positive aptitude decisions are as a rule issued by 15 August; the Eignungsbescheid is needed for enrolment (EFO § 7).
EFO § 5 Abs. 1 also requires knowledge in the application area of your chosen track; GPU-R does not check this, the admission committee does.

The German official texts were not opened.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Study Regulations Annex 6 (CES): suitable degrees are 'Computer sciences and related courses'; § 3 (6): for degrees not listed the examination board decides on suitability. § 3 (2): Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Science with 210 ECTS (or Diplom-Engineer with 240 ECTS), or 180 ECTS with an additional 30 ECTS qualification. grade_requirement.note: Study Regulations § 3 (3) (English reading version): 'A qualified degree is given if the overall grade is 2.5 or better'; grades from other systems are converted (method not quoted). Alternative in the same paragraph: 'A qualified degree is awarded if the applicant is one of the best 35% of the graduates in his or her' programme (interpolation rules if an ECTS grading table is used) — this cohort-ranking route cannot be checked by GPU-R; students with a worse grade who are in the top 35% of their cohort may still qualify (see notes, DECISION). Programme page: 'with a minimum grade of 2.5 (according to the German grading system)'. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 2.5 is stored as a hard limit because the engine cannot check the top-35% route; this can only be stricter than the regulation.

subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject or credit requirements beyond the degree field ('Computer sciences and related courses', Annex 6) are stated in the study regulations or on the programme page.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions for missing subject competences. The qualifying semester (30 CP) for 180-ECTS Bachelor's graduates makes up total credits only (see other_requirements); § 3 (3) conditional admission concerns only the later submission of the degree certificate.

descriptive_notes: Restricted admission (Annex 6): 'The course of study is subject to admission restrictions'; if applications exceed places, places are allocated in a local selection procedure under Section 7a ThürHZG according to the department's statute of 19 May 2022 (Amtliche Bekanntmachungen Nr. 11/2022; not opened, criteria unknown).

subject_credit_requirements.note: FPO-M Art. 2 § 4(2) area minimums. Program page lists 'solid knowledge' expectations per track (non-binding): Embedded Systems - digital design and computer organization, operating systems, computer networks, programming; Visual Computing - linear algebra and vector calculus, programming in C++ and Python, computer graphics, image processing; CISS - programming, machine learning, software engineering, operating systems.

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungs- und Studienordnung für den Masterstudiengang Computer Science an der Universität Regensburg (§ 4 Qualifikation, Anlage 1 Eignungsverfahren)
admission_regulation.version: vom 15. Mai 2025, geändert durch Satzung vom 02. Februar 2026 (consolidated text 'in der Fassung der Änderungssatzung vom 2. Februar 2026'); applies to students starting from WS 2025/26 (§ 32). The only amendment (Satzung vom 02.02.2026, in force the day after publication) changes only § 27 Abs. 2 (thesis weighting 60 -> 30 LP); it does not change admission. The regulation does not rely on a general examination regulation.

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'Qualifizierter Hochschulabschluss oder gleichwertiger Abschluss mit mindestens sechs Semestern Regelstudienzeit (180 LP)' in 'Computer Science (Informatik), Data Science oder einem anderen qualifizierten Fach gemäß Abs. 2'; Abs. 2 requires competences matching the B.Sc. Informatik of the University of Regensburg. The Kommission zum Eignungsverfahren checks the requirements (§ 4 Abs. 3). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'mit der Durchschnittsnote von mindestens 2,5'; 'bei ausländischen Studienabschlüssen erfolgt die Umrechnung nach der modifizierten bayerischen Formel'. Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.2: grade 2,6 or worse = not suitable. Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1: the regulation keeps one decimal of the average and drops the rest without rounding ('eine Stelle nach dem Komma … ohne Rundung gestrichen'), so 2,51–2,59 counts as 2,5 and 2,6 or worse is not suitable. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): the limit is stored as 2.59 so that the engine applies this truncation.

items.raw_label: Theoretische Informatik (Algorithmen, Datenstrukturen, formale Sprachen, Automatentheorie, Komplexität, Logik und formale Sprachen) — 12 LP (Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1)
Technische Informatik (Rechnerarchitektur, Schaltungstechnik, Verteilte Systeme, Betriebssysteme, Netzwerktechnik) — 12 LP (Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1)
Praktische Informatik (Programmieren, Datenbanken, Software Engineering, Modellbildung und Simulation, Visualisierung, IT Security) — 12 LP (Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1)
Informatik insgesamt: Theoretische (12) + Technische (12) + Praktische Informatik (12) + Weitere Module der Computer Science (24) = 60 LP (Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1)
Mathematik (Lineare Algebra, Analysis, Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie, Numerik, Statistik) — 18 LP (Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1); § 4 Abs. 2: 'Modulen der Grundlagen der Mathematik im Umfang von mindestens 18 LP'

subject_credit_requirements.note: § 4 Abs. 2: competences in Informatik 'im Umfang von mindestens 60 LP' and 'in Modulen der Grundlagen der Mathematik im Umfang von mindestens 18 LP' (78 LP), matching the B.Sc. Informatik of the University of Regensburg; the four Informatik groups (12+12+12+24) make up the 60 LP. Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1: the LP per group are maximum values credited (total maximum 78 LP); the curricular analysis is based on learning outcomes, 'nicht durch einen schematischen Abgleich von Modulen'. The regulation does not say whether excess LP in one group can be credited to 'Weitere Module'. Only completed modules may be entered in the curricular analysis form (program page). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Logik' mapped to discrete_math_logic, 'Modellbildung und Simulation' has no CS category and is not counted. GPU-R encoding (not regulation wording): Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1 caps the credits credited per group and in total (78 LP; at least 60 at application, the rest by the end of the 2nd semester). The group caps are stored as minimums with a conditions cap of 18 (78 − 60), which reproduces the 60-LP rule. Because the engine would otherwise count the same courses again for 'Weitere Module', that group is checked as a total of 60 LP in computer science (all four CS groups together); GPU-R reading (not regulation wording): credits above a group's cap are treated as 'Weitere Module'. Logic/discrete-mathematics courses are counted only in the mathematics group, so no course fills two groups.

conditional_admission.mechanism: § 4 Abs. 2: at application, of the 78 LP 'mindestens 60 LP' must be proven; the missing competences up to 78 LP may be acquired 'bis zum Ende des zweiten Fachsemesters aus Lehreinheiten des Bachelorstudiengangs Informatik', courses set by the Kommission zum Eignungsverfahren. Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.2: fewer than 60 LP = not suitable. max_ects 18 = 78 - 60 (GPU-R arithmetic from the regulation figures).

Computer Science and Data Science, which were amended on 02.02.2026). The regulation does not rely on a general examination regulation.

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: qualified degree with at least six semesters (180 LP) in 'Information Science (Informationswissenschaft), Data Science, Informatik' 'oder einem anderen qualifizierten Fach gemäß Abs. 2'; Abs. 2 requires competences matching the Bachelorstudiengang Informationswissenschaft (B.A.) of the University of Regensburg. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

mindestens 54 LP in Grundlagen der Information Science insgesamt, davon Empirisches Arbeiten und Statistik 12, Programmierung 12, Natürliche Sprachverarbeitung oder Informationssuche 18, weitere Leistungen 12 (§ 4 Abs. 2; Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1). Nested total: every computer-science and mathematics course counts here (engine rule E2a).

subject_credit_requirements.note: § 4 Abs. 2: at least 54 LP in Grundlagen der Information Science, including at least 12 LP empirical work and statistics, at least 12 LP programming and at least 18 LP natural language processing or information retrieval, matching the Bachelorstudiengang Informationswissenschaft (B.A.) of the University of Regensburg. Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1: maximum 54 LP credited; Nr. 5.1.2: fewer than 54 LP = not suitable. Program page examples (not in the regulation): statistics 'descriptive and inferential statistics'; NLP/IR 'embeddings, text summarization, information extraction'; programming 'databases, algorithms, object-oriented programming'; further courses 'task modelling, machine learning, linear algebra'. Only completed modules may be entered in the curricular analysis form (program page). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Empirisches Arbeiten' (empirical research methods) has no CS category and is checked via statistics_probability; NLP/IR has no exact category and is checked via machine_learning_ai (see DECISION in notes); information science and application-subject credits are not counted in the 'Weitere Leistungen' item. GPU-R encoding (Koushik's decision 15.10.2026): the 54 LP total is checked as computer science + mathematics together (nested total, E2a), so statistics, programming, NLP/IR and further courses (e.g. linear algebra, machine learning, task modelling) all count toward it; information-science and application-subject credits have no taxonomy category and are not counted (stricter; the committee could accept them). NLP/IR is checked via machine_learning_ai, whose taxonomy definition includes natural language processing (Koushik 15.10.2026: accepted; pure information-retrieval courses may not be recognised).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No rule for making up missing LP: § 4 Abs. 2 requires at least 54 LP at application and Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.2 treats fewer than 54 LP as not suitable.

descriptive_notes: Eignungsverfahren (Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.2): curricular analysis only; suitable with grade 2,5 or better and 54 LP; not suitable with grade 2,6 or worse and/or fewer than 54 LP. No essay or interview stage is described in the regulation.

admission_regulation.title: Fachspezifische Zugangs- und Zulassungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Computer Science an der Universität Potsdam
admission_regulation.version: Satzung vom 7. Februar 2024 (AmBek. UP Nr. 9/2024, S. 252), as amended by the Erste Satzung zur Änderung vom 17. Februar 2025 (AmBek. UP Nr. 6/2025 vom 28.3.2025, S. 215); Lesefassung AmBek. Nr. 6/2025, S. 217-219. Supplements the Allgemeine Zugangs- und Zulassungsordnung (ZulO) vom 24.02.2016 i.d.F. der Fünften Änderungssatzung vom 18.09.2024 (AmBek. Nr. 25/2024, Lesefassung S. 1017)

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 3 Nr. 1: Bachelorabschluss oder gleichwertiger erster berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss in einem der Fächer Informatik/Computer Science, IT-Systems Engineering, Data Science oder verwandten Fächern im Umfang von mindestens 180 Leistungspunkten. Program run by the joint Digital Engineering Faculty of HPI and the University of Potsdam.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade for access. The average grade counts 51 % in the selection score if admission is restricted (§ 6 / § 7). No foreign-grade conversion method stated in the fachspezifische ZulO.

items.raw_label: Algorithmen, Datenstrukturen und Theoretische Informatik im Umfang von insgesamt mindestens 14 LP
Softwareentwicklung und Programmiersprachen im Umfang von insgesamt mindestens 15 LP
Diskrete Strukturen und Logik, Analysis und Lineare Algebra und Stochastik im Umfang von insgesamt mindestens 15 LP
Technische Informatik wie z. B. Betriebssysteme, Rechnerarchitektur oder verteilte Systeme im Umfang von insgesamt mindestens 10 LP

subject_credit_requirements.note: § 3 Nr. 2 as amended 17.02.2025 (item a reduced from 15 to 14 LP). Proof must be submitted with the application (§ 5 Abs. 3 a). Under § 7 Abs. 5 ZulO, special access requirements are due by the application deadline, or by the end of the final-enrollment period if they are part of the mandatory curriculum of the degree or the exams are registered by the application deadline.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No admission with conditions (Auflagen) for missing subject knowledge in the fachspezifische ZulO or the ZulO. Only conditional admission before degree completion (§ 7 Abs. 4 ZulO: transcript covering the bachelor's credits minus at most 40 LP from completed modules; degree proof by final enrollment).

descriptive_notes: HPI application page: approximately 85 places per year, divided between winter and summer semester; selection procedure by the admissions committee.

Quota for foreign and stateless applicants (§ 6, as amended 2025): score = grade 51 % + GRE General Test Quantitative Reasoning 15 % + special subject-related achievements 34 %. GRE QR converted: >167 = 1.0; 162-167 = 2.0; 156-161 = 3.0; 150-155 = 4.0; <150 or not taken = 5.0. Achievements graded 1.0-5.0 by persuasiveness.

General university selection procedure (§ 7): grade 51 % + additional extracurricular qualifications and special achievements 24 % + subject-specific test in English 25 %. Qualifications rated 0-3 points each on relevance to the program and aptitude for scientific work (6 points = 1.0 ... 0 = 5.0). Test: >87.5 % = 1.0; 75-87.4 % = 2.0; 62.5-74.9 % = 3.0; 50-62.4 % = 4.0; <50 % or not taken = 5.0.
The University of Potsdam Master's Office states it does not provide a preliminary assessment of academic and language aptitude.

allowed_exemptions: degree from a recognised university in a programme taught exclusively in English
higher education entrance qualification obtained in an English-language programme in a country with English as official language
language_english.note: § 3 Nr. 3 fachspezifische ZulO: English at least CEFR C1, proven by a certificate listed in § 4 Abs. 2 ZulO: UNIcert III or IV; TOEFL iBT (incl. Home Edition) min. 95; Cambridge C1 Advanced min. 180; IELTS Academic or IELTS Online min. 7 in each band; PTE Academic (or Online) min. 76; Cambridge C2 Proficiency. Other certificates may be recognised by the examination board if at least C1.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: Foreign nationals and stateless persons not equated with German applicants, if the program is admission-restricted (§ 5 Abs. 4 fachspezifische ZulO)
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE General Test; Quantitative Reasoning score weighted 15 % (>167 = 1.0; 162-167 = 2.0; 156-161 = 3.0; 150-155 = 4.0; <150 or not taken = 5.0). No minimum score.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: Applicants in the general university selection procedure (Germans and equated applicants), if admission-restricted (§ 4, § 5 Abs. 4, § 7)
standardized_test_requirements.details: Online test in English, weighted 25 %; form and period published at the start of the application period. No minimum score.

aps_certificate.note: HPI application page (international procedure): 'APS certificate for applications with a school or university degree from India, China or Vietnam.'

other_requirements: Tabular CV from age 16 (§ 5 Abs. 3 c ZulO)
VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) for degrees from outside Germany
Proof of special subject-related achievements / extracurricular qualifications (selection, if restricted)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 June (application period 1 April - 1 June; § 6 Abs. 3 ZulO)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 December (application period 1 November - 1 December; § 6 Abs. 3 ZulO)

admission_regulation.version: Eignungsfeststellungsordnung vom 13. Februar 2025, Amtliche Bekanntmachungen der TU Dresden Nr. 2/2025 vom 24. März 2025, S. 10 (date and number as cited in § 9 of the 2026 draft), in force one day after publication (§ 8); replaces the EFO Master Informatik of 14.03.2018. Studienordnung vom 22.05.2025 (amtlich bekanntgemacht 27.05.2025), for students newly enrolled from WS 2025/26. A new 'Eignungsfeststellungsordnung in ihrer Version von 2026' (unsigned, undated, official publication pending per the faculty regulations page) is announced to govern applications for a start from SS 2027 and would change admission (subject areas 20/10/20/5/25 + 10 free LP instead of 35/35/20; aptitude test); it is NOT stored because it is not yet published. Fakultätsratsbeschlüsse of 21.05.2025 and 25.02.2026 'Anpassung des erforderlichen Sprachniveaus' (B2) are listed on the regulations page (not published in the Amtliche Bekanntmachungen as far as found).

accepted_degree_fields.note: EFO § 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 1: 'einen ersten berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschluss auf dem Gebiet Informatik'; Studienordnung § 3 Abs. 1: 'ein erster in Deutschland anerkannter berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss oder ein Abschluss einer staatlichen oder staatlich anerkannten Berufsakademie in Informatik'. Admission page: 'ein erster berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss in Informatik'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No grade requirement in the EFO or the Studienordnung; the aptitude decision is based on credit points in the listed areas (and, if needed, an interview).

items.raw_label: mindestens 35 Leistungspunkte zu Themen der Betriebssysteme, Rechnernetze, Verteilte Systeme, Rechnerarchitektur, Technische Informatik, Datenbanken, Datensicherheit, Computergrafik bzw. Mensch-Computer-Interaktion
mindestens 35 Leistungspunkte zu Themen der Grundlagen der Mathematik (für Informatik), Theoretische Informatik bzw. Künstliche Intelligenz
mindestens 20 Leistungspunkte zu Themen der Grundlagen der Programmierung, Datenstrukturen bzw. Software Engineering

subject_credit_requirements.note: EFO 2025 § 5 Abs. 1-2: aptitude is proven 'durch sich inhaltlich nicht überschneidende 90 Leistungspunkte aus den Bereichen gemäß Absatz 2' (the three area minimums sum to 90). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): area 1 mapped to operating_systems plus covered systems categories (networks/distributed systems/computer architecture counted under computer_engineering/operating_systems); area 2 to the contextual math + theoretical CS category plus machine_learning_ai. CONFLICT: the admission page and the unpublished 2026 EFO state different areas (20 LP systems/networks/databases/security; 10 LP theoretical CS and algorithms; 20 LP mathematics; 5 LP computer architecture/technical CS/HPC; 25 LP programming/SE/HCI/graphics/UX/web; plus up to 10 LP freely distributed; 90 total) — see notes. Module descriptions are required. Counting rule (GPU-R, applies once the course-based counting is approved): each requirement counts the student's courses from ANY of its listed categories (main + covered) added together; each course counts for only one requirement, never split; a course that fits several requirements goes where it leaves the smallest total shortfall.

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: the EFO provides no conditions (Auflagen); admission page: 'Eine Auflagenerteilung zum Erreichen der entsprechenden fachlichen Voraussetzungen ist nicht möglich.'

descriptive_notes: Aptitude assessment (EFO § 5 Abs. 3, § 6): the Zugangsausschuss reviews the documents (only if the degree and English requirements are met); if no decision is possible from the documents, an interview of at most 30 minutes is held (written invitation at least two weeks ahead; no right to a replacement date; a repeat can be requested in the next semester).
Admission page: the decision is binary ('Anträge werden nur angenommen oder abgelehnt').

Announced change: applications for a start from summer semester 2027 are to follow the 2026 version of the EFO (official publication pending), which adds a supervised English-language aptitude test at TU Dresden (passed with at least 60 percent) where records are unclear.

Announced 2026 rules: the admission page already lists new subject minimums (20/10/20/5/25 LP plus up to 10 LP) and says they govern applications from summer semester 2027, but the 2026 EFO is not yet officially published. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): the record checks the published 2025 rules (35/35/20 LP) until the 2026 version appears in the Amtliche Bekanntmachungen; check both.

allowed_exemptions: certificate of a university degree completed entirely in English (Studienordnung § 3 Abs. 3 example)
language_english.note: EFO § 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 and Studienordnung § 3 Abs. 3: C1 CEFR. SO examples: 'TOEFL iBt (120-95) oder IELTS (7.0, 7.5, 8.0)'; EFO § 4 Abs. 2 Nr. 7: an internationally offered test such as TOEFL or IELTS, or a comparable test set by the Zugangsausschuss. Admission page (stricter, not stored): TOEFL iBT at least 100 with all sections at least 20 (from January 2026: 5.0, sections at least 4.0), IELTS 7.0 with all bands at least 6.0, PTE Academic 78 with all parts at least 65, Cambridge C1 (each part at least B2), UNIcert III; English-medium study counts only in EU countries, Australia, UK, Norway, Switzerland, Canada, New Zealand, USA, Hong Kong, Taiwan or Singapore (India not listed). Fakultätsratsbeschlüsse of 21.05.2025 and 25.02.2026 on the regulations page accept B2 (TOEFL 80, IELTS 6.0, PTE 60). See notes, CONFLICT.

aps_certificate.note: TU Dresden uni-assist application page: applicants with Chinese, Vietnamese or Indian educational credentials must submit the 'Original des Zertifikates der Akademischen Prüfstelle der Deutschen Botschaft (APS)'. Not in the Ordnungen.

other_requirements: form-bound application for the aptitude assessment (aptitude portal; applicants with a foreign Bachelor's also upload the uni-assist final confirmation email as PDF)
CV showing the academic history
motivation letter (EFO § 4 Abs. 2: informal motivation letter; admission page: optional)
detailed official module descriptions or equivalent content overviews
application with foreign degree via uni-assist (EFO § 4 Abs. 1)
application before graduation: home university certificate of 80 percent of the credit points of the degree (EFO § 4 Abs. 4)

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung (Satzung) für den Masterstudiengang „Computer Science“ am Fachbereich Informatik und Elektrotechnik der Fachhochschule Kiel, § 7, together with the Prüfungsverfahrensordnung (Satzung) der Fachhochschule Kiel (PVO) § 5 and § 7 Abs. 7
admission_regulation.version: PO vom 29. Juni 2023, NBl. HS MBWFK Schl.-H. 3/2023 vom 14. Juli 2023 (S. 66); in force the day after publication, first applies to students starting in SS 2024 (§ 9 Abs. 1). The HAW Kiel regulations page for the Fachbereich Informatik und Elektrotechnik (checked 2026-10-11) lists only this version, with no Änderungssatzung, Berichtigung or Lesefassung. PVO vom 11.10.2016 as amended 06.04.2017, 10.01.2023 and 06.06.2024 (3rd amendment applies from 01.03.2025), read in the official Lesefassung; the PVO sets no grade or subject rule for this programme (only general § 5 and the 180-210 LP make-up power in § 7 Abs. 7 Nr. 9).

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 7 Abs. 1: Kiel UAS graduates of the Bachelor's 'Informatik', 'Medieningenieur/-in' or 'Wirtschaftsinformatik' with at least grade 2,5. § 7 Abs. 2: also access for a first professional degree in a 'fachlich eng verwandtes Studium' with at least grade 2,5; closely related = at least 120 LP in basic core competences (see subject item). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: PO § 7 Abs. 2: 'mit mindestens der Note 2,5 abgeschlossen hat'. FAQ: 'minimum Bachelor's grade of 2.5 (German grading scale)'. No conversion method for foreign grades is stated in the PO or the PVO.

items.raw_label: wenigstens 120 LP für grundlegende Kernkompetenzen in Mathematik, Informatik, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen, Programmieren und Datenbanken, Software-Engineering, Netzwerk und Projektmanagement (§ 7 Abs. 2)

subject_credit_requirements.note: One pooled area of 120 LP as written in PO § 7 Abs. 2. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Projektmanagement' has no category in the CS taxonomy and is not counted in the pool (stricter than the regulation; flagged DECISION in notes). The FAQ list of core competencies also names 'Working Experience' and is introduced with 'for example'; the regulation list is stored. The PO provides no Auflagen to make up missing core competences.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions for missing subject competences in PO § 7. The only make-up rule (§ 7 Abs. 3; PVO § 7 Abs. 7 Nr. 9) concerns prior study of at least 180 but under 210 LP (total credits, see other_requirements).

descriptive_notes: Admission-restricted programme (programme page: 'admission restrictions'). After priority quotas (programme page: foreign student and hardship quotas), '20% of the study places are allocated based on waiting time'; 'The remaining 80% are distributed according to a university selection quota'. A lottery may follow for remaining places.
Admission cannot be postponed to a later semester; it expires if you do not enrol (FAQ).

allowed_exemptions: school certificates showing English for at least 5 years up to the school-leaving qualification with a final grade of at least German 4 (PO § 7 Abs. 5)
English as native language (PO § 7 Abs. 5)
successfully completed English-language university degree (PO § 7 Abs. 5)
language_english.note: PO § 7 Abs. 5: English at least B2 (GER) for all applicants. Certificate table: Cambridge FCE (B2) grade B or better, CAE/CPE grade C or better; BULATS B2 60 points; IELTS Band 5.5; TOEFL PBT 515, CBT 185, iBT 70. Programme page lists 'evidence of English language skills' among the documents to upload with the application.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants with a Bachelor's degree obtained outside the Bologna area (PO § 7 Abs. 4)
standardized_test_requirements.details: 'GRE mit einem Mindestperzentil von 55 % im Quantitative Reasoning Teil des Tests.' FAQ: GRE General Test score required regardless of ECTS; not needed for Bologna-area degrees.

other_requirements: prior study with fewer than 210 but at least 180 LP: missing competences must be made up; as a rule 300 LP in total; set as Auflage by the Prüfungsausschuss after enrolment at the start of studies (PO § 7 Abs. 3). FAQ: 30 additional ECTS, to be completed before starting the Master's thesis; a Bachelor's from an anabin H+ institution treated as equivalent to a three-year German Bachelor's (180 ECTS) needs the additional 30 ECTS
application through uni-assist (FAQ)
application before graduation: at the application deadline no more than 15 credit points of the Bachelor's may be outstanding (programme page, FAQ)
proof of the above-mentioned university degree (bachelor's certificate, performance overview with grades, etc.)
first university entrance qualification (Abitur, technical college leaving certificate, etc)
complete proof of previous periods of study in the form of certificates
