admission_regulation.title: Zweite Ordnung zur Änderung und zugleich Neubekanntmachung der Prüfungsordnung für die konsekutiven Masterstudiengänge „Artificial Intelligence“, „Computer Science“ und „Cyber Security“ der Mathematisch-Naturwissenschaftlichen Fakultät der Rheinischen Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn, § 5
admission_regulation.version: vom 13.07.2026, Amtliche Bekanntmachungen 56. Jahrgang Nr. 32 vom 27.07.2026, in force from 01.10.2026 (official copy on the Institut für Informatik site; checked by independent checker 11.10.2026). § 5 values unchanged from the 21.01.2026 version: 18/14/18/12 ECTS, C1 English, no grade limit. Earlier: Neubekanntmachung 21.01.2026 (AB 56. Jg. Nr. 6) changed theory 15 -> 14, thesis 10 -> 12, English B2 -> C1 compared with PO 2023.

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 5 Abs. 1: first professional university degree 'in den Fächern Cyber Security oder Informatik oder in einem verwandten Fach'. The Cyber Security (§ 5 Abs. 4: IT security 24, maths 18, algorithm theory 9, programming/SE/IS 18, thesis 12 LP) and Artificial Intelligence (§ 5 Abs. 2: maths 18, algorithm theory 14, programming/SE/IS 20, thesis 12 LP) programmes have their own profiles; this record stores Computer Science (§ 5 Abs. 3) only. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in § 5. The grade is used for ranking only; application page: 'only good grades (better than 2,5 in the German system) bring in any points.'

items.raw_label: Module im Umfang von mindestens 18 ECTS-LP in mathematischen Grundlagen der Informatik (§ 5 Abs. 3 Nr. 1)
Module im Umfang von mindestens 14 ECTS-LP in Grundlagen der Algorithmentheorie, der Komplexitätstheorie oder formaler Sprachen (§ 5 Abs. 3 Nr. 2)
Module im Umfang von mindestens 18 ECTS-LP in Programmierung, Softwaretechnologie oder Informationssysteme (§ 5 Abs. 3 Nr. 3)

subject_credit_requirements.note: § 5 Abs. 3 (version of 21.01.2026). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Algorithmentheorie' is mapped to theoretical_cs plus algorithms_data_structures; 'Informationssysteme' to databases_systems; atomic categories are used in item 3 (not the practical_cs aggregate) so that algorithms credits are not counted twice. Admission FAQ: no Bachelor's thesis means rejection; 'A presentation or a publication is not accepted as a substitute for the actual thesis.' Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: eine wissenschaftliche Abschlussarbeit im Umfang von mindestens 12 ECTS-LP (§ 5 Abs. 3 Nr. 4)

conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen for missing subject credits in § 5. Admission FAQ: 'Our examination regulations only allow one type of conditional admission.' and 'Conditional admission will not enable you to catch up on missing requirements after enrolling.' (The one type is enrolment before graduation, § 5 Abs. 8, see other_requirements.)

descriptive_notes: Institution-specific admission restriction with a special selection procedure; selection follows the university's 'Ordnung für Auswahlverfahren' valid at the time of application and Anlage 4 of the PO (§ 5 Abs. 7; Anlage 4 not readable in the copy opened).

Ranking (application page): each criterion scored 0-10 and multiplied by a weight. Computer Science weights: good GPA for the Bachelor's (1); additional advanced modules on algorithms theory or complexity theory (2); modules on computer graphics, vision, audio or sensing (2); modules on artificial intelligence (1); additional advanced modules on mathematics (2); academic manuscripts (thesis, publications) (1); subject-related experience in teaching (1). Only grades better than 2,5 earn points.

Practica, internships, theses and graduation projects do not count toward the required subject credits (Bonn application page: https://www.informatik.uni-bonn.de/en/studies/master-programs/master-program-application).

allowed_exemptions: schooling or university education of at least three years in the education system of Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, or the United States of America (application page)
language_english.note: § 5 Abs. 5: 'Beherrschung der englischen Sprache mindestens auf dem Niveau C1'. Application page: IELTS Academic at least 7.0 (valid until the start of the semester); TOEFL at least 5.0 (new scoring system) or at least 95 (old scoring system); also PTE 76+, Oxford Test of English Advanced 141+, LanguageCert Academic 75+, TOLIMO 620+. FAQ: 'We do not accept a proof that English was the language of instruction in your Bachelor's'. All documents must be submitted by the deadline.

aps_certificate.note: Application page: 'If you have completed your previous education in China, India or Vietnam, you will need a Certificate of Authenticity' (Echtheitsbestätigung / APS certificate). Not in the PO.

other_requirements: enrolment before graduation if not more than 30 ECTS-LP are missing at application and all required examinations are taken in the semester before the start; proof to the Prüfungsausschuss at the latest four months after semester start, otherwise enrolment lapses (§ 5 Abs. 8)
application via the university application portal (no uni-assist, no VPD; FAQ)
Curriculum Vitae
Thesis
Summary of the thesis (only if the thesis is not in English, French or German)
Motivation letter
Complementary documents about your prior studies

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 November (SS 2027: first application period 1 October to 1 November 2026; non-EEA applicants only the first period)

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Informatik an der Rheinland-Pfälzischen Technischen Universität Kaiserslautern-Landau, §§ 2, 2a and Anhang 2 (Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren)
admission_regulation.version: vom 17.11.2025, Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 8 vom 03.12.2025, S. 28; in force the day after publication; applies to students first enrolled or re-enrolled from WS 2025/26 (§ 25). No amendment found in Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 9/2025, 3/2026 and 5/2026 (opened); issues 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 and 8/2026 could not be opened (robots), so an amendment cannot be ruled out. Anhang 2 could not be read in either German PDF (text extraction ends in Anhang 1); Anhang 2 values are taken from the department's official English 'translated excerpt' of these regulations ('as of Nov 17, 2025') as a fallback. The general AMPO was repealed on 11.05.2026 (Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 5/2026); no reference to it was seen in §§ 1-2a of the PO.

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'die Bachelorprüfung in Informatik an der RPTU oder mindestens gleichwertige Studien- und Prüfungsleistungen'; equivalence is 'kein schematischer Vergleich, sondern eine Gesamtbetrachtung in Bezug auf den gewählten Studiengang'. § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: subject aptitude under the Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren (Anhang 2). Applicants whose degree is not equivalent may be admitted under conditions (§ 2a). The applymsc platform is for foreign candidates; candidates from Germany use the Regular Application. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in §§ 2, 2a or in the Anhang 2 excerpt; the final grade is part of the documents (degree certificate 'showing the final grade').

items.raw_label: mindestens 30 Leistungspunkte in "Theoretische Grundlagen" (department page; Anhang 2)
mindestens 30 Leistungspunkte in "Software-Entwicklung" (department page; Anhang 2)
mindestens 30 Leistungspunkte in "Informatiksysteme" (department page; Anhang 2: equivalence assessment against the RPTU Bachelor Informatik; English excerpt calls it "Computer Systems")

subject_credit_requirements.note: Anhang 2 step 1 (excerpt): equivalence requires at least 30 credit points in each of the three compulsory sections 'Theoretical Foundations', 'Software Development' and 'Computer Systems'. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): categories chosen from the module lists of these sections in the RPTU Bachelor Informatik reading version (Theoretische Grundlagen: three 'Mathematik für Informatik' modules, Formale Sprachen und Berechenbarkeit, Logik und Semantik; Software-Entwicklung: programming, algorithms and data structures, project management, software project; the Bachelor's third section is named 'Informatiksysteme': computer architecture, systems software, information systems, communication systems, secure systems, scientific computing, AI). German Anhang 2 wording not seen (DECISION/BLOCKED in notes). The step-2 aptitude assessment is described under selection.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflagen (§ 2a; Anhang 2 excerpt): if the degree is not equivalent, the examination board 'may impose missing coursework and examinations from the corresponding Bachelor's program' up to a maximum of 30 credit points; admission under conditions is not allowed if more than 30 LP are required (§ 2a Abs. 3); conditions must be met 'innerhalb der ersten vier Prüfungszeiträume' (§ 2a Abs. 4); one retake of a failed condition exam.

descriptive_notes: Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren, step 2 (Anhang 2 excerpt): subject-specific aptitude is assessed from 'knowledge of the English language', 'competencies acquired in previous studies' and 'practical knowledge and experience that are beneficial for the Master's degree program'; no points or thresholds are published. The board may request additional documents or a presentation. Result: 'suitable' or 'not suitable'; an unsuccessful procedure 'may be repeated no earlier than after one year'.
Assessment fee of 60 Euros, valid for one intake only, to be received no later than one week after the application deadline (application platform).

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification obtained in Germany (§ 2 Abs. 6 Nr. 1)
determination by the Prüfungsausschuss (§ 2 Abs. 6)

admission_regulation.title: Fachspezifische Bestimmungen für den Bachelor- und Master-Studiengang Informatik der Universität des Saarlandes zur Gemeinsamen Prüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Master-Studiengänge der Fakultät 6 (Naturwissenschaftlich-Technische Fakultät I – Mathematik und Informatik) vom 2. Juli 2015, § 31, together with the Gemeinsame Prüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Master-Studiengänge der Fakultät für Mathematik und Informatik an der Universität des Saarlandes vom 25. Februar 2021, § 12
admission_regulation.version: FSB vom 2. Juli 2015 (Dienstblatt der Hochschulen des Saarlandes 2015 Nr. 73, S. 641-644), in force since the day after publication (30.09.2015); the official regulations page lists no amendment of the FSB. GPO vom 25. Februar 2021 (Dienstblatt 2021 Nr. 62, S. 580-602), which repealed the GPO Fakultät 6 of 2 July 2015 and keeps the FSB made under it in force as part of the new GPO (§ 26); the official regulations page lists no amendment of the GPO 2021. Neither document was found to have been amended for admission.

accepted_degree_fields.note: FSB § 31 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: Bachelor's degree from a German university or an equivalent degree from a foreign university 'in einem Studiengang der Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach'. Application guide: 'Bachelor's degree from a German university (at least 180 CP) or an equivalent qualification from a foreign university'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: Koushik decision 19.10.2026 (applied to all Saarland Informatics Campus programmes): store the official application-guide minimum as a hard grade — GPU-R policy (official university page, not regulation wording; the FSB set no limit). SIC Application Guide (page modified 02.10.2026, https://saarland-informatics-campus.de/en/studium-studies/master-english/application-guide/): 'Minimal prerequisite is a cumulative undergraduate grade point average (CGPA) of 75% or 3.00 GPA on a 4 point scale and ranking in the top 10% of the graduating class.' Cross-checked 19.10.2026 on MyGermanUniversity and Expatrio StudyBuddy (third-party; both state 75 %, most also the top-10 % ranking). GPU-R conversion: 3,00/4 with Nmin 2,0 → 2,5; 75 % read as CGPA 7,5/10 with Indian Nmin 5,0 → 1 + 3 × (10 − 7,5)/5 = 2,5. The top-10 % ranking cannot be checked (student note). Previous note: The regulation sets no numeric grade limit: FSB § 31 Abs. 2 b names 'die in der bisherigen akademischen Laufbahn erbrachten Leistungen' as a criterion of special aptitude, assessed by the Prüfungsausschuss. The SIC application guide states: 'Minimal prerequisite is a cumulative undergraduate grade point average (CGPA) of 75% or 3.00 GPA on a 4 point scale and ranking in the top 10% of the graduating class.' This is not a German grade and is not stored as a check (see selection notes). No conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: I. Mathematik (diskrete Mathematik, ein- und mehrdimensionale Analysis, Lineare Algebra, Numerik, Stochastik) — 'wesentliche Kompetenzen', no credit number

II. Theoretische Informatik (formale Methoden, formale Logik, Berechenbarkeit, Verständnis der Komplexität von Problemen – insbesondere der Komplexitätsklassen P und NP) — 'wesentliche Kompetenzen', no credit number

III. Praktische Informatik (funktionale und objektorientierte Programmierung, Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen, Datenbanken, Methoden der Softwareentwicklung, Systemarchitektur) — 'wesentliche Kompetenzen', no credit number

subject_credit_requirements.note: FSB § 31 Abs. 2 b: the candidate should show competences corresponding to those taught in the Bachelor's programme Informatik at Saarland University, in particular essential competences in the three areas above. No credit numbers are stated, so all three are presence-only. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Numerik' has no CS taxonomy category and is not mapped; 'formale Logik' belongs to theoretical_cs (rule R4), so area II checks theoretical_cs only — discrete_math_logic is NOT a covered category of area II, because it is the main category of area I and one discrete-maths course would otherwise pass both areas (R3/R10, decision N-37, 16.10.2026); 'Systemarchitektur' is mapped to computer_engineering. GPO § 12 Abs. 4: content is checked against the descriptions in the FSB.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Vorläufige Zulassung unter der Bedingung (GPO 2021 § 12 Abs. 5): missing contents are made up in a supplementary course of study within a fixed period, 'soweit in den Fachspezifischen Bestimmungen nicht anderes geregelt maximal im Umfang von 30 CP'. The FSB 2015 contains no different rule. The procedure is fixed in writing with a subject representative.

descriptive_notes: Special aptitude ('besondere Eignung', FSB § 31 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 and Abs. 2): the Prüfungsausschuss assesses advanced English (as a rule C1), previous academic achievements and the subject content of the Bachelor's degree, and study interest documented by a dossier and two qualifying references.

Application guide: minimal prerequisite of CGPA 75% or 3.00 on a 4-point scale and ranking in the top 10% of the graduating class; 'Satisfying these minimal standards, however, does not guarantee your admission!'
The decision whether the admission requirements are met is made by the Examination Board (FSB § 31; GPO § 12 Abs. 7); in doubtful cases subject representatives are heard.

allowed_exemptions: native speakers from Australia, Ireland, Canada, New Zealand, the UK and the USA
in-person studies while physically residing in one of these countries
language_english.note: FSB § 31 Abs. 2 a: 'Nachweis englischer Sprachkenntnisse auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau (in der Regel C1)'. Scores and exemptions are from the SIC application guide: IELTS (academic) 7.0, TOEFL iBT 95, TOEFL paper-based 600, PTE Academic 76, Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency; home editions and expired tests accepted; 'A confirmation of your university or a MOI (Medium of Instruction) is not a sufficient equivalent.'; 'The English certificate is a mandatory part of the application.'

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants with no degree certificate earned within the European Higher Education Area (EHEA), Switzerland or the UK (application guide and FAQ; not in FSB or GPO)
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE General Test or the Indian GATE test; 'There is no minimum score requirement'; home editions accepted; GRE subject tests or prep tests do not satisfy the requirement; no exception for degrees from branch campuses in non-EHEA countries.

aps_certificate.note: Application guide and FAQ: applicants with degrees from China, India or Vietnam must submit the original (digitally signed) APS Certificate issued by the Academic Evaluation Center. Not in FSB or GPO.

other_requirements: dossier and two qualifying references ('Gutachten') documenting study interest (FSB § 31 Abs. 2 c); application guide: two complete review forms by recommenders, at least one with an academic background
CV including research interests, projects or publications
certified list of all attended courses with the respective grades

provisional admission before the Bachelor's certificate only if all Bachelor examinations and the Bachelor thesis are completed by the start of the Master's; certificate as a rule within three months after semester start (GPO § 12 Abs. 3)

The 2nd amendment replaces § 4 and amends Anlage 5; per Art. 2 these changes apply to students starting from WS 2025/26. It changes admission (1st-amendment § 4 had grade 2,2 and an Auflagen cap of 18 LP; now grade 3,2 and no Auflagen rule in § 4). § 4 confirmed word for word from the German text of Amtl. Mitt. 23/2025 provided by Koushik on 15.10.2026. Anlage 5 and Art. 2 are still read only in the university's non-binding English translation (Koushik's copy also ends inside Anlage 3). accepted_degree_fields.note: StPO § 4 Abs. 1: 'Abschluss eines fachlich einschlägigen Bachelorstudienganges im Bereich Informatik oder ... eines vergleichbaren in- oder ausländischen berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschlusses'; a teaching degree for Gymnasien (Erste Staatsprüfung or Master) with the teaching subject Informatik also qualifies. The Eignungsfeststellungskommission decides on relevance and comparability (§ 4 Abs. 2, 3). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: StPO § 4 Abs. 1 (as amended 19.02.2025): 'Gesamtnote von 3,2 bzw. mit 7,3 Notenpunkten oder besser gemäß § 28'. No conversion method for foreign grades is stated in the StPO or the Allgemeine Bestimmungen. Before graduation, the average of graded module examinations covering at least 80% of the Bachelor's LP is used (§ 4 Abs. 1).

items.raw_label: insgesamt mindestens 90 LP in den beiden wissenschaftlichen Disziplinen Mathematik und Informatik
davon mindestens 12 LP auf Module aus der Mathematik
In der Mathematik müssen Kompetenzen in Grundlagen der Analysis ... erworben worden sein
In der Mathematik müssen Kompetenzen in Grundlagen ... der Linearen Algebra ... erworben worden sein
In der Mathematik müssen Kompetenzen in Grundlagen ... der Statistik erworben worden sein
davon mindestens 72 LP auf Module aus der Informatik
In der Informatik müssen mindestens 9 LP auf Kompetenzen aus dem Modul Theoretische Informatik entfallen

Leistungspunkte mindestens im angegebenen Umfang auf Kompetenzen aus mindestens 5 der folgenden Module: Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen (9 LP), Deklarative Programmierung (9 LP), Objektorientierte Programmierung (9 LP), Systemsoftware und Rechnerkommunikation (9 LP), Datenbanksysteme (9 LP), Softwaretechnik (6 LP) und Technische Informatik (9 LP) — min_ects 42 = smallest possible sum of 5 modules (6+9+9+9+9), GPU-R arithmetic

subject_credit_requirements.note: StPO § 4 Abs. 1 Sätze 4-7 (as amended 19.02.2025). Credits may come from the completed or a further degree programme. The '5 of 7 modules' rule cannot be checked exactly by the engine; the last item is a GPU-R approximation (see DECISION in notes). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): Deklarative and Objektorientierte Programmierung → programming_practical_cs; Systemsoftware und Rechnerkommunikation → operating_systems; Technische Informatik → computer_engineering. The regulation strongly recommends acquiring missing module competences before starting.

conditional_admission.mechanism: StPO § 4 (as amended 19.02.2025) contains no Auflagen rule (the 13.03.2024 version allowed Auflagen of up to 18 LP, excluding Theoretische Informatik). Allgemeine Bestimmungen § 4 Abs. 2 (Lesefassung 21.01.2026): the deciding body 'kann die Zulassung mit der Auflage verbinden, dass fehlende Studienleistungen und/oder Prüfungsleistungen im Umfang von höchstens 30 LP erbracht werden'. Whether this general rule applies to this programme is unresolved; stored as not allowed (GPU-R policy, conservative) — see DECISION in notes.

descriptive_notes: Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren (Anlage 5 § 4, as amended 19.02.2025): admission requires at least 65 of 100 points.
Points for the overall grade: 55 points for grade points 15.0-12.7 (decimal 0.7-1.4), 45 points for 12.6-10.0, 35 points for 9.9-7.3 (decimal down to 3.2).
10 points if a scientific thesis of at least 10 LP is compulsory in the qualifying programme, or an optional thesis has been completed or bindingly registered.
Subject points: 35 points for competences in all 7 listed modules, 20 points for 6 of the 7.
Rejected applicants may reapply only if they have obtained further relevant credits since the last application (Anlage 5 § 5).

allowed_exemptions: alternative route: English B1 plus German at least DSH-2 (StPO § 4 Abs. 4 b)
language_english.note: StPO § 4 Abs. 4 a: C1 'mittels eines Sprachzertifikats einer der nachfolgenden international anerkannten Sprachprüfungen': IELTS 7.0/7.5/8.0, TOEFL iBT 95-120, TOEFL PBT 627-677, TOEFL ITP Level 1 627-677, Cambridge FCE Grade A / CAE Grade B or C / BEC Higher, PTE Academic 76-84, TOEIC (L&R 945-990, Speaking 180-200, Writing 180-200), telc C1, UNIcert III, IGCSE 1st/2nd Language average C1. German programme page: 'Der Nachweis erfolgt ausschließlich durch ein Sprachzertifikat einer international anerkannten Sprachprüfung'; English programme page: C1 proven only by 'a language certificate from an internationally recognized language examination'. moi_not_accepted = true follows from this 'certificate only' wording. No deadline for the proof is stated.

other_requirements: application on the university form incl. the completed self-disclosure web form listing modules, scope, theses and language certificates (Anlage 5 § 2)

Einschreibung unter Vorbehalt if no final certificate at the application deadline: proof of passed module examinations of at least 80% of the Bachelor's LP with an average grade; all Bachelor achievements by 30.09 (winter start) / 31.03 (summer start); certificate by the end of the lecture period of the first semester (StPO § 4 Abs. 1)

admission_regulation.version: FPSO of 20.02.2025 (AB UBT 2025/005, in force 21.02.2025, for students starting from SS 2025), amended 15.04.2026 (AB UBT 2026/036, in force 16.04.2026) and by the Satzung zur Änderung von Bachelor- und Masterstudiengängen of 30.07.2026 (AB UBT 2026/067, in force 31.07.2026); both amendments change only the module table and do not change admission. accepted_degree_fields.note: FPSO § 3 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: degree 'im Bachelorstudiengang Informatik an der Universität Bayreuth oder im Bachelorstudiengang Angewandte Informatik an der Universität Bayreuth oder ein damit gleichwertiger Abschluss'; § 3 Abs. 2: no substantial differences in acquired competences; recognition of degrees under Art. 86 BayHIG; the Prüfungsausschuss decides. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: FPSO § 3 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'mit mindestens der Prüfungsnote „gut“ (2,5)'. Programme page: '“good” (2.5 - converted German overall grade) or better'. conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflage (FPSO § 3 Abs. 2): if 'ausgleichsfähige wesentliche Unterschiede' exist, admission with the condition to complete additional study and examination achievements 'im Umfang von maximal 15 Leistungspunkten aus dem Bachelorstudiengang Informatik' by the end of the second semester; otherwise the access requirements count as not fulfilled.

descriptive_notes: The Prüfungsausschuss decides whether the degree is equivalent and whether substantial differences can be compensated (FPSO § 3 Abs. 2).

German A1 is an admission requirement under the program regulation for applicants whose school-leaving qualification and first degree were not in German; the program page calls it optional and obtainable in the first year (the regulation is followed).

admission_regulation.title: Studienordnung für den konsekutiven Studiengang Computer Science for Digital Media mit dem Abschluss Master of Science vom 15. Juni 2020 (MdU 38/2020), § 2 Zulassungsvoraussetzungen, together with the Prüfungsordnung für den konsekutiven Studiengang Computer Science for Digital Media mit dem Abschluss Master of Science (MdU 37/2020), § 13
admission_regulation.version: Studienordnung MdU 38/2020 and Prüfungsordnung MdU 37/2020 (both of 15.06.2020), in force on the first day of the month after publication, applying first to students starting in WS 2020/21. The faculty regulations page lists no amendment. The examination committee's 'Supplementary Provisions' (entries 20.11.2013 – 28.01.2026) do not change admission.

accepted_degree_fields.note: StO § 2 Abs. 1: 'Als fachlich einschlägig gelten im Hauptfach belegte Studiengänge der Informatik, der Medieninformatik, sowie andere technisch-wissenschaftliche Studiengänge mit hohem Informatik-Anteil.' Application page names computer science, computer engineering, media informatics, information technology, software engineering, mathematics, or another technical or scientific subject with a computer science focus. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: StO § 2 Abs. 1: first degree 'mit mindestens „gut“ beendet'. PO § 13 Abs. 1 defines '1,6 bis 2,5 gut'; only the first decimal place counts (§ 13 Abs. 3). The application FAQ states a stricter limit of 2.1 ('If your cumulative GPA is worse than 2.1 (in the German grading system), we will not consider your application.') — see CONFLICT in notes. Application page: with a converted credit-weighted GPA of '2.0 or better, your chances of admission are good'. No conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: Mathematics amounting to at least 15 ECTS points (application FAQ; GPU-R policy, not regulation wording)
Computer Science amounting to at least 45 ECTS points (application FAQ; GPU-R policy, not regulation wording)

subject_credit_requirements.note: The regulation (StO § 2 Abs. 1) requires a relevant degree with 'hohem Informatik-Anteil' but states no credit numbers. The numbers come from the application FAQ, which also states 'Mathematics and Computer Science amounting to the equivalent of at least 90 ECTS points (approx.)'; the approximate 90 ECTS total is not stored as a check (see DECISION in notes). If other criteria are only partly met, the Prüfungsausschuss decides (StO § 2 Abs. 3). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): the FAQ's 15/45 ECTS figures are checked although the regulation only says 'hohem Informatik-Anteil'; the regulation does not define 'hohem Informatik-Anteil', so the FAQ figures are used as the university's own interpretation (see DECISION).

conditional_admission.mechanism: Zusatzleistungen (StO § 2 Abs. 3): 'Sind andere der erforderlichen Kriterien nur teilweise erfüllt, entscheidet der Prüfungsausschuss. Gegebenenfalls kann der Prüfungsausschuss vom Bewerber/von der Bewerberin zu erbringende Zusatzleistungen festlegen.' No cap stated. FAQ: applicants who narrowly miss the requirements may be accepted with stipulations of 'one or two supplementary courses'. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): because § 2 Abs. 3 covers any partly met criterion and states no cap, conditions are not used to bridge subject shortfalls in the check (an uncapped value would let any gap pass); the committee may still admit with supplementary courses (see DECISION).

descriptive_notes: Application FAQ (non-EU applicants): the committee first asks whether the thesis or papers show independent research, and how many and how advanced the computer science courses were and with which grades; if still undecided, references, a motivation letter and English scores are considered.
Application FAQ (EU/German applicants): ranking by closeness to the entry requirements, grades in relevant classes, English score above the minimum, and overall GPA.
Application FAQ: relevant job experience can compensate for too few computer science courses 'to some degree'.
Application page: applications are assessed on grades in core computer science courses and the scientific quality of the thesis, reports or papers.

If you narrowly miss the subject requirements, the examination board may admit you with one or two supplementary courses (§ 2 Abs. 3; FAQ). The FAQ also says applications with a converted grade worse than 2.1 are not considered, although the regulation requires 'mindestens gut', which PO § 13 defines as up to 2.5.

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or first professional degree acquired in an English-speaking country (StO § 2 Abs. 4 Nr. 1)
language_english.note: StO § 2 Abs. 4: B2 via IELTS Band 6,5 or better, TOEFL iBT 85 or better, Cambridge B2 First (FCE), or an equivalent proof. Application page adds PTE minimum 70, TOEFL '4.5 under the new grading system', IELTS no component below 6.0, certificates not older than two years. FAQ: 'Only if the country where you studied is English-speaking is no language certificate needed.'; 'the teaching language is not sufficient for us.'; 'You need to hand in your proof of English right before enrolment.' C1 is required later for thesis registration (PO § 17 Abs. 3 Nr. 5).

other_requirements: if the first degree did not include a scientific final thesis, another scientific paper written by the applicant must be submitted; the Prüfungsausschuss decides on this basis (StO § 2 Abs. 2)
Bachelor's thesis uploaded with the application (application page)
application via uni-assist for first degrees obtained outside the EU
application only with the final certificate (FAQ: 'You can only apply with your final certificate.')

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 January (via uni-assist)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung über den Zugang und die Zulassung für die konsekutiven Masterstudiengänge „Informatik“ und „Technische Informatik“ der Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Universität Hannover, § 2 and Anlage 1
admission_regulation.version: Verkündungsblatt der LUH Nr. 02/2024 vom 25.03.2024, S. 16-19; § 8: in force on the day after publication. No Übergangsvorschrift and no amendment named in the text. Read by WebFetch on 15.10.2026 (the PDF opened this time; quotes are short extracts by the tool, not a full read). Whether a later amendment exists could NOT be checked: the LUH regulations page and faculty page are still robots-blocked.

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZO § 2 Abs. 1: Bachelor or equivalent degree; for a foreign degree outside the Bologna states 'einen gleichwertigen Abschluss' in a subject-suitable programme 'gemäß Anlage 1' (equivalence also checked with anabin). Anlage 1: 'Bachelorabschluss in Informatik oder in einem fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen Studiengang'. 'Die Entscheidung, ob das vorangegangene Studium fachlich geeignet ist ... trifft die ... Auswahlkommission.' primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record.

grade_requirement.note: ZO § 2 sets no minimum grade. § 4: 'Die Auswahlentscheidung erfolgt auf der Basis einer Reihung', 'anhand der Abschluss- bzw. Durchschnittsnote' (ranking by grade only when applicants exceed places; ties by lot). Before graduation (§ 2 Abs. 2) the average of the achievements so far is used.

items.raw_label: 15 ECTS-LP in Mathematik (ZO Anlage 1)
10 ECTS-LP in Theoretischer Informatik (ZO Anlage 1)

20 ECTS-LP in Grundlagen der Informatik und 20 ECTS-LP in Vertiefung der Informatik (ZO Anlage 1) — both are general computer science in GPU-R's taxonomy, so they are checked together as at least 40 ECTS (rule R2)

subject_credit_requirements.note: ZO Anlage 1 (Informatik): 'Bachelorabschluss in Informatik oder in einem fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen Studiengang mit mindestens: 15 ECTS-LP in Mathematik, 10 ECTS-LP in Theoretischer Informatik, 20 ECTS-LP in Grundlagen der Informatik, 20 ECTS-LP in Vertiefung der Informatik'; equivalent competences 'gemäß den jeweils gültigen Modulhandbüchern' must be shown. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): Grundlagen and Vertiefung have no separate taxonomy categories (basic vs advanced), so they are combined as general_cs ≥ 40 (R2). Theoretical CS courses count toward the 10, not toward the 40 (sibling items, E2).

conditional_admission.mechanism: ZO § 2 Abs. 1: 'die Feststellung kann mit einer Nebenbestimmung versehen werden', 'noch fehlende Module innerhalb von zwei Semestern nachzuholen'. No credit cap is stated (only the two-semester limit); the Auswahlkommission decides (D4: uncapped committee conditions).

descriptive_notes: If applications exceed the places (festgesetzte Zulassungszahlen, § 3 Abs. 1), places are allocated by a ranking on the final or average grade only (§ 4); ties are decided by lot. No interview, no points system.
State portal 'Studieren in Niedersachsen' (not a university page, meta-date 29.09.2026): 'Örtliche Zulassungsbeschränkung, zwingend mit NC'; main language of instruction German.

allowed_exemptions: alternative: German C1 (ZO § 2 Abs. 3)
no language proof needed with a German Hochschulzugangsberechtigung or a German Bachelor's degree (§ 2 Abs. 3)
language_english.note: ZO § 2 Abs. 3: applicants without a German HZB and without a German Bachelor's degree need 'ausreichende Kenntnisse der deutschen Sprache auf dem Sprachniveau C1'; § 2 Abs. 4: for the Master Informatik (not Technische Informatik) 'ausreichende Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache auf dem Sprachniveau C1' can be shown instead. Accepted certificates and scores are on a university web page that is robots-blocked, so no test scores are stored. No IELTS/TOEFL minimum published (MyGU 24.10.2026 lists language 'English & German', no scores).

other_requirements: provisional admission with at least 150 Leistungspunkte; degree by the end of the first Master semester (ZO § 2 Abs. 2)
documents: Bachelor certificate, or a certificate of achievements, LP and average grade (§ 3 Abs. 2)
non-EU applicants: uni-assist VPD (state portal 'Studieren in Niedersachsen'; not confirmed on a university page)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung über den Zugang und die Zulassung für die internationalen Masterstudiengänge „International Master in Data Analytics“ und „International Master in Software Engineering“
admission_regulation.version: Verkündungsblatt der Universität Hildesheim Heft 189, Nr. 04/2024 vom 16.04.2024 (S. 85–89); in force on the day after publication (§ 8). No amendment is listed on the university's official regulations listing for the programme (regulations.php?page=study&study=67, checked 2026-10-14). The PO 2024 (Heft 188, 18.03.2024) and the Hochschulweite Rahmenprüfungsordnung 2026 (Heft 208, 20.02.2026, in force 01.04.2026) contain no admission requirements (RPO § 10 (1) refers to the programme-specific regulations); they do not change admission.

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZZO § 2 (1): Bachelor's degree or equivalent 'im Studiengang Angewandte Informatik oder in einem fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen Studium' (German/Bologna universities); other foreign universities: equivalent degree in a subject-suitable programme, equivalence per anabin (ZAB). The responsible body decides whether a programme is subject-suitable. Programme page (EN): 'Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, information technology, mathematics, statistics, data science, AI, or data analytics' 'or an equivalent degree programme in a related field'. PO 2024 § 2: Fundamental Track for graduates of other subjects, Advanced Track for graduates of dedicated Data Science programmes. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the ZZO. The grade is a ranking input only: ZZO § 4 (4) 'Punkte Abschlussnote = (MaxP) 90 * (4 – Note) / 3' (1.0 = 90 points, 4.0 = 0 points); 'Für andere Notenschemata erfolgt die Umrechnung entsprechend' (no explicit conversion formula).

items.raw_label: Programme page entry requirement: 'good programming skills' (FAQ P3: 'Programming is a crucial requirement of our program'); no credit number
Programme page entry requirement: 'Strong analytical, mathematical ... competences' (FAQ P4: 'Basic understanding of math, esp. calculus, linear algebra and stochastics'); no credit number
Programme page entry requirement: 'statistics competences'; no credit number

subject_credit_requirements.note: The ZZO itself names no subjects or credit numbers; it requires only a 'fachlich geeignet' (subject-suitable) degree (§ 2 (1)). The three presence-only items come from the official programme page (EN: 'Strong analytical, mathematical, and statistics competences, as well as good programming skills'; DE: 'Ausgeprägte analytische, mathematische und statistische Kompetenzen sowie guten Programmierkenntnissen') and the programme FAQ; storing them as checks is GPU-R policy (not regulation wording). FAQ: applicants without programming or without maths 'cannot be admitted as is' but may be admitted conditionally on completing Bachelor courses in programming/maths during the first year. FAQ P5: no prior knowledge of an application domain required. Ranking: 'Umfang und Noten von Bachelor-Modulen mit engem inhaltlichen Bezug zur Studienvariante' (ZZO § 4 (5) a).

conditional_admission.mechanism: Nebenbestimmung (ZZO § 2 (1) Satz 2): the positive finding of subject suitability 'kann mit einer Nebenbestimmung verbunden werden, noch fehlende Module innerhalb von zwei Semestern nachzuholen'. No credit cap is stated in the ZZO. PO 2024 § 5 (2) allows modules of at most 12 LP taken as admission conditions under § 2 ZugZulO to be credited in the Master's programme; this is a crediting rule, not a cap on conditions.

descriptive_notes: Selection only if qualified applications exceed places (ZZO § 1): ranking by points = grade points (max 90) + special aptitude (max 80) (ZZO § 4 (3)); ties decided by lot (§ 4 (2)).

Special aptitude criteria (ZZO § 4 (5)): scope and grades of Bachelor modules closely related to the programme, research activities, practical activities, and possibly a selection interview; weighting published at least 6 weeks before the portal opens.

Published weighting (Fachbereich 4 regulations page): Bachelor overall grade 53 %, number and grades of Bachelor courses in data analytics incl. mathematics, programming and machine learning 24 %, prior research activities 6 %, prior practical activities 6 %, general assessment up to 11 %. The programme page and FAQ instead show 53 % / 35 % (courses incl. maths and programming) / 6 % / 6 %.
Interviews (ZZO § 4 (6)) are held with all applicants who could still reach an admitting rank with the maximum interview result.
Enrolment is 'auflösend bedingt' (subject to cancellation) until the Bachelor's degree is proven: by 31 March for winter and 30 September for summer start (ZZO § 4 (8)).

allowed_exemptions: English as first language
at least one year of work or study in an English-speaking country within the last 10 years
a study programme of at least one year completed fully in English within the last 10 years
German Hochschulzugangsberechtigung (Abitur) with at least six years of English up to the Abitur or English in the Abitur exam with at least 10 points
language_english.note: ZZO § 2 (3): minimum test results not older than 10 years: CEFR 'Stufe B2', paper-based TOEFL 500, computer-based TOEFL 173, internet-based TOEFL 61, IELTS 'Niveaustufe 5', Cambridge FCE grade B or CAE grade C. Programme page: 'TOEFL Computer-based Test – min. 61 points, IELTS – min. 6, or an equivalent certificate'. The regulation value (IELTS 5) is stored; the programme page states IELTS 6. Programme page/FAQ: for English-taught studies a stamped and signed university document confirming the programme was conducted entirely in English. Proof is part of the application documents (ZZO § 3 (2)).

aps_certificate.note: Programme page: 'If the Bachelor’s degree was earned in one of the following countries, please upload the APS certificate': China (excluding Hong Kong and Macao), Vietnam, Mongolia, India. FAQ: can be uploaded in an English-certificate slot at application 'or latest when you enroll'. Not in the ZZO.

other_requirements: Copy of your Bachelor’s, Master’s, or diploma certificate, including a transcript of grades (in English or with an English translation)
Resume
provisional access before graduation with at least 144 Leistungspunkte; degree must be obtained by the end of the first Master's semester (ZZO § 2 (2))
application through the Faculty 4 application portal only

admission_regulation.title: Satzung über das Studium an der Technischen Universität Hamburg (TUHH) vom 27. Februar 2013, Teil I § 2, § 2 Abs. 2a, § 2 Abs. 3, § 3, with Anhang 1 (Sprachnachweise) and Anhang 2 (Fachspezifische Anforderungen, Data Science)
admission_regulation.version: Reading version (Lesefassung, not legally binding; only the Amtlicher Anzeiger publications are binding) as last amended 17 June 2026 (Amtlicher Anzeiger Nr. 47 vom 16. Juni 2026, S. 698); previous amendment 22 October 2025 (Amtl. Anz. Nr. 93 vom 02.12.2025, S. 2206). The individual 2025/2026 amending statutes were not opened, so whether they changed Data Science admission is not confirmed. The Data Science table of Anhang 2 could not be read in the 2026 reading version (text cut off); the subject table was read from the 2025 reading version (i.d.F. 23.04.2025, Anhang 2.2.3) and from the official Anhang 2 extract 'Specific requirements for Data Science (M.Sc.)', 'Gültig ab 1.12.2024' (linked on the programme page for WiSe 2025/26); both are identical.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Satzung § 2 (1): access requires 1. successful completion of a 'grundständigen Studiengang', 2. 'fachspezifische Kenntnisse und Kompetenzen, die in Umfang und Tiefe den Anforderungen für das jeweilige Master-Studium entsprechen' (Anhang 2), 3. language proof per Anhang 1; content review by a selection committee. Programme admission page: 'Applicants should hold a Bachelor's or equivalent degree in a Data Science programm or an equivalent programm with sufficiently strong background in computer science and mathematics'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No numeric grade limit. Satzung § 2 (3): applicants for the internationally oriented Master's programmes (Anhang 1 Nr. C3) with a first degree not from Germany or a § 5 (2) Nr. 1 state 'haben eine Benotung mindestens im oberen Leistungsviertel des jeweiligen Hochschulsystems nachzuweisen' (grade at least in the top quarter of the respective higher-education system), assessed on country-specific experience; the next sentence speaks of the 'oberen Leistungsdrittels' (top third), considering ZAB recommendations and TUHH evaluations. GPU-R cannot check this cohort/system-relative rule (see notes, DECISION); it is shown to students as a selection note. Programme page: 'very good previous academic performance'; application guide: precheck of whether the 'cumulative GPA is meeting our very strict requirements'.

items.raw_label: Mathematics 'Total 30' (Anhang 2): Linear Algebra 6 CP, Analysis 6 CP, Discrete Mathematics 6 CP, Stochastics 6 CP, Statistics or Numerical Mathematics 6 CP — stored as one maths total of 30 (Koushik's decision N-43, 16.10.2026)
Computer Science and Data Science: Programming 12 CP
Computer Science and Data Science: Algorithms and Data Structures 6 CP
Computer Science and Data Science: Theoretical Computer Science (Automata theory, Computability and / or Complexity Theory) 6 CP
Computer Science and Data Science: Machine Learning and Data Mining 12 CP

subject_credit_requirements.note: Anhang 2 zur Satzung über das Studium, 'Specific requirements for Data Science (M.Sc.)' (Anhang 2.2.3 in the 2025 reading version), 'Gültig ab 1.12.2024': Mathematics 'Total 30' (= sum of the five rows Linear Algebra, Analysis, Discrete Mathematics, Stochastics, Statistics or Numerical Mathematics, 6 CP each), Computer Science and Data Science 'Total 36' (= sum of the four rows). GPU-R encoding (not regulation wording): maths is stored as ONE general_mathematics item of 30 CP, the regulation's maths total (Koushik's decision N-43, 16.10.2026); the five 6 CP rows are kept in the label only. 'Data Mining' is added as covered category data_science.foundational_methods. Programme page (TUHH Bachelor graduates): 'Statistics or Numerical Mathematics, Machine Learning I' recommended. Application documents include an ECTS form and module manual. MINTFIT preparatory test strongly recommended (results not forwarded).

conditional_admission.mechanism: Satzung § 2 (2a): admission with individual Auflagen (Angleichleistungen, 'soll zwölf Leistungspunkte nicht überschreiten', to be completed by the end of the second semester) is possible only 'zu einem deutschsprachigen oder anteilig englischsprachigen Master-Studiengang gemäß Anhang 1'. Data Science is listed among the 'Englischsprachige Master-Studiengänge' in Anhang 2 and the programme page says 'The language of study is English'; the application guide does not mention conditional admission. GPU-R reading (not regulation wording): conditions are not available for this programme; the Anhang 1 column mark (fully vs partly English) could not be verified (see notes).

descriptive_notes: Grade rule for applicants with a foreign first degree (Satzung § 2 (3)): grade at least in the top quarter of the respective higher-education system, assessed on country-specific experience; GPU-R cannot check this, the selection committee decides.
Subject review by a selection committee (Auswahlkommission, Satzung § 2 (1)); the application guide describes a precheck of whether the cumulative GPA meets 'very strict requirements'.
Satzung § 20: applicants who do not meet the access conditions of § 2 (1) Nr. 1 and 2 and § 2 (3) are excluded.

allowed_exemptions: school-leaving qualification from a German school abroad or a school in Germany
school-leaving qualification from Austria, Switzerland or Liechtenstein
school-leaving qualification from the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand or Ireland
degree from a German university
degree from a university in Austria, Switzerland or Liechtenstein
degree from a university in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand or Ireland
degree from a university in the EEA (except Austria, Ireland, Liechtenstein) with a certificate note confirming English as language of instruction
language_english.note: Satzung Anhang 1 Abschnitt B ('Studiengänge mit Englisch als ausschließlicher Unterrichtssprache'): items 1-7 exemptions as listed; items 8-13 tests: 'TOEFL-Ergebnis (Mindestpunktzahl 90 [iBT])', 'IELTS-Academics-Ergebnis (mindestens 6.5 Punkte)', Cambridge Certificate of Proficiency in English, Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English, 'telc English C1', 'UNIcert English level III'. A medium-of-instruction note counts only for EEA degrees (item 7), so an Indian MOI letter is not in the list. Application guide (April 2026): 'The TOEFL ITP or the TOEFL Essentials Test will not be accepted!'. Satzung § 17 (5) (Teil II, restricted programmes): language proof 'sollte in der Regel nicht älter sein als zwei Jahre'.

aps_certificate.note: Application guide 'How to Apply for the Master's Programs Taught in English' (April 2026): 'Applicants with a school or university degree from China, India or Vietnam, regardless of' their nationality 'have to submit an APS certificate with their application!'; scholarship holders might be exempted. Not in the Satzung.

other_requirements: CV
degree certificate (or provisional certificate) and transcripts
explanation of the grading system
ECTS form
module manual
application before graduation only with no more than one semester left until graduation (application guide)
declaration that no examination in the same programme has been failed (Satzung § 2 (4))
GRE not required and not considered (application guide)
TUHH does not cooperate with uni-assist; direct application

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung des Fachbereichs Angewandte Informatik der Hochschule Fulda – University of Applied Sciences für den Master-Studiengang Data Science (SPO 2024), § 2 Zugangsvoraussetzungen, Zulassung
admission_regulation.version: SPO vom 17.01.2024 (Amtliche Mitteilung 31-2024 vom 14.06.2024, Genehmigung Präsidium 14.03.2024, in force 01.10.2024) as amended by the Satzung zur Änderung der Studien- und Prüfungsordnung ... für den Master-Studiengang Data Science (SPO 2024) (FBR 16.10.2024, Präsidium 25.02.2025, Amtliche Mitteilung 20-2025 vom 15.04.2025, in force 'mit Wirkung zum Wintersemester 2025/26'). The amendment changes admission: new § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 (German A2) and new § 2 Abs. 2 (both variants only from winter semester); grade, degree and aptitude-test rules unchanged. Both Amtliche Mitteilungen opened; the official reading version (Nichtamtliche Lesefassung) was used to check the combined text. ABPO 2018 (cited only in § 9 for § 20 Abs. 3): 6th amendment (AM 70-2025) and 7th amendment (AM 1-2026) opened, neither changes admission.

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'Der Abschluss eines Hochschulstudiums der Informatik oder eines Informatik-nahen Faches an einer deutschen Hochschule oder an einer vergleichbaren ausländischen Hochschule' of at least a) six semesters and 180 ECTS or b) seven semesters and 210 ECTS (foreign degrees: equivalent to at least three or three and a half years of German study). Applicants with at least 210 ECTS are placed in the three-semester (90 ECTS) variant, applicants with at least 180 ECTS in the four-semester (120 ECTS) variant (§ 1 Abs. 3, § 4). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'Der Notendurchschnitt muss 2,5 oder besser betragen.' The SPO states no conversion method. Master application page (international transcripts): uni-assist 'converts the foreign grade into the German grading system'.

items.raw_label: ausreichende Kompetenzen aus der Mathematik (subject of the Eignungsprüfung, § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3)
Kompetenzen aus dem Bereich der Angewandten Informatik (§ 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3; examples given 'wie z. B. Programmierung, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen und Datenbanken')

subject_credit_requirements.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: subject competences are proven in an Eignungsprüfung run by the Fachbereich Angewandte Informatik: 'Diese Fachkenntnisse umfassen ausreichende Kompetenzen aus der Mathematik und dem Bereich der Angewandten Informatik wie z. B. Programmierung, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen und Datenbanken sowie aus Anwendungsbereichen.' No credit numbers are stated. 'Anwendungsbereiche' has no taxonomy category and is not stored as an item. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): mathematics and Angewandte Informatik are checked as presence-only items; the regulation itself checks these competences through the aptitude test, which the Studiengangsleitung may waive for degrees from ECTS countries. The examples introduced with 'wie z. B.' (programming, algorithms/data structures and databases are only examples and are not separate checks.

conditional_admission.mechanism: The SPO contains no provision for admission with conditions (Auflagen) for missing subject competences. The 180 vs 210 ECTS difference is handled by the four-semester (120 ECTS) variant (§ 1 Abs. 3, § 4 Abs. 2), not by conditions.

descriptive_notes: Aptitude test (Eignungsprüfung, SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3) run by the Department of Applied Computer Science; it covers mathematics and applied computer science (e.g. programming, algorithms and data structures, databases) and application areas. Master application page: online test on computer science knowledge, usually mid-July for winter applicants; invitation and sample test sent by email about two weeks before.
The aptitude test can be waived for applicants with a degree from a country where ECTS standards apply; the Studiengangsleitung decides (SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3).

Master application page: admitted applicants who cannot take up the place may obtain a place within the next two semesters without retaking the online test (new uni-assist application with the admission notice); changed admission requirements must still be met.

language_english.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 4: 'Qualifizierte englische Sprachkenntnisse, die in der Regel durch einen TOEFL-Test (computer based mindestens 213 Punkte, paper based mindestens 550 Punkte, Internet-based mindestens 85 Punkte) nachgewiesen werden. Ersatzweise wird auch ein IELTS-Test mit einem Ergebnis von Band 6,5 und höher akzeptiert.' No CEFR level, no exemption and no Medium-of-Instruction rule stated.

language_german.required_level: A2 (CEFR); Goethe/telc/ÖSD/ECL A2, or DSH1 or TestDaF at least TDN3; exempt if the Hochschulzugangsberechtigung was obtained at a German-language institution

aps_certificate.note: Master application page (international transcripts): applications with documents from India (also China, Vietnam) need 'A scan of the certificate from the Academic Evaluation Centre (APS) of the respective German embassy'. Not in the SPO.

other_requirements: aptitude test (Eignungsprüfung), see selection notes
application via uni-assist for foreign degrees (75.00 EUR for the first study programme, 30.00 EUR for each additional one)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 May to 31 May (other nationalities with a foreign first degree; WS 2026/27: 31 May)

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Data Science als Vollzeitstudiengang an der Katholischen Universität Eichstätt-Ingolstadt, § 2 Qualifikationsvoraussetzungen and Anlage 1 (Eignungsverfahren), together with the Allgemeine Prüfungsordnung (APO) der Katholischen Universität Eichstätt-Ingolstadt vom 26. November 2014
admission_regulation.version: PO vom 1. April 2026 (Senat 12.02.2025, 30.07.2025, 11.02.2026; § 9: in force 1 April 2025 for study start from WS 2025/26 — cover date and § 9 date differ) as amended by the Satzung zur Änderung ... vom 29. Mai 2026 (in force 1 March 2026, applies from WS 2026/27). The amendment changes only Anlage 1 Nr. 2.1 Satz 4 Nr. 4: the GRE Subject Test Mathematics is no longer 'verpflichtend' for degrees from Bangladesh, China, India, Iran and Pakistan but 'dringend empfohlen' for degrees from states that have not ratified the Lisbon Convention; § 2 unchanged. Read from the Nichtamtliche konsolidierte Lesefassung; original PO and the amending statute also opened. APO: 5. Änderungssatzung (Senat 15.07.26, in force 1 October 2026, date 'TT.MM.JJJJ' pending) opened, no admission change; APO § 4 Abs. 2 lets the PO set additional requirements.

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 a): first degree 'in den Studiengängen Data Science, Mathematik, Statistik, Informatik, oder Physik'; b): degree 'in einem den vorgenannten Studiengängen verwandtem Studiengang' plus successful Eignungsverfahren. § 2 Abs. 1 Satz 2: if the degree was not obtained in a state that has ratified the Lisbon Convention (11 April 1997), the Eignungsverfahren must additionally be passed. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: PO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 a): degree in the listed fields 'mit mindestens der Gesamtnote 2,0'; 'soweit mit einer Gesamtnote schlechter als 2,0 abgeschlossen wurde, ist zusätzlich das Eignungsverfahren gemäß Anlage 1 erfolgreich zu absolvieren'. The Eignungsverfahren (Anlage 1 Nr. 3.2-3.4) averages three grades (degree grade, module relevance, individual achievements) and is passed with an overall 2,0 or better, so the degree grade alone is no fixed cut-off. No conversion method in the PO; program page: the KU grade conversion tool 'is based on the Bavarian formula' (not legally binding).

items.raw_label: Analysis I and II for Data Science
Linear Algebra I and II
Introductory Statistics and Stochastics
Optimization for Data Science (i.e. Introductory class on Optimization)
Introductory Programming class (preferentially basic Python programming skills)
Algorithms and Data Structures

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: 'erworbene Kompetenzen, die keine wesentlichen Unterschiede zu den in folgenden Modulen des Bachelorstudiengangs Data Science an der KU vermittelten Kompetenzen aufweisen' (six modules). No credit numbers in the PO, so all items are presence-only. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Optimization for Data Science' has no taxonomy category yet; it is stored as mathematics_statistics.optimization_numerics, which the engine does not measure, so it counts as 0 and must be checked by hand until an optimization category is added (decision N-36, 15.10.2026, same treatment as T3). It is NOT mapped to analysis, because one analysis course would then satisfy two requirements (R3/R10).

conditional_admission.mechanism: PO § 2 Abs. 1 Satz 3: 'Der Nachweis der nach Satz 1 Nr. 3 erforderlichen Kompetenzen kann entsprechend der Vorgaben der Kommission für das Eignungsverfahren bis zum Ende des zweiten Fachsemesters nachgeholt werden.' No cap stated. Program page: applicants who have not fully covered the core modules 'may still be admitted, but may be required to retake one or more Bachelor's modules', which do not count toward the Master's degree.

descriptive_notes: Eignungsverfahren (PO Anlage 1) required for degrees with an overall grade worse than 2,0, for degrees in related fields, and for degrees not obtained in a state that has ratified the Lisbon Convention (§ 2 Abs. 1).

Eignungsverfahren criteria (Anlage 1 Nr. 3.2): (1) degree grade or, before graduation, the ECTS-weighted average of at least 135 ECTS; (2) relevance of the completed modules measured against the KU Bachelor Data Science (graded 1,0-4,0); (3) individual achievements such as demanding modules with above-average grades, extracurricular activities in mathematics or data science, relevant internships, teaching or employment, publications, GRE Subject Test Mathematics (graded 1,0-4,0). Overall grade = arithmetic mean truncated to one decimal; passed with 2,0 or better (Nr. 3.3-3.4). No interview. The procedure can be repeated at a later date.
Eignungsverfahren is held once a year for a winter-semester start (Anlage 1 Nr. 2.2); if it is required, the study can only start in the winter semester (§ 5 Abs. 2).

allowed_exemptions: Reifezeugnis
Hochschulabschluss mit Ausbildungssprache Englisch (program page: confirmation from university required)
language_english.note: PO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'Kenntnisse in Englisch auf Niveau B2 (Europäischer Referenzrahmen); diese können durch das Reifezeugnis, einen Hochschulabschluss mit Ausbildungssprache Englisch, die Teilnahme an der TOEFL-Prüfung mit einer Gesamtpunktzahl von mindestens 78 oder einen anderen qualifizierenden Nachweis nachgewiesen werden'. IELTS 6.0 is from the program page only ('IELTS test 6.0 or better').

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: nobody (not mandatory); 'dringend empfohlen' for applications whose first degree was not obtained in a state that has ratified the Lisbon Convention (PO Anlage 1 Nr. 2.1 Satz 4 Nr. 4 as amended 29.05.2026, from WS 2026/27)
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE Subject Test Mathematik; no score threshold stated; considered among individual achievements in the Eignungsverfahren (Anlage 1 Nr. 3.2). Program page: 'Applicants from a non-European country are strongly encouraged to submit the results of a standardized test, ideally the GRE subject test Mathematics.'

aps_certificate.note: Program page: 'Applicants who obtained their first degree in China, India or Vietnam: APS certificate'. Not in the PO.

other_requirements: Eignungsverfahren (see selection notes)
Transcript of Records
tabellarischer Lebenslauf
application before graduation possible with at least 135 ECTS (Anlage 1 Nr. 2.1)
application via uni-assist for a Master's entrance qualification obtained outside the EU (program page; Anlage 1 Nr. 2.1: non-Lisbon degrees via uni-assist)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 July (application period 1 May to 15 July)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: not possible: program page — no summer start for a Master's entrance qualification obtained outside the EU; also, when the Eignungsverfahren is required (always for degrees from non-Lisbon states such as India), studies can start only in the winter semester (PO § 5 Abs. 2).

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Data Science der Fakultät für Angewandte Informatik und der Mathematisch-Naturwissenschaftlich-Technischen Fakultät der Universität Augsburg vom 17.02.2025
admission_regulation.version: Prüfungsordnung vom 17.02.2025 (M-520-9-1-000), § 4 and Anlage 1 (Eignungsordnung) §§ 2-4; in force 01.04.2025, first applies to students starting from WS 2025/26 (§ 25). German text read from the copy provided by Koushik on 15.10.2026. Rechtssammlung lists no Änderungssatzung (checked 14.10.2026).

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'den Abschluss eines Bachelorstudiengangs oder durch einen dem gleichwertigen sonstigen ersten berufsqualifizierenden in- oder ausländischen Abschluss' — no subject field is named; the subject requirements are the seven qualifications of Anlage 1 § 2. Comparability and equivalence of foreign degrees and grades: Prüfungsausschuss (§ 4 Abs. 3). Institute page: 'B.Sc. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science and related areas'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record.

grade_requirement.note: Anlage 1 § 4 Satz 2 Nr. 2: 'die Verfahrensnote ist gleich oder besser als 2,70'; Satz 3: other grading scales are converted 'nach der modifizierten bayerischen Formel'. Applicants before graduation (85 % of LP): missing credits are counted with 4,0 (§ 4 Satz 2 Nr. 2 b).

items.raw_label: Mehrdimensionale Analysis: Module im Umfang von mindestens 5 Leistungspunkten (LP)
Abstrakte Strukturen der (Linearen) Algebra: Module im Umfang von mindestens 5 LP

Grundlagen einer höheren Programmiersprache (mindestens 4 LP) und Praktische Programmierung (mindestens 4 LP, 'erworben ggf. in einer Übung') — Anlage 1 § 2; both map to programming_practical_cs, so they are checked together as at least 8 LP (rule R2: two areas of the same taxonomy category are combined)
Algorithmen oder numerische Verfahren: Module im Umfang von mindestens 5 LP
Diskrete Strukturen, Datenbanken oder Data Engineering: Module im Umfang von mindestens 5 LP
Data Science oder Maschinelles Lernen: Module im Umfang von mindestens 4 LP

subject_credit_requirements.note: Anlage 1 (Eignungsordnung) § 2: 'Um den Masterstudiengang Data Science erfolgreich studieren zu können, müssen folgende Qualifikationen kumulativ vorhanden sein': Mehrdimensionale Analysis ≥ 5 LP; Abstrakte Strukturen der (Linearen) Algebra ≥ 5 LP; Grundlagen einer höheren Programmiersprache ≥ 4 LP; Praktische Programmierung ≥ 4 LP; Algorithmen oder numerische Verfahren ≥ 5 LP; Diskrete Strukturen, Datenbanken oder Data Engineering ≥ 5 LP; Data Science oder Maschinelles Lernen ≥ 4 LP. § 4: the Auswahlkommission checks from the documents whether these are present 'in dem dort festgelegten Umfang'. POOLED (added up, D3): 'Diskrete Strukturen, Datenbanken oder Data Engineering' and 'Data Science oder Maschinelles Lernen'. GPU-R policy: 'numerische Verfahren' has no taxonomy category (only algorithms counted, stricter). Institute FAQ: each area must correspond to a full lecture on that topic.

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: the qualifications must be present 'kumulativ' (Anlage 1 § 2); the PO has no Auflagen rule. Institute page: 'No exceptions or extensions will be granted.' (§ 4 Abs. 2: only the pre-graduation route with 85 % of LP, degree to be proven by the end of the following semester.)

descriptive_notes: Open admission with an aptitude assessment process ('Zulassungsfrei (mit Eignungsverfahren)'); Institute page: 'The aptitude test is based on the list of prior knowledge in certain areas which needs to be included in the application.' 'No written exams or interviews are needed.' Admissions are not ranked.
Institute FAQ: the content of each required area must correspond to a full lecture on that topic, 'a fraction is not enough'; the committee checks the module handbook references.

allowed_exemptions: Hochschulzugangsberechtigung or first degree acquired at an English-language institution
Zeugnis der allgemeinen Hochschulreife with at least 'ausreichend' in English
previous degree taught entirely in English, proven by a Medium of Instruction (MOI) statement from the university
language_english.note: Program page: 'Englische Sprachkenntnisse mindestens auf dem Niveau B2 nach dem Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmen (GER)', otherwise 'den erfolgreichen Abschluss eines einschlägigen Test wie etwa TOEFL oder IELTS'. Scores from the university-wide admission requirements page (B2: Cambridge B2 First, IELTS overall band at least 5.5, telc English B2, TOEFL iBT at least 72, UNIcert II). Institute page: 'If only parts of the programme were taught in English (such as the thesis), this is not sufficient.' Not verified against the PO (BLOCKED).

aps_certificate.note: Program page: 'APS-Zertifikat: Bei Bewerber/Bewerberinnen aus China, Indien und Vietnam'; Institute page: APS needed for degrees from China, India or Vietnam.

other_requirements: module handbook of the previous programme with references (page number / module identifier) for each required area
ZAB statement of comparability if the university is not 'H+' in anabin
application before graduation possible with 85 % of the required credit points (missing credits counted with the minimum passing grade)
online application via the university portal (no uni-assist VPD for M.Sc. programmes)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 September (Anlage 1 § 3 Abs. 1, online via the VIBS portal)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 March (Anlage 1 § 3 Abs. 1)

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Studiengang „Data Science“ mit dem Abschluss „Master of Science (M.Sc.)“ der Philipps-Universität Marburg vom 25. Januar 2023, § 4 and Anlage 5 „Besondere Zugangsvoraussetzungen und Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren“, as amended by the Zweite Änderung vom 19. Februar 2025; together with the Allgemeine Bestimmungen für Studien- und Prüfungsordnungen in Masterstudiengängen an der Philipps-Universität Marburg vom 13. September 2010
admission_regulation.version: StPO of 25.01.2023 (Amtliche Mitteilungen Nr. 55/2023, 26.04.2023) as amended 13.03.2024 (Nr. 21/2024, published 28.03.2024; replaced § 4: grade 2,3, 90 LP, Auflagen up to 15 LP; applied from WS 2024/25) and 19.02.2025 (Nr. 25/2025, published 10.04.2025, in force 11.04.2025). The 2nd amendment replaces § 4 and adds Anlage 5; per Art. 2 these changes apply to students starting from WS 2025/26. It changes admission (grade 3,2; 72 + 18 LP; no Auflagen rule; aptitude points procedure). FB12 regulations page lists the version of 19.02.2025 as current ('Für Studierende mit Studienbeginn ab WS 2025/26'). Allgemeine Bestimmungen read in the Lesefassung of the 3rd amendment of 21.01.2026 (Amtl. Mitt. 04/2026); 1st and 2nd AB amendments not opened.

accepted_degree_fields.note: StPO § 4 Abs. 1 (as amended 19.02.2025): 'Abschluss eines fachlich einschlägigen Bachelorstudiengangs in den Bereichen Data Science, Mathematik oder Informatik oder ... eines vergleichbaren in- oder ausländischen berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschlusses'. The Eignungsfeststellungskommission decides on relevance and comparability (§ 4 Abs. 2, 3). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: StPO § 4 Abs. 1 (as amended 19.02.2025): 'mit einer Gesamtnote von 3,2 bzw. mit 7,3 Notenpunkten oder besser gemäß § 28'. No conversion formula in the StPO or the Allgemeine Bestimmungen. EAP page: for degrees from other universities the decimal grade given by that university applies, possibly converted by the application portal; 'There is no conversion to the Marburg grading system.' Before graduation, the average of graded module examinations covering at least 80% of the Bachelor's LP is used (§ 4 Abs. 1).

items.raw_label: insgesamt mindestens 72 LP in Modulen aus der wissenschaftlichen Disziplin Informatik
mindestens 18 LP in Modulen aus der wissenschaftlichen Disziplin Mathematik
Davon müssen mindestens 9 LP auf Kompetenzen aus dem Modul Maschinelles Lernen entfallen

sowie jeweils mindestens 9 LP auf die Kompetenzen aus mindestens 5 der 7 Module: Objektorientierte Programmierung, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen, Systemsoftware und Rechnerkommunikation, Effiziente Algorithmen, Grundlagen der Linearen Algebra, und entweder Grundlagen der Analysis und Grundlagen der Höheren Mathematik oder Analysis I und Analysis II — min_ects 45 = 5 x 9 LP, GPU-R arithmetic

subject_credit_requirements.note: StPO § 4 Abs. 1 Sätze 3-4 (as amended 19.02.2025). Credits may come from the completed or a further degree programme. 'Es wird dringend empfohlen, sich die Kompetenzen aus den genannten Modulen, die nicht bereits erbracht wurden, eigenverantwortlich vor Aufnahme des Studiums anzueignen.' The 9 LP Maschinelles Lernen and the 5-of-7-modules credits are part of ('Davon') the 72 LP Informatik / 18 LP Mathematik (NESTED). The '5 of 7 modules' rule cannot be checked exactly by the engine; the last item is a GPU-R approximation (see DECISION in notes). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): Objektorientierte Programmierung → programming_practical_cs; Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen and Effiziente Algorithmen → algorithms_data_structures; Systemsoftware und Rechnerkommunikation → operating_systems; Grundlagen der Linearen Algebra → linear_algebra; Analysis / Höhere Mathematik modules → calculus_analysis.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Verified 16.10.2026: the StPO of 25.01.2023 § 4 Abs. 4 allowed the Prüfungsausschuss to admit 'with the condition that additional coursework and/or examination grades representing a maximum of 30 credits be completed' (official EN translation); the Erste Änderung of 13.03.2024 reduced this to Auflagen of up to 15 LP. The Zweite Änderung of 19.02.2025 (Art. 1: § 4 replaced in full; Art. 2: the § 4 changes apply to students starting from WS 2025/26) gives § 4 a new text with Abs. 1-5 and NO such conditions clause — only enrolment 'unter Vorbehalt' for a pending degree certificate (80 % of LP). Programme page (EN): 'Note that the general admission requirements are hard requirements. Admission without meeting them is not possible.' The university-wide Allgemeine Bestimmungen § 4 Abs. 2 (Lesefassung 21.01.2026) still contain a general discretionary option ('kann ... höchstens 30 LP'), but the programme removed its own clause and states hard requirements; stored as not allowed (consistent with sibling record 9042, decision N-55).

descriptive_notes: Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren (Anlage 5, as amended 19.02.2025): admission requires at least 65 of 100 points.
Points for the overall grade: 55 points for grade points 15,0-12,7 (decimal 0,7-1,4), 45 points for 12,6-10,0 (decimal 1,5-2,3), 35 points for 9,9-7,3 (decimal 2,4-3,2).
10 points if a scientific thesis of at least 10 LP is compulsory in the qualifying programme, or an optional thesis has been completed or bindingly registered.
Subject points: 35 points for at least 9 LP in each of all 7 listed modules, 20 points for 6 of the 7; no subject points with only 5 of 7.

GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): with only 5 of the 7 modules, 65 points are reached only with a grade of 1,4 or better plus the thesis points; with 6 of 7, a grade of 2,3 or better (45 + 20 = 65), or any grade up to 3,2 together with the thesis points (35 + 20 + 10 = 65); with all 7, any grade up to 3,2.
Rejected applicants may reapply only if they have obtained further relevant achievements since the last application (Anlage 5 § 5 Abs. 2).

allowed_exemptions: alternative route: English B1 plus German at least DSH-2 (StPO § 4 Abs. 4 b)
language_english.note: StPO § 4 Abs. 4 a (as amended 19.02.2025): C1 'mittels eines Sprachzertifikats einer der nachfolgenden international anerkannten Sprachprüfungen': IELTS 7.0/7.5/8.0, TOEFL iBT 95-120, TOEFL PBT 627-677, TOEFL ITP Level 1 627-677, Cambridge FCE Grade A / CAE Grade B or C / BEC Higher, PTE Academic 76-84, TOEIC (L&R 945-990, Speaking 180-200, Writing 180-200), telc C1, UNIcert III, IGCSE 1st/2nd Language average C1. Programme page: C1 proven 'exclusively by a language certificate from an internationally recognized language examination'; 'Purely English-language studies or school certificates are not sufficient'. Anlage 5 § 2 Nr. 4: language proof is part of the application.

other_requirements: online application with the self-disclosure document created with the web form on the programme website (Anlage 5 § 2 Nr. 5; EAP page)

Einschreibung unter Vorbehalt if no final certificate at the application deadline: proof of passed module examinations of at least 80% of the Bachelor's LP with an average grade; all Bachelor achievements by 30.09 (winter start) / 31.03 (summer start); certificate by the end of the lecture period of the first semester (StPO § 4 Abs. 1)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 31 December (applicants with a foreign university degree; SS 2027: 1 November - 31 December 2026)
