admission_regulation.title: Fachspezifische Bestimmungen für den Bachelor- und Master-Studiengang Data Science and Artificial Intelligence vom 25. April 2019, § 32 (Zugang zum Master-Studium), together with the Gemeinsame Prüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Master-Studiengänge der Fakultät für Mathematik und Informatik an der Universität des Saarlandes vom 25. Februar 2021, § 12
admission_regulation.version: FSB vom 25. April 2019 (Dienstblatt der Hochschulen des Saarlandes 2019 Nr. 56, ausgegeben 20.08.2019, Anlage 1, S. 576 ff.), in force the day after publication (§ 36); the official regulations page for Master programmes of Fakultät MI lists no amendment of the FSB. GPO vom 25. Februar 2021 (Dienstblatt 2021 Nr. 62, S. 580-602), which repealed the GPO Fakultät 6 of 2 July 2015 (as amended 28.04.2016) and keeps FSB issued under it in force as part of the new GPO (§ 26 Abs. 2); the regulations page lists no amendment of the GPO 2021. No admission-relevant amendment found.

accepted_degree_fields.note: FSB § 32 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: Bachelor's degree from a German university or an equivalent degree from a foreign university 'in einem Studiengang der Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach', and (Nr. 2) proof of special aptitude (§ 77 Abs. 5 SHSG). Application guide and programme page: Bachelor's degree 'at least 180 CP' or an equivalent foreign qualification. The Prüfungsausschuss decides whether the access requirements are met. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: Koushik decision 19.10.2026 (applied to all Saarland Informatics Campus programmes): store the official application-guide minimum as a hard grade — GPU-R policy (official university page, not regulation wording; the FSB set no limit). SIC Application Guide (page modified 02.10.2026, https://saarland-informatics-campus.de/en/studium-studies/master-english/application-guide/): 'Minimal prerequisite is a cumulative undergraduate grade point average (CGPA) of 75% or 3.00 GPA on a 4 point scale and ranking in the top 10% of the graduating class.' Cross-checked 19.10.2026 on MyGermanUniversity and Expatrio StudyBuddy (third-party; both state 75 %, most also the top-10 % ranking). GPU-R conversion: 3,00/4 with Nmin 2,0 → 2,5; 75 % read as CGPA 7,5/10 with Indian Nmin 5,0 → 1 + 3 × (10 − 7,5)/5 = 2,5. The top-10 % ranking cannot be checked (student note). Previous note: The regulation sets no numeric grade limit: FSB § 32 Abs. 2 b names 'die in der bisherigen akademischen Laufbahn erbrachten Leistungen' as a criterion of special aptitude. The SIC application guide states: 'Minimal prerequisite is a cumulative undergraduate grade point average (CGPA) of 75% or 3.00 GPA on a 4 point scale and ranking in the top 10% of the graduating class.' This is not a German grade and is not stored as a check (see selection notes). No conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: I. Mathematik (diskrete Mathematik, ein- und mehrdimensionale Analysis, Lineare Algebra, Stochastik, Statistik) — 'wesentliche Kompetenzen', no credit number
II. Theoretische Informatik (Komplexitätstheorie, Berechenbarkeit) — 'wesentliche Kompetenzen', no credit number
III. Praktische Informatik (funktionale und objektorientierte Programmierung, Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen, Datenbanktechnologie) — 'wesentliche Kompetenzen', no credit number
IV. Maschinelles Lernen, Künstliche Intelligenz, Data Mining — 'wesentliche Kompetenzen', no credit number

subject_credit_requirements.note: FSB § 32 Abs. 2 b: the candidate should show competences corresponding to those taught in the Bachelor's programme Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at Saarland University; 'Dies schließt insbesondere wesentliche Kompetenzen in den folgenden Bereichen ein' (areas I-IV above). No credit numbers are stated, so all four areas are presence-only. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Data Mining' is mapped to data_science.foundational_methods. GPO § 12 Abs. 4: content is checked against the descriptions in the FSB.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Vorläufige Zulassung unter der Bedingung (GPO 2021 § 12 Abs. 5): if the content requirements of Abs. 4 are not met, missing contents are made up in a supplementary course of study within a fixed period, 'soweit in den Fachspezifischen Bestimmungen nicht anderes geregelt' 'maximal im Umfang von 30 CP'. The FSB 2019 contains no different rule. The procedure is fixed in writing with a subject representative.

descriptive_notes: Special aptitude ('besondere Eignung', FSB § 32 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 and Abs. 2): advanced English (as a rule C1), previous academic achievements and the subject content of the Bachelor's degree, and study interest documented by a dossier and two qualifying references are matched against the profile of the programme.

Application guide: minimal application prerequisite of CGPA 75% or 3.00 on a 4-point scale and ranking in the top 10% of the graduating class; 'Satisfying these minimal standards, however, does not guarantee your admission!'
The decision whether the access requirements are met is made by the Prüfungsausschuss (FSB § 32 Abs. 2; GPO § 12 Abs. 7).

allowed_exemptions: native speakers from Australia, Ireland, Canada, New Zealand, the UK and the USA
in-person studies at a university in one of these countries while residing there
language_english.note: FSB § 32 Abs. 2 a: 'Nachweis englischer Sprachkenntnisse auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau (in der Regel C1)'. Scores and exemptions from the SIC application guide: IELTS (academic) 7.0, TOEFL iBT 95, TOEFL paper-based 600, PTE Academic 76, Cambridge CAE or CPE; home editions and expired tests accepted; a university confirmation or MOI is 'not a sufficient equivalent'. Programme page: 'a MOI (Medium of Instruction) cannnot be accepted'.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants with no degree certificate earned within the European Higher Education Area (EHEA), Switzerland or the UK, starting with applications for summer semester 2026 (application guide; not in FSB or GPO)
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE General Test or the Indian GATE test; 'There is no minimum score requirement.' For applications until winter semester 2025/26 the GRE was optional.

aps_certificate.note: SIC application guide: applicants who obtained their university degree in China, India or Vietnam must submit the original (digitally signed) APS Certificate with the application. Not in FSB or GPO.

other_requirements: dossier and two qualifying references ('Gutachten') documenting study interest (FSB § 32 Abs. 2 c); application guide: two complete review forms from recommenders, at least one with an academic background; letters sent by mail are not accepted
personal statement written by the applicant (programme page)
CV including research interests, projects or publications
certified list of all attended courses with the respective grades, including an explanation of the grading system; copies of the 3 most recent degrees

provisional admission before the Bachelor's certificate only if all Bachelor examinations and the Bachelor thesis are completed by the start of the Master's; certificate as a rule within three months (GPO § 12 Abs. 3)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 November (application guide; programme page also names an early deadline of 15 May)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung über den Zugang und die Zulassung für den konsekutiven Masterstudiengang „Data Science and Machine Learning“ (M.Sc.) der Fakultät VI – Medizin und Gesundheitswissenschaften der Carl von Ossietzky Universität Oldenburg
admission_regulation.version: vom 04.06.2025, Amtliche Mitteilungen 44. Jahrgang 018/2025 (Fakultätsrat 12.02.2025, Präsidium 11.03.2025, MWK 22.05.2025); in force for the application round WS 2025/26 (§ 8). German text read from the copy provided by Koushik on 15.10.2026.

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 2 Abs. 1: Bachelor (or equivalent) of at least 180 LP in a 'fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen Studiengang der Data Science, Mathematik, Statistik, Physik, Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik' or another subject-suitable programme; foreign degrees outside Bologna states: equivalence per anabin. § 2 Abs. 1 Satz 2 Nr. 1: suitable if at least 30 LP in Mathematik und Informatik, including 20 LP Mathematik (of which at least 5 LP Analysis oder Lineare Algebra and at least 5 LP Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie oder Statistik) and 10 LP Informatik (of which at least 5 LP Algorithmen and 5 LP in einer höheren Programmiersprache, vorzugsweise Python). Nr. 2: degrees from other relevant fields additionally need at least 15 LP in Datenwissenschaften (not stored; other profile).

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the Zugangsordnung (§ 2). The grade is used only for ranking (§ 4 Abs. 2 a): 1,00-1,5 = 4 points … 2,76-3,0 = 1 point; 3,01-4,0 = 0 points. No conversion method stated in the Ordnung; the program refers to the university's conversion page.

items.raw_label: a) 20 credit points in mathematics
a.1) 5 CPs analysis or linear algebra (of the 20 CP mathematics)
a.2) 5 CPs in probability theory or statistics (of the 20 CP mathematics)
b) 10 credit points in computer science
b.1) 5 CPs in the field of algorithms (of the 10 CP computer science)
b.2) 5 CPs in a higher programming language (preferably Python) (of the 10 CP computer science)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Zugangsordnung 04.06.2025 § 2 Abs. 1 Satz 2 Nr. 1: 'mindestens 30 Leistungspunkte im Bereich Mathematik und Informatik …, darunter mindestens 20 Leistungspunkte in Mathematik, davon mindestens 5 Leistungspunkte in Analysis oder Linearer Algebra und mindestens 5 Leistungspunkte in Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie oder Statistik sowie 10 Leistungspunkte in Informatik, davon mindestens 5 Leistungspunkte im Bereich Algorithmen und mindestens 5 Leistungspunkte in einer höheren Programmiersprache (vorzugsweise Python)'. The 30 equals 20 + 10 and is not stored separately. NESTED: a.1 and a.2 count inside a; b.1 and b.2 inside b (engine rule E2a). POOLED: a.1 (Analysis or Linear Algebra), added up (D3).

conditional_admission.mechanism: § 2 Abs. 2 Satz 1 lit. b: provisional access if subject content of 'nicht mehr als 5 Leistungspunkten im Bereich Statistik und 5 Leistungspunkten in den Bereichen Algorithmen oder höhere Programmiersprachen fehlen, solange insgesamt 20 Leistungspunkte in Mathematik und 10 Leistungspunkte in Informatik vorhanden sind'; missing competences must be made up 'innerhalb von maximal zwei Semestern nach Einschreibung' (Satz 3; failing that, exmatriculation § 6 Abs. 6). max_ects stores the total of the two per-area caps (5 + 5 = 10, Koushik's rule for per-area caps); PER-AREA LIMIT: only statistics (max 5) and algorithms/programming (max 5) may be missing — gaps in the 20 LP mathematics, the 10 LP computer science or Analysis/Linear Algebra cannot be bridged (engine rule E8 still to do; until then the student must check this). If a pre-graduation case (lit. a) also applies, the total workload of all conditions should not exceed 30 LP (Satz 4). FAQ: additional classes are to be taken in the first term.

descriptive_notes: Places are awarded by a ranking only if there are more eligible applicants than places (§ 1 Abs. 3); quotas: 40 % for foreign nationals/stateless applicants with foreign qualifications not equated with Germans, 60 % for all others.

Ranking (§ 4 Abs. 2, max 6 points): a) grade 1,00-1,5 = 4; 1,51-1,75 = 3,5; 1,76-2,0 = 3; 2,01-2,25 = 2,5; 2,26-2,5 = 2; 2,51-2,75 = 1,5; 2,76-3,0 = 1; 3,01-4,0 = 0. b) 1 point per relevant professional or scientific activity in Data Science or Machine Learning (work, internship, Bachelor's thesis; at least 3 months each), max 2, listed in the specific eligibility form with proof.
Ties: better grade first, then lot (§ 4 Abs. 1). Program page: about 30 places per year.

allowed_exemptions: first university degree in English from a country with English or German as an official language or from a country of the European Union (FAQ); course page: university degree obtained in an EU country or a country with English or German as the official language (within the last two years)
language_english.note: Zugangsordnung § 2 Abs. 3: English at level B2 (GeR); proof by a first degree in an English-language programme in a country with English or German as official language or in an EU country, or tests at B2 or higher (TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge, UNIcert, TOEIC, TELC, university language tests); other proofs allowed if sufficient. B2 proof not older than two years at application; proof above B2 not older than six years. FAQ: 'Level B2 in accordance with the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, CEFR.' Recognised tests (FAQ): TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge English Language Assessment, UNIcert, TOEIC, TELC, or a test of the University of Oldenburg Language Centre or another German university; 'Other confirmation and proof is permitted as long as that proof documents sufficient language proficiency.' B2 proof no older than two years, proof above B2 no older than six years at the time of application. Course page: 'The proof of language proficiency must be presented for the enrolment.'; the FAQ lists proof of English among the application documents. No minimum scores stated by the program. University of Oldenburg 'English Language Proficiency, Reference Table for different Verification Documents' (https://uol.de/fileadmin/studium/download/iamt/internationale-studierende/uni-oldenburg-reference-table-english-language.proficiency.pdf) maps B2 to IELTS 5.5-6.5 / TOEFL iBT 43-71 and C1 to IELTS 7.0-8.0 / TOEFL iBT 72-94; it is a general university table, not program-specific, so no score is stored. No IELTS/TOEFL minimum published (official FAQ 24.10.2026).

other_requirements: completed specific eligibility form (DSML)
Bachelor's degree certificate and/or transcript of records
proof of semesters studied so far
certified translations of documents not in German or English
international applicants apply via uni-assist
application before graduation possible with a transcript; in an ECTS system at most 30 ECTS may be missing at the time of application
requirements being completed in the final term: proof that the applicant is currently studying them, e.g. a short statement from the instructor
optional: employer references, internship or supervisor certificates and the Bachelor's thesis subject (ranking Category B)
no letters of recommendation or motivation required

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 30 April via uni-assist for foreign-quota applicants (§ 3 Abs. 2; general deadline 15 July); application from 15 March
non_eu_deadlines.summer: no first-semester admission (summer entry only with recognisable credits from a fitting Master's programme)

admission_regulation.version: Studienordnung MdU 13/2023 and Prüfungsordnung MdU 14/2023 (both of 03.03.2023), in force on the first day of the month after publication, applying first to the winter semester 2023/24 (StO § 13; PO § 28). The Faculty of Civil Engineering regulations page and the programme course-of-study page list no amendment to either document; the university-wide MdU announcement index was not located, so the amendment search is limited to these faculty listings.

accepted_degree_fields.note: StO § 2 Abs. 1: 'Als fachlich einschlägig gelten im Hauptfach belegte Studiengänge des Bauingenieurwesens, Maschinenbaus, Informatik, der Medieninformatik, sowie andere technisch-wissenschaftliche Studiengänge aus den Fachbereichen Ingenieurwesen oder Informatik.' Also accepted: a degree of a Verwaltungsfachhochschule or of a state or state-recognised Berufsakademie. 'Über die Vergleichbarkeit von Abschlüssen und Ausnahmen entscheidet der Prüfungsausschuss'. Course-of-study page: 'A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, mechanical engineering, applied computer science or a comparable degree'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: StO § 2 Abs. 1: first degree 'mit einer Gesamtbewertung von mind. 2,3 beendeter'. The regulation states no conversion method. Application page FAQ: 'Uni Assist calculates your final value, which is used for decisions'; the Bavarian formula is mentioned there only as a guiding value for self-estimation.

subject_credit_requirements.note: The regulation names no subject areas or credit amounts; relevance of the degree (StO § 2 Abs. 1) is decided by the Prüfungsausschuss. After admission the Auswahlkommission sets individual 'Fundamentals' modules for the Anpassungsqualifizierung (StO § 2 Abs. 6; § 6 Abs. 4: 18 LP, to be completed in the first three semesters; part of the 120 LP curriculum). Application page FAQ: 'Courses from online course providers, for example Coursera or LinkedIn Learning, are not considered'.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Zusatzleistungen (StO § 2 Abs. 1): the Prüfungsausschuss decides on comparability of degrees and exceptions and 'ggfs. von dem/der Bewerber*in zu erbringende Zusatzleistungen festlegen kann'; no cap stated. The 18 LP 'Fundamentals' (Auflagenmodule, StO § 6 Abs. 4 and Anlage) are a compulsory part of the curriculum for all students, set individually at admission, not a cap on missing entry requirements. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): allowed stored as false because no capped condition for missing subject credits exists and no subject items are stored (same handling as sibling record 4238).

descriptive_notes: A selection committee of two examiners (one each from Medieninformatik and Bauingenieurwesen) decides which applicants meet the requirements of StO § 2 Abs. 1-5 (StO § 2 Abs. 6).
If the committee cannot reach a clear decision from the documents, an interview may be held to clarify suitability (StO § 2 Abs. 5).

allowed_exemptions: native-speaker status: university entrance qualification or first professional degree acquired in an English-speaking country (StO § 2 Abs. 3); the application page excludes India and Pakistan from this rule
language_english.note: StO § 2 Abs. 3: English B2 (GER) via native-speaker status or 'TOEFL (Internet-based Score 85 oder besser)', 'Cambridge Certificate First Certificate in English (FCE)', 'IELTS, Band 6.5 (mind. 6.0 in jedem Teilbereich)' 'oder anhand eines gleichwertigen Nachweises'. PTE Academic min. 68 is from the application page only (not in the regulation). Application page: 'However, two exceptions of this rule are India and Pakistan.' (a degree from these countries does not count as native-speaker proof). C1 (IELTS 7,0, TOEFL iBT 94 or CAE) is required later for admission to the Master's thesis (StO § 7 Abs. 2; PO § 20 Abs. 2 Nr. 5). Application page: certificates should be 'no more than two years old'.

aps_certificate.note: Application page document table: APS certificate required for applicants who graduated outside Europe from China, India and Vietnam only; 'Please add your APS certificate during the application procedure. Your application will be rejected without this.' Not in the regulation.

other_requirements: if the first degree did not include a scientific final thesis, another scientific work written by the applicant must be submitted (StO § 2 Abs. 2); the application page requires the complete document (abstracts, shortened versions or excerpts lead to rejection)
one-page letter of motivation in English (StO § 2 Abs. 4)
Europass CV (application page)
application via uni-assist for applicants who graduated outside Europe
German A1 required for admission to the Master's thesis, not for admission to the programme (StO § 7 Abs. 3; PO § 20 Abs. 2 Nr. 6)

admission_regulation.version: Neufassung vom 15.05.2024, Amtliche Mitteilungen 43. Jahrgang 011/2024 (Fakultätsrat 13.03.2024, Präsidium 09.04.2024, MWK 02.05.2024); in force for the application round WS 2024/25; all earlier versions repealed (§ 8). German text read from the copy provided by Koushik on 15.10.2026.

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 2 Abs. 1 Satz 1: Bachelor (or equivalent) of at least 180 LP 'in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Elektrotechnik oder einem fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen informationstechnischen Studiengang mit überwiegenden technischen und informatischen Anteilen oder vergleichbarem anderen Studiengang'; foreign degrees outside Bologna states: equivalence per anabin. (The course page also names 'Ingenieurwissenschaften'; the Ordnung does not.) primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the Zugangsordnung (§ 2). The grade only gives ranking points (§ 4 Abs. 2: 90 × (4 − Note) / 3).

items.raw_label: a) mindestens 5 Leistungspunkte im Bereich der objektorientierten Modellierung und Programmierung (§ 2 Abs. 1 Satz 2)
b) mindestens 5 Leistungspunkte im Bereich Informationsverarbeitung (§ 2 Abs. 1 Satz 2)
c) mindestens 10 Leistungspunkte im Bereich Mathematik, insb. lineare Algebra und Analysis (§ 2 Abs. 1 Satz 2)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Zugangsordnung 15.05.2024 § 2 Abs. 1 Satz 2: 'Fachlich geeignet ist ein vorangegangenes Studium in der Regel, wenn das vorangegangene Studium Kompetenzen im Umfang von a) mindestens 5 Leistungspunkten im Bereich der objektorientierten Modellierung und Programmierung, b) mindestens 5 Leistungspunkten im Bereich Informationsverarbeitung sowie c) mindestens 10 Leistungspunkten im Bereich Mathematik, insb. lineare Algebra und Analysis vermittelt hat.' GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Informationsverarbeitung' stored as general_cs; 'insb.' -> general_mathematics (rule R6). FLAG (open decision): general_cs also contains programming, so one programming course could satisfy a) and b) until the engine assigns each course to one requirement (D13).

conditional_admission.mechanism: § 2 Abs. 2 Satz 1 lit. b: provisional access if subject content of 'nicht mehr als 12 Leistungspunkten' is missing; the missing competences must be made up 'innerhalb von maximal 4 Semestern nach Einschreibung … und vor Anmeldung der Masterarbeit' (Satz 3); otherwise exmatriculation (§ 6 Abs. 6). If several provisional cases apply (pre-graduation, missing content, missing language proof), the total workload of all conditions should not exceed 30 LP (§ 2 Abs. 4).

descriptive_notes: Ranking only if more eligible applicants than places (§ 1 Abs. 3); restricted admission.

Points (§ 4 Abs. 2): grade points = 90 × (4 − grade) / 3 (1,0 = 90; 2,0 = 60; 3,0 = 30; 4,0 = 0); relevant internships of at least 3 months = 10 points each; relevant work experience of at least 12 months = 20 points; subject-related experience abroad of at least 4 months during previous studies = 10 points; voluntary social activities of at least 6 months = 10 points. Ties: lot.
Study guidance page: the extra criteria are applied when there are more than 25 applications.

allowed_exemptions: first university degree in an English-language programme in a country with English or German as an official language (§ 2 Abs. 3 Satz 2)
language_english.due: at application; provisional access possible if the proof is expected within one semester (B2 by the end of the first semester, § 2 Abs. 3 Satz 7-8)
language_english.note: § 2 Abs. 3: English B2 (GeR), proof by such a degree or tests at B2 or higher (TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge, UNIcert, TOEIC, TELC, university language tests); other proofs allowed if sufficient; proof not older than 2 years at application; doubtful cases decided by the admissions committee. No minimum scores stated. Course page: 'Englischkenntnisse auf dem Niveau B2 gemäß des Gemeinsamen europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GeR)'; 'Sprachtest auf Niveau B2 ...' or 'wenn ein erster Hochschulabschluss in einem englischsprachigen Studiengang in einem Land mit Englisch oder Deutsch als Amtssprache erworben wurde (innerhalb der letzten 2 Jahre).' 'Der Nachweis der Sprachkenntnisse muss spätestens bei der Einschreibung vorliegen.' No minimum scores stated by the program. University of Oldenburg 'English Language Proficiency, Reference Table for different Verification Documents' (https://uol.de/fileadmin/studium/download/iamt/internationale-studierende/uni-oldenburg-reference-table-english-language.proficiency.pdf) maps B2 to IELTS 5.5-6.5 / TOEFL iBT 43-71 and C1 to IELTS 7.0-8.0 / TOEFL iBT 72-94; it is a general university table, not program-specific, so no score is stored. No IELTS/TOEFL minimum published (official application page 24.10.2026: B2).

other_requirements: applicants with an international Bachelor's degree apply via uni-assist (submission recommended by 31 May)
German-degree applicants: online application, then signed printed 'Bewerbungsantrag' with the other required documents sent to the University of Oldenburg

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 June for degrees from third countries (§ 3 Abs. 2: one month before the general 15 July deadline); via uni-assist, submission recommended by 31 May
non_eu_deadlines.summer: no admission (winter semester only)

items.raw_label: Grundlagen der Wirtschaftsinformatik, insbesondere Methoden und Theorien der Systemanalyse, der Anwendungssysteme, der IT-Sicherheit und der Kommunikationssysteme (GPO Anhang 6, Voraussetzungen; no credit number)

Beherrschung von grundlegenden Theorien und Methoden [der Mathematik,] der Statistik und der Empirie — part: Statistik und Empirie (GPO Anhang 6, Voraussetzungen; no credit number)

subject_credit_requirements.note: GPO Anhang 6 (as replaced by the Vierte Änderungsordnung 2024) lists the competences 'vorausgesetzt' for students enrolling in the programme, without credit numbers; all are stored presence-only (min_ects 0). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): Anhang 6 read as the 'erforderliche Kompetenzen' of GPO § 33 Abs. 4; category mapping is GPU-R policy. Two listed competences have no taxonomy category and are NOT stored: 'Kenntnisse in Public Management, insbesondere im Aufbau, zu den Trägerstrukturen und den Handlungsprinzipien des öffentlichen Sektors (d.h. in Politik und Verwaltung)' and 'Kenntnisse des Öffentlichen Rechts' (see DECISION in notes). Projektmanagement and Präsentationstechnik have no category and are only part of the label of the scientific-work item. English B2 is also listed there (see language_english). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): to stop one course from satisfying both the Wirtschaftsinformatik and the Informatik area, databases_systems and software_engineering are counted only for the Informatik area; the Wirtschaftsinformatik area is checked through IT-Sicherheit (it_security) and Kommunikationssysteme (computer_engineering). Systemanalyse and Anwendungssysteme have no taxonomy category. This is stricter than the regulation wording. Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: Grundlagen und Erfahrung mit Methoden der Wissenschaft, mit Projektmanagement, mit wissenschaftlichem Schreiben und mit Präsentationstechnik

conditional_admission.mechanism: Zulassung unter Auflagen (GPO § 33 Abs. 4): if the Prüfungsausschuss finds that 'erforderliche Kompetenzen aus einem Bachelorstudiengang' are not proven, it can admit under conditions; the outstanding work 'darf einen Umfang von 30 Leistungspunkten nicht überschreiten' and must be completed by registration of the Master's thesis. Rahmen-PO § 5 Abs. 3 (prevails in case of conflict): difference of 'höchstens 30 ECTS-Leistungspunkten', missing examinations to be passed by the end of the first year of study, otherwise enrolment is cancelled.

descriptive_notes: Only complete applications are assessed, in a standardised procedure set by the Prüfungsausschuss on the basis of the final grades of the previous degree (GPO § 33 Abs. 3).
The Prüfungsausschuss decides on the equivalence of foreign degrees and on which required competences are missing (GPO § 33 Abs. 1, 4; Rahmen-PO § 5 Abs. 1).

Admission regardless of the overall grade is possible for special subject-related reasons, e.g. a Bachelor thesis graded 'sehr gut' or at least one year of subject-related professional work (GPO § 33 Abs. 1 Satz 2-3).

language_english.note: GPO § 33 Abs. 2: for E-Government 'fundierte Englischkenntnisse' are required, proven by 'Level B2 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens'; the Prüfungsausschuss decides on exceptions. Anhang 6 also lists 'Englisch Qualifikation entsprechend des Europäischen Referenzrahmen Niveau B2'. Test scores only on the Fachbereich Informatik international page: 'TOEFL with at least 550 points (paper based), 213 points (computer based) or 79–80 points (internet based)', 'IELTS at level 6,5 or higher' or 'a corresponding certificate'; certificates are required for all applicants 'even if the previous periods of study were completed in the corresponding language'. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): toefl_ibt_min stored as 80, the upper end of the stated '79–80'. due: language certificates are listed among the uni-assist application documents.

aps_certificate.note: International Office uni-assist application page, document list: 'APS certificate (for applications from China, Mongolia, Vietnam and India)'. Not in the regulation.

other_requirements: application via uni-assist for applicants whose first degree / higher education entrance qualification was obtained outside Germany (International Office)
motivational letter (uni-assist document list)

school leaving certificate and university certificates/transcripts with an overview of subjects and grades; officially certified translations if not in English or German; the same page also says 'a sworn translation (by the Embassy or sworn notary) must be provided and uploaded!'; uncertified passport copy (uni-assist document list)

admission before graduation: possible if at least 150 LP are achieved and the average so far is at least 'gut' (2.5); missing requirements must be met by the end of the second Master's semester, otherwise re-enrolment is refused (GPO § 33 Abs. 5-6); Rahmen-PO § 5 Abs. 4 allows provisional admission only for University of Koblenz students who have registered their Bachelor thesis, once
personal laptop with a current Windows, macOS or Linux (programme page)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 June (non-EU citizens; non-EU students strongly advised to apply by 15 May because of visa processing)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 December (non-EU citizens; non-EU students strongly advised to apply by 15 November)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung über den Zugang und die Zulassung für den konsekutiven Masterstudiengang „Engineering of Socio-Technical Systems (M.Sc.)“ der Fakultät II – Informatik, Wirtschafts- und Rechtswissenschaften der Carl von Ossietzky Universität Oldenburg
admission_regulation.version: Neufassung vom 15.05.2024, Amtliche Mitteilungen 2024-012 (Fakultätsrat 13.03.2024, Präsidium 09.04.2024, MWK 02.05.2024); in force for the application round WS 2024/25; all earlier versions repealed (§ 9). German text read from the copy provided by Koushik on 15.10.2026.

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 2 Abs. 1 Satz 1: Bachelor (or equivalent) of at least 180 LP 'in einem fachlich geeigneten Studiengang der Informatik oder einer fachlich eng verwandten technischen Fachrichtung, in Wirtschaftsinformatik mit überwiegenden informatischen und technischen Anteilen, Psychologie oder Kognitionswissenschaften oder in einem anderen fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen Studiengang'; foreign degrees outside Bologna states per anabin. Only the Informatik profile (§ 2 Abs. 1 Satz 3-4) is stored as items. Psychology/cognitive science profile (Satz 2): at least 90 LP psychology/cognitive science, incl. 5 LP quantitative methods/statistics, 5 LP experimental psychology, 6 LP general/cognitive psychology, 5 LP biological psychology/neuroscience.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the Zugangsordnung (§ 2). The grade only gives ranking points (§ 4 Abs. 2: 90 × (4 − Note) / 3).

items.raw_label: mindestens 6 Leistungspunkte in den Bereichen mathematische Grundlagen der Informatik (§ 2 Abs. 1 Satz 3)
6 Leistungspunkte in Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen (§ 2 Abs. 1 Satz 3)
6 Leistungspunkte in Programmierung (§ 2 Abs. 1 Satz 3)
6 Leistungspunkte in Softwaretechnik (§ 2 Abs. 1 Satz 3)
6 Leistungspunkte der Technischen Informatik (§ 2 Abs. 1 Satz 3)
Kenntnisse der Signal- und Bildverarbeitung im Umfang von mind. 4 Leistungspunkten (§ 2 Abs. 1 Satz 4)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Zugangsordnung 15.05.2024 § 2 Abs. 1 Satz 3: an Informatik / Wirtschaftsinformatik / related degree is fachlich geeignet 'wenn Kompetenzen im Umfang von mindestens 6 Leistungspunkten in den Bereichen mathematische Grundlagen der Informatik, 6 Leistungspunkte in Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen, 6 Leistungspunkte in Programmierung, 6 Leistungspunkte in Softwaretechnik sowie 6 Leistungspunkte der Technischen Informatik vermittelt worden sind.' Satz 4: 'Die nachgewiesenen Kompetenzen … müssen Kenntnisse der Signal- und Bildverarbeitung im Umfang von mind. 4 Leistungspunkten enthalten.' GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): Signal- und Bildverarbeitung stored as graphics_visual_computing (covers image processing; signal processing has no CS taxonomy category, so a pure signal-processing course is not counted — stricter). § 7: the admissions committee may additionally assign foundation modules in the study entry phase (curriculum, not an admission check).

conditional_admission.mechanism: § 2 Abs. 2 Satz 1 lit. b: provisional access if subject content of 'nicht mehr als 30 Leistungspunkten' is missing; missing competences must be made up 'innerhalb der Regelstudienzeit und vor Anmeldung zur Masterarbeit' (Satz 3); otherwise exmatriculation (§ 6 Abs. 6). If pre-graduation access (lit. a) also applies, the total workload of all conditions should not exceed 30 LP (Satz 4).

descriptive_notes: Ranking only if more eligible applicants than places (§ 1 Abs. 3); limited places.

Points (§ 4 Abs. 2): grade points = 90 × (4 − grade) / 3 (1,0 = 90; 2,0 = 60; 3,0 = 30; 4,0 = 0); relevant internships of at least 3 months = 10 points each; relevant work experience of at least 12 months = 20 points; experience abroad of at least 6 months during previous studies = 10 points. Ties: lot.
Study entry phase (§ 7): the admissions committee may name foundation modules to be taken in the first semester.

allowed_exemptions: first university degree in an English-language programme (§ 2 Abs. 3 Satz 2)
language_english.due: at application (§ 3 Abs. 3 lit. b: language proof is part of the application); course page: by enrolment
language_english.note: § 2 Abs. 3: 'ausreichende Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache auf dem Niveau B2'; proof by a first degree in an English-language programme or tests at B2 or higher; other proofs allowed if sufficient. CONFLICT: the English course page (changed 03 Aug 2026) says C1, the German course page and programme information page say B2; the regulation (B2) is stored (rule: regulation wins). No minimum scores stated.  Official programme page (24.10.2026): English C1 (MyGU still shows B2) — C1 stored. No test scores published (official page, MyGU).

other_requirements: completed form for the application documents
provisional admission possible if the English proof is expected within two semesters of enrolling (course page)
German-degree applicants: online application, then signed printed 'Bewerbungsantrag' with the other required documents sent to the University of Oldenburg

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 June for degrees from third countries (§ 3 Abs. 2: one month before the general 15 July); the program's deadline overview names 30 April via uni-assist — check the current page
non_eu_deadlines.summer: no first-semester admission (2024/25 deadline overview lists summer only for transferring students)

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Master-Studiengänge am Campus Sankt Augustin der Hochschule Bonn-Rhein-Sieg (Fachbereich Informatik, incl. Master-Studiengang „Game Technologies“) vom 28.11.2024, § 48 (Zugangsvoraussetzungen Master Game Technologies) with § 3, as amended by the 1. Änderungsordnung vom 22.05.2025
admission_regulation.version: PO vom 28.11.2024 in der Fassung der 1. Änderungsordnung vom 22.5.2025, Amtliche Bekanntmachung der Hochschule Bonn-Rhein-Sieg, laufende Nummer 24/2025, Sankt Augustin 10.11.2025 (consolidated text; §§ 3, 32, 48 read in German from the copy provided by Koushik on 15.10.2026). Original PO: Amtliche Bekanntmachungen 02/2025.

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 32 Abs. 1: 'Voraussetzung für die Zulassung zum Master-Studium sind ein berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss) in einem Fach, in dem der Informatikanteil mindestens 120 ECTS-Leistungspunkte betrug … sowie hinreichende Kompetenzen hinsichtlich Konzepten, Methoden und Werkzeugen der Informatik.' Satz 2: with a degree in Informatik or a mathematics/natural-science, engineering or economics programme and an Informatik share of at least 90 but less than 120 ECTS, admission 'mit der Maßgabe, dass sie oder er zusätzlich individuell festzulegende Studienleistungen im Umfang der Differenz aus den geforderten 120 ECTS-Leistungspunkten und den bislang im Bereich Informatik vorliegenden ECTS-Leistungspunkten erbringt' (set by the Auswahlausschuss). § 48 Abs. 3: 'bei einen Informatikanteil von mindestens 120 ECTS-Leistungspunkten die Note … 3,0 oder besser'; 'bei mindestens 90 ECTS-Leistungspunkten, aber weniger als 120 ECTS-Leistungspunkten die Note … 2,5 oder besser'; 'Der Auswahlausschuss kann in begründeten Ausnahmefällen von der gegebenen Grenze von 90 ECTS-Leistungspunkten abweichen.' The thresholds are absolute ECTS figures (not percentages); the '(about 67 % / 50 %)' on the admission page is only illustrative. This record is route T1 (Informatik share at least 120 ECTS, grade 3,0 or better); route T2 is 10332_T2.

grade_requirement.note: PO § 48 Abs. 3 Satz 1: with an Informatik share of at least 120 ECTS 'die Note des berufsqualifizierenden Abschlusses 3,0 oder besser'. No conversion method is stated in the PO; the admission page links a Bavarian-formula conversion tool.

items.raw_label: Informatikanteil mindestens 120 ECTS-Leistungspunkte (PO § 32 Abs. 1 Satz 1, § 48 Abs. 3 Satz 1; route T1)

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO § 32 Abs. 1 / § 48 Abs. 3 (absolute ECTS). The PO does not define which modules count as Informatik. Students with 90 to under 120 ECTS Informatik fall under route T2 (grade 2,5 and make-up conditions).

conditional_admission.mechanism: Route T1 (at least 120 ECTS Informatik, grade 3,0 or better, PO § 48 Abs. 3 Satz 1): no conditions; applicants with 90-119 ECTS Informatik use route T2 (§ 32 Abs. 1 Satz 2).

descriptive_notes: § 48 Abs. 6: the Auswahlausschuss compiles a qualified list from the written application documents, considering 'den Umfang und die Relevanz der informatikbezogenen Inhalte sowie die Noten der qualifizierenden Zugangsberechtigung'; the best-placed applicants are admitted within capacity. Admission page: 'If all admission requirements are met, the selection committee will compile a qualified list based on the uploaded application documents. The qualification takes into account the scope and relevance of the computer science-related content as well as the grades of the qualifying university degree. The first-ranked applicants will be admitted to the available places.'
The university does not evaluate certificates before the application ('We appreciate your understanding not being able to evaluate your certificates beforehand.').

allowed_exemptions: secondary school-leaving certificate certifying English at level B2 (usually EU/EEA or German certificates, e.g. Abitur)
medium of instruction (MOI) of English-language secondary school-leaving certificate or university degree
language_english.note: PO § 48 Abs. 4: English 'auf dem Niveau B2 (GER)' (§ 3 Abs. 5: the university provides the conversion scheme for TOEFL/IELTS etc.). Admission-requirements page: 'English language skills must be at least level B2 (CEFR)'; accepted proofs include 'medium of instruction (MOI) of English-language secondary school-leaving certificate or university degree' or a 'certificate of an accepted English test'. H-BRS language centre list, B2 group: IELTS Academic ≥ 5.5, PTE Academic ≥ 59; TOEFL iBT ≥ 4 (new score scale) or ≥ 72 (previous score scale); the 'Management Sciences only' footnote (single asterisk) belongs to BEC, the TOEFL double asterisk is 'ETS / TOEFL Institution Code: 7977'. toefl_ibt_min stores the previous-scale value 72. 'No German language certificate is required.'

aps_certificate.note: Admission-requirements page, application documents: 'APS certificate if you acquired your university degree in China, India, or Vietnam'.

other_requirements: qualifying degree completed by 30 September ('Admission is only possible if you have completed your qualifying degree by 30 September.')
current curriculum vitae (CV) in tabular form
letter of motivation (self-written, maximum 2 pages), focusing on motivation for studying with an emphasis on technical/scientific foundations of game development
university degree certificate including final transcript of records (international grade reports in original language with German or English translation and grading system)
applicants with a visa requirement and a degree from abroad who do not yet have a visa apply exclusively via uni-assist

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 February (application period 15 November to 15 February via uni-assist for applicants with a visa requirement who do not yet have a visa; others 15 November to 15 September via Apollo)

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung des Fachbereichs Angewandte Informatik der Hochschule Fulda – University of Applied Sciences für den Master-Studiengang Global Software Development (SPO 2020), § 2 Zugangsvoraussetzungen, Zulassung
admission_regulation.version: SPO vom 22.01.2020 (AM 23-2020, published 29.09.2020, in force 01.10.2020) as amended six times: 1. Änderung 14.04.2021 (AM 51-2021), 2. Änderung 19.10.2022 (AM 2-2023), 3. Änderung 16.11.2022 (AM 62-2023), 4. Änderung 12.04.2023 (AM 63-2023), 5. Änderung 17.01.2024 (AM 32-2024 vom 14.06.2024, in force WS 2024/25), 6. Änderung 16.10.2024 (AM 21-2025 vom 15.04.2025, Präsidium 25.02.2025, in force 'mit Wirkung zum Wintersemester 2025/26'). Combined text read from the official Nichtamtliche Lesefassung (incl. all six amendments) as fallback, because the binding original AM 23-2020 and amendments 1-4 were not located (Amtliche Mitteilungen listing shows 2024 onward only). Binding amendments 5 and 6 opened: the 6th changes admission (new § 2 Abs. 1 Sätze 10-11: German A1; § 3 German proof as application document); the 5th adds the sentence on winter-semester start to § 2 Abs. 2 (no change to admission criteria). ABPO 2018 is cited only in § 9 Abs. 1 (§ 20 Abs. 3 ABPO, not admission).

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'Der Abschluss eines Hochschulstudiums der Informatik oder eines Informatik-nahen Faches an einer deutschen Hochschule oder an einer vergleichbaren ausländischen Hochschule' of at least a) six semesters and 180 ECTS or b) seven semesters and 210 ECTS (foreign degrees: equivalent to at least three or three and a half years of German study). Three-semester variant (90 ECTS) for 210-ECTS degrees, four-semester variant (120 ECTS) for 180-ECTS degrees (§ 1 Abs. 3, § 4 Abs. 1-2). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'Der Notendurchschnitt muss mindesten 2,5 oder besser bzw. 75% der maximal erreichbaren Leistungen entsprechen.' (typo 'mindesten' in the source). The alternative '75% der maximal erreichbaren Leistungen' is stated in the regulation; the SPO states no conversion method. Master application page (international transcripts): uni-assist 'converts the foreign grade into the German grading system'.

items.raw_label: ausreichende Kompetenzen aus dem Bereich der Angewandten Informatik (subject of the Eignungsprüfung, § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3; examples given 'wie z. B. Programmierung, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen, Software Engineering und Datenbanken')

subject_credit_requirements.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: subject aptitude is proven in an Eignungsprüfung run by the Fachbereich Angewandte Informatik: 'Diese Fachkenntnisse umfassen ausreichende Kompetenzen aus dem Bereich der Angewandten Informatik wie z. B. Programmierung, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen, Software Engineering und Datenbanken sowie aus Anwendungsbereichen wie zum Beispiel Kommunikationssysteme, Medieninformatik, betrieblichen Anwendungen oder eingebetteten Systeme.' No credit numbers are stated. 'Anwendungsbereiche' has no taxonomy category and is not stored as an item. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): Angewandte Informatik is checked as one presence-only item (same treatment as sibling record 8953); the examples introduced with 'wie z. B.' are not separate checks. The regulation itself checks these competences through the aptitude test, which the Studiengangsleitung may waive for degrees from ECTS countries.

conditional_admission.mechanism: The SPO contains no provision for admission with conditions (Auflagen) for missing subject competences (checked in the Lesefassung incl. all amendments). The 180 vs 210 ECTS difference is handled by the four-semester (120 ECTS) variant (§ 1 Abs. 3, § 4 Abs. 2), not by conditions.

descriptive_notes: Aptitude test (Eignungsprüfung, SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3) run by the Department of Applied Computer Science on applied computer science (e.g. programming, algorithms and data structures, software engineering, databases) and application areas (e.g. communication systems, media informatics, business applications, embedded systems). Master application page: online test, usually mid-July for winter and mid-December for summer applicants; invitation and sample test sent by email about two weeks before.
The aptitude test can be waived for applicants with a degree from a country where ECTS standards apply; the Studiengangsleitung decides (SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3).

Master application page: admitted applicants who cannot take up the place may obtain a place within the two subsequent semesters (new application) without retaking the online test; changed admission requirements must still be met.

language_english.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 4: 'Es müssen qualifizierte englische Sprachkenntnisse, die in der Regel durch einen TOEFL-Test (computer based mindestens 213 Punkte, paper based mindestens 550 Punkte, Internet-based mindestens 85 Punkte) nachgewiesen werden. Ersatzweise wird auch ein IELTS-Test mit einem Ergebnis von Band 6,5 und höher akzeptiert.' § 3 lists 'Nachweis der englischen Sprachkompetenz' among the application documents. No CEFR level, exemption or Medium-of-Instruction rule stated.

language_german.required_level: A1 (CEFR); Goethe/telc/ÖSD/ECL A1, or DSH1 or TestDaF at least TDN 3; only for applicants whose Hochschulzugangsberechtigung was not obtained at a German-language institution
language_german.due: at application

aps_certificate.note: Master application page (international transcripts): additional information for applications with documents from China, Vietnam and India — APS certificate of the respective German embassy required. Not in the SPO.

other_requirements: aptitude test (Eignungsprüfung), see selection notes

application documents (SPO § 3): 'Tabellarischer Lebenslauf auf einer Seite inkl. eines Passfotos (4cm x 5 cm)', proof of English and German language skills, secondary school leaving certificate, degree certificate of the first degree, final certificate of the first degree with complete list of all subjects and grades incl. the grading system used
application via uni-assist for foreign first degrees (master application page)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 May to 31 May (all other nationals with a foreign first degree)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 November to 1 December (all other nationals with a foreign first degree)

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung des Fachbereichs 2: Informatik und Ingenieurwissenschaften – Computer Science and Engineering der Frankfurt University of Applied Sciences für den Master-Studiengang High Integrity Systems vom 29. Mai 2019, § 3 Zulassungsvoraussetzungen
admission_regulation.version: PO vom 29.05.2019 (published 12.09.2019, in force 01.10.2019 / WS 2019/20) i.d.F. der Änderung vom 29. Oktober 2025 (RSO 1751, 01.12.2025) — official Nichtamtliche Lesefassung 'PO MA HIS Lesefassung i.d.F.d.Änd. vom 29.10.2025' (official Lesefassungen page). Amendments in its table: 21.10.2020 (RSO 1120), 27.10.2021 (RSO 1291), 01.11.2023 (RSO 1511, Präsidium 04.12.2023, published 19.12.2023; changes § 3 Abs. 3 Satz 3 only), 19.06.2024 (RSO 1591, Präsidium 29.07.2024, published 20.08.2024; no change to § 3), 29.10.2025 (RSO 1751, Präsidium 01.12.2025, published 03.12.2025; CHANGES ADMISSION: rewrites § 3 — 70 % Informatik share for every degree with at least 180 ECTS, English exemptions reduced to two (§ 3 Abs. 2), second route reworded to 'Gesamtnote schlechter als 1,8 und besser oder gleich 2,5', Bachelor thesis added as proof of besondere Qualifikation). The binding RSO-1751 PDF was not opened (URL too long for the fetch tool); the Lesefassung states no in-force date or transition clause for it. The binding original texts were not opened separately (Lesefassung used).

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 3 Abs. 1 (i.d.F. der Änderung vom 29.10.2025): the applicant must hold 'einen ersten berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschluss in einem mindestens sechssemestrigen Hochschulstudiengang' 'mit mindestens 180 ECTS-Punkten (Credit Points) erworben hat, dessen Informatikanteil mindestens 70%' 'der in diesem Studiengang möglichen ECTS-Punkte (Credit Points) beträgt.' No degree field is named; the 70 % Informatik share applies to every degree. Route split (GPU-R ids): this record 3903_DIRECT is the regular route of § 3 Abs. 1 (grade 'mindestens 1,8'). The other route, 3903_CONDITIONAL, covers § 3 Abs. 5-6: 'Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit einer Gesamtnote schlechter als 1,8 und besser oder gleich 2,5' 'können nach der Maßgabe des Absatzes 6 zugelassen werden.' — i.e. if they prove a besondere Qualifikation (§ 3 Abs. 6). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: PO § 3 Abs. 1: 'Die Note des Hochschulabschlusses muss mindestens 1,8 betragen.' Program page: 'The minimum grade is 1.8.' No conversion method for foreign grades is stated. Grades worse than 1,8 and up to 2,5 are handled by route 3903_CONDITIONAL (PO § 3 Abs. 5-6 i.d.F. 29.10.2025).

items.raw_label: ersten berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschluss in einem mindestens sechssemestrigen Hochschulstudiengang mit mindestens 180 ECTS-Punkten (Credit Points) …, dessen Informatikanteil mindestens 70% der in diesem Studiengang möglichen ECTS-Punkte (Credit Points) beträgt (PO § 3 Abs. 1 i.d.F. der Änderung vom 29.10.2025); stored as min_ects 126: GPU-R arithmetic (70 % of 180), not regulation wording

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO § 3 Abs. 1 (i.d.F. der Änderung vom 29.10.2025, RSO 1751) requires 'einen ersten berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschluss in einem mindestens sechssemestrigen Hochschulstudiengang' 'mit mindestens 180 ECTS-Punkten (Credit Points) erworben hat, dessen Informatikanteil mindestens 70%' 'der in diesem Studiengang möglichen ECTS-Punkte (Credit Points) beträgt.' The 70 % share applies to every degree; the former alternative 'in der Fachrichtung Informatik' was deleted by the 2025 amendment. Program page (EN): 'a university degree with at least 180 ECTS credits, of which at least 70% must be in computer science'; regulation and program page now agree. The regulation states a percentage of the applicant's own degree, not a fixed number. GPU-R arithmetic (70 % of 180), not regulation wording: the engine cannot compute a percentage of the student's total, so the item stores 70 % of the minimum 180 ECTS = 126 ECTS. For degrees with more than 180 ECTS (e.g. 240) the true 70 % figure is higher (168 for 240), so 126 is more lenient for such degrees (see DECISION in notes).

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: the PO contains no provision for admission with Auflagen for missing subject content. (The route name 'CONDITIONAL' in the GPU-R id refers to the route for grades worse than 1,8 and up to 2,5 (§ 3 Abs. 5-6), which is not admission with conditions.)

descriptive_notes: PO § 3 Abs. 3: the Prüfungsausschuss selects applicants on the basis of the application documents (proof of the requirements, CV, motivation letter), using an evaluation scheme it sets ('Der Prüfungsausschuss legt ein Schema für die Bewertung der Bewerbungsunterlagen fest, anhand dessen die Entscheidung über die Zulassung getroffen wird.').
Applicants with a grade worse than 1,8 and up to 2,5 are not covered by this route; see the separate route record 3903_CONDITIONAL (PO § 3 Abs. 5-6).
Program page (DE): applications for WS 2027/28 'voraussichtlich ab Juni 2027 möglich'; this sits next to the international deadline of 15 April — check the program page before applying.

allowed_exemptions: first degree (§ 3 Abs. 1) obtained in the English-speaking area (PO § 3 Abs. 2 a)
first degree contains at least 30 ECTS of English-taught modules (PO § 3 Abs. 2 b)
language_english.note: PO § 3 Abs. 2 (i.d.F. der Änderung vom 29.10.2025): proof by a 'Sprachtest (z. B. TOEFL, IELTS,' 'Cambridge Certificate)' or another proof showing at least B2 (GER), 'nicht älter als drei Jahre'; no proof is needed if the first degree was obtained '… im englischen Sprachraum' (a) or contains 'einen Anteil von mindestens 30' 'ECTS-Punkten an englischsprachigen Modulen' (b). No test scores are stated in the PO or on the program page. University PDF 'Englisch-Sprachnachweise für Master-Studiengänge' (WS 26/27 and SoSe 27): High Integrity Systems Niveau B2; 'Der Nachweis darf nicht älter als 3 Jahre sein'; not accepted: self-tests, placement tests, tests of private providers, TOEFL Essentials, TOEFL ITP and the DAAD-Test; single language modules are not sufficient. International admission page: English proof must be submitted 'bei der Bewerbung'. Medium of Instruction is not mentioned. CONFLICT: the university's Englisch-Sprachnachweise PDF (WS 26/27, SoSe 27) still accepts native-language proof, but the regulation (§ 3 Abs. 2 i.d.F. 29.10.2025) no longer has a native-language exemption; the regulation value is stored. MyGermanUniversity (checked 24.10.2026): IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 79, Cambridge B2 First.

aps_certificate.note: International admission page (Internationale Zulassung): 'APS-Zertifikat (mit Zeugnissen aus China, Indien und Vietnam)'. Not in the PO.

other_requirements: Lebenslauf covering study and professional career up to the application date (PO § 3 Abs. 3 Nr. 2)
Motivationsschreiben stating the particular interest in the Master's programme High Integrity Systems and the applicant's own qualification for it (PO § 3 Abs. 3 Nr. 3)
application via uni-assist for international applicants (program page; international admission page)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 April (international applicants; application period January – 15 April)

admission_regulation.title: Studienordnung für den konsekutiven Studiengang Human-Computer Interaction mit dem Abschluss Master of Science (MdU 29/2019), § 3 Zulassungsvoraussetzungen, together with the Prüfungsordnung für den konsekutiven Studiengang Human-Computer Interaction mit dem Abschluss Master of Science (MdU 28/2019), § 13
admission_regulation.version: Studienordnung MdU 29/2019 and Prüfungsordnung MdU 28/2019 (both dated 1 July 2019), in force on the first day of the month after publication, applying first to students starting in WS 2019/20 (StO § 9, PO § 26). The faculty page 'Organizational matters' lists them as the current regulations (from WS 2019/20) and lists no amendment.

accepted_degree_fields.note: StO § 3 Abs. 1: 'ein Abschluss Bachelor of Science mit mindestens der Note „gut“ in den Studiengängen Mensch-Computer-Interaktion (Human-Computer Interaction HCI) oder Medieninformatik oder ein vom zuständigen Prüfungsausschuss als fachlich einschlägig anerkannter, erster berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss' (also Verwaltungsfachhochschule / Berufsakademie). § 3 Abs. 2: 'Als fachlich einschlägig gelten i.d.R. im Hauptfach belegte Studiengänge der Mensch-Computer Interaktion (Human-Computer Interaction), der Medieninformatik und der Informatik sowie andere technischwissenschaftliche Studiengänge mit HCI-Bezug und Informatikanteilen.' Application page: 'Bachelor of Science degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science or a related technical-scientific field that contains sufficient numbers of courses in computer science and HCI.' FAQ: students from other technical areas 'need to have completed around half of their classes in CS-related subjects' (approximate; not stored as a check). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: StO § 3 Abs. 1: Bachelor of Science 'mit mindestens der Note „gut“'. PO § 13 Abs. 1 defines '1,6 bis 2,5 gut'; only the first decimal place counts (§ 13 Abs. 3). Application page (non-German applicants): converted credit-weighted average 'at least 2.0 in the German system' = 'your chances of acceptance are very good'. FAQ: 'if your grade is below satisfactory (2.5 or worse in the German system), we need very strong evidence for "other qualifications" to consider your application.' If criteria are not or only partly met, the Prüfungsausschuss decides case by case (StO § 3 Abs. 3). No conversion method stated. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): the hard limit 2.5 is stricter than the regulation, which lets the Prüfungsausschuss review applications case by case when criteria are not or only partly met ('unterliegt der Antrag der Einzelfallprüfung durch den Prüfungsausschuss', StO § 3 Abs. 3).

subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject item is checked (Koushik's decision N-61, 16.10.2026). StO § 3 Abs. 2: 'Weiterhin müssen grundlegende Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Mensch-Maschine-Interaktion, Usability, Wahrnehmung und Kognition nachgewiesen werden. Der Nachweis erfolgt in der Regel durch eine erfolgreiche Teilnahme an entsprechenden Lehrveranstaltungen im Rahmen des Bachelorstudiums im Umfang von mindestens 6 Leistungspunkten (LP).' Because the 6 LP are only the usual proof ('in der Regel') and StO § 3 Abs. 3 lets the Prüfungsausschuss review any unmet criterion case by case and set Zusatzleistungen, the HCI knowledge is shown as information, not as a hard check. The regulation states no credit number for computer science; for Informatik degrees no CS share is required, other technical degrees need 'Informatikanteile' (FAQ: 'around half of their classes in CS-related subjects', approximate — not stored). FAQ: 'You definitely need solid programming skills'.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Zusatzleistungen (StO § 3 Abs. 3): 'Sind die erforderlichen Kriterien nicht oder nur teilweise erfüllt, unterliegt der Antrag der Einzelfallprüfung durch den Prüfungsausschuss, und der Bewerber/die Bewerberin kann in Abhängigkeit der Qualifikation zugelassen werden. Ein Anspruch auf Zulassung besteht in diesem Falle nicht. Gegebenenfalls kann der Prüfungsausschuss vom Bewerber/von der Bewerberin zu erbringende Zusatzleistungen festlegen.' No cap stated. FAQ: 'we may accept you with stipulations of doing extra courses/credits'; 'With more than one extra course, you will most likely need at least five semesters.' GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): because § 3 Abs. 3 covers any criterion not or only partly met and states no cap, conditions are not used to bridge subject shortfalls in the check (same treatment as 4238); the committee may still admit with Zusatzleistungen (see DECISION).

descriptive_notes: Basic knowledge of HCI, usability, perception and cognition is expected, as a rule shown by bachelor courses of at least 6 LP (StO § 3 Abs. 2); not checked by GPU-R — applicants without such courses are reviewed case by case and may get Zusatzleistungen (§ 3 Abs. 3).

FAQ: 'We are looking for bright students.' 'Excellent grades are a very good indicator, but not the only one.' Other factors: closeness of the degree to the entry requirements, grades in relevant classes, English scores above the minimum, and other qualifications such as internships or publications.

Motivation letter (StO § 3 Abs. 5): in English, about 2-4 pages, on the motivation for the HCI Master and the academic and professional/practical background (e.g. HCI projects, internships, student engagement, scientific work), documented where possible.

If the admission criteria are not or only partly met, the Prüfungsausschuss reviews the case individually and may admit, possibly with supplementary courses (Zusatzleistungen); there is no entitlement to admission (StO § 3 Abs. 3).

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or first professional degree acquired in an English-speaking country (StO § 3 Abs. 4 Nr. 1)
language_english.note: StO § 3 Abs. 4: B2 (GER) via native-speaker proof or 'IELTS Band 6,5 oder besser, TOEFL Internet-based Score 85 oder besser, Cambridge Certificate (B2 First (FCE)) oder anhand eines gleichwertigen Nachweises'. Application page: IELTS 6.5 '(maximum 1 test component 6.0, none 5.5)'; TOEFL computer-based 213; PTE '68 points minimum (changing to 70 minimum for the upcoming intake for SS 2027)'; certificate 'should not be more than 2 years old'; exemption for a Bachelor's degree 'in a native English-speaking country (US, CAN, UK, NZ, AUS, ...)'. pte_min stores 70: 68 until WS 2026/27, 70 from SS 2027 (application page); the next intake is SS 2027. FAQ: 'The teaching language is NOT sufficient for us.' C1 English is required later for registration of the Master's thesis (PO § 16 Abs. 1 Nr. 5).

März 2023
admission_regulation.version: SPO vom 15.10.2024, in force 15.10.2024, applies first to students starting in the summer semester 2025 (§ 14); replaces the SPO of 23.01.2008 as amended by the fifth Änderungssatzung of 10.12.2013. No amendment of the SPO 2024 found (the THA regulations pages list none; only a study plan 'SPO 2025' dated 28.03.2025, which does not change admission). Eignungsfeststellungssatzung of 28.03.2023 (amendments not searched separately).

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 1: Bachelor's degree from a German Hochschule or Universität 'informationstechnischer oder technischer Ausrichtung oder eines betriebswirtschaftlichen Studienganges mit technischer Ausrichtung mit mindestens 210 ECTS-Kreditpunkten'; Satz 4: degrees recognised as equivalent are admitted under the same rules; Satz 3: applicants who do not meet the criteria may be admitted 'in Ausnahmefällen' by the Prüfungskommission. The Zulassungskommission decides 'nach pflichtgemäßem Ermessen' (§ 3 Abs. 2). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: SPO § 3 Abs. 1: 'mit überdurchschnittlichem Erfolg (Prüfungsgesamtnote 2,3 oder besser)' = admission; 'Liegt die Abschlussnote des Vorstudiums zwischen 2,3 und 2,6, erfolgt die Zulassung nach bestandenem Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren entsprechend Anhang A.5' (interview). Program page: 'grade average of at least 2,6 in accordance with the German grading system'. 2.6 is the limit for being able to apply; 2.3 or better avoids the interview. No conversion method for foreign grades is stated in the SPO or on the program page.

subject_credit_requirements.note: The SPO sets no subject-credit requirement; it requires only a Bachelor's degree of information-technology or technical orientation (or a technology-oriented business degree).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen for subject gaps. SPO § 3 Abs. 6-7 'Nachqualifikation' applies only to applicants with at least 180 but fewer than 210 CP (total-credit shortfall, see other_requirements): missing competences in the scope of the missing CP within the first year after enrolment; enrolment 'unter Vorbehalt'.

descriptive_notes: IMPORTANT: German B1 is MANDATORY at application (SPO § 3 Abs. 3). Only the 'International' track is taught in English (with a compulsory German course each semester); the Safety/Security tracks are 50 % German and need B2 (programme flyer, DAAD).

Aptitude procedure (SPO § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 2, Anhang A.5): applicants with a final grade between 2,3 and 2,6 are admitted only after passing a 20-minute admission interview at Hochschule Augsburg: a 10-minute short presentation on an industrial-safety topic announced at least two weeks before, and a 10-minute technical discussion; each part scored on subject competence, intellectual abilities, and cooperation/communication (0-4 points each, max 12 per part). Admission requires at least 17 of 24 points.
Applicants with a grade of 2,3 or better are admitted without the interview (SPO § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 1).

The Zulassungskommission decides on the qualification requirements at its dutiful discretion; the Prüfungskommission may admit applicants who do not meet the criteria in exceptional cases (SPO § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 3, Abs. 2).
A failed aptitude procedure can be repeated once within one year (Eignungsfeststellungssatzung of 28.03.2023, § 17 Abs. 3 with § 8).

Track depends on German level: with German B1 the admission is to the 'International' track (taught in English, a German course of 5 ECTS each semester per the program page); the 'Safety' and 'Security' tracks are taught 50 % German / 50 % English and switching to them requires German B2 by the end of the first semester (SPO § 3 Abs. 3, § 4 Abs. 3).

language_english.note: SPO § 3 Abs. 3: 'Mindestniveau B1 (siehe Anhang A.6) für die deutsche und B2 für die englische Sprache'; accepted English certificates are those of the annex to the THA Immatrikulationssatzung (not opened). Scores from the program page (B2 examples): TOEFL iBT '80 – 94', IELTS 'at least 6.5 overall (with at least 5.5 in each band)', TOEIC listening 430-485 / reading 400-450, PTE Academic '65 - 75'; 'Your test results must be less than two years old'; 'Proof of language proficiency has to be submitted togehter with the official application'; course certificates from individual language schools not accepted. No English exemption or MOI rule is stated.

language_german.due: at application

other_requirements: German B1 (SPO Anhang A.6: DSH at least Stufe 1; TestDaF at least Stufe 3 in all 4 parts and at least 12 points overall; telc Deutsch B1 Hochschule; Goethe Zertifikat B1; program page also lists telc Deutsch B1, DSD I (B1) ('Kultusministerkonferenz Deutsches Sprachdiplom - Erste Stufe DSD I Niveau B1'), ÖSD Zertifikat B1, DTZ B1); exempt: applicants from Austria and German-speaking Switzerland and international applicants with a German-taught Bachelor's degree (SPO § 3 Abs. 3)

applicants with at least 180 but fewer than 210 CP can be admitted and must make up the missing competences in the scope of the missing CP within the first year after enrolment (Nachqualifikation; missing practical competences by a practical activity equivalent to a practical semester); six-semester degrees without CP or with a different grading system count as 180 CP (SPO § 3 Abs. 6-7)

Juni 2026
admission_regulation.version: FPSO vom 28.03.2024 (amtlich veröffentlicht 28.03.2024, in force 01.04.2024, for study start from WS 2024/25) as amended by the Änderungssatzung vom 23.06.2026 (No. 2026-043, amtlich veröffentlicht 23.06.2026, in force 01.09.2026). The amendment changes admission: § 36 and Anlage 2 (Eignungsverfahren) are replaced; the new Anlage 2 applies to all students starting from the summer semester 2027 (§ 2 Satz 3), i.e. to the current application round (1 Oct - 30 Nov 2026). Values read from the binding Änderungssatzung and checked against the official reading version (Lesbare Fassung, 'Verbindlich ist allein die amtlich veröffentlichte Version').

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPSO § 36 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 (i.d.F. 23.06.2026): at least six-semester qualified Bachelor's degree or equivalent 'in Information Engineering oder Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik oder vergleichbaren Studiengängen'; § 36 Abs. 2: qualified if there are no essential differences in competences in the elementary subject groups of Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2. Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2 has two alternative reference profiles: (A) TUM Bachelor Information Engineering (stored as items) and (B) TUM Bachelor Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik: Informatik at least 24 credits (max. 15 points), theoretische Informationstechnik at least 15 (10 points), Mess- und Regelungstechnik at least 5 (5 points), elektrotechnische Grundlagen von Information Systems at least 5 (5 points), Mathematik at least 32 (20 points). Program page: 'Bachelor's degrees in Information Engineering, Informatics, Industrial Engineering, or Electrical Engineering and Information Technology' (the latter 'provided that the applicant has completed a concentration in Computer Science'); this list is page wording, not regulation wording. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in FPSO § 36 or Anlage 2. The grade only gives points in the aptitude procedure (Anlage 2 Nr. 5.1.1 b): one point per tenth of a grade by which the average is better than 3,0, max. 20 points; average of the best-graded modules totalling 140 credits (or 7/9 of the first-degree credits for non-ECTS systems), weighted by credits; if no module details are given, the overall average is used. 'Bei ausländischen Abschlüssen wird die über die bayerische Formel umgerechnete Note herangezogen.'

items.raw_label: Fachliche Grundlagen im Bereich Informatik im Umfang von mindestens 61 Credits (max. 35 Punkte): Introduction to Informatics 6, Fundamentals of Programming (Exercises & Laboratory) 6, Introduction to Computer Organization and Technology - Computer Architecture 8, Introduction to Software Engineering 6, Fundamentals of Algorithms and Data Structures 6, Fundamentals of Databases 6, Basic Principles: Operating Systems and System Software 6, Computer Networking and IT Security 6, Business Process Management 5, Signal Processing 6 (Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2, Fächergruppen Information Engineering) — gate: with full maths points, at least 10 Informatik points are needed for the 30-point total, i.e. at least 36 credits (GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording; Koushik's decision 15.10.2026): Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2 deducts missing competences 'entsprechend den Credits der zugeordneten Module' and rejects applicants with 'weniger als 10 Punkte im Bereich Mathematik oder weniger als insgesamt 30 Punkte'; read as 1 point per missing credit (the strictest reading)).

Fachliche Grundlagen im Bereich Mathematik im Umfang von mindestens 36 Credits (max. 20 Punkte): Discrete Structures 8, Computational Mathematics 1: Linear Algebra 8, Computational Mathematics 2: Calculus 8, Discrete Probability Theory 6, Information Theory and Theory of Computation 6 (Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2, Fächergruppen Information Engineering) — gate: at least 10 of 20 maths points, i.e. at most 10 of 36 credits missing = at least 26 credits (GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording; Koushik's decision 15.10.2026): Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2 deducts missing competences 'entsprechend den Credits der zugeordneten Module' and rejects applicants with 'weniger als 10 Punkte im Bereich Mathematik oder weniger als insgesamt 30 Punkte'; read as 1 point per missing credit (the strictest reading)). 'Information Theory and Theory of Computation' is in TUM's Mathematik group, so theoretical_cs is covered here (added up).

Informatik + Mathematik zusammen: insgesamt mindestens 30 Punkte (Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2) = at most 25 of 97 reference credits missing = at least 72 credits (GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording; Koushik's decision 15.10.2026): Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2 deducts missing competences 'entsprechend den Credits der zugeordneten Module' and rejects applicants with 'weniger als 10 Punkte im Bereich Mathematik oder weniger als insgesamt 30 Punkte'; read as 1 point per missing credit (the strictest reading)). Nested total: every Informatik and Mathematik course counts here (engine rule E2a).

subject_credit_requirements.note: Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2 (i.d.F. 23.06.2026, applies from SS 2027): the curricular analysis is competence-based ('nicht durch schematischen Abgleich der Module, sondern auf der Basis von Kompetenzen') against the TUM Bachelor Information Engineering or Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik. Without essential differences the applicant gets max. 55 points; 'Fehlende Kompetenzen werden entsprechend den Credits der zugeordneten Module ... abgezogen'; no negative points. 'Wer weniger als 10 Punkte im Bereich Mathematik oder weniger als insgesamt 30 Punkte erzielt hat, wird nicht zum Eignungsverfahren zugelassen.' With a successful GRE/GATE (where required) the level of the first degree is assumed to be equivalent. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): the credit figures are reference values for a points deduction, not hard minimums, so both areas are stored as presence-only (the 10-point mathematics floor and the 30-point total, with mathematics capped at 20, mean that both areas must be present); the exact points gate cannot be checked by the engine yet (see DECISION in notes). Only the Information Engineering profile is stored (GPU-R domain); the EE&IT profile is described in accepted_degree_fields.note. Since 15.10.2026 (Koushik's decision, regulation text read in full): the points gate of Nr. 4.2 is encoded as three credit minimums (maths+theory >= 26, Informatik >= 36, together >= 72) using 1 point per missing credit; this is the strictest reading of 'entsprechend den Credits'. A GRE/GATE result only confirms the level (Nr. 4.2 Satz 8); it does not replace missing modules. The later 39/53-point stages (grade points + interview) are selection steps shown to the student, not checked. Koushik decision 20.10.2026 (option B): general_cs (= all CS subjects) would let any student pass, so the Informatik item (36) counts ONLY the categories of the ten modules TUM names (add-up rule, each course once): programming_practical_cs (Fundamentals of Programming) + computer_engineering (Computer Architecture) + software_engineering + algorithms_data_structures + databases_systems + operating_systems + computer_networks + it_security (Computer Networking and IT Security) + business_administration (Business Process Management) + digital_signal_processing + signals_systems (Signal Processing). 'Introduction to Informatics' has no specific category and is not counted. The Informatik+Mathematik total (72) counts the same categories plus general_mathematics and theoretical_cs (TUM's Mathematik group). This follows TUM's points rule: any 25 of the 61 Informatik credits may be missing. computer_networks, digital_signal_processing, signals_systems = TAXONOMY GAPS.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen rule in the FPSO i.d.F. 23.06.2026 (Anlage 2 applicable from SS 2027). The previous Anlage 2 Nr. 5.1.3 (version 28.03.2024, for study starts up to WS 2026/27) allowed the Auswahlkommission to require basic exams of max. 30 credits as an Auflage; this rule was removed by the 2026 amendment.

descriptive_notes: Curricular analysis (Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2): your first degree is compared, by competences, with the TUM Bachelor Information Engineering (Informatik 61 credits = max. 35 points, Mathematik 36 credits = max. 20 points) or the TUM Bachelor Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik. Missing competences are deducted according to the credits of the corresponding TUM modules. Fewer than 10 points in Mathematik or fewer than 30 points in total = not admitted to the aptitude procedure.

Stage 1 (Anlage 2 Nr. 5.1): curricular-analysis points (max. 55) + grade points (max. 20; one point per tenth better than 3,0, best 140 credits, Bavarian formula for foreign grades) = max. 75 points, rounded up. 53 or more = passed; fewer than 39 = failed; 39-52 = interview.

Stage 2 (Anlage 2 Nr. 5.2): individual interview of 20-30 minutes in English, as a rule by video conference, three equally weighted focus areas (special commitment / aptitude for a specialization or research experience; prior subject knowledge and competences from the Bachelor's incl. thesis topic; communication skills), scored by two committee members on 0-45 and averaged (rounded up). Interview points + stage-1 curricular and grade points: 53 or more = passed, fewer than 53 = failed.

Program page description of the interview (about 20 minutes; knowledge of the program structure and the occupational profile of a computer scientist; abstract, logical, system-oriented thinking; transdisciplinary solutions; additional qualifications; reasoning in English) differs from the three focus areas in Anlage 2 Nr. 5.2.2.
A failed aptitude procedure can be taken once more (Anlage 2 Nr. 7).

allowed_exemptions: Bachelor's thesis written in English
applicants whose language of education (Ausbildungssprache) is English (FPSO wording)
students and alumni of the TUM B.Sc. Information Engineering (program page)
language_english.note: FPSO § 36 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'adäquate Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache'; proof required from students 'deren Ausbildungssprache nicht Englisch ist' by a recognised test such as TOEFL (min. 88), IELTS (min. 6,5), Cambridge Main Suite of English Examinations or Pearson English Language Test (min. 65); a Bachelor's thesis written in English also proves adequate English. Program page: 'Proof of English language proficiency must be submitted with the application' (a TUM-accepted certificate or a Bachelor's thesis written in English). The FPSO does not say how 'Ausbildungssprache' is proven; MOI is not addressed.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants whose first degree was not completed in a signatory state of the Lisbon Recognition Convention of 11 April 1997 (FPSO § 36 Abs. 1 Nr. 3)
standardized_test_requirements.details: 'Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test' or 'Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE)'. No minimum score is stated in the FPSO or on the program page. With a successful GRE/GATE the level of the first degree is assumed to have no essential differences and the curricular analysis is carried out (Anlage 2 Nr. 4.2).

aps_certificate.note: Program page: APS certificate required for 'All applicants from India, China and Vietnam.' Not in the FPSO.

other_requirements: Transcript of Records with modules of at least 140 credits (or at least 7/9 of the credits of the first degree for non-ECTS systems), issued by the examination authority (Anlage 2 Nr. 2.3.1)

curriculum of the first degree (e.g. module handbook, module descriptions) and the TUM CIT form listing names and credits of the required examinations (curriculum analysis via the Master Evaluation Tool) (Anlage 2 Nr. 2.3.2; program page)
tabular CV (Anlage 2 Nr. 2.3.3; program page: 'Complete and Current Résumé' in English)
Bachelor's certificate and diploma to be submitted at the latest five weeks after the start of lectures (Anlage 2 Nr. 2.2)
VPD from uni-assist for qualifications not obtained at a German university (program page; may follow after the deadline with a declaration that you applied to uni-assist)
copy of a valid passport or identity card (program page)

program page also lists a TUMonline checkbox assuring that the motivation letter and essay were written independently; the FPSO i.d.F. 23.06.2026 no longer lists a motivation letter or essay (Anlage 2 Nr. 2.3)
