admission_regulation.version: Verkündungsblatt der TH OWL 2026 Nr. 47 (11.06.2026): consolidated text of the MPO in the version of the Bekanntmachung of 19.02.2024 (VKBL 2024 Nr. 14) as amended by the Satzungen of 05.08.2025 (VKBL 2025 Nr. 45; changes admission: English rule § 4 Abs. 3 replaced, 70 % alternative in § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 b deleted, oral aptitude test in § 5 replaced by GRE/GATE for non-Bologna applicants, applies from the SS 2025 application round) and of 01.06.2026 (VKBL 2026 Nr. 38; changes admission: § 5 (GRE/GATE) deleted, in force with effect from SS 2026). The Bekanntmachung states the text 'in der vom 1. März 2026 geltenden Fassung'.

accepted_degree_fields.note: MPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 a: Bachelor or Diplom in Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Informatik or Mechatronik (Regelstudienzeit at least six semesters / 180 ECTS) with overall grade 2,5 or better at a German or Bologna-signatory university; in exceptional cases another programme with a substantial share of content from these programmes (vergleichbarer Studiengang). § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 b: an equivalent Bachelor's degree in a closely related programme at another foreign university, unless an essential quality difference can be shown, 'mit einer Gesamtabschlussnote von 2,5'. The Prüfungsausschuss decides (§ 4 Abs. 2). Program page: 'electrical engineering, information technology, computer science, mechatronics, or another closely related field'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record.

grade_requirement.note: MPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 a: 'Gesamtabschlussnote von 2,5 oder besser'; Nr. 2 b (other foreign universities): 'mit einer Gesamtabschlussnote von 2,5'. § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 c Satz 3-4 (applicants applying before the degree is complete, average of results so far 2,5; GPU-R reading (not regulation wording): this interview route is read as limited to applicants before graduation because it stands in Nr. 2 c, which opens 'soweit zum Bewerbungszeitpunkt die Zugangsvoraussetzungen der Nummer 2.a) und 2.b) nicht vorliegen'; if the reading is wrong, the stored hard 2.5 is stricter than the regulation, not more lenient): 'Wurde diese Gesamtnote nicht erreicht', the Prüfungsausschuss may establish aptitude instead of the qualified degree if the overall picture of the application lets expect successful completion; a personal interview with the Prüfungsausschuss is held. The MPO states no conversion method; the International Office page tells applicants to convert their average grade with the Bavarian formula for the online application.

subject_credit_requirements.note: The MPO sets no subject-credit requirement; it requires a degree in Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Informatik or Mechatronik or a comparable / closely related programme.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen for missing subject competences in the MPO. § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 c allows enrolment before the degree is complete (aptitude based on the average of results so far, 2,5); proof of the admission requirements within six months after enrolment; this is not a subject-gap condition.

descriptive_notes: The Prüfungsausschuss decides whether the admission requirements are met (MPO § 4 Abs. 2).

Applicants whose degree is not yet complete may be enrolled if their average so far is 2,5 and the missing proof is not their fault; the proof must follow within six months of enrolment (MPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 c). If this grade is not reached, the Prüfungsausschuss may establish aptitude from the overall picture of the application after a personal interview (§ 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 c Satz 3-4).
Admission is not restricted (program page: 'Non-restricted').

admission_regulation.title: Fächerspezifische Bestimmungen für den Masterstudiengang Intelligente Interaktive Systeme an der Universität Bielefeld (Studienmodell 2011), Ziffer 2, together with the Prüfungs- und Studienordnung für das Masterstudium (MPO Fw. - Studienmodell 2011) § 4
admission_regulation.version: FsB vom 16. Mai 2023 (Verkündungsblatt Jg. 52 Nr. 6 S. 109) i.V.m. den Änderungen vom 15. Dezember 2023, 1. April 2025 (Verkündungsblatt Jg. 54 Nr. 04 S. 158, as cited in the 3rd amendment) und 14. Oktober 2025 sowie der Berichtigung vom 16. Juli 2024 (eKVV reading version; only the Verkündungsblatt versions are binding). 1st amendment (15.12.2023) and 3rd amendment (14.10.2025) opened: they change only curriculum/module tables, not admission. The admission text DID change after the original: the original of 16.05.2023 requires an Abschlussnote 'von mindestens 3,0', the reading version 'von mindestens 2,7'. Neither the 1st nor the 3rd amendment contains this change, so it comes from the 2nd amendment (01.04.2025) or the Berichtigung (16.07.2024); neither was opened, so the binding text of the 2,7 is not verified. Ziffer 9 Abs. 1 (one-time rule 'mindestens 3,0' 'ausschließlich für das Bewerbungsverfahren zum Wintersemester 2023/24') is a transition rule, not the current limit. The interdisciplinary alternative of item c. is already in the original of 16.05.2023 (re-checked 2026-10-15). Framework: MPO Fw. vom 1. September 2015 (in force 1.10.2015); later amendments of the MPO Fw. not located.

accepted_degree_fields.note: FsB Ziffer 2 Abs. 1-2: 'Nachweis eines vorangegangenen qualifizierten Abschlusses (§ 49 Abs. 6 S. 3 HG NRW)'; a degree is qualified if all three subject requirements (a.-c.) are documented by Leistungen and a (possibly provisional) final grade of at least 2,7 is shown. No field of study is named; the check is by competences. Competences are assessed under the recognition rules and standards (incl. the European Area of Recognition Project) by criteria such as quality of the institution/degree (accreditation), workload and concrete learning outcomes. MPO Fw. § 4 Abs. 2: holders of a foreign first degree are admitted if there is 'kein wesentlicher Unterschied' to a national first degree. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: FsB Ziffer 2 Abs. 2: '(ggf. vorläufige) Abschlussnote des qualifizierten Abschlusses von mindestens 2,7'. Ziffer 9 Abs. 1 set 3,0 only for the WS 2023/24 application round (expired). No conversion method for foreign grades is stated in the FsB or MPO Fw. § 4.

items.raw_label: a. Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten in Grundlagenfächern, die unmittelbar auf die Informatik bezogen sind (z.B. Algorithmen, Datenstrukturen, Theoretische oder Technische Informatik, Rechnerarchitekturen) im Umfang von 30 ECTS oder einem entsprechenden Gesamtworkload
b. Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten in Mathematik (z.B. Analysis, Lineare Algebra, Stochastik) im Umfang von 10 ECTS oder einem entsprechenden Gesamtworkload

c. Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten in grundlegenden technischen Methoden zur Entwicklung intelligenter Systeme (z.B. Maschinelles Lernen, Künstliche Intelligenz, Mustererkennung, Robotik, Bild-/Sprachverarbeitung, Mensch-Maschine-Interaktion) im Umfang von 30 ETCS oder einem entsprechenden Gesamtworkload. Alternativ können Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten in interdisziplinären Grundlagen intelligenter oder interaktiver Systeme (z.B. aus Psychologie, Neurobiologie, Linguistik, Philosophie) im Umfang von bis zu 10 ETCS oder einem entsprechenden Gesamtworkload angerechnet werden.

subject_credit_requirements.note: FsB Ziffer 2 Abs. 2 a.-c. The 'z.B.' introduces example TOPICS; the ECTS figures (30/10/30) are stated without 'z.B.' and are binding. Ziffer 2 Abs. 3: each criterion is scored 0 points (competences not present) or 1 point (present); 'Es müssen für die Kriterien insgesamt 3 Punkte erzielt werden, um Zugang zu erhalten.' Applicants must upload degree certificate/transcript and module descriptions to the portal by the deadline; late documents are not considered. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): item a. is the open area 'Grundlagenfächer, die unmittelbar auf die Informatik bezogen sind'; it is encoded with the named examples (algorithms/data structures, theoretical CS, technical CS/computer architecture) plus the other core CS categories, but WITHOUT machine_learning_ai, graphics_visual_computing and hci, which are kept only in item c. so that no course counts for both areas (lesson 16). Item c. (add-up, D3/E1): Robotik is stored as covered category engineering.robotics; Bildverarbeitung -> graphics_visual_computing, Sprachverarbeitung/Mustererkennung -> machine_learning_ai, Mensch-Maschine-Interaktion -> hci. The regulation lets up to 10 ECTS of item c. come from interdisciplinary foundations ('Alternativ können … bis zu 10 ETCS … angerechnet werden'; psychology, neurobiology, linguistics, philosophy): stored as covered category interdisciplinary.cognitive_foundations, which counts for AT MOST 10 ECTS of the 30 (per-area cap, engine to-do E8). Both new categories are not yet in the taxonomy (T5), so they count 0 until Part 1 classifies courses into them (record complete, engine later; Koushik's decision N-66, 16.10.2026). Neither is mandatory: they are optional ways to fill item c. Program page: applicants must provide 'a list of courses passed successfully during their qualifying degree (Bachelor) in each of the three areas, along with the ECTS or the overall workload for each course'.

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: MPO Fw. § 4 Abs. 3 lets the Fächerspezifische Bestimmungen provide access 'unter Auflagen' ('Sie können auch vorsehen …'; Angleichungsstudien should not exceed 30 LP), but the IISY FsB Ziffer 2 contain no such rule, and Ziffer 2 Abs. 3 requires all three criteria ('Es müssen für die Kriterien insgesamt 3 Punkte erzielt werden, um Zugang zu erhalten.'). (FsB Ziffer 4 '– entfällt –' concerns admission before acquiring the access requirements, not Auflagen.) Read from the non-binding eKVV reading version; the binding 2nd amendment (01.04.2025, VB Jg. 54 Nr. 04 S. 158) was not opened.

descriptive_notes: No selection procedure: FsB Ziffer 3 (Zulassungsverfahren) reads '- entfällt –'; the programme is admission-free. Access is decided on the three subject criteria and the grade.
Decision by an examiner of the Technische Fakultät by electronic notice; an objection within one week leads to review by a second examiner (FsB Ziffer 2 Abs. 4).

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification (Studienqualifikation) obtained in Australia, Ireland, Canada, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the USA (B2 Richtlinien)
regular German Abitur (program page)
German language proficiency under the Ordnung über den Zugang internationaler Studienbewerber*innen instead of English (FsB Ziffer 2 Abs. 1)
language_english.note: FsB Ziffer 2 Abs. 1: English 'auf dem Sprachniveau der Stufe B2 des Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen nach Maßgabe der Richtlinien der Universität Bielefeld oder in Deutsch nach der Ordnung über den Zugang internationaler Studienbewerber*innen'. admission_regulation.version: Studienordnung vom 28. April 2022, 'rechtsbereinigt mit Stand vom 19. Januar 2024, vom 28. Januar 2024 und vom 6. Januar 2025', redaktionelle Änderung vom 21. Oktober 2022 (consolidated copy in the WHZ module database Modulux, 'Studienordnung ab 2025', valid from WS 2025). Amending statutes opened: 19.01.2024 (in force 1.3.2024, module catalogue only), 28.02.2024 (in force 1.3.2024, re-words § 2 Abs. 2 - the admission rules stored here), 06.01.2025 (in force 1.9.2025, module replacements only). The consolidated header says '28. Januar 2024' while the amending statute is dated 28. Februar 2024. Official publication reference (Amtliche Bekanntmachungen) not located.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Studienordnung § 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 1: 'Ein erster berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss auf Bachelor-Niveau auf dem Gebiet der Informatik oder ein gleichwertiger Studienabschluss an einer Hochschule im In- und Ausland.' § 2 Abs. 1: consecutive master's programme. § 2 Abs. 3: the Prüfungsausschuss decides whether the access requirements are met. grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the Studienordnung or on the program pages. If applicants exceed places, the Zulassungskommission selects 'nach Eignung und Leistung' (§ 3 Abs. 2).

subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject credit requirements: § 2 requires a Bachelor-level degree 'auf dem Gebiet der Informatik' or an equivalent degree, without a credit breakdown by subject. The Prüfungsausschuss decides on equivalence of degrees (§ 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 3, Abs. 3).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen for missing subject competences in the Studienordnung. § 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 3 only lets the Prüfungsausschuss decide on 'die Möglichkeiten der Kompensation fehlender ECTS-Punkte' (total credits below 180; see other_requirements).

descriptive_notes: Restricted entry: if applicants exceed the available places, the Zulassungskommission decides 'unter Beachtung der Zugangsvoraussetzungen nach § 2 dieser Studienordnung und nach Eignung und Leistung'; a selection interview may be held (§ 3 Abs. 2).

Further documents (e.g. additional qualifications, professional experience) can be considered in the selection; the programme director and the Prüfungsausschuss decide on their recognition (§ 3 Abs. 1 Nr. 4).

No tests or scores are named. Flyer (12.05.2025): 'language certificate (English instruction language is not sufficient)'. English program page: 'English B2 or similar'. admission_regulation.title: Studiengangsordnung (Satzung) für Studierende des Masterstudiengangs IT Security an der Universität zu Lübeck mit dem Abschluss „Master of Science“, § 3 Zugang zum Studium
admission_regulation.version: SGO vom 31. Januar 2017 (NBl. HS MSGWG Schl.-H. S. 35), geändert durch Satzungen vom 4. Juli 2019 (NBl. HS MBWK Schl.-H. S. 50) und vom 15. Februar 2022 (NBl. HS MBWK Schl.-H. S. 31; applies to students starting from WS 2022/23). The Zweite Änderungssatzung (opened) re-words § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 (grade, 28/60/12 KP) and Nr. 3 (English B2), i.e. it changes admission. § 3 Abs. 4-6 read from the non-binding Leseabschrift nach 2. Änderung; the 2017 original and the 2019 Erste Änderungssatzung were not opened. No later amendment of this SGO listed in the Bekanntmachungen 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026.

accepted_degree_fields.note: SGO § 3 Abs. 1: 'Der Masterstudiengang ist konsekutiv zum Bachelorstudiengang IT-Sicherheit der Universität zu Lübeck.' § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 1: Bachelor or equivalent degree in IT-Sicherheit 'oder in einem fachlich eng verwandten Studiengang' at a German or Bologna-signatory university (a), or 'an einer ausländischen Hochschule einen gleichwertigen Abschluss in einem fachlich eng verwandten Studiengang' (b); equivalence of foreign degrees 'nach Maßgabe der Bewertungsvorschläge der Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen'. Program page: 'A Bachelor's degree in IT security or a related field'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: SGO § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 a): 'Erststudium mit einer Note von 2,7 oder besser abgeschlossen.' § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 1: 'Die Noten der ausländischen Bildungsnachweise sind in das deutsche Notensystem umzurechnen.' (no formula stated). Program page FAQ: 'equal or better than a German GPA of 2.7'; program page admission section: 'A grade better than a German GPA of 2.7' (see CONFLICT in notes).

items.raw_label: b) grundlegende, mathematische Konzepte der Stochastik, Analysis und Linearen Algebra: mindestens 28 Kreditpunkte (KP)
c) grundlegende informatische Anteile wie Softwareentwicklung, IT-Sicherheit, Kryptologie, Rechnersysteme und theoretische Informatik: mindestens 60 KP
d) mindestens 12 KP davon aus dem Bereich der IT-Sicherheit

subject_credit_requirements.note: SGO § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 b)-d) (as amended 15.02.2022). Item d) is a sub-minimum INSIDE item c) ('davon'): the 12 KP IT security count toward the 60 KP computer science; they are not additional. Both items share it_security (it_security is part of the general_cs aggregate), which is intended here (nested rule, see NESTED/DECISION in notes). Item c) lists its topics with 'wie' (such as), so the open aggregate general_cs is used. Mathematics: GPU-R policy (not regulation wording; Koushik's rule R1/R6): stored as one general_mathematics total (discrete mathematics then also counts). § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 e): 'Im Einzelfall kann von den Vorgaben a) - d) abgesehen werden, wenn die Bewerberin oder der Bewerber ihre oder seine fachliche Eignung auf andere geeignete Art und Weise nachweist.' Application: an eligibility form with conversion of the workload into ECTS ('Please enter at least 12 ECTS worth of security related courses in the gray fields').

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: the SGO provides no Auflagen for missing subject credits. § 3 Abs. 4 (Zulassung unter Vorbehalt before graduation) is not a subject condition (see other_requirements); § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 e) allows an individual exception from a)-d) if suitability is proven otherwise (case-by-case, not a credit cap). SGO § 4 'Master Agreement': for applicants for whom the Prüfungsausschuss, on the basis of the competences acquired in the bachelor's programme, considers it 'sachlich sinnvoll' to make up subject prerequisites from the bachelor's programme, a Master Agreement can be concluded on which bachelor modules 'bis zu welchem Zeitpunkt erfolgreich absolviert werden sollten'; 'Es dürfen nicht mehr als drei Module vereinbart werden.' It is not stated as a way around § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 a)-d) and states no ECTS cap, so allowed stays false (conservative GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

descriptive_notes: Admission-restricted programme (program page FAQ: 'Yes, admission to Master's program is restricted'); selection under the Satzung zur Durchführung der Auswahlverfahren in den zulassungsbeschränkten Bachelor- und Masterstudiengängen (latest amendment 18.11.2025; master selection criteria not verified).

E-Test: program page lists 'The completion of our E-Test' as an admission requirement and the application-documents page requires an e-test for IT Security; its content and pass rule are not stated in the sources found, and it is not in the SGO.
Individual exception (SGO § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 e)): the Prüfungsausschuss may waive requirements a)-d) if subject suitability is proven in another suitable way.

allowed_exemptions: German Abitur showing English for at least seven years (SGO § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 3)
Bachelor Degree with English MOI (university language-proficiency page)
native speakers (university language-proficiency page)
language_english.note: SGO § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 3: 'Ausreichende Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache gemäß CEFR B2', proven by German Abitur with English for at least seven years 'oder durch entsprechende Sprachprüfungen (z.B. TOEFL, IELTS)' - no scores in the SGO. Scores from the university language-proficiency page: 'TOEFL iBT until 20/01/2026: score 72 or better', 'TOEFL iBT as of 21/01/2026: score 4 or better' (new TOEFL scale; 72 stored), 'IELTS 5.5 or better', 'Pearsons PTE Academic 59 or better', Cambridge FCE grade B or C, TOEIC (L&R 785, Speaking 160, Writing 150), telc B2, UNIcert II. Due: certificate of proficiency in English is an application document (application-documents page).

aps_certificate.note: Application-documents page for international degree-seeking applicants: certificate from the Academic Evaluation Center (APS) for all academic documents if you are from China, Vietnam or India. Not in the SGO.

other_requirements: completion of a thesis (program page); bachelor's thesis or a three-page summary of it required for certain programmes (application-documents page); not stated as a general rule in the SGO
eligibility form with conversion of the workload into ECTS (program page; IT Security eligibility form)
E-Test (program page; application-documents page)
CV and letter of motivation (application-documents page)
application via uni-assist for non-EU applicants (program page; application-documents page)

Zulassung unter Vorbehalt before graduation: at least 135 KP with an average of at least 2,7 and the bachelor's thesis already begun; degree to be proven within three months after the start of studies, otherwise admission lapses (SGO § 3 Abs. 4)
enrolment refused if a required examination in an IT-Sicherheit programme at a German university was finally failed or the applicant is in such an examination procedure (SGO § 3 Abs. 5)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung des Studiengangs Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Master of Science (M.Sc.) (Ausführungsbestimmungen zu den Allgemeinen Prüfungsbestimmungen der TU Darmstadt (APB), with Anhänge), Artikel 1 zu § 17a APB
admission_regulation.version: Satzungsbeilage 2023-IV (Erscheinungsdatum 31.05.2023; cover: 'Berichtigte Fassung gemäß Erratum der Satzungsbeilage 2025-VI' — the erratum concerns only the Lehramt practical-training ordinance), approved by the Presidium 11.05.2023 (Az. 652-7-1), in force 01.10.2023 (PO 2023). Faculty council dates in the English translation: header 31.03.2022, preamble 09.02.2023 (inconsistent). The binding German text (SB 2023-IV p. 69 ff.) could NOT be read (text extraction ends before p. 69; German department copy blocked); all regulation values are taken from the department's English translation ('This translation is not an official document ... The legally binding document is the German version'). No amendment found: tables of contents of Satzungsbeilagen 2025-I to 2026-VI checked (none concerns this programme); 2023-V to 2024-IX not checked.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Ordnung zu § 17a (2) (English translation): 'The admission requirement for the Master's study program Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (M.Sc.) is a Bachelor's degree in Informatik (B.Sc.) from the TU Darmstadt or a degree in a study program which imparts competencies amounting to at least 180 CP, of which at least 60 CP are not significantly different from the entry competencies taught in the reference study program (comparable study program).' Programme page (DE): 'Abschluss des B.Sc. Informatik der TU Darmstadt (Referenzstudiengang) oder ein gleichwertiger Abschluss.' No list of accepted degree names. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: Neither the Ordnung (English translation) nor the programme pages state a minimum grade. No conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: at least 60 CP not significantly different from the entry competencies of the reference programme B.Sc. Informatik TU Darmstadt (Anhang II areas: Theoretical Computer Science — Propositional and Predicate Logic; Automata, Formal Languages and Decidability; Modelling, Specification and Semantics | Practical Computer Science — Algorithms and Data Structures; Operating Systems; Computer Security; Computer Networks and Distributed Systems; Introduction to Compiler Construction; Functional and Object-oriented Programming Concepts; Formal Methods in Software Design; Information Management; Parallel Programming; Probabilistic Methods in Computer Science; Scientific Computing; Software Engineering; Visual Computing | Computer Engineering — Digital Design and Computer Organisation | Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning — Introduction to Artificial Intelligence; Information Management; Probabilistic Methods in Computer Science)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Ordnung zu § 17a (2) and Anhang II (English translation): 'applicants for the M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning must prove entry competencies of a total of 60 CP' (from the reference programme or equivalent competencies); Anhang II names no CP per area. Programme page (DE): 'Insgesamt müssen mindestens 60 CP aus dem Referenzstudiengang oder äquivalente Kompetenzen nachgewiesen werden.' (EN: 'partial overlaps are to be counted proportionally'). The department's eligibility checklist (orientation only, 'no legal or procedural effect') lists the 19 reference courses with 10/10/5 ECTS each (total 105). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): one pooled item, added up (E1): general_cs (all CS areas of Anhang II; logic counted as theoretical_cs, R4) plus statistics_probability ('Probabilistic Methods in Computer Science') and mathematics_statistics.optimization_numerics ('Scientific Computing'; GPU-R category not yet in cs_taxonomy.json, counts 0 for now). Not split module by module (R1 does not apply): the regulation requires 60 of the listed competences in total, not each module. Whether a course is 'not significantly different' is decided by the examination board in the formal/substantive entrance examination (see subsequent_selection_criteria_display).

conditional_admission.mechanism: Ordnung zu § 17a (8) (English translation): 'If, after the entrance examination, it is found that the applicant lacks entrance competencies that can be compensated for by completing credits amounting to no more than 30 CP, a conditional admission may be granted.' The admission letter lists the imposed modules and the completion deadline; only two attempts per condition (no second repeat § 31 APB, no oral supplementary exam § 32 APB). Read from the non-binding English translation only (binding German text not read, see notes BLOCKED).

descriptive_notes: Entrance examination (§ 17a (4)/(5)): a formal check of the submitted documents (degree certificate and Diploma Supplement or comparable documents); if the entry competences cannot be clearly decided, a substantive entrance examination follows — oral, 30 minutes, on campus or by video; if more than 10 applicants need it, the examination board may use a 90-minute written test on campus or online. It cannot be repeated in the same application procedure.

Programme page / entrance-exam page: in practice a 90-minute computer-based written exam in English on campus (no remote option), usually first week of September (winter) and first week of March (summer); winter 2026/27 date: 1 September 2026, 14:00 CEST.
Exemption from the substantive entrance examination via GRE or GATE scores (see standardized_test_requirements).
No numerical admission restriction once the entrance requirements are met (programme page).
Applicants may apply to only one of M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, M.Sc. Computer Science or M.Sc. IT Security per admission period (programme page).

allowed_exemptions: confirmation from the university at which the degree was completed that English was the programme's language of instruction
language_english.note: Programme page: 'English C1' (DE: 'Englisch C1'). The English translation of the Ordnung only states 'The language of instruction for the study program is English' and contains no language-proof rule. University page for international applicants, 'Language Requirements for Degree Programmes taught in English': IELTS 7.0; PTE Academic 76; Cambridge CAE; TOEFL itp 627; TOEFL Paper 550; TOEFL CBT 213; TOEFL iBT (incl. Special Home Edition) 95 (a further line reads 'TOEFL iBT 5 to 5.5', apparently the new score scale); TOEIC L490/R455/S200/W200; OOPT 80; MET 64; ECPE; telc English B2-C1 University 'C1 certificate'; UNIcert III; or confirmation of English as language of instruction. No validity period stated. Due date not stated.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: nobody (optional: exemption from the substantive entrance examination)
standardized_test_requirements.details: Entrance-exam page: Verbal Reasoning >= 155, Quantitative Reasoning >= 165, Analytical Writing >= 3.5 ('all binding'); scores via ETS, institution code 2249, department code 0402; submit by 20 August (winter) / 20 February (summer). Ordnung § 17a: exemption possible on the basis of an admission/aptitude test 'e.g. GRE or comparable tests'.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: nobody (optional: exemption from the substantive entrance examination)

admission_regulation.title: Fachstudien- und -prüfungsordnung für den Studiengang Artificial Intelligence Engineering mit dem Abschluss Master of Science an der Universität Passau (§ 3 Qualifikation), together with the Allgemeine Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für Studiengänge mit dem Abschluss Master of Science der Fakultät für Informatik und Mathematik an der Universität Passau (AStuPO, § 4 Qualifikation)
admission_regulation.version: FStuPO vom 17. Mai 2021 (vABlUP S. 39), in force 01.10.2021, in der Fassung der Änderungssatzung vom 08. Juli 2024 (in force 15.07.2024; changes only § 6 and the heading of § 7, not admission). AStuPO vom 27. April 2016 (vABlUP S. 24) in der Fassung der Dritten Änderungssatzung vom 24. Februar 2026 (in force 01.03.2026; only rewords § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 4 Satz 1 to name 'Informatik' and 'Artificial Intelligence Engineering'); 1st amendment 12.09.2019 (vABlUP S. 198; introduced the 70 % wording and the 10 ECTS scientific-work rule) and 2nd amendment 04.08.2025 (vABlUP S. 72; in § 4 only the legal citation Art. 86 BayHIG) opened. Reading versions from the university's Rechtsvorschriften folder ('Rechtlich verbindlich ist ausschließlich der amtliche ... Text'); amendments read in the Virtuelles Amtsblatt.

accepted_degree_fields.note: AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1: 'Einen Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor, Magister, Diplom, Staatsexamen) mit mindestens der Gesamtnote „befriedigend“ (2,7) an einer Hochschule des In- oder Auslands auf der Grundlage eines mindestens dreijährigen Studiums oder einen gleichwertigen Abschluss, mit einem Fachanteil, der in der jeweiligen Fachstudien- und -prüfungsordnung festgelegt wird'. Programme page: 'an undergraduate university degree in computer science or mathematics or a related discipline'; 'we only recognise degrees awarded by universities with 'H+' status in the Anabin database'. Programme page (not in the regulations): 'If you completed a four-year non-ECTS degree, the 120 ECTS credit requirement is deemed to be met if approximately two-thirds of your credit points were earned in computer science/mathematics related modules/courses.' primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record.

grade_requirement.note: AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1: Gesamtnote 'befriedigend' (2,7); 'der Gesamtnote „befriedigend“ (2,7) steht es gleich, wenn der Bewerber oder die Bewerberin im Ranking seines oder ihres Abschlussjahrgangs unter den besten 70 Prozent der Absolventen oder Absolventinnen ist.' FAQ: the ranking document must state the total number of graduates in the cohort and the applicant's rank (e.g. 40/120) and be issued by the university. GPU-R cannot check the cohort-ranking alternative (see DECISION in notes); it is shown to students. Conversion: AStuPO § 8 Abs. 4 Satz 4 (binding conversion rules are set by the Fakultätsrat, not printed); the university's grade converter uses the 'modified Bavarian formula' (orientation only, 'non-binding').

items.raw_label: Fachanteil Informatik und/oder Mathematik von mindestens 120 ECTS-Leistungspunkten (FStuPO § 3 Satz 1)
Fachanteil Informatik mindestens 40 ECTS-Leistungspunkte (FStuPO § 3 Satz 2; of the 120) — Theoretische Informatik counted in the mathematics share (GPU-R policy)
Fachanteil Mathematik inklusive dem Fach Theoretische Informatik mindestens 35 ECTS-Leistungspunkte (FStuPO § 3 Satz 3; of the 120)

subject_credit_requirements.note: FStuPO § 3: 'Der gemäß § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 AStuPO nachzuweisende Abschluss muss einen Fachanteil Informatik und/oder Mathematik von mindestens 120 ECTS-Leistungspunkten enthalten. Der Fachanteil Informatik beträgt dabei mindestens 40 ECTS-Leistungspunkte. Der Fachanteil Mathematik inklusive dem Fach Theoretische Informatik beträgt mindestens 35 ECTS-Leistungspunkte.' NESTED: the 40 and 35 items count inside the 120 total (E2a); the 120 item is a pooled 'und/oder' total, added up (E1). Mathematics share stored as the contextual category math_and_theoretical_cs_combined (= the four maths categories + theoretical_cs), matching the regulation's 'inklusive dem Fach Theoretische Informatik'. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording; stricter, lesson 16): theoretical_cs is left out of the 40 ECTS CS item so a course cannot count for both sibling items (see DECISION). AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 4 (10 ECTS independent scientific work, usually the Bachelor's thesis, or another scientific work written by the applicant) is stored as other.thesis_scientific_work 10. FAQ: 'If your Bachelor's degree does not meet these requirements, you will not be admitted'; 'The Admission Board can consider modules that you are going to study according to your study plan during your last semester.' Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: Nachweis von mindestens 10 ECTS-Leistungspunkten über die Kompetenz, ein Problem aus dem Themenschwerpunkt des qualifizierenden Hochschulabs

conditional_admission.mechanism: None in the FStuPO (no Auflagen clause). Framework option only: AStuPO § 4 Abs. 2 Satz 2: the examination board 'kann ... die Immatrikulation vom erfolgreichen Ablegen von Zusatzprüfungen abhängig machen' (additional examinations before enrolment, no cap). FAQ: 'waivers for any requirements are not granted.' Stored as not allowed (owner rule for framework 'kann' clauses; see DECISION).

descriptive_notes: Qualification decided by the examination board (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 2, Art. 86 BayHIG); it may consult the Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen and may make enrolment dependent on passing additional examinations (Zusatzprüfungen).

Grade alternative: applicants ranked among the best 70 % of their graduating cohort meet the grade requirement even above 2.7 (ranking document issued by the university, stating cohort size and rank).
FAQ: no pre-screening of applications; incomplete applications at the deadline are rejected automatically.

allowed_exemptions: first degree or secondary education completed exclusively (100 %) in English, stated on an official document (FAQ)
language_english.note: AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 2: applicants whose 'Ausbildungssprache nicht Englisch ist' prove English 'auf dem Niveau B 2 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen durch einen anerkannten Sprachtest oder ein Äquivalent'. Programme FAQ: 'TOEFL (567 paper-based, 87 internet-based, ITP 543 'silver' or better)', 'IELTS (score 5.5)', CAE or CPE; MOI counts only 'if the MOI was 100% in English'; 'the certificate of English language proficiency must be provided at the time of application.' The university's central English page gives different B2 bands (IELTS 6.0-6.5, TOEFL iBT 72-94, PTE 59-75, certificates max. two years old, Duolingo not accepted); programme FAQ values stored (see notes).

language_german.due: within one year after the start of studies (enrolment 'unter Vorbehalt' until then)

aps_certificate.note: Programme FAQ: 'The APS ('Akademische Prüfstelle') exists in China, Vietnam and India'; for these countries 'the APS certificate is a mandatory requirement for applying to a German university.' Not in the regulations.

other_requirements: English or German abstract/summary of the Bachelor's thesis / dissertation / final-year project with a link to the full paper; without a thesis, an academic research paper or publication (programme page / FAQ)
degree from a university with 'H+' status in anabin (programme page)
first degree based on at least three years of study (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1)

application before graduation: in exceptional cases if all degree coursework is completed by the start of lectures and the Transcript of Records shows an average of at least 2,7; degree to be proven by the end of the 10th lecture week, enrolment 'unter Vorbehalt' (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 3)
applicants with an Indian degree apply via uni-assist (application-methods page: direct application only for EU/EEA or listed countries)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 December (1 November - 15 December, all applicants)

admission_regulation.title: Zugangssatzung für den Masterstudiengang Computational Sciences des Fachbereichs Biologie, Chemie, Pharmazie, des Fachbereichs Geowissenschaften, des Fachbereichs Mathematik und Informatik und des Fachbereichs Physik der Freien Universität Berlin
admission_regulation.version: FU-Mitteilungen 31/2020 vom 20.07.2020, S. 526, in force on the day of publication (repeals the Zugangssatzung of 21.01.2016); no amendment listed on the program page

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 3 Abs. 1 ZugS: berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss (or equivalent German/foreign degree) in one of the listed subjects. Stored profile: Informatik with at least 20 LP in Mathematik, Chemie und/oder Physik. Other profiles: Chemie (min. 10 LP Mathematik and min. 8 LP Physik); Physik; Geologische Wissenschaften; Meteorologie (min. 10 LP Mathematik); Geographische Wissenschaften (min. 10 LP Mathematik); Mathematik (min. 20 LP in Informatik, Chemie und/oder Physik); Ingenieurswissenschaften (min. 20 LP in Mathematik, Chemie und/oder Physik). Equivalence decided by the Gemeinsame Kommission (§ 3 Abs. 4).

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade for access. The grade only yields selection points (max 50) via the Anlage table (1.0 = 50, 2.0 = 30, 2.5 = 20, 3.0 = 15, 3.5 or worse = 10). No foreign-grade conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: Informatik mit einem Studienanteil von mindestens 20 LP in Mathematik, Chemie und/oder Physik

subject_credit_requirements.note: One pooled area total: 20 LP from mathematics, chemistry and/or physics in any combination (§ 3 Abs. 1 ZugS).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No admission with conditions/bridging modules provided in the ZugS. (Only provisional admission 'unter Vorbehalt' for applicants selected on a transcript before degree completion, § 2 Abs. 5 and § 5 Abs. 3 ZugS.)

descriptive_notes: If places are limited: points-based selection, max 65 points (§ 4 ZugS): grade up to 50 points (Anlage); one-time 15 additional points for applicants with a Mathematik or Informatik degree who prove at least 10 LP in a relevant natural science (e.g. Chemie, Physik, Geologische Wissenschaften, Meteorologie) beyond the § 3 Abs. 1 requirement (for natural-science/engineering degrees: 10 LP in Mathematik or Informatik).
Quotas (§ 4 Abs. 1 ZugS): 80 % of places remaining after pre-quotas via this procedure (Hochschulquote); 20 % under § 15 BerlHZG; a 5 % quota under § 15 Abs. 1 Satz 3 BerlHZG.
Whether the program is admission-restricted (NC) is decided anew each semester (program page).

Application before degree completion possible if at least 2/3 of the total workload has been graded and the thesis is registered (§ 2 Abs. 5 ZugS); ranking then uses the current transcript average. Admission 'unter Vorbehalt'; degree generally due by end of first semester (§ 5 Abs. 3).

allowed_exemptions: degree from an institution where English is the language of instruction
language_english.note: § 3 Abs. 2 ZugS: English at CEFR B1 if the degree was not obtained at an institution with English as language of instruction. No test scores named in the sources read. MyGermanUniversity (checked 24.10.2026): B1 — IELTS 4.5, TOEFL iBT 60, Cambridge PET, UNIcert I.

aps_certificate.note: FU page 'Application with International Degree': applicants with certificates from China, India or Vietnam generally have to submit an APS certification; a VPD from uni-assist is required for foreign degrees.

other_requirements: VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) from uni-assist for foreign degrees

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 31 May (§ 2 Abs. 3 ZugS); FU deadline page: 31 May if admission-restricted, 15 August if unrestricted (same for international applicants)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung für die Bachelorprüfung in den Studiengängen ... und die konsekutiven Masterstudiengänge Elektrotechnik (M.Eng.), Elektrotechnik Teilzeit (M.Eng.) und Informatik / Computer Science (M.Sc.) an der Technischen Hochschule Bingen, Fachbereich 2 (Prüfungsordnung FB 2, ET-IN-SY), § 3; together with the Allgemeine Prüfungsordnung (APO) der Technischen Hochschule Bingen für die Prüfungen in den Bachelor- und Masterstudiengängen, § 4
admission_regulation.version: PO FB 2: TH Publica 4/2025 vom 06.05.2025 (Fachbereichsrat 28.04.2025, Präsidium 30.04.2025), in force 01.09.2025 from WS 2025/26 (§ 10); no amendment clause and no later amendment found (the TH Publica listing could not be opened, so not exhaustive). An identical copy is also served at new.th-bingen.de/.../250611-thb-fb2-pruefungsordnung-ET-IN-SY.pdf (cover also reads TH Publica 4/2025 vom 06.05.2025). APO: TH Publica 06/2022 vom 09.11.2022 (in force 01.03.2023), amended by TH Publica 02/2025 vom 24.03.2025, which changes only § 17 Abs. 3 (thesis workload) and not admission. Exact full title of the PO is truncated in the record (the Bachelor programme list was not read verbatim).

accepted_degree_fields.note: APO § 4 Abs. 2: Bachelor- oder Diplomabschluss oder 1. Staatsexamen 'eines gleichen oder artverwandten Studiengangs' 'mit gutem Ergebnis'; the requirements 'können in der SGPO konkretisiert werden'. PO FB 2 § 3 Abs. 3 refers to a first degree 'in einem nach Abs. 2 geeigneten Studiengang' and lets the Prüfungsausschuss establish 'ob die notwendigen Grundlagen vorhanden sind'. Program page (DE): 'einen Bachelor- oder Diplomabschluss im Bereich Informatik oder einem eng verwandten Fachgebiet'; (EN): 'computer science or a closely related field'.

grade_requirement.note: APO § 4 Abs. 2: 'in der Regel den Nachweis eines mit gutem Ergebnis (Note 2,5 oder ECTS-Note B nach § 8 Abs. 11 oder besser)'. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): the 2,5 is checked as a hard limit, which is stricter than 'in der Regel' plus the Abs. 3 exception. APO § 4 Abs. 3: if the grade is not met, 'weitere für die Erlangung des Masterabschlusses förderliche Aspekte' (e.g. practical work, degree in standard period, Fachschaft work, semester abroad) can be considered; 'Näheres kann die SGPO regeln' (PO FB 2 has no such rule). Program page: grade 'mindestens „gut“' or recognised foreign equivalent; 'In begründeten Einzelfällen kann von dieser Regelung abgewichen werden'; FAQ: 2.5 or better, other cases decided by the examination board. Foreign grades: equivalence and GPA conversion by uni-assist (program page); no formula named. Note: APO Tabelle 1 puts overall grades up to 2,1 under 'gut', but § 4 Abs. 2 explicitly names 'Note 2,5'; the explicit number is stored.

items.raw_label: Software-Engineering. Insbesondere beinhaltet dies umfassende Programmierkompetenzen sowie Erfahrungen zur Software-Planung und -Qualitätssicherung (PO FB 2 § 3 Abs. 3; no credit number)
Informatik-Technologien. Hierunter sind zentrale Konzepte und Systeme wie Datenbanken, Betriebssysteme und Rechnerarchitekturen zu verstehen (PO FB 2 § 3 Abs. 3; no credit number)
Theoretische Informatik (PO FB 2 § 3 Abs. 3; no credit number)

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO FB 2 § 3 Abs. 3 ('Gemäß § 29 der Allgemeinen Prüfungsordnung der TH Bingen (APO) wird APO §4 Abs. 4 wie folgt studiengangspezifisch erweitert'): the Prüfungsausschuss establishes whether the necessary foundations exist; for Informatik / Computer Science proof is required in the three areas Software-Engineering, Informatik-Technologien and Theoretische Informatik. No credit numbers are stated anywhere (PO, APO, program page), so all three are presence-only (min_ects 0). POOLED: 'Informatik-Technologien' is one area with an open list ('wie Datenbanken, Betriebssysteme und Rechnerarchitekturen'), stored as one item with main + covered categories (add-up, E1). Software-Engineering includes 'umfassende Programmierkompetenzen', so programming is a covered category (GPU-R mapping, not regulation wording). The three items share no category.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflagen (APO § 4 Abs. 4, extended programme-specifically by PO FB 2 § 3 Abs. 3): 'Insbesondere hat der Prüfungsausschuss die Möglichkeit, die Zulassung unter der Auflage vorzusehen, dass vor Beginn der Masterarbeit bestimmte Studien- und Prüfungsleistungen aus einem Bachelorstudiengang erbracht werden.' No credit cap is stated (D4: uncapped committee conditions). The separate 180-to-210-ECTS rule (APO § 4 Abs. 6) only makes up total credits and is not a subject condition (see other_requirements).

descriptive_notes: The examination board (Prüfungsausschuss) checks each application individually for the necessary foundations in software engineering, computer science technologies and theoretical computer science (PO FB 2 § 3 Abs. 3); the program page describes a 'formalized selection process, where each application is carefully evaluated by a committee'.

Grade below 2.5: the APO allows other aspects (practical work, degree in standard time, semester abroad) to be considered (APO § 4 Abs. 3); the program page says the examination board decides other cases and that 'professional work experience can't compensate unsatisfied admission requirements'.

allowed_exemptions: German university entrance qualification showing level B2 (program page)
university entrance qualification from an English-speaking country: GB, IRL, NZ, AUS, USA or an English-speaking Canadian province (program page)
language_english.note: Neither PO FB 2 nor the APO sets an English requirement (APO § 29 Abs. 2 lets the Fachbereichsräte set language requirements for foreign students in the SGPO; PO FB 2 does not). Values from the program page only: level B2; IELTS 'Min. Note 5,5', TOEFL internet-based 'Min. 72 Pkt.', TOEIC Listening and Reading 'Min. 785 Pkt.', Cambridge Certificate; test results 'nicht älter als zwei Jahre'. One FAQ answer lists only IELTS, TOEFL and TOEIC as accepted certificates (inconsistent with the admission section). The certificate is uploaded with the application. All courses and examinations are in English. Medium of instruction is not mentioned.

aps_certificate.note: TH Bingen 'Checkliste Bewerbungsunterlagen' (Stand 02/2025), application documents for foreign certificates: 'Wenn Hochschulzugang oder Vorstudium in China, Vietnam, Indien erworben: APS Zertifikat'. Not on the programme page; not in the regulation.

other_requirements: application only via the TH Bingen application portal (program page)

VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) from uni-assist issued specifically for TH Bingen; equivalence certificate and GPA conversion by uni-assist (program page; foreign-certificates page: VPD valid one year, may be submitted within four weeks after applying)
Bachelor's certificate needed for the application; if delayed by a few days a Bonafide certificate can be submitted (program page)

provisional admission before the Bachelor's is completed if the thesis deadline is at most one month after the start of lectures of the first Master's semester and all other modules are passed; enrolment lapses if the requirements are not proven by the end of the first semester (PO FB 2 § 3 Abs. 2; APO § 4 Abs. 5)

Bachelor's with at least 180 but fewer than 210 ECTS: provisional admission with the condition to make up the missing credits within at most four semesters, otherwise enrolment lapses; standard period extended from three to four semesters (APO § 4 Abs. 6-7); program page: usually 210 ECTS, 180 ECTS considered 'if your Bachelor's closely aligns with our curriculum'

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 June (from winter semester 2026/27; program page: 'not fixed and may change')

September 2025 (amending statute itself not found, not opened; whether it changed § 3 is not confirmed — the reading version's § 3 reads 110 ECTS). AStuPO vom 27. April 2016 (vABlUP S. 24) in der Fassung der Dritten Änderungssatzung vom 24. Februar 2026 (in force 01.03.2026; only rewords § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 4 Satz 1 to name 'Informatik' and 'Artificial Intelligence Engineering'); 1st amendment 12.09.2019 (vABlUP S. 198) and 2nd amendment 04.08.2025 (vABlUP S. 72) opened. Reading versions from the university's Rechtsvorschriften folder ('Rechtlich verbindlich ist ausschließlich der amtliche, im offiziellen Amtsblatt veröffentlichte Text').

accepted_degree_fields.note: AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1: 'Einen Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor, Magister, Diplom, Staatsexamen) mit mindestens der Gesamtnote „befriedigend“ (2,7) an einer Hochschule des In- oder Auslands auf der Grundlage eines mindestens dreijährigen Studiums oder einen gleichwertigen Abschluss, mit einem Fachanteil, der in der jeweiligen Fachstudien- und -prüfungsordnung festgelegt wird'. Programme page: undergraduate degree 'in computer science or a related field', standard length of three years or more; only degrees from universities with 'H+' status in anabin. Programme page (not in the regulations): for a four-year non-ECTS degree the 110-credit requirement is met if about two-thirds of the credit points came from computer science modules/courses.

grade_requirement.note: AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1: Gesamtnote 'befriedigend' (2,7); 'der Gesamtnote „befriedigend“ (2,7) steht es gleich, wenn der Bewerber oder die Bewerberin im Ranking seines oder ihres Abschlussjahrgangs unter den besten 70 Prozent der Absolventen oder Absolventinnen ist.' GPU-R cannot check the cohort-ranking alternative (see DECISION in notes). Conversion: AStuPO § 8 Abs. 4 Satz 4 (Fakultätsrat rules, not printed); university grade converter: 'modified Bavarian formula' (orientation only, non-binding).

items.raw_label: Fachanteil Informatik von mindestens 110 ECTS-Leistungspunkten (FStuPO § 3)

subject_credit_requirements.note: FStuPO § 3: 'Der gemäß § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 AStuPO nachzuweisende Abschluss muss einen Fachanteil Informatik von mindestens 110 ECTS-Leistungspunkten enthalten.' No sub-areas named. AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 4 (in force for 'Informatik'): at least 10 ECTS independent scientific work, usually the Bachelor's thesis, or another scientific work written by the applicant — stored as other.thesis_scientific_work 10. FAQ: if the 110 ECTS are not met 'you will not be admitted'; 'The Admission Board can consider modules that you are going to study' in the last semester. Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: Nachweis von mindestens 10 ECTS-Leistungspunkten über die Kompetenz, ein Problem aus dem Themenschwerpunkt des qualifizierenden Hochschulabs

conditional_admission.mechanism: None in the FStuPO (no Auflagen clause). Framework option only: AStuPO § 4 Abs. 2 Satz 2: the examination board 'kann ... die Immatrikulation vom erfolgreichen Ablegen von Zusatzprüfungen abhängig machen' (additional examinations before enrolment, no cap). FAQ: 'waivers for any requirements are not granted.' Stored as not allowed (owner rule for framework 'kann' clauses; see DECISION).

descriptive_notes: Qualification decided by the examination board (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 2, Art. 86 BayHIG); it may consult the Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen and may make enrolment dependent on passing additional examinations (Zusatzprüfungen).
Grade alternative: applicants ranked among the best 70 % of their graduating cohort meet the grade requirement even above 2.7 (ranking document from the university).

allowed_exemptions: first degree completed exclusively (100 %) in English, stated on an official document (FAQ)
German-track alternative: German proof under § 3 Satz 1 Nr. 7 Immatrikulationssatzung instead of English (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 3)
language_english.note: FStuPO § 2 Abs. 3: 'Die Unterrichtssprache ist Deutsch, das Studium kann aber auch – mit eventuellen Einschränkungen bei der Schwerpunktbildung – auf Englisch absolviert werden.' AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 3 Satz 4: in programmes taught in German that can also be studied entirely in English 'genügt es, wenn der Nachweis der Kenntnisse nach Nr. 2 erbracht wird' (English B2 'durch einen anerkannten Sprachtest oder ein Äquivalent', plus German A1). Programme FAQ: TOEFL 567 paper / 87 internet-based / ITP 543, IELTS 5.5, CAE/CPE; MOI only 'if the MOI was 100% in English'; certificate 'must be provided at the time of application'. Central English page gives other B2 bands (IELTS 6.0-6.5, TOEFL iBT 72-94, PTE 59-75); programme FAQ values stored (see notes).

language_german.required_level: A1 (English track); German-track applicants: 'hinreichende Kenntnisse' under § 3 Satz 1 Nr. 7 Immatrikulationssatzung
language_german.due: A1: within one year after the start of studies (enrolment 'unter Vorbehalt' until then)

aps_certificate.note: Programme FAQ: for China, Vietnam and India 'the APS certificate is a mandatory requirement for applying to a German university.' Not in the regulations.

other_requirements: English or German abstract of the undergraduate thesis with a link to the full paper; without a thesis, a research paper or publication (programme page)
degree from a university with 'H+' status in anabin (programme page)
first degree based on at least three years of study (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1)

application before graduation: in exceptional cases if all degree coursework is completed by the start of lectures and the Transcript of Records shows an average of at least 2,7; degree to be proven by the end of the 10th lecture week, enrolment 'unter Vorbehalt' (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 3)
applicants with an Indian degree apply via uni-assist (application-methods page: direct application only for EU/EEA or listed countries)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 31 May (uni-assist 1 April - 31 May; direct 15 April - 31 May)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 December (1 November - 15 December)

admission_regulation.title: Fachprüfungsordnung (Satzung) der Technischen Fakultät der Christian-Albrechts-Universität zu Kiel für Studierende des 1-Fach-Masterstudiengangs Informatik mit dem Abschluss Master of Science (M. Sc.) – 2025 (§ 9), together with the Satzung der Technischen Fakultät der Christian-Albrechts-Universität zu Kiel zur Feststellung der Eignung für den 1-Fach-Masterstudiengang Informatik (Eignungsprüfungssatzung, § 3)
admission_regulation.version: FPO 2025 vom 21.11.2024, NBl. HS MBWFK Schl.-H. 17.12.2024 S. 72, in force 01.04.2025 (first-semester students from SS 2025; all students from WS 2026/27, § 14); read from the Studierendenservice reading copy ('Keine amtliche Bekanntmachung'); the official PDF on uni-kiel.de (Amtliche Bekanntmachung 2024 Nr. 84) could not be opened (robots). No amendment found. Eignungsprüfungssatzung vom 15.02.2023, NBl. HS MBWFK Schl.-H. 2023 S. 12 (published 20.04.2023), amended by the Erste Änderungssatzung vom 21.02.2025, NBl. 2025 S. 12 (published 16.04.2025): the German original and the amendment PDF could NOT be opened (robots); § 3 was read ONLY in the official non-binding English translation, which states it is 'amended by the statute of 21 February 2025' (consolidated). What the 2025 amendment changed was not seen.

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPO 2025 § 9 Abs. 1: 'Der Zugang zum Studiengang setzt voraus, dass die Bewerberin oder der Bewerber einen anerkannten, qualifizierten Bachelor of Science in Informatik oder einer verwandten Disziplin besitzt. Der Zugang kann nur erfolgen, wenn 1. mit diesem Abschluss dieselben Lernziele erreicht werden, die mit dem Bachelor of Science Informatik der Christian-Albrechts-Universität zu Kiel erreicht werden, oder 2. gemäß der Satzung zur Feststellung der Eignung für den 1-Fach-Masterstudiengang Informatik die Eignung festgestellt wurde.' The Prüfungsausschuss Informatik decides (§ 9 Abs. 2). This record stores route Nr. 2 (aptitude procedure with credit prerequisites), the only route with credit numbers; route Nr. 1 (same learning objectives as the Kiel B.Sc. Informatik, no numbers) is described here only (see DECISION in notes).

grade_requirement.note: Neither FPO 2025 § 9, the Eignungsprüfungssatzung (English translation) nor the PVO sets a minimum grade. No conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: Eignungsprüfungssatzung § 3 Nr. 1: academic achievements whose learning objectives and contents correspond to those of the compulsory modules in the 1-subject Bachelor's degree programme in Computer Science at Kiel University, scope 80 ECTS credits (includes the mathematics below)
Eignungsprüfungssatzung § 3 Nr. 1: academic achievements in the field of mathematics at least 20 ECTS credits (within the 80)
Eignungsprüfungssatzung § 3 Nr. 1: of which at least six ECTS credits in discrete mathematics (within the 20 mathematics)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Prerequisites for admission to the aptitude assessment (Eignungsprüfungssatzung § 3, read only in the official English translation; German original blocked). NESTED: mathematics 20 counts inside the 80 total; discrete mathematics 6 counts inside the mathematics 20 (E2a: courses used for a nested minimum also count for the total). The 80 item adds up CS and mathematics (main general_cs + covered general_mathematics, E1). § 3 Nr. 2 (at least 30 ECTS of CS topics NOT covered by the Kiel compulsory modules, in addition to the 80) is NOT stored as an item (Koushik's decision N-73, 17.10.2026): the taxonomy cannot separate 'Kiel compulsory topics' from other CS topics, and CS-field students practically exceed it; it is shown to the student as information. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): the reference to the Kiel compulsory modules is not converted into module-level items (R7); module content comparability is decided by the university.

conditional_admission.mechanism: None found: FPO 2025 contains no conditions clause (the word 'Auflage' does not occur); the Eignungsprüfungssatzung (English translation) has none; the PVO 2019 (as amended 19.06.2026) sets no general conditions rule for Master's access and leaves access to the Fachprüfungsordnungen (PVO § 3 Abs. 4). The Studienqualifikationssatzung lists no conditions for Informatik M.Sc.

descriptive_notes: Applicants who do not reach the same learning objectives as the Kiel B.Sc. Informatik (FPO § 9 Abs. 1 Nr. 1) must pass an oral aptitude assessment (Eignungsprüfung): one examiner and one assessor, 30-45 minutes, in English, usually by video platform with ID check; it examines specialised knowledge and abilities; examiner and assessor decide on suitability from the interview and the submitted documents; result by e-mail within one week (Eignungsprüfungssatzung § 4).
The aptitude assessment cannot be repeated in the same admission period; appeals within one month to the Examination Board for Computer Science (§§ 5-6).
The Prüfungsausschuss Informatik decides whether the admission requirements are met (FPO § 9 Abs. 2).

allowed_exemptions: allgemeine Hochschulreife (FPO § 9 Abs. 3 Nr. 1)
fachgebundene Hochschulreife with at least 3 years of English at Grundkursniveau (FPO § 9 Abs. 3 Nr. 2)
GRE revised General Test with at least 145 points in 'Verbal Reasoning' (FPO § 9 Abs. 3 Nr. 4)
graduates of the Kiel Bachelor's programme on which the Master's builds, where already checked
language_english.note: FPO 2025 § 9 Abs. 3 and Studienqualifikationssatzung § 3 (Informatik M.Sc.): proof of English by general university entrance qualification, subject-restricted entrance qualification with 3 years of English, 'Niveau B1 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER)', or GRE Verbal Reasoning at least 145. No test scores (IELTS/TOEFL) are named in the official sources read. Studienqualifikationssatzung § 2: proof at enrolment unless § 3 says otherwise. Teaching: each module in German or English; the Institute offers an English-language programme (FPO § 5). Medium of instruction is not mentioned. No IELTS/TOEFL minimum published (MyGU 24.10.2026: B1, or GRE Verbal 145 / Quant 157 / AW 3.0 as alternative proof).

other_requirements: form 'Bescheinigung über die Erfüllung der Zugangsvoraussetzungen laut Studienqualifikationssatzung' (studium.uni-kiel.de programme page)

Eignungsprüfungssatzung § 3 Nr. 2: at least 30 ECTS credits in computer science modules whose topics are not covered in the compulsory module section of the Kiel 1-subject B.Sc. Computer Science (in addition to the 80) — not checked by GPU-R.

admission_regulation.title: Besondere Bestimmungen der Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Computer Science der Fakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informatik und Mathematik an der Universität Paderborn vom 24. Mai 2024 (§ 34 Zugangsvoraussetzungen), together with the Allgemeine Bestimmungen für die Masterstudiengänge der Fakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informatik und Mathematik an der Universität Paderborn (§ 5)
admission_regulation.version: Besondere Bestimmungen: AM.Uni.Pb. 30.24 vom 24.05.2024, in force 01.10.2024, for students first enrolled from WS 2024/25 (§§ 44-45); replaces the PO Master Informatik vom 16.06.2017 (AM.Uni.Pb. 44.17, last amended AM.Uni.Pb. 22.22). Allgemeine Bestimmungen: AM.Uni.Pb. 32.24 vom 24.05.2024, in force 01.10.2024 (replaces AM.Uni.Pb. 25.20). No amendment of either is listed on the Institute's regulations page (Computer Science M.Sc. 'V1 (ab WiSe 24/25)') or found by search; the full AM.Uni.Pb. listing was not searched, so not exhaustive.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Allgemeine Bestimmungen § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: a first professional qualifying degree with a standard period of at least six semesters (foreign degrees: no substantial difference in competencies; the Prüfungsausschuss decides); further requirements in the Besondere Bestimmungen. Besondere Bestimmungen § 34 sets only the subject areas and grade, not a degree name. Program page: 'Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Paderborn University or in an equivalent or comparable degree program'. Institute admission page: 'Gesamtnote von in der Regel mindestens 3.0 in einem methodenorientierten Bachelorstudiengang in Informatik'; graduates of other Bachelor programmes can apply and the committee may set additional prerequisites.

grade_requirement.note: Besondere Bestimmungen § 34 Abs. 1 b: 'Der Studienabschluss muss mit einer Gesamtnote von mindestens 3,0 erfolgt sein.' The Institute admission page says 'in der Regel mindestens 3.0'; the regulation has no 'in der Regel'. No conversion method in the regulation; the Institute's international page links a Bavarian-formula calculator (TUM) to calculate the German grade equivalent.

items.raw_label: mindestens 20 Leistungspunkte (LP) im Bereich Softwaretechnik
mindestens 20 LP im Bereich der Theoretischen Informatik
mindestens 15 LP im Bereich der Technischen Informatik
mindestens 15 LP im Bereich mathematischer Grundlagen der Informatik

subject_credit_requirements.note: Besondere Bestimmungen § 34 Abs. 1 a ('In Umsetzung des § 5 Absatz 1 Nr. 2b) der Allgemeinen Bestimmungen'): the degree must include at least 20 LP Softwaretechnik, 20 LP Theoretische Informatik, 15 LP Technische Informatik and 15 LP mathematische Grundlagen der Informatik (sum 70 LP). The regulation names areas only, no modules. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Bereich Softwaretechnik' is stored as software engineering with programming and databases as covered categories (added up, E1); Technische Informatik as computer_engineering only; mathematics as one general_mathematics total. The four items share no category. Which courses belong to each 'Bereich' is decided by the Prüfungsausschuss (AB § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 b); see DECISION lines in the notes.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Einschreibung mit Auflage (Allgemeine Bestimmungen § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 b; Besondere Bestimmungen § 38 Abs. 3 'Im Fall der Einschreibung mit Auflagen gemäß § 34'): 'Fehlen in zulassungsfreien Studiengängen Kompetenzen oder Studienanteile so kann die Einschreibung mit der Auflage erfolgen, die Leistungspunkte durch angemessene Studien nachzuholen und durch das Bestehen zugehöriger Prüfungen bis zur Meldung zur Masterarbeit nachzuweisen.' The Prüfungsausschuss decides; 'Die fehlenden und nachzuholenden Studien dürfen 30 Leistungspunkte nicht überschreiten.' Proof before admission to the Master's thesis (BB § 38 Abs. 3).

descriptive_notes: Free admission (no NC) according to the program page.

Foreign applicants not treated as Germans by international treaty must prove their ability to study by a very good final grade, the GRE or the dMAT (see standardized tests); applicants with a German university entrance qualification are exempt (Besondere Bestimmungen § 34 Abs. 1 c).
The Prüfungsausschuss decides on equivalence of foreign degrees and which courses count for each area (Allgemeine Bestimmungen § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 2).

allowed_exemptions: successful school English lessons from grade 5 for at least five years (BB § 34 Abs. 3 a)

Bachelor's degree from an English-speaking country, i.e. where English is the official language and the medium of instruction of the programme, or from a programme in Germany accredited as English-taught (BB § 34 Abs. 3 b)
tests of equivalent level (BB § 34 Abs. 3 f)
language_english.note: Besondere Bestimmungen § 34 Abs. 3: 'Zum Masterstudiengang Computer Science wird eingeschrieben, wer englische Sprachkenntnisse besitzt', proven by school English, a Bachelor's from an English-speaking country, 'einen Sprachtest mindestens auf dem Niveau TOEFL 550 (paper and pencil) oder TOEFL 80 (internet-based)', 'Cambridge Test-Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) mit mindestens der Note B', 'IELTS mit dem Mindestergebnis 6.5' or equivalent tests. PTE Academic 75 and Duolingo 105 are from the Institute's international-students page only (not in the regulation). No CEFR level named. uni-assist asks for the language certificate with the application, but the regulation ties it to enrolment.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: foreign applicants not treated as Germans by or under international treaties (exempt: applicants with a German university entrance qualification); alternatives: very good final grade or dMAT
standardized_test_requirements.details: BB § 34 Abs. 1 c: one of (i) 'einer sehr guten Abschlussnote des Abschlusses gemäß §5 Absatz 1 Nr. 1a) der Allgemeinen Bestimmungen', (ii) GRE Revised General Test 'mit in der Regel mindestens 157 Punkten im Teil "Quantitative Reasoning" und mindestens 4,0 Punkten im Teil "Analytical Writing"', (iii) 'Test-AS Mastertest Computer Science dMAT mit mindestens 50% der erreichbaren Punkte'. Institute international page: the exception requires a Bachelor's grade 'below the threshold of 1.8'.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: alternative to the GRE for the same applicants
standardized_test_requirements.details: at least 50% of the achievable points (BB § 34 Abs. 1 c iii)

aps_certificate.note: University page 'Application Procedure and Documents' lists 'APS if you are applying from India, China or Vietnam' among the application documents. Not in the regulation.

other_requirements: application via uni-assist for applicants without a German university entrance qualification, regardless of nationality (program page)
GRE or dMAT result uploaded with the uni-assist application for Computer Science (application documents page)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 30 November (uni-assist, English-taught programmes; additional documents by 15 January)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung der Universität Trier für die Prüfung im Masterstudiengang Data Science (1-Fach), § 2, together with the 'Regeln für die Zulassung von Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern für den M.Sc. Data Science' (Beschluss des Prüfungsausschusses vom 16. Februar 2024) and the Allgemeine Prüfungsordnung für die Masterstudiengänge an der Universität Trier (APOM)
admission_regulation.version: Nichtamtliche Lesefassung (7. LF) of the Ordnung vom 21.12.2017, incorporating the amendments of 18.02.2019, 12.08.2019, 27.07.2020, 05.05.2021, 18.07.2022, 06.03.2023 and 02.08.2023 (applies to students first enrolled from WS 2021/22); the binding Verkündungsblatt texts of the ordinance and its amendments were not opened. accepted_degree_fields.note: This record is route A. FPO § 2 Nr. 1: 'Bachelorabschluss oder gleichwertiger Studienabschluss' a) in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsmathematik, Statistik oder Volkswirtschaftslehre (1,7 or better) or b) in einer verwandten Fachrichtung (1,4 or better); equivalence decided by the Prüfungsausschuss case by case. at least five school years of English in Sekundarstufe I and II
at least five points in English in the university entrance qualification (Abitur)

conversion of the local GPA to the German scale with the formula (Gmax - G)/(Gmax - Gmin) x 3 + 1, truncated after the first decimal, with maximum and minimum passing grade (prospective-applicants information)

accepted_degree_fields.note: This record is route D. FPO § 2 Nr. 1: 'Bachelorabschluss oder gleichwertiger Studienabschluss' a) in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsmathematik, Statistik oder Volkswirtschaftslehre (1,7 or better) or b) in einer verwandten Fachrichtung (1,4 or better); equivalence decided by the Prüfungsausschuss case by case. GPU-R route split (lesson 15 / E9; GPU-R arithmetic, not regulation wording): FPO § 2 Nr. 1 and the Prüfungsausschuss rules of 16.02.2024 give four routes for a CS-type applicant. Route A: degree classified as Informatik (§ 2 Nr. 1 a), grade 1,7 or better. Route B: Informatik, grade 1,8 to 2,2, plus a weighted average of at least 1,7 over 20/180 ECTS of Programmierung/Algorithmen/Datenbanksysteme modules. Route C: degree classified as verwandte Fachrichtung (§ 2 Nr. 1 b), grade 1,4 or better, usually at least 50/180 ECTS relevant modules. Route D: verwandte Fachrichtung, grade 1,5 to 1,9, plus a weighted average of at least 1,4 over 20/180 ECTS of the listed relevant modules. A degree titled exactly 'Computer Science' is Informatik without further check; 'Computer Science and Engineering', 'Software Engineering', 'Software Technology', 'Information Technology', 'Computer Engineering', 'Data Science', 'Data Engineering' and similar are Informatik only with at least 100/180 ECTS in Informatik or Mathematik, of which at least 7 ECTS clearly theoretical computer science; otherwise the committee may treat them as a related field. The programme is shown once with the student's best route. Prospective-applicants information (10.10.2026): Computer Science and Engineering 'usually' equivalent to computer science; Information Technology (in the past approx. 30 %) and Computer Engineering (approx. 90 %) classified as computer science depending on theory modules; Software Engineering 'usually' a related area; Data Science/AI/ML usually equivalent to the listed fields. Other degrees should apply only with at least 50 ECTS (27,8 % of non-ECTS credits) in computer science, mathematics or statistics.

grade_requirement.note: FPO § 2 Nr. 1: for a degree in a related field 'mit der Note zwischen 1,5 und 1,9' the Prüfungsausschuss decides case by case by published criteria. PA rules 16.02.2024: weighted average of at least 1,4 over modules of 20/180 ECTS from the modules listed for Informatik, Mathematik or Statistik/VWL (not checked by the engine). Grades 1,4 or better: route C. Conversion: modified Bavarian formula, one decimal, no rounding.

items.raw_label: Verwandte Fachrichtung (PA rules to § 2 Nr. 1b FPO): 'in der Regel mindestens 50/180 ECTS (bzw. mindestens 27,7% aller im Bachelorzeugnis ausgewiesenen Punkte) in fachlich relevanten Modulen' (examples: Informatik — Programmierung, Datenbanksysteme, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen, Softwaretechnik, Softwareentwicklung, Komplexitätstheorie, Formale Sprachen, Automatentheorie, Betriebssysteme, Data Mining, Maschinelles Lernen, Sprachverarbeitung, Grundlagen der KI; Mathematik — Analysis, Lineare Algebra, Wahrscheinlichkeitsrechnung, Numerische Mathematik; Statistik — Deskriptive/Induktive/Mathematische Statistik, Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie, Statistische Programmiersprachen, Statistical bzw. Data Literacy u.a.)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Route D item: as route C. The PA rules state the limits for a 180-ECTS bachelor; for other totals 'gelten die analogen Punktanteile' (percentages in brackets: 55,5 %, 3,9 %, 11,1 %, 27,7 %). admission_regulation.version: PO vom 23.09.2020 (AM 20/2020, S. 35 ff.), geändert durch Ordnung vom 24.11.2020 (AM 26/2020, S. 9 ff.; § 3 neu gefasst incl. Auflagen cap), 2. Änderungsordnung vom 02.11.2023 (AM 25/2023, S. 1-4; § 3 Abs. 2 und 5 geändert, grade 2,7, from the SS 2024 application round). No consolidated version found. The faculty pages announce a 'PO 2026' expected from WS 2026/27 (only a draft study plan is published); no PO 2026 text or 4th amendment was found (BLOCKED: central regulations listing unreadable).

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 3 Abs. 1 (i.d.F. 2. ÄO 2022): a) Bachelor Data Science TU Dortmund, b) Bachelor Datenanalyse und Datenmanagement TU Dortmund, or c) 'ein anderer Abschluss in einem mindestens dreijährigen (sechssemestrigen) statistisch, informatisch oder mathematisch orientierten Studiengang mit empirischer Anwendung', if the Prüfungsausschuss finds no essential differences; comparability is 'in der Regel' given with the subject contents stored as items. Foreign degrees: KMK/HRK equivalence agreements and ZAB recommendations (§ 3 Abs. 4).

grade_requirement.note: PO § 3 Abs. 2 a) i.d.F. 3. ÄO 02.11.2023 (from the SS 2024 application round): 'mindestens die Note 2,7 („befriedigend“) oder, im Falle eines ausländischen Abschlusses, eine der Gesamtnote 2,7 mindestens gleichwertige Note'. Self-disclosure form 2026 (faculty): conversion with the modified Bavarian formula, truncated after the first decimal ('2.79 counts as sufficient'). Earlier versions: 2,5 ('gut').

items.raw_label: § 3 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'Leistungen in den zentralen Bereichen der Mathematik, der Informatik und der Statistik im Umfang von mindestens 44 Leistungspunkten, zusammengesetzt aus' aa), bb), cc)
aa) 'Leistungen in der Informatik in den Gebieten „Algorithmen“, „Datenstrukturen“, „Objekt-Orientierte Programmierung“ und „Softwaretechnik“ im Umfang von mindestens 8 Leistungspunkten'
bb) 'Leistungen in der Mathematik in den Gebieten „Analysis“, „Lineare Algebra“, „Differentialgleichungen“, „Diskrete Mathematik“ und „Numerik“ im Umfang von mindestens 8 Leistungspunkten'

cc) 'Leistungen im Bereich Statistik im Umfang von mindestens 12 Leistungspunkten' (Grundlagen — (deskriptive) Statistik, Wahrscheinlichkeitsrechnung — mindestens 4 LP; fortgeschrittene Inferenz — Punktschätzung, Intervallschätzung, Hypothesentests, Stochastik — mindestens 8 LP)
§ 3 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'Leistungen in der Informatik aus dem Bereich „Datenbanken“ im Umfang von mindestens 4 Leistungspunkten'

§ 3 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: 'Leistungen in Veranstaltungen der Datenmodellierung aus den Gebieten der „(generalisierten) linearen Modelle“, „statistischer / maschinelle Lernverfahren“, „Zeitreihen“ und der (praktischen) Optimierung im Umfang von mindestens 8 Leistungspunkten' — optimization: no taxonomy category yet, counts 0

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO § 3 Abs. 1 i.d.F. 2. ÄO 05.05.2022 (unchanged by the 3. ÄO 2023). NESTED: aa) 8 + bb) 8 + cc) 12 count inside the 44 LP total of Nr. 1 (E2a); Nr. 2 Datenbanken 4 and Nr. 3 Datenmodellierung 8 are separate requirements. The 44 LP total is stored with main category general_mathematics (incl. statistics) plus the aa) computer-science categories (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording). Statistics cc) is stored as one 12 LP item; the 4 LP basic / 8 LP inference split cannot be checked by category (see DECISION). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Numerik' in bb) is covered by calculus_analysis (taxonomy: numerical methods); '(praktische) Optimierung' in Nr. 3 is stored as mathematics_statistics.optimization_numerics (allowed GPU-R name, not yet in cs_taxonomy.json, counts 0); generalized linear models and time series are statistics but statistics_probability is kept only in cc) so that no course counts twice between sibling requirements (stricter; DECISION). CONFLICT: the faculty admission page and the self-disclosure form 2026 state different numbers (44 total; CS 8; mathematics 16; basic statistics 8 resp. at least 4 plus one course 'fully dedicated to statistics'; no databases or data-modelling requirement) — regulation values stored.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflagen (PO § 3 Abs. 3 i.d.F. Ordnung vom 24.11.2020, not changed by the 2022 and 2023 amendments): 'Abhängig von dieser Beurteilung kann der Prüfungsausschuss eine Zulassung ohne oder mit Auflagen zur erfolgreichen Absolvierung fehlender Studienleistungen aussprechen oder die Zulassung ablehnen. Auflagen können bis zu einem Umfang von insgesamt höchstens 30 Leistungspunkten verlangt werden.' To be fulfilled by the start of 'Case Studies' (Modul 4, Project Work). CONFLICT: the faculty admission page says 'If any of these four criteria are not met, admission cannot be granted. No exceptions are permitted.'

descriptive_notes: Not admission restricted (no NC); the Prüfungsausschuss compares content, scope and requirements of the previous courses with the TU Dortmund Data Science bachelor (§ 3 Abs. 3).

Special subject aptitude (§ 3 Abs. 2 e): applicants with a degree under lit. c) must submit a self-written final report on a university data-analysis project (statistical report task published by the faculty) with a sworn declaration.
Online self-assessment: participation is required; the faculty page says its score has no influence on admission.
Master's degrees, professional experience and further-education certificates are not considered (faculty page); admission cannot be deferred to a later semester.

allowed_exemptions: German Allgemeine Hochschulreife (usual proof)
graduation from an English-language school
degree from an English-language study programme
language_english.note: PO § 3 Abs. 2 b) i.d.F. 3. ÄO 2023: good English 'mindestens dem Niveau B2 des europäischen Referenzrahmens'; usually the Allgemeine Hochschulreife; substitute proofs e.g. 'ein international anerkanntes Sprachzertifikat, der Abschluss einer englischsprachigen Schule oder der Abschluss eines englischsprachigen Studiengangs'. self-disclosure form of the Faculty of Statistics, signed twice (§ 3 Abs. 2 d)
