admission_regulation.title: Zugangssatzung für den Masterstudiengang Data Science des Fachbereichs Mathematik und Informatik und des Fachbereichs Erziehungswissenschaft und Psychologie der Freien Universität Berlin
admission_regulation.version: FU-Mitteilungen 3/2025 vom 14.02.2025, S. 125-128, in force from the day after publication; as amended by Erste Satzung zur Änderung der Zugangssatzung (FU-Mitteilungen 22/2025 vom 16.12.2025, S. 446; replaces Anlage 2 Selbstauskunft)

accepted_degree_fields.note: § 3 Abs. 1 ZugS: first professional degree of 180 LP/ECTS 'im Fach Informatik' (CS profile, stored here: no further subject-credit conditions stated for this profile) OR a degree 'in einem anderen Fach' with at least 20 LP mathematics modules (incl. at least 5 LP linear algebra or analysis and at least 5 LP probability theory or statistics) and at least 10 LP computer science modules (incl. at least 5 LP algorithms and at least 5 LP in a module teaching a higher programming language, e.g. C/C++, Java, Python). § 3 Abs. 3: 'Über die Gleichwertigkeit vorgelegter Nachweise entscheidet der Prüfungsausschuss' (the examination board decides on the equivalence of submitted documents). GPU-R engine policy (not regulation wording): CS, CSE and IT degrees are treated as 'im Fach Informatik'. If FU's board classes a degree as 'anderes Fach', the 20 LP mathematics / 10 LP computer science route applies.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade for access. The average grade only yields selection points (max 60) via the table in Anlage 1 ZugS (1.0 = 60 points, minus 2 points per 0.1 grade step, 4.0 = 0 points). No conversion method for foreign grades is stated in the ZugS.

subject_credit_requirements.note: CS profile (degree of 180 LP in Informatik) has no separate subject-credit items in § 3 Abs. 1 ZugS. Alternative profile for other subjects (not stored as items): Mathematik-Module insgesamt mindestens 20 LP (davon mind. 5 LP Lineare Algebra oder Analysis, mind. 5 LP Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie oder Statistik) und Informatik-Module insgesamt mindestens 10 LP (davon mind. 5 LP Algorithmen, mind. 5 LP höhere Programmiersprache). The department asks all applicants to highlight the courses fulfilling the mathematics and computer science requirements in the transcript.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No admission with conditions/bridging modules provided in the ZugS. (Only provisional admission 'unter Vorbehalt' for applicants selected on a transcript before degree completion, § 2 Abs. 5 and § 5 Abs. 3 ZugS.)

descriptive_notes: Competitive points-based selection, max 100 points (§ 4 ZugS): average grade up to 60 points (Anlage 1); 10 points for at least 15 LP in theoretical computer science; 10 points for at least 15 LP in interdisciplinary data science (e.g. psychology, digital humanities, natural sciences); 20 points for at least 450 hours of study-relevant research-oriented activity (e.g. student/research assistant).
No published minimum score: places go to the top-ranked applicants. The department states: 'Due to limited capacity, we can only offer the 20 top ranked applicants a place in the program.'

Quotas (§ 4 Abs. 1 ZugS): 80 % of places remaining after pre-quotas via this selection procedure (Hochschulquote); 20 % under § 15 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 2 BerlHZG; a 5 % pre-quota under BerlHZG. Number of places is set per admission date in the FU Zulassungsordnung.

Application before degree completion possible if at least 2/3 of the total workload has been graded and the thesis is registered (§ 2 Abs. 5 ZugS); then the current transcript average is used. Admission is then 'unter Vorbehalt'; the degree must generally be submitted by the end of the first semester (§ 5 Abs. 3 ZugS).

Degree check: FU's examination board decides whether your degree counts as 'Informatik'. If it does not (possible for IT or related degrees), you need at least 20 LP mathematics (incl. 5 LP linear algebra or analysis and 5 LP probability or statistics) and 10 LP computer science (incl. 5 LP algorithms and 5 LP a higher programming language).

allowed_exemptions: degree from an institution where English is the language of instruction
language_english.note: § 3 Abs. 2 ZugS: English at CEFR C1 for applicants who did not obtain their degree at an institution with English as language of instruction. Anlage 2 (as amended by FU-Mitteilungen 22/2025) names examples ('e.g.'): university degree from an English-taught institution, IELTS 7.0, TOEFL iBT 95, UNIcert III. The list is illustrative, not exhaustive.

aps_certificate.note: FU page 'Application with International Degree': applicants with certificates from China, India or Vietnam generally have to submit an APS certification in addition to the other documents; a VPD from uni-assist is also required for foreign degrees.

other_requirements: Self-indication form (Selbstauskunft, Anlage 2 ZugS)
VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) from uni-assist for foreign degrees

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 31 May (§ 2 Abs. 3 ZugS; WS 2026/27: mid-April to 31 May 2026; VPD must be requested from uni-assist before 31 May)

admission_regulation.title: Fachstudien- und -prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Wirtschaftsinformatik / Information Systems an der Universität Passau (§ 3 Qualifikation (Fachanteile, Note, GMAT, und Sprachkenntnisse)), together with the Allgemeine Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für Masterstudiengänge der Wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Fakultät (AStuPO, § 4 Qualifikation)
admission_regulation.version: FStuPO vom 01. September 2025, in force 01.09.2025, applies first to students starting in the Sommersemester 2026; replaces the Studien- und Prüfungsordnung Master Wirtschaftsinformatik of 13.07.2012 (as amended 22.12.2014), which expires 31.03.2026 for new students. No amendment of the FStuPO found by search. AStuPO vom 20. Dezember 2017 (vABlUP S. 72) in der Fassung der dritten Änderungssatzung vom 04. August 2025 (in force 01.10.2025; changes § 4 Abs. 3 on application before graduation: subject shares and GMAT must be met 'bis zum Ende der Bewerbungsfrist'); first amendment: Satzung zur Änderung der AStuPO Master WiWi vom 28. Februar 2024 (in force 01.03.2024; § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2/3, Abs. 2, Abs. 3 changed; Abs. 3 superseded by the 3rd ÄS); further amendment 21.08.2024 (vABlUP S. 120) and the first amendment not opened. Reading versions from the university's Rechtsvorschriften folder; the 3rd AStuPO amendment read in the Virtuelles Amtsblatt.

accepted_degree_fields.note: FStuPO § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 1: the degree under § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 AStuPO 'ist in einem wirtschaftsinformatischen Studiengang oder einem Studiengang, welcher einen wirtschaftsinformatischen Anteil im Umfang von mindestens 60 ECTS-Leistungspunkten (ECTS-LP) oder einen vergleichbaren Umfang aufweist, mit der Gesamtnote „2,7“ oder besser nachzuweisen.' AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1: 'einen Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor, Magister, Diplom, Staatsexamen) an einer Hochschule des In- oder Auslands auf der Grundlage eines mindestens dreijährigen Studiums'. Programme page: 'at least three years of study in information systems' or a related field. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): a CS degree qualifies only through the 60 ECTS share rule (items); primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record.

grade_requirement.note: FStuPO § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 1-2: 'mit der Gesamtnote „2,7“ oder besser'; 'Alternativ zur Gesamtnote 2,7 kann die Bewerberin oder der Bewerber die Qualifikation nachweisen, wenn sie oder er zu den besten 50 Prozent der Absolventinnen und Absolventen des jeweiligen Prüfungstermins gehört hat.' GPU-R cannot check the cohort-ranking alternative (see DECISION in notes). Conversion: AStuPO § 8 Abs. 4 (binding conversion rules by the Fakultätsrat, not printed); programme page refers to the university grade converter ('modified Bavarian formula', orientation only).

items.raw_label: wirtschaftsinformatischer Anteil im Umfang von mindestens 60 ECTS-LP (oder vergleichbarer Umfang), davon bis zu 40 ECTS-LP aus wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Fächern und bis zu 40 ECTS-LP aus informatischen Fächern (FStuPO § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 1 und 3)
of the 60: at least 20 ECTS-LP not from informatische Fächer, i.e. Wirtschaftsinformatik or wirtschaftswissenschaftliche Fächer (GPU-R arithmetic, not regulation wording: 60 minus the 40 CS cap)

subject_credit_requirements.note: FStuPO § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 3: 'Von dem wirtschaftsinformatischen Fachanteil im Umfang von 60 ECTS-LP können bis zu 40 ECTS-LP aus wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Fächern und bis zu 40 ECTS-LP aus informatischen Fächern erbracht worden sein.' Programme page: 'at least 60 ECTS credits (or equivalent) in information systems subjects. Of these 60 ECTS credits, up to 40 ECTS credits may be in subjects on management, economics or business administration and up to 40 ECTS credits may be in subjects on computer science.' POOLED/NESTED: item 1 is the 60 total, added up (E1); items 2 and 3 are GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording) that express the two 40 ECTS caps the engine cannot apply: since at most 40 CS credits count, at least 20 must come from Wirtschaftsinformatik or business/economics, and vice versa; they count inside the 60 (E2a). Wirtschaftsinformatik / information systems and economics (VWL) have no category in cs_taxonomy.json (economics exists only in the mechanical taxonomy); GPU-R assumes Wirtschaftsinformatik courses are classified into CS or business categories (see DECISION). Self-assessment form required at application. FAQ: credits must be earned by the application deadline. Koushik's decision N-70 (17.10.2026): the 'at least 20 CS' item (from the 40 business cap) is removed, because this record is only matched against CS-field students, who always have more than 20 CS credits; the 'at least 20 business' item (from the 40 CS cap) stays.

conditional_admission.mechanism: None in the FStuPO (no Auflagen clause). Framework option only: AStuPO § 4 Abs. 2 Satz 2: the examination board 'kann ... die Immatrikulation vom erfolgreichen Ablegen von Zusatzprüfungen abhängig machen' (no cap). AStuPO § 4 Abs. 3 (as amended 04.08.2025): even when starting before graduation, the subject shares and GMAT must be met by the end of the application period. FAQ: 'waivers for any requirements are not granted.' Stored as not allowed (owner rule for framework 'kann' clauses; see DECISION).

descriptive_notes: Grade alternative: applicants among the best 50 % of graduates of their examination date meet the grade requirement even above 2.7 (FStuPO § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 2).

Qualification decided by the examination board (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 2, Art. 86 BayHIG); it may consult the Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen and may make enrolment dependent on passing additional examinations (Zusatzprüfungen).
GMAT for degrees from states that have not signed the Lisbon Recognition Convention (see standardized_test_requirements); applications are not processed until the score is received (programme page).

allowed_exemptions: first higher-education degree completed entirely in English, noted on the transcripts or officially confirmed by the institution (central English page)
Abitur/Matura stating English at B2 or higher
language_english.note: AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 2: English 'auf dem Niveau B 2 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen durch einen anerkannten Sprachtest oder ein Äquivalent'. Programme page: 'proof of English language skills equivalent to level B2 CEFR' (links to the central page). Central page 'requirements-for-study/english': IELTS 6.0-6.5, TOEFL iBT 72-94 (@home 4.0-4.5), TOEFL ITP 543, PTE Academic 59-75, Cambridge FCE A-C = B2; certificates max. two years old at application; Duolingo and DAAD certificates not accepted. FAQ: certificate 'must be provided at the time of application'.

language_german.due: within one year after the start of studies (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 3 Satz 5)

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants whose degree was not obtained in a state that signed the Lisbon Recognition Convention of 11 April 1997 (FAQ names India as such a country)
standardized_test_requirements.details: FStuPO § 3 Abs. 2: 'mindestens 600 Punkten (10th Edition) oder 565 Punkten (Focus Edition)'. FAQ: 'Other tests (e.g. GRE) are not recognised'; score must be submitted by the application deadline; 'No exceptions can be made.'

aps_certificate.note: Not on the Information Systems pages. University FAQ (M.Sc. AI Engineering / Computer Science pages): for China, Vietnam and India 'the APS certificate is a mandatory requirement for applying to a German university' (general statement, see notes).

other_requirements: self-assessment form uploaded with the application (programme page)
first degree based on at least three years of study (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1)

application before graduation: at least 140 ECTS by the start of lectures, provisional overall grade meeting the required grade, subject shares/GMAT by the end of the application period; degree to be proven within one year after starting (Ausschlussfrist) (AStuPO § 4 Abs. 3); programme page: certificate due 30 September (winter start) / 31 March (summer start) of the following year
applicants with a degree from outside the EEA must apply via uni-assist (FAQ)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 30 June (uni-assist 1 April - 30 June; direct applicants 15 April - 15 July)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 January (1 November - 15 January, all applicants)

admission_regulation.title: Satzung über besondere Zugangsvoraussetzungen für Studiengänge der Fakultät für Mathematik, Informatik und Naturwissenschaften der Universität Hamburg (Neufassung vom 17.04.2024), Nr. 12 Intelligent Adaptive Systems; together with the Auswahlsatzung of the Fakultät MIN
admission_regulation.version: Neufassung vom 17.04.2024 (Präsidium 30.04.2024, Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 32 vom 15.05.2024; § 4: effective on the day following publication), read only in the official English translation 'Revised Bylaws Regarding the Special Conditions of Admission for Degree Programs in the Faculty of Mathematics, Informatics and Natural Sciences' (https://uni-hamburg.de/campuscenter/studienorganisation/ordnungen-satzungen/zugangsvoraussetzungen/min/20240417-zugang-min-32-eng.pdf); German binding text robots-blocked. NOT OPENED: Neufassung 18.12.2024, Neufassung 21.05.2025 (search indexes link it to IAS, so it is probably the current text for IAS), Änderungen 19.11.2025 and 18.03.2026. Whether these change entry 12 is not confirmed.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Bylaw 17.04.2024 Nr. 12.1 (official EN translation): 'A bachelor of science either in' Informatics / Information Systems / Software Systems Development / Human-computer interaction / Computing in Science … 'provided that at least 60 ECTS credits of coursework has been completed in informatics'; 'Comparability of the degree program is determined by the selection committee.' Application Information PDF (onTEAM, Feb 2023): 1a 'A Bachelor's degree with at least 60 ECTS in core computer science courses' from listed Universität Hamburg MIN degrees, or 1b 'A Bachelor's degree in a related field from Universität Hamburg or another University', provided '60 ECTS credit points were acquired in the field of computer science'; the selection committee decides comparability. Department application page: 'A Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field insofar as 60 ECTS credit points were acquired in the core field of computer science.' Foreign qualifications must be recognised by Universität Hamburg (Anabin evidence). IAS wiki: degree 'equivalent to at least a three year Bachelor in Germany'; university 'recognized with H+'.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the official sources read; the binding statute was not read (BLOCKED). The grade and its comparability with the Universität Hamburg Bachelor's in Computer Science is selection criterion 2 (30%). The grade must be documented in numbers with the grading scale by an official document; self-calculated grades are not accepted (IAS wiki).

items.raw_label: at least 60 ECTS credits of coursework … completed in informatics (Satzung über besondere Zugangsvoraussetzungen MIN, Neufassung 17.04.2024, Nr. 12.1, read in the official English translation); Department page: 'Any kind of maths, economics, management, electrical engineering, soft skills courses do not count'

subject_credit_requirements.note: Source: official Universität Hamburg application information and Department of Informatics application page (binding Zugangssatzung Nr. 12.1 read in the official English translation; German binding text robots-blocked). Courses with unclear names ('Project', 'Thesis') need extra proof of significant computer science content; applicants fill in a 60-ECTS table template with finished core CS subjects only. general_cs excludes mathematics, so the exclusion of maths/EE/economics/soft skills is respected (GPU-R mapping, not regulation wording). The old record mentioned a rule that all 60 ECTS must come from a single degree; this was not found in any official source read today (not stored).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions (Auflagen) clause found in the sources read: the FSB 2018 has none, and the application information and Department pages mention none. The binding Zugangs-/Auswahlsatzung could not be read (BLOCKED), so a clause there cannot be excluded. The application information allows submitting the Bachelor's certificate by the end of the first semester (not a subject condition).

descriptive_notes: If there are more applicants than places, a selection committee ranks applications: letter of motivation 40% (possibly including a telephone/e-mail interview), result of the Bachelor's degree and its comparability with the Universität Hamburg Bachelor's in Computer Science 30%, relevant professional and international experience 30% (Application Information PDF; IAS wiki).

Department application page: 'Approximately the best 5% of ranked applications receive a letter of acceptance.' IAS wiki: a ranking of around 85% was needed to be among the Top 30 (past guidance, not a rule).
Only complete applications submitted by the deadline are evaluated; missing documents cannot be submitted after the deadline.

allowed_exemptions: native English speakers, or applicants who lived or studied in an English-speaking country for three years or longer, case by case by the selection committee (Application Information PDF)
language_english.note: Application Information PDF ('Additional special admission requirement 2') and Department page: CEFR/TELC 'at least B2 in all categories or C1'; IELTS 'Overall band 6.5 + B2' with minimum subscores of 6.0 for Listening, Comprehension, Speaking, Writing; TOEFL iBT 90 with minimum subscores of 20 for Reading, Listening, Speaking, Writing, PBT 575, CBT 230; Cambridge CAE or CPE; 'You still have to reach the overall minimum level'. Department page: 'The medium of instruction of your degree is not sufficient proof of English Language Proficiency!' The binding statute was not read (BLOCKED). Bylaw Nr. 12.2: 'CEFR/TELC B2'; IELTS Academic at least 6.5; TOEFL iBT at least 90; CAE; CPE 'or equivalent proof. Comparability of proof is determined by the selection committee.'

other_requirements: letter of motivation (max. 1.5 pages)
cover letter form (template provided)
curriculum vitae
table proving at least 60 ECTS in core computer science (template provided)
transcript of records, Bachelor certificate or official letter with expected graduation date and preliminary grade, Diploma Supplement, grade and grading scale
proof of recognition of foreign educational qualifications (Anabin)
certified translations of documents not in English or German
online application via STiNE; Bachelor's certificate can be submitted by the end of the first semester (Application Information PDF)

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Fachprüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang International Software Systems Science an der Otto-Friedrich-Universität Bamberg, §§ 31 and 33, together with the Allgemeine Prüfungsordnung für Bachelor- und Masterstudiengänge der Fakultät Wirtschaftsinformatik und Angewandte Informatik (APO WIAI)
admission_regulation.version: SFPO vom 29.09.2025 (Amtliche Veröffentlichung 2025-81), in force 01.10.2025; replaces the SFPO vom 24.09.2024 (2024-76), which the Änderungssatzung vom 31.03.2025 (2025-31) had amended (§ 33 Abs. 1 grade 2,0 -> 2,7, from the WS 2025/26 application round). No amendment of the 2025 SFPO is listed on the regulations page or in the 2025 announcements index (checked up to 2025-114); 2026 index checked (16.10.2026): no SFPO amendment. APO WIAI vom 31.03.2008, zuletzt geändert durch 26. Änderungssatzung vom 05.08.2026 (2026-44, in force 01.10.2026; inserts only § 11 Abs. 7, not admission-relevant): consolidated text could not be read (BLOCKED); 24th and 25th amendments opened, not admission-relevant.

accepted_degree_fields.note: This record stores § 33 Abs. 2 (related degree). § 31: 'Verwandte Studiengänge ... sind alle Studiengänge des Studienbereichs Informatik (insbesondere Bioinformatik, Computer- und Kommunikationstechniken, Informatik, Ingenieurinformatik/Technische Informatik, Medieninformatik, Medizinische Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik)'; the Prüfungsausschuss decides in individual cases. § 33 Abs. 1 (other profile): degree of at least six semesters / 180 ECTS 'in einem Studiengang im gleichen Studienfach' with grade 2,7 or better and no subject items ('gleiches Studienfach' is not defined; program page: 'in Software Systems Science'). Both require at least six semesters and 180 ECTS.

grade_requirement.note: SFPO 2025 § 33 Abs. 2: 'Gesamtnote 2,0 oder besser in einem verwandten Studiengang gemäß § 31' (Abs. 1 same subject: 2,7). Program page: 'at least second class corresponding to the German grade 2.0'. No conversion method stated in the SFPO (APO WIAI not readable).

items.raw_label: 'Kompetenzen auf den Gebieten Mathematik, theoretische Grundlagen der Informatik oder formalen Softwareanalyse in einem Umfang von mindestens 34 ECTS-Punkten'

'Kompetenzen auf den Gebieten Programmierung, Softwaretechnik oder Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen in einem Umfang von mindestens 33 ECTS-Punkten, zu denen auch die Bachelorarbeit im Bereich Informatik zählen kann'

'Kompetenzen auf den Gebieten Datenbanksysteme, Rechner und Betriebssysteme, Informationssicherheit, Verteilte Systeme, Datenkommunikation, Interaktive Systeme oder Mobile Systeme in einem Umfang von mindestens 36 ECTS-Punkten'

subject_credit_requirements.note: SFPO 2025 § 33 Abs. 2 Satz 2: the 115 ECTS of Satz 1 ('gemäß den Modulen der Modulgruppen A1, A2, A3 und A4 des Bachelorstudiengangs Informatik: Software Systems Science der Universität Bamberg, bzw. der Modulgruppen A1, A2 und A3 des Bachelorstudiengangs Informatik') consist of the four areas (34 + 33 + 36 + 12 = 115), so no separate total item is stored. Pooled 'oder' areas: one item each with main + covered categories (engine adds up, E1). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): formal software analysis -> theoretical_cs (formal methods/verification); Rechner, Verteilte Systeme, Datenkommunikation, Mobile Systeme -> computer_engineering; Interaktive Systeme -> hci; the bachelor thesis 'kann' count in area 2 -> other.thesis_scientific_work. The fourth area ('weitere Kompetenzen ... Mathematik oder Informatik') repeats the topics of areas 1-3, so its categories overlap them by the regulation's own wording (flagged; relies on one-course-one-requirement, E2). Koushik's decision N-79 (17.10.2026): area 4 ('weitere Kompetenzen auf dem Gebiet Mathematik oder Informatik … 12 ECTS', on top of areas 1-3) is NOT stored as an item; CS-field students practically exceed it. It is shown as information.

conditional_admission.mechanism: None in the SFPO 2025 (no Auflagen clause in § 33). § 33 Abs. 5 allows only Abs. 1 (same-subject) applicants to start with at least 150 ECTS before the degree, proof by the end of the 2nd semester (not a subject condition). APO WIAI could not be read, so a general framework rule on Auflagen cannot be excluded (BLOCKED).

descriptive_notes: The Prüfungsausschuss decides in individual cases whether a degree counts as related (§ 31); competences are compared with the modules of module groups A1-A4 of the Bamberg bachelor Informatik: Software Systems Science (or A1-A3 of the bachelor Informatik).
GRE or GATE required for applicants from outside the Lisbon Convention states whose grade is worse than 1,5 (see standardized_test_requirements).

language_english.note: SFPO 2025 § 33 Abs. 3: English skills enabling English-language study, 'Der Nachweis ist durch Zertifikate entsprechend zumindest IELTS 6.5 oder TOEFL 90 iBT oder gleichwertige Sprachnachweise zu erbringen.' Program page: 'English language proficiency must be above level B2'. No exemptions or MOI rule found.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants whose qualifying degree is not from a signatory state of the Lisbon Recognition Convention (11.04.1997) and whose overall grade is worse than 1,5
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE General Test: at least 153 Verbal Reasoning, 164 Quantitative Reasoning and 4,0 Analytical Writing; or GATE: at least 500 points (GATE General Score) (SFPO 2025 § 33 Abs. 4)

other_requirements: online application form of the Registrar's Office (portal open from mid May for winter, mid November for summer)
originals or notarised copies of the documents; documents not in German, English, French or Spanish need a notarised translation
SFPO § 33 Abs. 2: 'weitere Kompetenzen auf dem Gebiet Mathematik oder Informatik in einem Umfang von mindestens 12 ECTS-Punkten' in addition to areas 1-3 (total 115 ECTS) — not checked by GPU-R.

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung für den gemeinsamen Elite-Masterstudiengang Software Engineering vom 3. Juli 2013 in der Fassung vom 27. November 2013 (Konsolidierung, Rechtssammlung M-530-1-2-001)
admission_regulation.version: PO vom 3. Juli 2013, geändert durch Satzung vom 27. November 2013 (consolidated, Rechtssammlung M-530-1-2-001); § 8 and Anlage 1 (Eignungsordnung) read from the text provided by Koushik on 17.10.2026.

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 8 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'den Abschluss eines Bachelorstudiengangs in Informatik an einer inländischen wissenschaftlichen Hochschule oder einen sonstigen, diesen Anforderungen gleichwertigen in- oder ausländischen Abschluss'; Nr. 2: passing the Eignungsverfahren (Anlage 1). The Prüfungsausschuss decides on comparability and equivalence (§ 8 Abs. 2); 'Eine Gesamtnote ist gleichwertig, wenn bei einem Vergleich der beiden Notensysteme mindestens die gleiche Notenstufe erreicht wurde.'

grade_requirement.note: No fixed grade limit. Anlage 1 § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: the grade gives points in stage 1: 'bei der Abschlussnote 1,0 12 Punkte. Für jede Zehntelnote, die die Abschlussnote schlechter als 1,0 ist, erhält der Bewerber/die Bewerberin 0,4 Punkte abgezogen'; foreign grades 'über die bayerische Formel umgerechnet'. Stage 1 needs at least 26 of 40 points (subject qualification max 22, grade max 12, key qualifications max 6; § 5 Abs. 3). GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): with full subject and extra-curricular points (28) any grade can reach 26, so no grade cut-off can be derived.

items.raw_label: FAQ (programme website, not regulation): 'basic skills in both applied and theoretical computer science are needed' — applied computer science
FAQ (programme website, not regulation): 'basic skills in both applied and theoretical computer science are needed' — theoretical computer science

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO § 8 sets no subject credit minimums. Anlage 1 § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 scores the 'Fachliche Qualifikation' (max 22 points) on the areas A) Softwaretechnik, B) Formale Methoden und IT-Sicherheit, C) Verteilte Systeme, D) Datenbanken, E) Multimedia und Human-Computer-Interaction — scoring areas, not minimums, so they are not stored as items. The two presence-only items come from the programme FAQ ('basic skills in both applied and theoretical computer science are needed'), GPU-R policy (official page, not regulation wording).

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: PO § 8 has no Auflagen clause. § 8 Abs. 3 only admits applicants with at least 140 of 180 (or 165 of 210) LP 'unter der auflösenden Bedingung' that the degree is proven by the end of the following summer semester — a pending-degree rule, not a subject condition.

descriptive_notes: Eignungsverfahren (PO Anlage 1), held once a year for a winter start; the application deadline is an Ausschlussfrist set by the Masterboard (§ 3).

Stage 1 (§ 5): documents scored 0-40 points: subject qualification in Softwaretechnik, Formale Methoden und IT-Sicherheit, Verteilte Systeme, Datenbanken, Multimedia und HCI (max 22); final grade (1,0 = 12 points, minus 0,4 per tenth; Bavarian formula for foreign grades); key qualifications and extra-curricular activities such as internships, relevant work, tutoring, volunteering, stays abroad (max 6). Fewer than 26 points: 'ungeeignet'.

Stage 2 (§ 6): individual aptitude interview of about 45 minutes (software engineering, formal methods, databases, distributed systems, HCI; project management and teamwork; problem solving), scored 0-60; suitable with at least 45,00 points.
Programme page: 'outstanding grades from previous courses' and personal dedication beyond the normal curriculum are expected.

language_english.note: No IELTS/TOEFL minimum exists in any official source (checked 17.10.2026). PO Anlage 1 § 1 Abs. 1: English knowledge 'in einem Maße, das dazu befähigt, auf wissenschaftlicher Grundlage anspruchsvolle Software-Lösungen in einem Team zu entwickeln' is only an aptitude parameter (assessed in the documents and the interview); no level or test score. Programme page: 'Minimum foreign language skills: English (see exam regulations for details)'; language certificates are listed only as an OPTIONAL application document. So ielts_min/toefl_ibt_min stay null. MyGermanUniversity (checked 24.10.2026): IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 88, PTE 65, Cambridge CAE/CPE (A–C); other certificates not recognised.

aps_certificate.note: Program page (documents for applicants with a foreign degree): 'APS certificate: For applicants from China, India and Vietnam'.

other_requirements: letter of motivation
curriculum vitae including activities beyond the study program
transcript of academic records (with average grade to date if not yet graduated)
brief description of the grading scheme
certificate stating the average grade if the transcript does not show it
Bachelor degree certificate, if available
optional supplementary PDF (e.g. award certificates, language proficiency proof)
application via the University of Augsburg application system (vibs); each document a separate PDF in German or English

admission_regulation.title: Studiengangsprüfungsordnung (StgPO) für den Masterstudiengang Digital Transformation des Fachbereichs Informatik an der Fachhochschule Dortmund (Bekanntmachung der Neufassung vom 26. September 2023), § 4 and Anlage 3 'Fachausschussprozess', with § 4 Rahmenprüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Masterstudiengänge der Fachhochschule Dortmund (RahmenPO)
admission_regulation.version: Neufassung of 26.09.2023 (Verkündungsblatt 44. Jg. Nr. 86, 29.09.2023) 'In der Fassung der Berichtigung vom 21.01.2025 und 29.05.2026', incorporating the amending ordinances of 25.03.2020, 28.07.2021, 15.12.2022 and 21.09.2023 (4th amendment, Verkündungsblatt Nr. 85, 26.09.2023: new § 3a winter start, § 6 deleted, thesis weighting, Anlage 1; no change to § 4 or Anlage 3 reported). 5th amending ordinance of 23.07.2026 (Verkündungsblatt 47. Jg. Nr. 32.11-064, 28.07.2026) changes only § 29 (not admission-relevant). The two Berichtigungen were not opened separately. RahmenPO read in the Lesefassung 'In der Fassung der 8. Änderungsordnung vom 11. Juni 2026' (reading version).

accepted_degree_fields.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'Der Abschluss eines Diplom- oder Bachelorstudiengangs der Informationstechnik, der Wirtschaftsinformatik, der Softwaretechnik, der Informatik oder eines fachlich nahen Studiengangs an einer Fachhochschule oder einer Universität oder der Abschluss eines entsprechenden akkreditierten Bachelorausbildungsgangs an einer Berufsakademie mit einer Gesamtnote von mindestens „gut“ (2,5).' Programme page (English): 'A diploma or a bachelor's degree in (technical) computer science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology,' or related programmes — the page names Electrical Engineering, the regulation does not (regulation wins; see notes). Foreign programmes 'müssen des Weiteren eine ... vergleichbare Abschlussarbeit (Thesis bzw. Diplomarbeit) vorsehen'; in doubt the Fachausschuss decides. Route split (GPU-R, E9): this record is route A: field A 'Software Engineering' at level 4; the other routes are 4879_B, 4879_C, 4879_D (another field at level 4). The second regulation combination (one field only at level 2, two fields at level 4) needs no separate record because in ECTS terms it is never easier (GPU-R arithmetic, not regulation wording). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'mit einer Gesamtnote von mindestens „gut“ (2,5)'. Conversion: Ordnung über die Zulassung ausländischer und staatenloser Studienbewerber*innen (Neufassung 05.12.2025) § 2 Abs. 1: 'Ausländische Noten sind nach den Richtlinien der Kultusministerkonferenz (KMK) umzurechnen'. The programme page states no grade.

items.raw_label: Kompetenzfeld A 'Software Engineering' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 uC-Programming, Structured programming languages (C, VB), Scripting languages; Stufe 2 OOP (e.g. C++, Java), operating systems, RTOS; Stufe 3 Modelling (UML), SW architectures, SW platforms (e.g. Java platform); Stufe 4 SW engineering, DSLs, model driven design — at least Stufe 4: 'min. 48 ECTS' (this route's level-4 field)

Kompetenzfeld B 'Business Computing' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 Office IT Systems, Databases, Mobile Devices; Stufe 2 ERP-Systems, PPS Systems, Database Programming; Stufe 3 Business Process Engineering, Web and UI Programming; Stufe 4 HMI development, CSCW and Groupware Systems, Digital Value Chain — at least Stufe 3: 'min. 30 ECTS'

Kompetenzfeld C 'Digital Systems' / 'Digitale Systeme' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 Microcontrollers, basic Computer Engineering; Stufe 2 Communication Technology (e.g. TCP/IP), Digital Electronics; Stufe 3 Basic Signal Theory and Signal Processing, Protocol Stacks; Stufe 4 Communication Systems (e.g. UMTS), Microelectronics, basic Security — at least Stufe 3: 'min. 30 ECTS'

Kompetenzfeld D 'Systems Engineering' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 R&D Project Management, Domain knowledge; Stufe 2 Processes for Software Design, Software Engineering; Stufe 3 Systems Modelling, e.g. sysML, System Verilog; Stufe 4 Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Requirements Engineering (RE) — at least Stufe 3: 'min. 30 ECTS'

subject_credit_requirements.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 Satz 2: 'Der vorangegangene Studiengang muss einschlägige Kompetenzen im Bereich der Digitalen Systeme und der Softwaretechnik im erforderlichen Umfang und auf dem erforderlichen Niveau vermitteln (Siehe Anlage 3).' Anlage 3 'Fachausschussprozess': four Kompetenzfelder A Software Engineering, B Business Computing, C Digital Systems, D Systems Engineering, each on 5 Stufen with minimum ECTS (A, B, C: Stufe 1 min. 18, Stufe 2 min. 30, Stufe 3 min. 30, Stufe 4 min. 48, Stufe 5 min. 48; D: 18, 30, 30, 36, 36). 'Die Stufen bauen aufeinander auf.' 'Die Stufe 5 ist informatorisch.' Valid combinations: 'Kompetenzfelder A, B, C, D müssen alle mindestens auf Stufe 3 sein UND 1 Kompetenzfeld muss mindestens auf Stufe 4 sein.' or 'FALLS ein Kompetenzfeld aus A, B, C, D nur auf Stufe 2 ist, müssen mindestens 2 Kompetenzfelder mindestens auf Stufe 4 sein UND 1 Kompetenzfeld muss mindestens auf Stufe 3 sein.' GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): Stufe 2 and Stufe 3 have the same ECTS minimum (30), so in ECTS terms both combinations need at least 30 ECTS in every field; the first combination additionally needs one field at its Stufe-4 minimum (48 for A, B, C; 36 for D), the second needs two such fields and is therefore never easier in ECTS. The engine checks ECTS only; the content level (which topics a course covers) is judged by the Fachausschuss. The first combination is split into four route records 4879_A to 4879_D (one per field that reaches Stufe 4, E9). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording) for categories: A -> programming_practical_cs + operating_systems + software_engineering; B -> databases_systems + hci (ERP/PPS systems, Business Process Engineering, CSCW, Digital Value Chain have no taxonomy category; Web and UI Programming and Mobile Devices are kept only in A's programming category, so no course counts for two fields — stricter); C -> computer_engineering + it_security (signal theory/processing has no taxonomy category; System Verilog of field D is kept only in C's computer_engineering); D -> software_engineering (R&D project management via software project management; Domain knowledge has no category). software_engineering appears in A and D because the regulation itself names it in both fields (A Stufe 4 'SW engineering', D Stufe 2 'Software Engineering') — flagged; the engine's one-course-one-requirement rule (E2) must assign each course to one field. Anlage 3: 'Das Kompetenzprofil wird regelmäßig vor dem Beginn eines Bewerbungszeitraums vom Fachausschuss überprüft und angepasst.'

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions clause: StgPO § 4 (current Neufassung 2023 with Berichtigungen 2025/2026) contains no 'Auflage'; § 4 Abs. 4 refers to § 4 RahmenPO, whose Lesefassung (8. Änderungsordnung 11.06.2026) also contains no Auflagen rule (§ 4 Abs. 5 only requires a first degree with 180/210/240 ECTS according to the Master's length). The 5th amendment (2026) does not add one.

descriptive_notes: Competence check by a Fachausschuss of the Prüfungsausschuss (StgPO § 4 Abs. 2-3, Anlage 3 'Fachausschussprozess'): it assigns your bachelor's courses to the four fields Software Engineering, Business Computing, Digital Systems and Systems Engineering and to levels by content as well as ECTS; it may ask for further documents. GPU-R checks only the ECTS minimums.
Valid level combinations (Anlage 3): all four fields at least level 3 and one field at least level 4; or, if one field is only at level 2, at least two fields at level 4 and one at least at level 3.
The competence profile is reviewed and may be adjusted by the Fachausschuss before each application period (Anlage 3).
All applicants (EU, German, non-EU) must pass a document pre-check before the online application (programme page).

language_english.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'TOEFL-ITP Test mit mindestens 550 Punkten bzw. TOEFL-iBT Test mit mindestens 90 Punkten', taken 'innerhalb der letzten zwei Jahre vor Eingang der Bewerbung'; other equivalent tests 'nach dem europäischen Referenzrahmen (z.B. IELTS mit mindestens 6.5 Punkten)'; 'in Ausnahmefällen durch ein äquivalentes Zertifikat oder Nachweise mit den entsprechenden Mindestanforderungen (entsprechend C1 ...)'; 'Der Fachausschuss entscheidet, ob eine Äquivalenz vorliegt.' C1 is named only as the level for exceptional equivalent certificates, so required_level is left null (GPU-R reading). No exemption list and no statement on medium-of-instruction letters (moi_not_accepted left null). Timing: FH Dortmund page for non-EU Master applicants: 'At time of appliying you do not need to proof english language yet and it also will not be checked yet!' — proof is needed after an offer, for enrolment.

other_requirements: foreign degrees must include a thesis comparable to German minimum quality requirements (StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1)
document pre-check before the application, for all applicants (programme page; pre-check portal precheck.go-study-europe.de, operated by FH Dortmund)
VPD required for foreign certificates (programme page)
documents not in German or English must be translated by a sworn translator (Ordnung Zulassung ausländischer Studienbewerber*innen § 2 Abs. 3 Nr. 8)
the Fachausschuss may request further documents (StgPO § 4 Abs. 2)
accredited Berufsakademie bachelor programmes are also accepted (StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1)

admission_regulation.version: Neufassung of 26.09.2023 (Verkündungsblatt 44. Jg. Nr. 86, 29.09.2023) 'In der Fassung der Berichtigung vom 21.01.2025 und 29.05.2026', incorporating the amending ordinances of 25.03.2020, 28.07.2021, 15.12.2022 and 21.09.2023 (4th amendment, Verkündungsblatt Nr. 85, 26.09.2023: new § 3a winter start, § 6 deleted, thesis weighting, Anlage 1; no change to § 4 or Anlage 3 reported). 5th amending ordinance of 23.07.2026 (Verkündungsblatt 47. Jg. Nr. 32.11-064, 28.07.2026) changes only § 29 (not admission-relevant). The two Berichtigungen were not opened separately. RahmenPO read in the Lesefassung 'In der Fassung der 8. Änderungsordnung vom 11. Juni 2026' (reading version).

accepted_degree_fields.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'Der Abschluss eines Diplom- oder Bachelorstudiengangs der Informationstechnik, der Wirtschaftsinformatik, der Softwaretechnik, der Informatik oder eines fachlich nahen Studiengangs an einer Fachhochschule oder einer Universität oder der Abschluss eines entsprechenden akkreditierten Bachelorausbildungsgangs an einer Berufsakademie mit einer Gesamtnote von mindestens „gut“ (2,5).' Programme page (English): 'A diploma or a bachelor's degree in (technical) computer science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology,' or related programmes — the page names Electrical Engineering, the regulation does not (regulation wins; see notes). Foreign programmes 'müssen des Weiteren eine ... vergleichbare Abschlussarbeit (Thesis bzw. Diplomarbeit) vorsehen'; in doubt the Fachausschuss decides. Route split (GPU-R, E9): this record is route B: field B 'Business Computing' at level 4; the other routes are 4879_A, 4879_C, 4879_D (another field at level 4). The second regulation combination (one field only at level 2, two fields at level 4) needs no separate record because in ECTS terms it is never easier (GPU-R arithmetic, not regulation wording). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'mit einer Gesamtnote von mindestens „gut“ (2,5)'. Conversion: Ordnung über die Zulassung ausländischer und staatenloser Studienbewerber*innen (Neufassung 05.12.2025) § 2 Abs. 1: 'Ausländische Noten sind nach den Richtlinien der Kultusministerkonferenz (KMK) umzurechnen'. The programme page states no grade.

items.raw_label: Kompetenzfeld A 'Software Engineering' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 uC-Programming, Structured programming languages (C, VB), Scripting languages; Stufe 2 OOP (e.g. C++, Java), operating systems, RTOS; Stufe 3 Modelling (UML), SW architectures, SW platforms (e.g. Java platform); Stufe 4 SW engineering, DSLs, model driven design — at least Stufe 3: 'min. 30 ECTS'

Kompetenzfeld B 'Business Computing' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 Office IT Systems, Databases, Mobile Devices; Stufe 2 ERP-Systems, PPS Systems, Database Programming; Stufe 3 Business Process Engineering, Web and UI Programming; Stufe 4 HMI development, CSCW and Groupware Systems, Digital Value Chain — at least Stufe 4: 'min. 48 ECTS' (this route's level-4 field)

Kompetenzfeld C 'Digital Systems' / 'Digitale Systeme' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 Microcontrollers, basic Computer Engineering; Stufe 2 Communication Technology (e.g. TCP/IP), Digital Electronics; Stufe 3 Basic Signal Theory and Signal Processing, Protocol Stacks; Stufe 4 Communication Systems (e.g. UMTS), Microelectronics, basic Security — at least Stufe 3: 'min. 30 ECTS'

Kompetenzfeld D 'Systems Engineering' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 R&D Project Management, Domain knowledge; Stufe 2 Processes for Software Design, Software Engineering; Stufe 3 Systems Modelling, e.g. sysML, System Verilog; Stufe 4 Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Requirements Engineering (RE) — at least Stufe 3: 'min. 30 ECTS'

subject_credit_requirements.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 Satz 2: 'Der vorangegangene Studiengang muss einschlägige Kompetenzen im Bereich der Digitalen Systeme und der Softwaretechnik im erforderlichen Umfang und auf dem erforderlichen Niveau vermitteln (Siehe Anlage 3).' Anlage 3 'Fachausschussprozess': four Kompetenzfelder A Software Engineering, B Business Computing, C Digital Systems, D Systems Engineering, each on 5 Stufen with minimum ECTS (A, B, C: Stufe 1 min. 18, Stufe 2 min. 30, Stufe 3 min. 30, Stufe 4 min. 48, Stufe 5 min. 48; D: 18, 30, 30, 36, 36). 'Die Stufen bauen aufeinander auf.' 'Die Stufe 5 ist informatorisch.' Valid combinations: 'Kompetenzfelder A, B, C, D müssen alle mindestens auf Stufe 3 sein UND 1 Kompetenzfeld muss mindestens auf Stufe 4 sein.' or 'FALLS ein Kompetenzfeld aus A, B, C, D nur auf Stufe 2 ist, müssen mindestens 2 Kompetenzfelder mindestens auf Stufe 4 sein UND 1 Kompetenzfeld muss mindestens auf Stufe 3 sein.' GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): Stufe 2 and Stufe 3 have the same ECTS minimum (30), so in ECTS terms both combinations need at least 30 ECTS in every field; the first combination additionally needs one field at its Stufe-4 minimum (48 for A, B, C; 36 for D), the second needs two such fields and is therefore never easier in ECTS. The engine checks ECTS only; the content level (which topics a course covers) is judged by the Fachausschuss. The first combination is split into four route records 4879_A to 4879_D (one per field that reaches Stufe 4, E9). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording) for categories: A -> programming_practical_cs + operating_systems + software_engineering; B -> databases_systems + hci (ERP/PPS systems, Business Process Engineering, CSCW, Digital Value Chain have no taxonomy category; Web and UI Programming and Mobile Devices are kept only in A's programming category, so no course counts for two fields — stricter); C -> computer_engineering + it_security (signal theory/processing has no taxonomy category; System Verilog of field D is kept only in C's computer_engineering); D -> software_engineering (R&D project management via software project management; Domain knowledge has no category). software_engineering appears in A and D because the regulation itself names it in both fields (A Stufe 4 'SW engineering', D Stufe 2 'Software Engineering') — flagged; the engine's one-course-one-requirement rule (E2) must assign each course to one field. Anlage 3: 'Das Kompetenzprofil wird regelmäßig vor dem Beginn eines Bewerbungszeitraums vom Fachausschuss überprüft und angepasst.'

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions clause: StgPO § 4 (current Neufassung 2023 with Berichtigungen 2025/2026) contains no 'Auflage'; § 4 Abs. 4 refers to § 4 RahmenPO, whose Lesefassung (8. Änderungsordnung 11.06.2026) also contains no Auflagen rule (§ 4 Abs. 5 only requires a first degree with 180/210/240 ECTS according to the Master's length). The 5th amendment (2026) does not add one.

descriptive_notes: Competence check by a Fachausschuss of the Prüfungsausschuss (StgPO § 4 Abs. 2-3, Anlage 3 'Fachausschussprozess'): it assigns your bachelor's courses to the four fields Software Engineering, Business Computing, Digital Systems and Systems Engineering and to levels by content as well as ECTS; it may ask for further documents. GPU-R checks only the ECTS minimums.
Valid level combinations (Anlage 3): all four fields at least level 3 and one field at least level 4; or, if one field is only at level 2, at least two fields at level 4 and one at least at level 3.
The competence profile is reviewed and may be adjusted by the Fachausschuss before each application period (Anlage 3).
All applicants (EU, German, non-EU) must pass a document pre-check before the online application (programme page).

language_english.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'TOEFL-ITP Test mit mindestens 550 Punkten bzw. TOEFL-iBT Test mit mindestens 90 Punkten', taken 'innerhalb der letzten zwei Jahre vor Eingang der Bewerbung'; other equivalent tests 'nach dem europäischen Referenzrahmen (z.B. IELTS mit mindestens 6.5 Punkten)'; 'in Ausnahmefällen durch ein äquivalentes Zertifikat oder Nachweise mit den entsprechenden Mindestanforderungen (entsprechend C1 ...)'; 'Der Fachausschuss entscheidet, ob eine Äquivalenz vorliegt.' C1 is named only as the level for exceptional equivalent certificates, so required_level is left null (GPU-R reading). No exemption list and no statement on medium-of-instruction letters (moi_not_accepted left null). Timing: FH Dortmund page for non-EU Master applicants: 'At time of appliying you do not need to proof english language yet and it also will not be checked yet!' — proof is needed after an offer, for enrolment.

other_requirements: foreign degrees must include a thesis comparable to German minimum quality requirements (StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1)
document pre-check before the application, for all applicants (programme page; pre-check portal precheck.go-study-europe.de, operated by FH Dortmund)
VPD required for foreign certificates (programme page)
documents not in German or English must be translated by a sworn translator (Ordnung Zulassung ausländischer Studienbewerber*innen § 2 Abs. 3 Nr. 8)
the Fachausschuss may request further documents (StgPO § 4 Abs. 2)
accredited Berufsakademie bachelor programmes are also accepted (StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 July (Ordnung über die Zulassung ausländischer und staatenloser Studienbewerber*innen § 3 Abs. 1, Master programmes; programme page: 'May 15 through July 15'); FH Dortmund non-EU Master page and the MDT page of go-study-europe.de (FH Dortmund): 15 June

accepted_degree_fields.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'Der Abschluss eines Diplom- oder Bachelorstudiengangs der Informationstechnik, der Wirtschaftsinformatik, der Softwaretechnik, der Informatik oder eines fachlich nahen Studiengangs an einer Fachhochschule oder einer Universität oder der Abschluss eines entsprechenden akkreditierten Bachelorausbildungsgangs an einer Berufsakademie mit einer Gesamtnote von mindestens „gut“ (2,5).' Programme page (English): 'A diploma or a bachelor's degree in (technical) computer science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology,' or related programmes — the page names Electrical Engineering, the regulation does not (regulation wins; see notes). Foreign programmes 'müssen des Weiteren eine ... vergleichbare Abschlussarbeit (Thesis bzw. Diplomarbeit) vorsehen'; in doubt the Fachausschuss decides. Route split (GPU-R, E9): this record is route D: field D 'Systems Engineering' at level 4; the other routes are 4879_A, 4879_B, 4879_C (another field at level 4). The second regulation combination (one field only at level 2, two fields at level 4) needs no separate record because in ECTS terms it is never easier (GPU-R arithmetic, not regulation wording). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'mit einer Gesamtnote von mindestens „gut“ (2,5)'. Conversion: Ordnung über die Zulassung ausländischer und staatenloser Studienbewerber*innen (Neufassung 05.12.2025) § 2 Abs. 1: 'Ausländische Noten sind nach den Richtlinien der Kultusministerkonferenz (KMK) umzurechnen'. The programme page states no grade.

items.raw_label: Kompetenzfeld A 'Software Engineering' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 uC-Programming, Structured programming languages (C, VB), Scripting languages; Stufe 2 OOP (e.g. C++, Java), operating systems, RTOS; Stufe 3 Modelling (UML), SW architectures, SW platforms (e.g. Java platform); Stufe 4 SW engineering, DSLs, model driven design — at least Stufe 3: 'min. 30 ECTS'

Kompetenzfeld B 'Business Computing' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 Office IT Systems, Databases, Mobile Devices; Stufe 2 ERP-Systems, PPS Systems, Database Programming; Stufe 3 Business Process Engineering, Web and UI Programming; Stufe 4 HMI development, CSCW and Groupware Systems, Digital Value Chain — at least Stufe 3: 'min. 30 ECTS'

Kompetenzfeld C 'Digital Systems' / 'Digitale Systeme' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 Microcontrollers, basic Computer Engineering; Stufe 2 Communication Technology (e.g. TCP/IP), Digital Electronics; Stufe 3 Basic Signal Theory and Signal Processing, Protocol Stacks; Stufe 4 Communication Systems (e.g. UMTS), Microelectronics, basic Security — at least Stufe 3: 'min. 30 ECTS'

Kompetenzfeld D 'Systems Engineering' (Anlage 3): Stufe 1 R&D Project Management, Domain knowledge; Stufe 2 Processes for Software Design, Software Engineering; Stufe 3 Systems Modelling, e.g. sysML, System Verilog; Stufe 4 Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Requirements Engineering (RE) — at least Stufe 4: 'min. 36 ECTS' (this route's level-4 field)

subject_credit_requirements.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 Satz 2: 'Der vorangegangene Studiengang muss einschlägige Kompetenzen im Bereich der Digitalen Systeme und der Softwaretechnik im erforderlichen Umfang und auf dem erforderlichen Niveau vermitteln (Siehe Anlage 3).' Anlage 3 'Fachausschussprozess': four Kompetenzfelder A Software Engineering, B Business Computing, C Digital Systems, D Systems Engineering, each on 5 Stufen with minimum ECTS (A, B, C: Stufe 1 min. 18, Stufe 2 min. 30, Stufe 3 min. 30, Stufe 4 min. 48, Stufe 5 min. 48; D: 18, 30, 30, 36, 36). 'Die Stufen bauen aufeinander auf.' 'Die Stufe 5 ist informatorisch.' Valid combinations: 'Kompetenzfelder A, B, C, D müssen alle mindestens auf Stufe 3 sein UND 1 Kompetenzfeld muss mindestens auf Stufe 4 sein.' or 'FALLS ein Kompetenzfeld aus A, B, C, D nur auf Stufe 2 ist, müssen mindestens 2 Kompetenzfelder mindestens auf Stufe 4 sein UND 1 Kompetenzfeld muss mindestens auf Stufe 3 sein.' GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): Stufe 2 and Stufe 3 have the same ECTS minimum (30), so in ECTS terms both combinations need at least 30 ECTS in every field; the first combination additionally needs one field at its Stufe-4 minimum (48 for A, B, C; 36 for D), the second needs two such fields and is therefore never easier in ECTS. The engine checks ECTS only; the content level (which topics a course covers) is judged by the Fachausschuss. The first combination is split into four route records 4879_A to 4879_D (one per field that reaches Stufe 4, E9). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording) for categories: A -> programming_practical_cs + operating_systems + software_engineering; B -> databases_systems + hci (ERP/PPS systems, Business Process Engineering, CSCW, Digital Value Chain have no taxonomy category; Web and UI Programming and Mobile Devices are kept only in A's programming category, so no course counts for two fields — stricter); C -> computer_engineering + it_security (signal theory/processing has no taxonomy category; System Verilog of field D is kept only in C's computer_engineering); D -> software_engineering (R&D project management via software project management; Domain knowledge has no category). software_engineering appears in A and D because the regulation itself names it in both fields (A Stufe 4 'SW engineering', D Stufe 2 'Software Engineering') — flagged; the engine's one-course-one-requirement rule (E2) must assign each course to one field. Anlage 3: 'Das Kompetenzprofil wird regelmäßig vor dem Beginn eines Bewerbungszeitraums vom Fachausschuss überprüft und angepasst.'

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions clause: StgPO § 4 (current Neufassung 2023 with Berichtigungen 2025/2026) contains no 'Auflage'; § 4 Abs. 4 refers to § 4 RahmenPO, whose Lesefassung (8. Änderungsordnung 11.06.2026) also contains no Auflagen rule (§ 4 Abs. 5 only requires a first degree with 180/210/240 ECTS according to the Master's length). The 5th amendment (2026) does not add one.

descriptive_notes: Competence check by a Fachausschuss of the Prüfungsausschuss (StgPO § 4 Abs. 2-3, Anlage 3 'Fachausschussprozess'): it assigns your bachelor's courses to the four fields Software Engineering, Business Computing, Digital Systems and Systems Engineering and to levels by content as well as ECTS; it may ask for further documents. GPU-R checks only the ECTS minimums.
Valid level combinations (Anlage 3): all four fields at least level 3 and one field at least level 4; or, if one field is only at level 2, at least two fields at level 4 and one at least at level 3.
The competence profile is reviewed and may be adjusted by the Fachausschuss before each application period (Anlage 3).
All applicants (EU, German, non-EU) must pass a document pre-check before the online application (programme page).

language_english.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'TOEFL-ITP Test mit mindestens 550 Punkten bzw. TOEFL-iBT Test mit mindestens 90 Punkten', taken 'innerhalb der letzten zwei Jahre vor Eingang der Bewerbung'; other equivalent tests 'nach dem europäischen Referenzrahmen (z.B. IELTS mit mindestens 6.5 Punkten)'; 'in Ausnahmefällen durch ein äquivalentes Zertifikat oder Nachweise mit den entsprechenden Mindestanforderungen (entsprechend C1 ...)'; 'Der Fachausschuss entscheidet, ob eine Äquivalenz vorliegt.' C1 is named only as the level for exceptional equivalent certificates, so required_level is left null (GPU-R reading). No exemption list and no statement on medium-of-instruction letters (moi_not_accepted left null). Timing: FH Dortmund page for non-EU Master applicants: 'At time of appliying you do not need to proof english language yet and it also will not be checked yet!' — proof is needed after an offer, for enrolment.

other_requirements: foreign degrees must include a thesis comparable to German minimum quality requirements (StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1)
document pre-check before the application, for all applicants (programme page; pre-check portal precheck.go-study-europe.de, operated by FH Dortmund)
VPD required for foreign certificates (programme page)
documents not in German or English must be translated by a sworn translator (Ordnung Zulassung ausländischer Studienbewerber*innen § 2 Abs. 3 Nr. 8)
the Fachausschuss may request further documents (StgPO § 4 Abs. 2)
accredited Berufsakademie bachelor programmes are also accepted (StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1)

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den englischsprachigen Studiengang Media Engineering (MME) vom 11.09.2024, § 1 Zulassungsvoraussetzungen und Studienbeginn, together with the Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für Studiengänge mit dem Abschluss Master an der Hochschule Anhalt (Allgemeine Bestimmungen) vom 31.01.2018 and the Satzung zur Durchführung des Feststellungsverfahrens für Studiengänge mit besonderen Eignungsvoraussetzungen der Hochschule Anhalt
admission_regulation.version: MME SPO of 11.09.2024 (Fachbereichsrat 11.09.2024, Senate 11.12.2024, approved by the President 12.12.2024), Amtliches Mitteilungsblatt Nr. 96; applies to students enrolled from WS 2025/26 (§ 8). No amendment of the MME SPO is listed on the university's Ordnungen page. NOT OPENED (blocked, see notes): Allgemeine Bestimmungen Master 2018 (AM 78/2018) and their Änderungssatzung 2026 (AM 99/2026); Feststellungsverfahren-Satzung 2022 i.d.F. 2023 (AM 91/2022) with Ergänzungssatzungen 2024 (AM 94/2024) and 2025 (AM 96/2025). Whether these set a grade limit or conditions for MME is not confirmed.

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 1 Abs. 3 (4-semester variant): 'ein qualifizierter Hochschulabschluss in den Bachelor-Studiengängen Informatik, Medieninformatik, Digitale Medien, Medientechnik oder in vergleichbaren Studiengängen mit einer Regelstudienzeit von mindestens 6 Semestern und 180 Credits (Leistungspunkte).' § 1 Abs. 2 (3-semester variant): same fields with 'mindestens 7 Semestern und 210 Credits'. § 1 Abs. 1: the Zulassungsvoraussetzungen of the Allgemeine Bestimmungen also apply (not opened). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: The MME SPO states no grade limit, and none of the official programme pages read states one. SPO § 1 Abs. 5: 'Die Zulassung zum Studium kann darüber hinaus an ein Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren gebunden werden.' under the Feststellungsverfahren-Satzung, which could not be opened (its Ergänzungssatzung 2025 is in the same Mitteilungsblatt Nr. 96 as the MME SPO). subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject-credit requirement in the MME SPO: access depends on the degree field (Informatik, Medieninformatik, Digitale Medien, Medientechnik or comparable) and on 180 or 210 credits. conditional_admission.mechanism: The MME SPO (11.09.2024, current) contains no Auflagen or bridging clause. descriptive_notes: Admission may additionally be tied to an aptitude assessment procedure (Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren) under the university's Feststellungsverfahren-Satzung (SPO § 1 Abs. 5); its content for Media Engineering was not available.

admission_regulation.title: Fachspezifische Bestimmungen für den Bachelor- und den Master-Studiengang Mathematik und Informatik der Universität des Saarlandes zur Gemeinsamen Prüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Master-Studiengänge der Fakultät 6 vom 28. April 2016, § 32, with § 12 of the Gemeinsame Prüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Master-Studiengänge der Fakultät für Mathematik und Informatik an der Universität des Saarlandes vom 25. Februar 2021
admission_regulation.version: FSB of 28.04.2016 (Dienstblatt 2016 Nr. 63, S. 568), in force 01.10.2016; still current: GPO 2021 § 26 Abs. 2 keeps the Fachspezifische Bestimmungen issued under the 2015 GPO as part of the new ordinance. GPO of 25.02.2021 (Dienstblatt 2021 Nr. 62, S. 580), original promulgated text. The university's official regulations listing (Fundstellen, Masterstudiengänge Fakultät MI) shows no amendment to the FSB, the Studienordnung or the GPO.

accepted_degree_fields.note: FSB § 32 Abs. 1: 'Zugangsberechtigt zum Master-Studiengang ist, 1. wer an einer deutschen Hochschule einen Bachelor-Abschluss oder an einer ausländischen Hochschule einen äquivalenten Abschluss in einem integrierten Studiengang der Mathematik und Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach erworben hat. 2. und die besondere Eignung (§ 69 Abs. 5 UG) nachweist.' Programme page: 'either in a subject area that closely combines mathematics and computer science, or in a related discipline.' Faculty page (German): 'Fundierte Grundkenntnisse sowohl in der Mathematik wie auch der Informatik sind Voraussetzung für eine Zulassung' (a one-sided education is not enough). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: Koushik decision 19.10.2026 (applied to all Saarland Informatics Campus programmes): store the official application-guide minimum as a hard grade — GPU-R policy (official university page, not regulation wording; the FSB set no limit). SIC Application Guide (page modified 02.10.2026, https://saarland-informatics-campus.de/en/studium-studies/master-english/application-guide/): 'Minimal prerequisite is a cumulative undergraduate grade point average (CGPA) of 75% or 3.00 GPA on a 4 point scale and ranking in the top 10% of the graduating class.' Cross-checked 19.10.2026 on MyGermanUniversity and Expatrio StudyBuddy (third-party; both state 75 %, most also the top-10 % ranking). GPU-R conversion: 3,00/4 with Nmin 2,0 → 2,5; 75 % read as CGPA 7,5/10 with Indian Nmin 5,0 → 1 + 3 × (10 − 7,5)/5 = 2,5. The top-10 % ranking cannot be checked (student note). Previous note: No numeric grade limit in the FSB or GPO. FSB § 32 Abs. 2 b: the Prüfungsausschuss assesses 'die in der bisherigen akademischen Laufbahn erbrachten Leistungen und der fachliche Inhalt des Bachelor-Abschlusses' as a criterion of 'besondere Eignung'. The CGPA minimum (75% / 3.00 GPA, top 10%) on the Saarland Informatics Campus application guide is stated only for Computer Science, DSAI, Embedded Systems and Visual Computing, not for this programme.

items.raw_label: I. Mathematik (Analysis, Lineare Algebra, Numerik, Stochastik) — 'wesentliche Kompetenzen', no credit number (FSB § 32 Abs. 2 b)

II. Informatik (funktionale und objektorientierte Programmierung, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen, Methoden der Softwareentwicklung, Theoretische Informatik) — 'wesentliche Kompetenzen', no credit number (FSB § 32 Abs. 2 b)

subject_credit_requirements.note: FSB § 32 Abs. 2 b: 'Der Kandidat/die Kandidatin sollte dabei Kompetenzen nachweisen, die denen im Bachelor-Studiengang Mathematik und Informatik an der Universität des Saarlandes vermittelten Kompetenzen entsprechen. Dies schließt insbesondere wesentliche Kompetenzen in den folgenden Bereichen ein: I. Mathematik (Analysis, Lineare Algebra, Numerik, Stochastik) II. Informatik (funktionale und objektorientierte Programmierung, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen, Methoden der Softwareentwicklung, Theoretische Informatik)'. No credit numbers, so both areas are presence-only (R7: the reference bachelor curriculum is not converted into numbers). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): mathematics is one general_mathematics item (owner rule); 'Numerik' is also covered by mathematics_statistics.optimization_numerics (GPU-R category, not yet in cs_taxonomy.json, counts 0 for now; numerical methods are also listed under calculus_analysis in the taxonomy). Informatik is one pooled item with the four named topics as main + covered categories. Mathematics department page for international applicants: 'A strong command of Linear Algebra and Real Analysis is absolutely essential for success in our Master's programme'; lacking Numerics or Stochastics is not disqualifying but 'will limit your options regarding our programme's focus areas'.

conditional_admission.mechanism: GPO 2021 § 12 Abs. 5: if the content prerequisites are missing, provisional admission ('vorläufige Zulassung') is possible under the Auflage to make up the missing content in a supplementary study within a set deadline, 'maximal im Umfang von 30 CP', unless the Fachspezifische Bestimmungen provide otherwise; agreed with an examination-authorised subject representative and recorded in writing. FSB § 32 has no different rule. No amendment found.

descriptive_notes: Aptitude ('besondere Eignung', FSB § 32 Abs. 2) is assessed by the Prüfungsausschuss from English (usually C1), previous academic performance and the content of the bachelor's degree, and a dossier with two qualifying references; the profile is compared with the requirements of the programme.
In doubtful cases subject representatives are consulted (GPO § 12 Abs. 7).

allowed_exemptions: native speakers from Australia, Ireland, Canada, New Zealand, the UK and the USA
applicants who studied in one of these six countries
German applicants: English up to the Abitur
language_english.note: FSB § 32 Abs. 2 a: 'Nachweis englischer Sprachkenntnisse auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau (in der Regel C1)'. Mathematics department English page: IELTS academic 'min. 7.0 out of 9', TOEFL iBT 'min. 95 out of 120', TOEFL paper 'min. 600 out of 677', Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency, 'PTE Academic: min. 76'; 'The English certificate is a mandatory part of the application.' 'A confirmation of your university or a MOI (Medium of Instruction) is not a sufficient equivalent.' SIC application guide: home editions and expired tests accepted.

aps_certificate.note: Mathematics department page for international applicants: 'If you obtained your university degree in China, India or Vietnam, you need an original APS Certificate'. SIC application guide: applicants with a degree from China, India or Vietnam 'are required to submit the original' APS certificate. Not in the FSB/GPO.

other_requirements: personal statement / dossier documenting interest in the subject (FSB § 32 Abs. 2 c; programme page)
two letters of recommendation (qualifying references) from academic referees (FSB § 32 Abs. 2 c)

statement of purpose should address readiness for the department's sample problems (linear algebra, real analysis, numerics, stochastics) and level in algebra, measure theory, complex analysis, numerics, stochastics (mathematics department page for international applicants)
CV, copies of degrees and a certified list of courses with grades (SIC application guide)
provisional admission possible if all bachelor exams and the thesis are completed by the start of the Master's; certificate normally within three months after semester start (GPO § 12 Abs. 3)
GRE/GATE is required on the SIC application guide only for Computer Science, Cybersecurity, DSAI, Embedded Systems and Visual Computing, not for this programme
application via the online application portal of the Saarland Informatics Campus (apply.cs.uni-saarland.de)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 November (early round 15 May with decision by July)

admission_regulation.version: MPO vom 20. August 2025, Amtliche Bekanntmachungen 55. Jahrgang Nr. 61 vom 3. September 2025, in force 1 October 2025 (§ 12) ('Version 20252', applies to students starting after WS 2025/26 per the programme's examinations page); no amendment of the MPO found. POO-AEI vom 20. August 2025 (AB 55. Jg. Nr. 53 vom 29.08.2025), referred to 'in der jeweils geltenden Fassung' (MPO § 1 Abs. 2); an 'Änderung der Prüfungsorganisationsordnung' of 04.09.2026 is listed on the university regulations page but was NOT opened (handle blocked).

accepted_degree_fields.note: MPO § 5 Abs. 1: 'einen ersten berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschluss im Umfang von mindestens 180 ECTS-LP im Fach Geodäsie/Geodesy, Informatik/Computer Science oder in einem verwandten Fach'. Programme page: 'strong BSc degree in computer science, geodesy, robotics, or a related subject' (naming electrical engineering, mechatronics and applied mathematics as related); 'All requirements have to be fulfilled with the bachelor degree.' (job experience and master's degrees do not count). The Prüfungsausschuss decides which programmes are related (POO-AEI § 6 Abs. 3). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: MPO 2025 § 5 Abs. 2 (current, in force 01.10.2025): 'Der Hochschulabschluss gemäß Absatz 1 muss mindestens mit der Note 2,2 abgeschlossen worden sein.' CONFLICT resolved 19.10.2026 (text supplied by Koushik): the accreditation update (AB 56. Jg. Nr. 42, 07.07.2026) quotes 'mindestens mit der Note 2,5' from the ORIGINAL accreditation report of 04.03.2025, which assessed the older MPO 'der Landwirtschaftlichen Fakultät' before the faculty announced 'eine Anpassung der Prüfungsordnung im Sommersemester 2025' — superseded by the MPO of 20.08.2025 (2,2). Programme page: 'We expect a minimum average BSc grade of 2.0' (guideline; regulation prevails). No conversion method stated in the MPO.

items.raw_label: mindestens 18 ECTS-LP aus Mathematik (§ 5 Abs. 3 Nr. 1)
mindestens 6 ECTS-LP aus Programmierung (§ 5 Abs. 3 Nr. 2)

Items 1-3 together: at least 50 ECTS-LP from the areas a) Mathematik, b) Programmierung, c) Ingenieurwissenschaften, d) Physik, e) Informatik und f) Geodäsie (= 18 + 6 + 'weitere Leistungen … im Gesamtumfang von mindestens 26 ECTS-LP', § 5 Abs. 3 Nr. 3; GPU-R arithmetic, not regulation wording)

subject_credit_requirements.note: MPO § 5 Abs. 3: 'Durch den Hochschulabschluss gemäß Absatz 1 müssen folgende Qualifikationen nachgewiesen werden:' (items 1-4). Item 3 is one pooled area ('aus mindestens einem der Fachgebiete ... im Gesamtumfang von mindestens 26 ECTS-LP'; add-up, E1). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): a) Mathematik -> general_mathematics; b) Programmierung and e) Informatik -> general_cs (contains programming_practical_cs); d) Physik -> general_physics; c) Ingenieurwissenschaften -> only its robotics part via engineering.robotics (allowed GPU-R name, not yet in cs_taxonomy.json, counts 0 for now); other engineering sciences and f) Geodäsie have no category and are not counted (stricter). The regulation itself lists Mathematik and Programmierung both as separate minimums (items 1-2) and inside the 'weitere Leistungen' (item 3), so general_mathematics and programming are shared between items: 'weitere' means credits beyond items 1-2, which needs one-course-one-requirement (E2). Programme page states the same: 18 Mathematics, 6 Programming, 26 from areas 3a-f, thesis 10. Correction 16.10.2026 (independent check): 'weitere Leistungen' are credits ON TOP OF the 18 maths and 6 programming, so item 3 is stored as a nested total of 50 (18 + 6 + 26); maths and programming courses count in items 1-2 and also inside the 50 (E2a). This gives the regulation's result without the one-course-one-requirement engine rule (a student with 18 maths + 6 programming + 8 physics = 32 now fails, as in the regulation). Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: eine wissenschaftliche Abschlussarbeit im Umfang von mindestens 10 ECTS-LP oder eine vergleichbare wissenschaftliche Leistung (§ 5 Abs. 3 Nr

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: MPO § 5 (Abs. 1-6) contains no Auflagen clause; the POO-AEI of 20.08.2025 does not contain 'Auflage', 'unter Vorbehalt' or 'vorläufig' (its § 6 Abs. 2 'Über Umfang und Art der zu erbringenden fehlenden Leistungen entscheidet der Prüfungsausschuss' concerns partial recognition of credits within a module, not admission). The POO-AEI amendment of 04.09.2026 was not opened. Programme page: 'All requirements have to be fulfilled with the bachelor degree.'

descriptive_notes: Programme page: 'an open-admission program' if the academic and language requirements are met; the examination board decides eligibility on the application documents.
MPO § 5 Abs. 5-6: capacity-based admission restrictions (Numerus clausus) remain unaffected; a selection, if needed, follows the Ordnung für Auswahlverfahren in force at the time of application.
Programme page: 'We expect a minimum average BSc grade of 2.0' (the regulation states 2,2).

allowed_exemptions: native English speakers (programme page)
German, Swiss, Austrian citizens with Abitur/Matura (programme page)
students who received their first degree entirely in English (official document proving the language of instruction; programme page)
language_english.note: MPO § 5 Abs. 4: 'Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache mindestens auf Niveau B2/C1 des Gemeinsamen europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GeR)'; 'als Nachweis dient ein anerkannter Sprachtest (z. B. TOEFL iBT 90/120, IELTS 6.5/9, Cambridge Certificate, PTE Academic) oder eine äquivalente Qualifikation.' Programme page: 'The niveau has to be minimun B2 and can be fulfilled by tests or ceritfied language of the Bachelor degree'; TOEFL paper-based 575, TOEFL iBT 90, IELTS 6.5. B2 is stored (see DECISION on 'B2/C1'). PTE Academic is named without a score. German not required at enrolment (§ 5 Abs. 4).

other_requirements: application without the final Bachelor's certificate possible; the final certificate must be submitted within the first semester of studies (programme page)
official transcript of records in English or German showing course names and ECTS credit points for each course (programme page)
CV showing education, programming skills and, if present, work experience (programme page)
all documents certified and in English; online application via the university portal, no postal documents (programme page)
enrolment refused if a non-compensable examination in a closely related programme was finally failed (POO-AEI § 6 Abs. 1)

subject_credit_requirements.note: The SPO names no subject areas or credit amounts; access requires a degree 'der Fachrichtung Informatik oder verwandter Fachrichtungen' (§ 2 Nr. 1) and the aptitude test (§ 2 Nr. 2, § 8), whose tasks cover 'komplexe Aufgaben zu einschlägigen Themen aus der Mathematik und Informatik' (§ 8 Abs. 1). subject_credit_requirements.note: SPO MAI § 3 Abs. 2 Satz 2: the competences 'sollen ... insbesondere nachgewiesen werden' — 'sollen' (as a rule); the 20 / 15 ECTS are stored as hard minimums: GPU-R policy (not regulation wording; strictest reading). a) 'anwendungsbereite, fortgeschrittene Fähigkeiten im Programmieren (typischerweise nachgewiesen durch Arbeitsproben ... und/oder durch die eigene wissenschaftliche Abschlussarbeit)' is not stored as an item (proof by work samples, no credit number) — shown as information. Koushik decision 19.10.2026 (approved as is) REVISED 20.10.2026: general_cs (= all CS subjects) would let any student pass, so the 15 ECTS Informatik count ONLY the areas the regulation names (add-up rule): practical CS = software_engineering + databases_systems + operating_systems (Verteilte Systeme mapped to operating_systems); theoretical CS = algorithms_data_structures + theoretical_cs (automata, complexity, logic). Two presence-only items check that both areas ('sowohl … als auch') are present, nested inside the 15. Programming (a) still shown as information only.

conditional_admission.mechanism: SPO MAI § 3 has no conditions rule for missing subject knowledge. § 3 Abs. 4: if not admission-restricted, applicants with 180–209 ECTS may be admitted provisionally; the missing qualification is made up by Nachqualifikation (bachelor modules) or relevant professional experience (20 weeks full-time if the first degree had no practical semester), 'unter der auflösenden Bedingung', proof by the end of the first semester — a total-credit rule (180→210), not subject conditions → false (owner rule). § 3 Abs. 5: provisional admission if at most 30 ECTS of the bachelor are still missing (degree completion).

allowed_exemptions: native speakers

application fee EUR 50 for non-EU applicants (program page)
SPO MAI § 3 Abs. 2 Satz 2 a): ready-to-use, advanced programming skills, typically shown by work samples from programming projects/labs and/or the bachelor thesis — not checked by GPU-R.
