admission_regulation.title: Prüfungs- und Studienordnung für den Masterstudiengang Philosophy & Computer Science an der Universität Bayreuth, § 2 and Anhang 2 (Eignungsverfahren)
admission_regulation.version: PSO vom 1. März 2024 (AB UBT 2024/014), in force 2 March 2024, for students starting from WS 2024/25 (copy on the programme website). Amended by Satzung vom 20. November 2025 (AB UBT 2025/040), in force 21 November 2025: changes only § 4, § 17, § 25 and Anhang 1 (modules/curriculum), NOT § 2 or Anhang 2 - admission unchanged. Later 2026 amendment notices checked (2026/033, 035, 036, 067) concern other programmes.

accepted_degree_fields.note: PSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'ein Hochschulabschluss in einem Bachelorstudiengang mit mindestens 180 Leistungspunkten; dieser muss folgende Studienleistungen bzw. damit gleichwertige Leistungen enthalten:' one of four tracks: a) 'Philosopher's Track': at least 60 LP in philosophy, incl. one course each in theoretical philosophy, practical philosophy and a philosophical methods course (e.g. logic, argumentation theory); b) 'Computer Scientist's Track' (stored in this record, GPU-R domain computer_science); c) 'Mixed Track': 'insgesamt mindestens 60 Leistungspunkte in den Bereichen Philosophie und Informatik – davon insgesamt drei Kurse zu unterschiedlichen Themen aus den Bereichen theoretische Philosophie, praktische Philosophie und philosophische Methodik (z.B. Logik, Argumentationstheorie), theoretische Informatik, Programmierung und Anwendung der Informatik (z.B. Mensch-Maschine-Interaktion)'; d) 'Development Track': at least 60 LP in philosophy and CS incl. one course from each of the six areas. Equivalence: no 'wesentlichen Unterschiede' in competences; the Prüfungsausschuss decides (§ 2 Abs. 2). Programme page: 'a Bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) in computer science, philosophy, or a related field'; interdisciplinary degrees (e.g. cognitive science, computational linguistics) welcome. Degree awarded: M.A. or M.Sc. (§ 1 Abs. 4), proposed by the thesis supervisor (§ 12 Abs. 2).

grade_requirement.note: No grade limit in the PSO. Grades enter only the aptitude procedure (Anhang 2 Nr. 5.1.2, Nr. 9): subject-specific performance gives 0.6-4.0 points by verbal bands ('4,0 - 3,5 Punkte: hervorragende Leistungen ... (durchschnittliche Note von mind. 1,5)'; '3,4 - 2,4 Punkte: ... erheblich über den durchschnittlichen Anforderungen'; '2,3 - 1,3 Punkte: durchschnittliche Leistungen'; '1,2 - 0,6 Punkte: ... trotz ihrer Mängel noch den Anforderungen genügen'). Only the top band names a grade, so no German grade limit can be derived. Programme page: 'Rather than based on previous grades, we select students using an aptitude check.' Grade conversion of recognised credits: modified Bavarian formula (PSO § 8 Abs. 2); Nr. 5.1.2 allows conversion for foreign applicants.

items.raw_label: b) „Computer Scientist's Track“: insgesamt mindestens 60 Leistungspunkten im Bereich der Informatik (§ 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 lit. b)
– davon ein Kurs in theoretischer Informatik (§ 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 lit. b; one course, no LP number)
– davon ein Programmierkurs (§ 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 lit. b; one course, no LP number)
– davon ein Anwendungskurs (z.B. Mensch-Maschine-Interaktion) (§ 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 lit. b; one course, no LP number)

subject_credit_requirements.note: PSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 lit. b: 'insgesamt mindestens 60 Leistungspunkten im Bereich der Informatik – davon je ein Kurs in theoretischer Informatik, ein Programmierkurs und ein Anwendungskurs (z.B. Mensch-Maschine-Interaktion)'. The three 'davon' courses are nested inside the 60 LP total (E2a: a course counted for a sub-requirement also counts for the 60 LP total) and are presence-only (one course each, no LP number). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): the application course is mapped to hci, the only example named; other CS application areas are not counted (stricter, see DECISION). The other tracks (a, c, d) are described in accepted_degree_fields.note and are not checked. Programme FAQ: 'your bachelor's degree should contain 60 ETCS in philosophy and/or computer science covering at least 3 of the six basic modules' (this matches the Mixed Track c wording, see CONFLICT).

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: the PSO (§ 2, Anhang 2) contains no Auflagen clause and no rule for making up missing subject credits; the 2025 amendment does not change § 2. (Conditional enrolment exists only for a missing degree certificate - transcript with at least 150 ECTS, certificate by the end of the 2nd semester, § 2 Abs. 3 - and for German A1 proof by the end of the 2nd semester, § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3; see other_requirements.)

descriptive_notes: Aptitude procedure (Eignungsverfahren, PSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 4, Anhang 2), held once a year for the following winter semester by the Prüfungsausschuss.

Stage 1 (Anhang 2 Nr. 5.1): two committee members score independently: written motivation statement max. 4.0 points (language/structure 1, scientific quality and reference to questions at the intersection of philosophy and computer science 1, reasons for the choice of programme, competences and special qualifications 2) plus subject-specific performance of the first degree max. 4.0 points (table Nr. 9); result = average of both members, one decimal.
Stage 1 outcome: 5.5 points or more = aptitude confirmed (Nr. 5.2); below 3.0 = rejected (Nr. 5.3); 3.0 to below 5.5 = invited to an aptitude interview (Nr. 5.4).

Interview: individual, 15-30 minutes, in English, four criteria at 1 point each (max. 4.0); missing the interview means rejection (Nr. 5.4-5.6). Final: interview result plus the subject-specific performance points (Nr. 5.1.2) are added; below 5.5 points = not suitable (Nr. 5.7).

GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): with at most 4.0 points for the motivation statement (stage 1) or for the interview (stage 2), an applicant needs at least 1.5 subject-specific performance points to reach 5.5 in either path. Table Nr. 9 gives verbal bands only, so this cannot be turned into a German grade.
Applicants who fail may apply to the procedure once more (Nr. 7); a passed procedure remains valid for later applications to this programme unless content and aims change substantially (Nr. 6.3).

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification and first degree obtained in English (PSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2)
first study programme or high school diploma completed in English: a confirmation that English was the medium of instruction is sufficient (programme FAQ)
German Abiturzeugnis listing English at level B2 or better (programme FAQ)
language_english.note: PSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'der Nachweis von Englischkenntnissen mindestens der Niveaustufe B2' (for applicants whose entrance qualification and first degree were not obtained in English). Programme FAQ: UNIcert II pass or better, Cambridge Proficiency pass or better, Cambridge Advanced grade C or better, Cambridge First grade B or better, IELTS band 6.5 or better, TOEFL iBT 80, TOEFL ITP 543. Programme page: 'excellent command of written and spoken English (level B2)'.

language_german.due: by the end of the 2nd semester (conditional enrolment if not available at application; PSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3)

aps_certificate.note: Programme FAQ: 'students from India, Vietnam, and mainland China are required to apply for the APS certificate.' Not in the PSO.

other_requirements: written motivation statement in English (max. 500 words) on reasons for choosing the programme, qualifying competences and how to expand them (Anhang 2 Nr. 3; programme page)
declaration of independent authorship (Anhang 2 Nr. 3)
first-degree certificate with transcript, or transcript with individual grades of at least 150 ECTS/LP, and a module list with expected examination dates (PSO § 2 Abs. 3; Anhang 2 Nr. 3)
CV (Anhang 2 Nr. 3; programme page)
if the degree certificate is not yet available: conditional enrolment, certificate by the end of the 2nd semester (PSO § 2 Abs. 3); programme page: degree must be completed 'by 1 October to enroll'
non-EU degrees: Vorprüfungsdokumentation (VPD) from uni-assist, fee-based, request 6-8 weeks before the deadline (international office page; FAQ)
online application via CAMPUSonline; no paper documents by post (international office page)

Programme FAQ (https://philcs.uni-bayreuth.de/en/applicants/faq/index.html): '3-year bachelor's degrees from India are not formally equivalent to 3-year bachelor's degrees from Germany' … 'Unfortunately, we will not be able to consider your application'; they 'recommend only accepting students with four years of higher education from India'. The PSO itself only requires a degree of 'mindestens 180 Leistungspunkten'.

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungs- und Studienordnung – Besondere Bestimmungen – für den Studiengang Research in Computer and Systems Engineering mit dem Abschluss „Master of Science“ (PStO-BB), § 3 and Anlage „Besondere Zugangsvoraussetzungen“, together with the Ordnung für den Zugang zu Masterstudiengängen an der Technischen Universität Ilmenau (MAZugO) vom 13. Juli 2020
admission_regulation.version: PStO-BB published in Verkündungsblatt Nr. 225/2021, in der Fassung der Ersten Änderungssatzung vom 12. Juli 2022 (Verkündungsblatt Nr. 233/2022; faculty council 15.06.2022, approved by the President 12.07.2022); applies to all students enrolled from SS 2022 (§ 16). The document read is the consolidated Verkündungsblatt version of the 1st amendment; the original 225/2021 and the amending text 233/2022 were not opened separately. No later amendment found in Verkündungsblatt issues 268/2024, 269/2024, 281/2026, 284/2026 and 289/2026 (checked) — the full Verkündungsblatt listing was not searched, so this is not exhaustive. MAZugO of 13.07.2020 (Senate 07.07.2020, President 13.07.2020; replaces the version of 25.03.2013, Verkündungsblatt 111/2013); no amendment found. Grade words from PStO-AB, new version Verkündungsblatt 281/2026 (16.02.2026), § 18 Abs. 3.

accepted_degree_fields.note: PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 3: the degree is rated 'in einschlägigen Studiengängen beziehungsweise Fachgebieten mit 40 Punkten, zum Beispiel Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering' and 'in nah verwandten Studiengängen beziehungsweise Fachgebieten mit 20 Punkten, zum Beispiel Electrical Engineering, Automation'. This route record applies ONLY to a degree rated 40 points (einschlägig); CS-related students are the only students matched against this computer_science file. GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): a 20-point degree (EE, Automation) reaches 70 only with 'sehr gut' + all 15 subject points + the 5 thesis/experience points (20+30+15+5) and is not covered by a record. Route split (E9): route A = 40 + grade 'sehr gut' (30) = 70; route B (4092_B) = 40 + grade 'gut' (20) + at least 10 points from subject grades and/or thesis/experience. MAZugO § 3 Abs. 2: a degree with at least 180 ECTS (or expected within one semester parallel to the Master's). Programme page: 'Bachelor's degree in a similar field'; the programme is 'based on a bachelor's degree in computer science, technical computer science, computer engineering'.

grade_requirement.note: PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 4: 'Zusätzlich wird der Grad der Qualifikation nach der Abschlussnote bewertet: a) sehr gut = 30 Punkte b) gut = 20 Punkte'. Grade word defined in PStO-AB (Verkündungsblatt 281/2026) § 18 Abs. 3: 'von 1,0 bis 1,5 = sehr gut', 'von 1,6 bis 2,5 = gut'. GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): with a 40-point degree, 'sehr gut' (1,5 or better) gives exactly the 70 points needed (Ziff. 6) without any subject or thesis points, so route A has a grade limit of 1,5 and no other check. The limit is derived from the points table, not a cut-off stated as such. No conversion method for foreign grades is stated in the PStO-BB, MAZugO or PStO-AB.

subject_credit_requirements.note: Route A has no subject check: 40 (degree) + 30 (grade 'sehr gut') = 70 points (PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 6: 'Erreicht der Bewerber entsprechend der Bewertungen nach Ziffer 3 bis 5 eine Gesamtpunktzahl von 70 und mehr Punkten, ist die Eignungsüberprüfung mit „Besondere Zugangsvoraussetzungen vorliegend“ zu bewerten.'). The regulation states no ECTS minimums. Subject points (Ziff. 4: grade 'gut' or 'sehr gut' in Software Engineering, Databases, Operation Systems, Communication Networks, Theoretical Computer Science, Automation; 5 points each, max 15) and thesis/experience points (Ziff. 5) are not needed in this route. Whether the degree is 'einschlägig' (40 points) is decided by the Prüfungsausschuss in case of doubt (Ziff. 7).

conditional_admission.mechanism: None in the PStO-BB: Anlage Ziff. 6 'Werden weniger als 70 Punkte erreicht ist die Eignungsüberprüfung mit „Besondere Zugangsvoraussetzungen nicht vorliegend“ zu bewerten (§ 4 Absatz 4 Satz 4, Absatz 6 Satz 1 MAZugO).' The points system has no subject-credit gaps that could be bridged. Framework options (MAZugO, not stored): § 4 Abs. 4 lit. b allows 'Besondere Zugangsvoraussetzungen vorliegend' with a positive prognosis and additional work 'im Umfang von maximal 30 Leistungspunkten (ECTS)' ('die Zulassung zum Studium ist in diesen Fällen nur mit Auflage zulässig'); § 4 Abs. 6 Satz 2: if at most 60 LP are missing, admission may instead be conditional on prior successful participation in a university preparatory course, where the faculty offers one. This route record applies ONLY to a degree rated 40 points (einschlägig); CS-related students are the only students matched against this computer_science file. GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): a 20-point degree (EE, Automation) reaches 70 only with 'sehr gut' + all 15 subject points + the 5 thesis/experience points (20+30+15+5) and is not covered by a record. grade_requirement.note: PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 4: 'Zusätzlich wird der Grad der Qualifikation nach der Abschlussnote bewertet: a) sehr gut = 30 Punkte b) gut = 20 Punkte'. Grade word defined in PStO-AB (Verkündungsblatt 281/2026) § 18 Abs. 3: 'von 1,6 bis 2,5 = gut'. GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): a grade worse than 'gut' gives 0 grade points, and 40 + 15 + 5 = 60 < 70, so 'gut' (2,5 or better) is the weakest grade with which a 40-point degree can reach 70. With 'gut' the applicant has 60 points and needs at least 10 more: two of the six subjects graded 'gut' or better (5 + 5), or one such subject plus a Bachelor thesis graded 'gut' or better / at least one year of qualified professional experience (5 + 5). The limit is derived from the points table, not a cut-off stated as such. No conversion method for foreign grades is stated. See the IMPORTANT selection note: route B is eligible only with the additional 10 subject/thesis points (not checked by GPU-R).

subject_credit_requirements.note: PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 4: 'Die Erzielung einer Abschlussnote „gut“ oder „sehr gut“ in den folgenden studiengangrelevanten Fächern beziehungsweise Fächergruppen - Software Engineering - Databases - Operation Systems - Communication Networks - Theoretical Computer Science und - Automation wird mit jeweils 5 Punkten bewertet. Es sind maximal 15 Punkte erreichbar.' Ziff. 5: 'Zusätzlich wird der Abschluss einer Bachelorarbeit beziehungsweise einer gleichwertigen Abschlussarbeit mit der Note „gut“ oder „sehr gut“ oder eine nachweisbare qualifizierte Berufserfahrung von mindestens einem Jahr mit 5 Punkten bewertet.' Route B needs at least 10 of these points (GPU-R arithmetic, not regulation wording). The regulation states no ECTS minimums: the points depend on the GRADE of each subject (group) and on an any-two-of-six choice, which the engine cannot check with credit items. No item is stored; the rule is shown to the student as a selection note. GPU-R limitation: the engine is MORE LENIENT than the regulation here (a 'gut' graduate without two well-graded subjects, or one plus a good thesis/experience, would not reach 70) — see DECISION in notes. admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 2025/343 of 24.09.2025 (SPO of 18.09.2025), in force from WS 2025/26; ÜPO as amended, Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 2026/067 (20th version, 21.04.2026; replaces 2025/221)

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 3 (1): recognised first university degree per § 3 (4) ÜPO; § 3 (2): achievements must be comparable to those of the RWTH Bachelor's programme Informatik. Program page: 'first degree in Computer Science or closely related field'.

grade_requirement.note: Neither SPO § 3 nor ÜPO § 3 (4) sets a minimum grade. The program page only recommends a CGPA of at least 65% (not a requirement).

items.raw_label: Praktische Informatik (33 CP): Programmierung 8 CP
Praktische Informatik (33 CP): Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen 7 CP
Praktische Informatik (33 CP): Datenbanken und Informationssysteme 6 CP
Praktische Informatik (33 CP): Softwaretechnik 6 CP
Praktische Informatik (33 CP): Elements of Machine Learning and Data Science 6 CP
Technische Informatik (22 CP): Einführung in die Technische Informatik 6 CP + Datenkommunikation 6 CP
Technische Informatik (22 CP): Betriebssysteme und Systemsoftware 6 CP
Technische Informatik (22 CP): IT-Sicherheit 4 CP
Theoretische Informatik (18 CP): Formale Systeme, Automaten und Prozesse 6 CP; Berechenbarkeit und Komplexität 6 CP; Mathematische Logik I 6 CP
Kompetenzen im Bereich der Mathematik im Umfang von 26 CP: Diskrete Strukturen 6 CP; Analysis für Informatik 8 CP; Lineare Algebra 6 CP; Einführung in die angewandte Stochastik 6 CP

subject_credit_requirements.note: Area totals as printed in SPO 2025/343 § 3 (2) (33 + 22 + 18 + 26 = 99 CP); module CP listed in raw_label. Content is judged against the RWTH Bachelor Informatik modules by the examination board. The program page mentions a small margin when qualifications 'deviate from the required courses only slightly' (website only, not in the SPO). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording; Koushik's decision 14.10.2026): the CS areas are checked module by module with the CP stated in SPO § 3 (2), one item per taxonomy category (stricter than checking only the area totals); mathematics is checked as one 26 CP total. Einführung in die Technische Informatik and Datenkommunikation share the category computer_engineering (6 + 6 = 12 CP); Mathematische Logik I is counted under theoretical_cs (logic for computer science), so it cannot overlap with Diskrete Strukturen in mathematics.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflagen (SPO § 3 Abs. 4 i.V.m. § 3 Abs. 6 ÜPO): RWTH Bachelor modules, to be proven before registering the Master's thesis; admission not possible if Auflagen of more than 22 CP are necessary

descriptive_notes: Open admission (not restricted, no NC).
The program page strongly recommends a minimum CGPA of 65%; this is a recommendation, not a requirement.

Course content must be comparable to the RWTH Bachelor Informatik modules; the examination board decides. The program page mentions a small margin if qualifications deviate from the required courses only slightly.
Most applicants do not qualify for a higher-semester start; apply for the first semester.

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or degree from the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Canada or the United States
language_english.note: SPO § 3 (5): English per § 3 Abs. 9 ÜPO. Scores from the official RWTH language-requirements page (ÜPO § 3 Abs. 9): TOEFL iBT 90, IELTS 6.0, PTE Academic 60, Cambridge B2 First grade B or better, C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency, UNIcert II, school certificate showing B2. Program page: proof due when you enroll. MOI is not addressed on the SSE pages.

standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE General Test at time of application: Quantitative Reasoning in the top 25% (above 75th percentile); Verbal Reasoning in the top 85% (above 15th percentile); Analytical Writing at least 3.5

other_requirements: Module descriptions document with completed cover page (uploaded in RWTHonline)

Programme page: 'in the field of Visual Computing or a related field (particularly informatics, computer science, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering or mechatronics) or proof of equivalent academic achievement.' primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: The FSB 2025 set no grade limit. Official SIC application guide (Saarland Informatics Campus): 'Minimal prerequisite is a cumulative undergraduate grade point average (CGPA) of 75% or 3.00 GPA on a 4 point scale and ranking in the top 10% of the graduating class.' Koushik decision 19.10.2026: store the guide's minimum as a hard grade (GPU-R policy, official page, not regulation wording). GPU-R conversion: 3,00/4 with Nmin 2,0 (↔ Indian Nmin 5,0) → 1 + 3 × (4,0 − 3,0)/(4,0 − 2,0) = 2,5; 75 % on the Indian 10-point scale = CGPA 7,5 → 1 + 3 × (10 − 7,5)/(10 − 5) = 2,5 (both give 2,5). The 'top 10 % of the graduating class' condition cannot be checked (student note). Guide re-checked 19.10.2026 (page modified 02.10.2026): the same minimum is stated in the Visual Computing block. '75%' is read as CGPA 7,5/10 (GPU-R arithmetic); if a university reports percentage marks, its own %-to-CGPA rule may differ.

items.raw_label: lit. b: Nachweis von Kompetenzen im Bereich Mathematik (diskrete Mathematik, ein- und mehrdimensionale Analysis, Lineare Algebra, Numerik, Stochastik, Statistik) im Umfang von insgesamt mindestens 18 CP (§ 32 Abs. 2 lit. b)

lit. c: I. Informatik, insbesondere Programmierung sowie Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen; II. Kernthemen des Visual-Computing-Bereichs (zum Beispiel Bildgebende Verfahren, Bildverarbeitung, Computer Vision, Mustererkennung, Computergrafik, wissenschaftliche Visualisierung, geometrische Modellierung); III. bildnahe Gebiete (zum Beispiel Datenwissenschaften, Künstliche Intelligenz, Robotik); IV. 'In den Bereichen I bis III müssen insgesamt 27 CP erbracht werden.' (§ 32 Abs. 2 lit. c)

subject_credit_requirements.note: FSB § 32 Abs. 2 lit. b and c. The mathematics topic list is closed (no 'zum Beispiel'); the 18 CP are a binding total with no sub-minimums, so mathematics is one item. Areas I-III have no separate minimums, only the joint total of 27 CP ('insgesamt'), so they are ONE pooled item (owner decision 16.10.2026, add-up E1). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): area I Informatik -> general_cs (aggregate, contains programming, algorithms/data structures and the other CS categories); area II (imaging, image processing, computer vision, pattern recognition, computer graphics, scientific visualisation, geometric modelling) -> graphics_visual_computing and, for pattern recognition, machine_learning_ai, both already inside general_cs; area III Datenwissenschaften -> data_science.foundational_methods, Künstliche Intelligenz -> machine_learning_ai (inside general_cs), Robotik -> engineering.robotics. 'Numerik' in the mathematics item -> mathematics_statistics.optimization_numerics. engineering.robotics and mathematics_statistics.optimization_numerics are allowed GPU-R category names not yet in cs_taxonomy.json; they count 0 until Part 1 classifies courses into them (record first, engine later). The two items share no category (theoretical_cs and discrete maths: discrete maths stays only in general_mathematics, general_cs contains theoretical_cs, which is a different category). The SIC application guide lists the same areas without CP and adds 'telecommunication' and 'machine learning' to area IV/III; the FSB 2025 text is stored.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Vorläufige Zulassung (FSB § 32 Abs. 4): 'Studienbewerberinnen und Studienbewerber, welche die Zugangsvoraussetzungen nichtvollumfänglich erfüllen, können vorläufig zum Studium zugelassen werden. Die festgestellten fehlenden Inhalte der in Absatz 2 lit.c , IV. genannten Bereiche (I-III) sind in diesem Fall bis zur Anmeldung der Abschlussarbeit zu erbringen.' The FSB state no cap; the cap 30 CP is taken from GPO 2021 § 12 Abs. 5 ('soweit in den Fachspezifischen Bestimmungen nicht anderes geregelt maximal im Umfang von 30 CP') - GPU-R policy (not regulation wording). The clause names only the missing contents of areas I-III, not the mathematics 18 CP (lit. b). No amendment removes the clause. IMPORTANT (Koushik decision 19.10.2026: keep allowed, cap 30): conditions cover ONLY missing contents of the computer science areas I–III (lit. c, 27 CP) — NOT the mathematics 18 CP (lit. b). A maths gap cannot be bridged by conditions. Engine to-do: per-item 'conditions allowed' flag; until then the engine may wrongly show a maths gap as CONDITIONAL.

descriptive_notes: Special aptitude ('besondere Eignung', FSB § 32 Abs. 2-3): a selection committee of at least two professors appointed by the Prüfungsausschuss rates each applicant 'geeignet' or 'nicht geeignet' on English, mathematics, the subject areas I-III, a short statement of reasons for choosing the programme, two expert references and (optional) relevant practical experience of at least six months.

SIC application guide: 'Minimal prerequisite is a cumulative undergraduate grade point average (CGPA) of 75% or 3.00 GPA on a 4 point scale and ranking in the top 10% of the graduating class.' This minimum is not in the FSB.

allowed_exemptions: native speakers from Australia, Ireland, Canada, New Zealand, the UK and the USA (SIC application guide)
in-person studies at a university in one of these countries while physically residing there (SIC application guide)
language_english.note: FSB § 32 Abs. 2 lit. a: 'der Nachweis englischer Sprachkenntnisse auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau (in der Regel C1 nach dem gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmen (GER)'. 'in der Regel' = as a rule: the stored C1 hard check is GPU-R policy (not regulation wording). Scores from the SIC application guide: IELTS (academic) min. 7.0, TOEFL iBT min. 95 ('2026: 5 out of 6'), TOEFL paper-based min. 600, Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency, PTE Academic min. 76; 'Home editions of all of the above-mentioned English tests are accepted as well as expired tests.' Programme page: 'C1, a MOI (Medium of Instruction) cannnot be accepted'.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants for Visual Computing without a degree from the EHEA, Switzerland or the UK (SIC application guide; not in FSB or GPO)
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE General Test or the Indian GATE test; 'There is no minimum score requirement and we accept home editions of the GRE/GATE tests.'; 'There are no exceptions from this requirement for degrees from branch campuses located in non-EHEA countries.'

aps_certificate.note: SIC application guide: applicants with degrees from 'China, India or Vietnam' must submit the digitally signed APS certificate from the Academic Evaluation Center (Akademische Prüfstelle). Not in FSB or GPO.

other_requirements: short written statement of reasons for choosing the programme (skills, interests, background) (FSB § 32 Abs. 2 lit. d)

two references from experts who know the applicant from a scientific context and confirm study aptitude (FSB § 32 Abs. 2 lit. e); SIC guide: two complete review forms filled out by recommenders in the application system, at least one with an academic background; application counts as submitted only after both forms are filled out
optional: relevant practical experience of at least six months (FSB § 32 Abs. 2 lit. f; optional, not a requirement)

copy of the university entrance qualification, copies of the 3 most recent degrees (certified translation if needed), certified list of courses and grades with explanation of the grading system, CV (SIC guide; PDF only)

provisional admission before the Bachelor's certificate only if all Bachelor examinations and the Bachelor thesis are completed by the start of the Master's; certificate as a rule within three months after semester start (GPO § 12 Abs. 3)

admission_regulation.title: Gemeinsame Prüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Masterstudiengänge des Fachbereichs Informatik an der Universität Koblenz (GPO FB Informatik), § 33 Zugangsvoraussetzungen and Anhang 9 (Master Web and Data Science), together with the Rahmenprüfungsordnung der Universität Koblenz (Rahmen-PO) vom 24. Juni 2025, § 5
admission_regulation.version: GPO vom 09.07.2019 (Mitteilungsblatt 3/2019), amended 17.12.2019 (4/2019), 03.08.2022 (4/2022, editorial correction 29.11.2022, 7/2022), 20.09.2023 (4/2023) and 11.09.2024 (Vierte Änderungsordnung, Mitteilungsblatt 4/2024, in force 01.10.2024; it inserts in § 33 Abs. 4 Satz 3 'und sind nach den jeweiligen Bestimmungen der Prüfungsordnung zu erbringen' and replaces the Anhänge). § 33 read in the non-binding Lesefassung i.d.F. vom 11.09.2024; the binding amending text (Mitteilungsblatt 4/2024) was opened for § 33 only. Anhang 9 (Web and Data Science) read 18.10.2026 from text supplied by Koushik (BLOCKED resolved). The Informatik index of the Mitteilungsblatt lists no amendment after 11.09.2024. Rahmen-PO (Mitteilungsblatt 2/2025, 27.06.2025) in force 01.10.2025; it applies in addition and prevails in a conflict (§ 1 Abs. 2); programme POs are to be adapted by the next accreditation (§ 36 Abs. 2); no amendment found.

accepted_degree_fields.note: GPO § 33 Abs. 1: 'Zu einem Masterstudiengang nach dieser Ordnung kann nur zugelassen werden, wer das Zeugnis über die bestandene Bachelorprüfung nach dieser Ordnung oder ein Zeugnis über eine nach Maßgabe des § 10 anerkannte Abschlussprüfung besitzt'. Rahmen-PO § 5 Abs. 1: a Bachelor's 'oder einen gleichwertigen Studienabschluss'; 'In begründeten Fällen kann der Prüfungsausschuss andere Abschlüsse für den Zugang zum Masterstudiengang anerkennen.' Programme page: 'A Bachelors' degree in Computer Science, Computational Visualistics, Information Systems or a Bachelors' degree with comparable curriculum'; 'The programme requires competencies acquired in a preceding Bachelor study programme, which is equivalent to Computer Science studies of type 1 (core computer science) or type 2 (computer science with specific application subject).' 'Non-academic, practical experience in computer science will not be taken into account.' primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording). GPO Anhang 9: the master 'builds on competencies acquired in a preceding bachelor study programme, which is equivalent to computer science studies of type 1 (core computer science), type 2 (computer science with specific application subject) or type 3 (interdisciplinary study programme with a share in computer science education comparable to the weight of other subjects)'.

grade_requirement.note: GPO § 33 Abs. 1 Satz 1: 'und die Prüfung mindestens mit der Note „gut“ (2,5) abgeschlossen hat.' Programme page: 'with an overall grade of 2.5 ("good") or better'; 'The overall grade must be 2.5 (in the German grading system) or better.' Exception (§ 33 Abs. 1 Satz 2-3): 'Bei Vorliegen eines adäquaten Hochschulabschlusses kann unabhängig von der Gesamtnote eine Zulassung zum Masterstudiengang erfolgen, wenn besondere fachliche Gründe vorliegen. Mögliche fachliche Gründe sind beispielsweise die Bewertung der Bachelorarbeit mit „sehr gut“ oder eine mindestens einjährige Berufstätigkeit mit Bezug zu dem jeweiligen Fachgebiet des Studiengangs.' GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): the exception is not applied by the engine (E10, same as 6924). No conversion formula in the GPO or Rahmen-PO; the Fachbereich Informatik international page states for Master's applicants 'a minimum grade of 2.5 (equivalent to CGPA 65% or grade B)'.

items.raw_label: GPO Anhang 9 'Prior Qualification for the Curriculum': 'Skills in programming and analysing of basic data structures and algorithms' (no credit number)
GPO Anhang 9: 'Basic knowledge in the design, modelling and testing of software according to the software development process' (no credit number)

GPO Anhang 9: 'Understanding of formal foundations and principles of programming languages' + 'Basic understanding of formal languages, automata theory and computational complexity theory' (two bullets, combined because both map to theoretical_cs; no credit number)
GPO Anhang 9: 'Basic knowledge in analysis, linear algebra, discrete mathematics and logics' (no credit number)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Source: GPO FB Informatik, Anhang 9 (Master Curriculum Web and Data Science), section 'Prior Qualification for the Curriculum' — text supplied by Koushik 18.10.2026 (BLOCKED resolved); identical to the programme-page list. Students 'are expected to bring along the following competencies, skills and knowledge'; no credit numbers, so all items are presence-only (min_ects 0). The seventh bullet 'English skills' is handled under language_english. Anhang 9 also states the bachelor must be equivalent to computer science studies of type 1 (core CS), type 2 (CS with an application subject) or type 3 (interdisciplinary with a CS share comparable to the other subjects). Category mapping is GPU-R policy: the two theory bullets are one theoretical_cs item (R2); 'logics' is part of the maths bullet and stays in general_mathematics (R6). Koushik decision 19.10.2026: bullet 1 stays one pooled presence item (programming + data structures/algorithms). Missing required competences can be admitted with conditions (GPO § 33 Abs. 4, cap 30 LP). Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: GPO Anhang 9: 'Foundational skills in academic writing and presenting' (no credit number)

conditional_admission.mechanism: Zulassung unter Auflagen (GPO § 33 Abs. 4 as amended 2024): 'Stellt der Prüfungsausschuss fest, dass erforderliche Kompetenzen aus einem Bachelorstudiengang für die Zulassung zu einem der Masterstudiengänge nicht nachgewiesen sind, kann durch ihn eine Zulassung unter Auflagen erfolgen.' 'Die noch zu erbringenden Leistungen dürfen einen Umfang von 30 Leistungspunkten nicht überschreiten und sind nach den jeweiligen Bestimmungen der Prüfungsordnung zu erbringen. Die Auflagen müssen bis zur Anmeldung der Masterarbeit erfüllt sein.' Rahmen-PO § 5 Abs. 3 (prevails in a conflict): difference of 'höchstens 30 ECTS-Leistungspunkten'; missing examinations to be passed 'bis zum Ablauf des ersten Studienjahres', otherwise 'die Einschreibung wird ohne erneute Mitteilung aufgehoben'. Both caps are 30.

descriptive_notes: Only complete applications are assessed, in a standardised procedure set by the Prüfungsausschuss on the basis of the final grades of the previous degree (GPO § 33 Abs. 3).

Admission regardless of the overall grade is possible for special subject-related reasons, e.g. a Bachelor thesis graded 'sehr gut' or at least one year of subject-related professional work (GPO § 33 Abs. 1 Satz 2-3).

Non-academic, practical experience in computer science is not taken into account for the academic requirements; applicants are expected to reflect on the required competences in a motivational letter (programme page).

language_english.note: GPO § 33 Abs. 2: 'Für die Zulassung zu dem Masterstudiengang E-Government (deutschsprachig, englischsprachig) und dem englischsprachigen Masterstudiengang Web and Data Science sind fundierte Englischkenntnisse erforderlich. Diese gelten als nachgewiesen, wenn Level B2 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen bestanden wurde. Über Ausnahmen entscheidet der Prüfungsausschuss.' Programme page: 'a TOEFL result of at least 79 (internet based/ Home Edition), 550 (paper-based) or 213 (computer based)', 'IELTS test with 6.5 points minimum', 'Cambridge certificate at level B2 or higher'; 'A standardized English language certificate is required; any proof that your previous studies were held in English is not sufficient and not negotiable.' Fachbereich Informatik international page: 'TOEFL ... 79–80 points (internet based)'. The programme-page value 79 is stored (the approved 6924 stores 80 from the international page only). Due: language certificates are listed among the uni-assist application documents.

aps_certificate.note: uni-assist application page of the University of Koblenz: 'APS certificate (for applications from China, Mongolia, Vietnam and India)'. Not in the GPO or Rahmen-PO.

other_requirements: motivational letter reflecting on the academic requirements (programme page; uni-assist document list)
Bachelor thesis, final project report or a major scientific paper ('for M.Sc. Web & Data Science application only', uni-assist document list)
application via uni-assist for a first degree obtained outside Germany; fee 75 euros for the first choice, 30 euros for each additional choice
university certificates and transcript of records, school leaving certificate, passport copy, certified translations if not in English or German (uni-assist document list)
admission before the Bachelor certificate is possible with at least 150 LP and an average of at least 'gut' (2.5); missing requirements by the end of the second Master's semester (GPO § 33 Abs. 5-6)
personal laptop with a current version of Windows, macOS or Linux (programme page)

admission_regulation.title: Studienordnung für den englischsprachigen konsekutiven Studiengang Web Engineering mit dem Abschluss Master of Science (M.Sc.) an der Technischen Universität Chemnitz vom 18. Dezember 2025, § 3 Zugangsvoraussetzungen
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Bekanntmachungen Nr. 48/2025 vom 19. Dezember 2025, S. 2071 ff.; applies to students enrolled from WS 2026/2027 (§ 11); in force the day after publication. Students enrolled earlier stay under the Studienordnung of 04.08.2015 (AB 31/2015, S. 1304) unless they opt in by 30.10.2026. Prüfungsordnung of the same date (AB 48/2025, listed on the regulations page as '48/2055') contains no admission rule. The regulations page lists no amendment of the 2025 Studien- or Prüfungsordnung. Admission change against 2015: the 2015 § 3 also named the TU Chemnitz Bachelor 'Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik'; the 2025 § 3 names only Informatik and Angewandte Informatik.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Studienordnung 2025 § 3 Abs. 1: 'Die Zugangsvoraussetzungen für den Masterstudiengang Web Engineering erfüllt, wer an der Technischen Universität Chemnitz im Bachelorstudiengang Informatik oder im Bachelorstudiengang Angewandte Informatik oder wer in einem inhaltlich gleichwertigen Studiengang einen berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschluss erworben hat und ein abgeschlossenes Sprachniveau B2 Englisch entsprechend des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER) nachweist.' § 3 Abs. 2: 'Über die Gleichwertigkeit sowie über den Zugang anderer Bewerber entscheidet der Prüfungsausschuss.' Programme pages (DE and EN) still name 'Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik' / 'Information & Communication Technology' (2015 wording; see notes). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the Studienordnung 2025 § 3 or on the programme pages. No conversion method stated.

subject_credit_requirements.note: The regulation names no subjects or credit numbers: access requires a degree in TU Chemnitz Informatik / Angewandte Informatik or 'in einem inhaltlich gleichwertigen Studiengang' (content-equivalent programme); the Prüfungsausschuss decides on equivalence and on other applicants (§ 3 Abs. 2). No checkable item is stored (R7: the reference Bachelor curriculum is not converted into numbers). Programme page: 'Es findet kein Auswahlverfahren statt.'

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: the Studienordnung 2025 § 3 and the Prüfungsordnung 2025 contain no rule on admission with Auflagen (conditions) for missing subject content (checked through WebFetch summaries of both documents). No university-wide conditions rule was found on the pages read.

descriptive_notes: No admission restriction and no selection procedure (programme page: 'Für diesen Studiengang gibt es keine Zulassungsbeschränkung.' 'Es findet kein Auswahlverfahren statt.').
The Prüfungsausschuss decides whether a degree from another programme is content-equivalent to the TU Chemnitz Bachelor in Informatik or Angewandte Informatik (Studienordnung § 3 Abs. 2).

allowed_exemptions: completed degree with English as the language of instruction
completed degree in English Studies or American Studies
professional qualification as a state-examined interpreter/translator
applicants from countries where English is an official, educational or native language (some countries may still require proof)
language_english.note: Studienordnung 2025 § 3 Abs. 1: 'ein abgeschlossenes Sprachniveau B2 Englisch entsprechend des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER)'. Programme page (EN): 'English language proficiency according to level B 2 Common European Framework of Reference for Languages,' 'UNIcert level 2 or equivalent.' Application page for international applicants (English-taught programmes, B2): IELTS 5.5; 'TOEFL iBT 4.0 (72 points)'; TOEFL ITP Level 1 543; Cambridge PET with Distinction, FCE grade B or C, BEC Vantage/ILEC/ICFE, IGCSE with B2; Pearson PTE Academic 59; TOEIC L&R 785, Speaking 160, Writing 150; telc B2; UNIcert II; plus the exemptions listed. Proof is part of the application documents.

aps_certificate.note: TU Chemnitz application page for international applicants: 'original APS-certificate or digital verifiable document (only for Chinese, Vietnamese and Indian applicants)'. Not in the Studien- or Prüfungsordnung.

other_requirements: Web Engineering is one of seven Master's programmes in the pilot with direct application through the EduApplication Portal (instead of uni-assist) for applicants with an international Bachelor's degree (application page)
no German language certificate needed at application (application page)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 January (non-restricted programmes, non-EU applicants; extended 28 February only for EU/EEA/Swiss applicants)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung über den Zugang und die Zulassung für die internationalen Masterstudiengänge „International Master in Data Analytics“ und „International Master in Software Engineering“ (ZZO / ZugZulO)
admission_regulation.version: Verkündungsblatt der Universität Hildesheim Heft 189, Nr. 04/2024 (16.04.2024), S. 85; in force the day after publication (§ 8). The official regulations listing for the programme (study=68) and the document page (docID=9826) show no amendment. The PO 2024 (Heft 188, 18.03.2024, in force with effect from 01.10.2024) sets no admission requirements; § 5 Abs. 2 only regulates crediting of up to 12 LP of admission conditions.

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZZO § 2 Abs. 1: a Bachelor's 'oder diesem gleichwertigen Abschluss im Studiengang Angewandte Informatik oder in einem fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen Studium' (German or Bologna-state university), or a foreign 'gleichwertigen Abschluss in einem fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen Studium'; 'die Gleichwertigkeit wird nach Maßgabe der Bewertungsvorschläge der Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen ... (http://anabin.kmk.org) festgestellt.' 'Die Entscheidung, ob ein Studiengang fachlich geeignet ist, trifft die hierfür zuständige Stelle'. § 2 is the same for Data Analytics and Software Engineering; § 1: access and admission are decided separately per programme. Programme page: 'Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, information technology, computer engineering, mathematics' or equivalent related degrees. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the ZZO, on the programme page or in the FAQ. The grade is a ranking input only: ZZO § 4 'Punkte Abschlussnote = (MaxP) 90 * (4 – Note) / 3' (1,0 = 90 points; 'die schlechteste, als bestanden gewertete Note 4.0 ergibt 0 Punkte'). No explicit conversion formula for foreign grades.

items.raw_label: Programme page entry requirement: 'good programming competences' ('Strong analytical, creative, and logical competences, as well as good programming competences'); no credit number
FAQ: 'basic understanding of maths (e.g., as typically required in B.Sc. in computer science'; applicants without it only conditionally; no credit number

subject_credit_requirements.note: The ZZO names no subjects or credit numbers; it requires only a 'fachlich geeignet' (subject-suitable) degree (§ 2 Abs. 1). The two presence-only items come from the official programme page and the programme FAQ; storing them as checks is GPU-R policy (not regulation wording), the same approach as the approved sibling record 5561 (Data Analytics, same ZZO). FAQ: applicants with other qualifications may be admitted 'conditionally on completing some additional Bachelor courses in maths' from the Applied Computer Science Bachelor during the first year; 'there are no requirements on prior knowledge' in any application domain. Ranking criterion: 'Umfang und Noten von Bachelor-Modulen mit engem inhaltlichen Bezug zur Studienvariante' (ZZO § 4 Abs. 5 a).

conditional_admission.mechanism: Nebenbestimmung (ZZO § 2 Abs. 1): 'die positive Feststellung kann mit einer Nebenbestimmung verbunden werden, noch fehlende Module innerhalb von zwei Semestern nachzuholen.' No credit cap is stated in the ZZO. PO 2024 § 5 Abs. 2: on application the Prüfungsausschuss can allow modules 'im Umfang von maximal 12 LP, die bei der Zulassung zur Auflage nach § 2 ... ZugZulO International Master in Software Engineering ... gemacht wurden' to be credited in the Anwendungsbereich; 'Bei höheren Auflagen sind die einzubringenden Leistungspunkte zu kappen.' This is a crediting rule, not a cap on conditions.

descriptive_notes: Selection only if qualified applications exceed places (ZZO § 1): ranking by points = grade points (max 90) + special aptitude (max 80) (ZZO § 4); ties decided by lot.

Special aptitude criteria (ZZO § 4 Abs. 5): scope and grades of Bachelor modules closely related to the programme, research activities, practical activities, and possibly a selection interview; the weighting is published at least 6 weeks before the portal opens on https://www.uni-hildesheim.de/fb4/ordnungen/se/.

Weighting on the programme page: overall Bachelor grade 53 %, number and grades of Bachelor courses in Software Engineering incl. mathematics and programming 35 %, prior research activities in Software Engineering 6 %, prior practical experience in Software Engineering 6 %.
Interviews are held with applicants who could still reach an admitting rank with the maximum interview result (ZZO § 4).
Enrolment is conditional until the Bachelor's degree is proven: by 31 March for a winter start and 30 September for a summer start (ZZO § 4).

allowed_exemptions: English as first language
at least one year of work or study in an English-speaking country within the last 10 years
a study programme of at least one year completed fully in English within the last 10 years
German Hochschulzugangsberechtigung with at least six years of English up to the Abitur or English in the Abitur exam with at least 10 points
language_english.note: ZZO § 2 Abs. 3 c, tests not older than 10 years: 'Common European Framework Stufe B2', 'Paper-based TOEFL 500 Punkte', 'Computer-based TOEFL 173 Punkte', 'Internet-based TOEFL 61 Punkte', 'International English Language Testing (IELTS) Niveaustufe 5', Cambridge FCE 'mit Mindestnote B' or CAE 'mit Mindestnote C'. Programme page: 'TOEFL Computer-based Test – min. 61 points, IELTS – min. 6, or an equivalent certificate' or a German high school diploma; for English-taught studies 'a document from the respective university is required certifying that the program was conducted entirely in English', 'stamped and signed by the university'. The regulation value (IELTS 5) is stored; the programme page states IELTS 6 (not verdict-relevant). Proof is part of the application. Koushik decision 19.10.2026: IELTS stored as 6.0 (official programme/department pages 'IELTS – min. 6'; stricter than ZZO § 2 Abs. 3 'IELTS Niveaustufe 5'; GPU-R policy — higher scores also help at the visa stage). MyGermanUniversity (third-party) shows IELTS 5 / TOEFL iBT 61, i.e. the regulation values.

aps_certificate.note: Programme page: APS required if the Bachelor's degree was earned in China (excluding Hong Kong and Macau), Vietnam, Mongolia or India; upload it 'in one of the sections for English language certificates'. The FAQ lists only China, Vietnam and Mongolia. Not in the ZZO.

other_requirements: application exclusively through the Faculty 4 application portal (https://www.ismll.uni-hildesheim.de/apply/)
Bachelor's, Master's or diploma certificate with transcript of grades, in English or with an English translation; resume (programme page)
provisional access before graduation with at least 144 LP; the degree must be obtained by the end of the first Master's semester (ZZO § 2 Abs. 2)
the Bachelor's certificate must be provided before the end of the first term, otherwise the admission is cancelled (FAQ)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 30 June (ZZO § 3; portal opens 15 April; EU applicants 31 August)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 December (ZZO § 3; portal opens 19 September; EU applicants 15 February)

admission_regulation.title: Aufnahmeordnung für den Masterstudiengang „Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Systems“ an der Universität Bremen
admission_regulation.version: Vom 5. Juli 2023 (Amtliches Mitteilungsblatt der Universität Bremen Nr. 3 vom 13.07.2023, S. 59), berichtigt durch Berichtigung vom 12. Februar 2024 (Amtliches Mitteilungsblatt Nr. 2 vom 04.03.2024, S. 21); applies to first admission from WS 2024/25 (§ 6). The Berichtigung changes only § 4 Abs. 3 ('130 CP' -> '120 CP' for the grade average used in ranking) and § 1 Abs. 3 (adds the 30 June date for summer start); it does not change the access requirements. No later amendment found in the Amtliches Mitteilungsblatt issues 2024 Nr. 5-6, 2025 Nr. 1-8 and 2026 Nr. 1-6 (tables of contents checked). The university's exam framework (Allgemeiner Teil der Masterprüfungsordnungen, Lesefassung vom 10.04.2026) contains no admission rule.

accepted_degree_fields.note: AO § 1 Abs. 1 a): 'Ein erster berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss in einem der folgenden Studiengänge: Informatik, Systems Engineering, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Elektrotechnik, Physik oder in einem Studiengang, der keine wesentlichen Unterschiede in Inhalt, Umfang und Anforderungen zu den vorgenannten erkennen lässt, mit Studienleistungen im Umfang von mindestens 180 Leistungspunkten'. § 1 Abs. 2: the Auswahlkommission decides on recognition of degrees/achievements under a) and b). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: The AO sets no minimum grade for access. The grade gives up to 50 of 100 ranking points only if the qualified applicants exceed capacity (§ 4 Abs. 1 and 3: 1,0-1,5 = 50 ... 3,6-4,0 = 0 points; grades rounded to one decimal; for applicants not yet graduated the average of at least 120 CP). Foreign grades: University of Bremen master FAQ 9: average grade 'converted to the German grading system using the "Bavarian formula"'.

items.raw_label: Der Nachweis von mindestens 90 CP im Bereich Informatik (insbesondere in den Teilbereichen Mathematik, Künstliche Intelligenz, Machine Learning, Softwaredesign, Theoretische Informatik, Programmieren und/oder Projektarbeiten), die im Vorstudium erbracht worden sind.

subject_credit_requirements.note: AO § 1 Abs. 1 b). One pooled area of 90 CP 'im Bereich Informatik'; the list after 'insbesondere' names Teilbereiche that count, without separate minimums, so it is ONE item (add-up, E1). general_cs already contains machine_learning_ai (Künstliche Intelligenz, Machine Learning), software_engineering (Softwaredesign), theoretical_cs and programming_practical_cs; Mathematik is named as a Teilbereich and is stored as covered category general_mathematics (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording; precedent 9042/9058/9863). 'Projektarbeiten' has no taxonomy category: CS project modules count only if Part 1 classifies them into a CS category (stricter). The 90 CP figure is binding (no 'z. B.'). § 1 Abs. 2: the Auswahlkommission decides on the recognition of achievements under b). The same areas are scored again for ranking (§ 4 Abs. 3: up to 40 points for 'Vorerfahrungen aus dem Vorstudium' in these areas).

conditional_admission.mechanism: None for subject gaps: the AO has no Auflagen clause (word 'Auflagen' does not occur; the Berichtigung of 12.02.2024 does not add one). § 1 Abs. 3 only allows applying before graduation with at least 120 CP; admission is then 'unter der Bedingung' that all achievements for the first degree and the C1 English proof are provided at the latest two weeks after the start of lectures (certificates by 31 December for winter start). This is degree completion, not a condition for missing subject credits (lesson 8). The Allgemeiner Teil der Masterprüfungsordnungen (Lesefassung 10.04.2026) has no admission/Auflagen rule.

descriptive_notes: Restricted admission (40 first-year places in the Zulassungszahlensatzung for WS 2025/26 and WS 2026/27). If more qualified applicants than places: ranking out of 100 points (AO § 4 Abs. 3): up to 50 points for the overall grade or current average (min. 120 CP; 1,0-1,5 = 50, 1,6-2,0 = 40, 2,1-2,5 = 30, 2,6-3,0 = 20, 3,1-3,5 = 10, 3,6-4,0 = 0), up to 40 points for prior experience in Mathematik, Künstliche Intelligenz, Machine Learning, Softwaredesign, Theoretische Informatik, Programmieren and/or Projektarbeiten, up to 10 points for the motivation letter.

Motivation letter criteria (AO § 4 Abs. 3): specific reference to the programme, clear statement of own qualification and goals (link between career path and programme), match between motivation and the programme's orientation.
Hardship quota of 5 % of places on application (AO § 4 Abs. 5). Decision on admission by the Rektorin/Rektor (§ 4 Abs. 6).

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung) or last university degree obtained in English (AO § 1 Abs. 1 c)
Medium of Instruction letter from school/university (University of Bremen master FAQ 20)
language_english.note: AO § 1 Abs. 1 c): English 'mindestens dem Niveau C1' (GER); 'Zum Zeitpunkt der Bewerbung müssen Englisch-Sprachkenntnisse, die mindestens dem Niveau B2 ... entsprechen, nachgewiesen werden.' C1 proof is due at the latest two weeks after the start of lectures (§ 1 Abs. 3, § 3 Abs. 2-3). The AO names no tests. Scores are from the Sprachenzentrum der Hochschulen im Lande Bremen table 'Übersicht über anerkannte Sprachnachweise für die Studienzulassung' (Stand April 2026, for WS 2026/27): C1 = IELTS Academic Band 7.0-8.0, TOEFL iBT 'Ab 95 Punkten (alte Skala) 5.0 und höher (neue Skala)', PTE Academic 76-84; B2 (needed at application) = IELTS 6.0-6.5, TOEFL iBT 72-94 (4.0-4.5 new scale), PTE 59-75. The column assignment is read from the table layout (header 'A1 A2 B1 B2 C1 C2'; GPU-R reading, not stated per row). Language courses (except UNIcert) do not count as proof. MyGermanUniversity (third-party, checked 19.10.2026): 'At the time of the application, B2 is sufficient, but C1 must be proved 2 weeks after the start of the lecture period'; '90 credit points must be in Computer Science', mathematics named as one area within the 90 — matches the record.

aps_certificate.note: University of Bremen master FAQ 10: 'China, Vietnam, India:' APS certificate; 'The APS certificate must be available at the time of application.' Applications without it 'will be rejected'.

other_requirements: motivation letter (max. 2 pages) explaining the particular interest in the programme, with information per § 4 Abs. 3 (AO § 1 Abs. 1 d)
application and proofs submitted electronically by the deadline (moin portal) (AO § 3 Abs. 1)

at enrolment, at the latest two weeks after lectures start, in paper form: Annahmeerklärung, proofs of all § 1 requirements, English proof B2 and later C1, Darstellung des bisherigen Studienverlaufs (Transcript of Records) and motivation letter; copies officially certified by German authorities; certified translations of documents not in German or English (AO § 3 Abs. 2-3)
applicants not yet graduated: at least 120 CP by the deadline; degree certificates by 31 December (winter start) (AO § 1 Abs. 3)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 March (Ausschlussfrist; application period 01.02.-15.03.; same for all applicants)

admission_regulation.title: Aufnahmeordnung für den Masterstudiengang „Management Information Systems“ an der Universität Bremen
admission_regulation.version: Vom 16. Oktober 2024 (Amtliches Mitteilungsblatt der Universität Bremen Nr. 6 vom 21.10.2024, S. 153; genehmigt 16.10.2024); applies to admission from WS 2025/26 and repeals the Aufnahmeordnung vom 19. Oktober 2022 (§ 6). The PDF on the DBS page shows 'Vom 16. Oktober 2023' in the heading while its approval line and the Mitteilungsblatt say 16.10.2024 (the Mitteilungsblatt version is stored). No amendment or Berichtigung found in Amtliches Mitteilungsblatt 2025 Nr. 1-8 and 2026 Nr. 1-6 (tables of contents checked).

accepted_degree_fields.note: AO § 1 Abs. 1 a): 'Ein erster berufsqualifizierender Hochschulabschluss in einem der folgenden Studiengänge: Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaft, Digitale Medien, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder in einem Studiengang, der keine wesentlichen Unterschiede in Inhalt, Umfang und Anforderungen zu den vorgenannten erkennen lässt, mit Studienleistungen im Umfang von mindestens 180 Leistungspunkten'. § 1 Abs. 2: the Auswahlkommission decides on recognition. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the AO; programme FAQ: 'There is no minimum GPA or numerus clausus.' The grade gives up to 50 of 100 ranking points if qualified applicants exceed capacity (§ 4 Abs. 3 a), average of at least 130 CP). Foreign grades: University of Bremen master FAQ 9 ('Bavarian formula').

items.raw_label: mindestens 12 CP in den Bereichen praktische Informatik
12 CP betriebswirtschaftliche Grundlagen

subject_credit_requirements.note: AO § 1 Abs. 1 b): 'Der Nachweis von mindestens 12 CP in den Bereichen praktische Informatik und 12 CP betriebswirtschaftliche Grundlagen, die in einem vorherigen Studium erbracht worden sind.' Two separate minimums -> two items with no shared category. Programme FAQ examples: practical CS '(e.g. software, algorithms, data structures, programming languages)'; business '(e.g. marketing, accounting, HR, finance, strategic management; please note: economics courses do not count as business studies)'. practical_cs (programming, algorithms/data structures, databases, software engineering) matches these examples (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording). The FB 7 'MIS Aufnahmekriterien' sheet for Bremen students also lists Bremen modules such as Grundlagen des Maschinellen Lernens, Rechnernetze, Informationssicherheit and Technische Grundlagen der Informatik as ways to reach the 12 CP; these are not stored as covered categories (see DECISION in notes). Proof is required by the application deadline (FAQ: 'by the time of application').

conditional_admission.mechanism: None: the AO has no Auflagen clause; programme FAQ: 'If the requirements are not met, enrollment is not possible. There is no conditional admission.' AO § 1 Abs. 3 only allows applying before graduation with at least 130 CP; admission 'unter der Bedingung' that the degree and the C1 English proof follow at the latest two weeks after lectures start (certificates by 31 December). That is degree completion, not a subject condition (lesson 8).

descriptive_notes: Restricted admission (40 first-year places in the Zulassungszahlensatzung for WS 2025/26 and WS 2026/27). If more qualified applicants than places: ranking out of 100 points (AO § 4 Abs. 3): a) up to 50 points for the overall grade or current average (min. 130 CP; 1,0-1,5 = 50, 1,6-2,0 = 40, 2,1-2,5 = 30, 2,6-3,0 = 20, 3,1-3,5 = 10, 3,6-4,0 = 0); b) up to 50 points for the relevance of the study focus and prior experience in Wirtschaftsinformatik, 'unter besonderer Berücksichtigung von Projekten'.
Hardship quota of 5 % of places on application (AO § 4 Abs. 5). Decision on admission by the Rektorin/Rektor (§ 4 Abs. 6).

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or last university degree obtained in English (AO § 1 Abs. 1 c); programme FAQ: '(MOI / proof required)'
Medium of Instruction letter from school/university (University of Bremen master FAQ 20)
language_english.note: AO § 1 Abs. 1 c): English 'mindestens dem Niveau C1' (GER); B2 must be proven at the time of application; C1 by two weeks after the start of lectures (§ 1 Abs. 3, § 3 Abs. 2-3). Programme page: 'Englisch B2 zum Zeitpunkt der Bewerbung, C1 zum Zeitpunkt der Immatrikulation (gültig ab 2025)'. The AO names no tests. Scores from the SZHB table (Stand April 2026): C1 = IELTS 7.0-8.0, TOEFL iBT from 95 (5.0 new scale), PTE 76-84; B2 = IELTS 6.0-6.5, TOEFL iBT 72-94, PTE 59-75 (column assignment read from the table layout; GPU-R reading). German is not required (programme FAQ). MyGermanUniversity (third-party, checked 19.10.2026): 'at the time of application: English level B2; at the time of enrollment: C1 (from 2025)'; at least 12 CP practical computer science and 12 CP business basics — matches the record. (Expatrio StudyBuddy mentions German C1 for enrollment — not in the regulation; not stored.)

aps_certificate.note: University of Bremen master FAQ 10: 'China, Vietnam, India:' APS certificate; 'The APS certificate must be available at the time of application.' The MIS FAQ refers to this Student Office FAQ.

other_requirements: application and proofs submitted electronically by the deadline (AO § 3 Abs. 1)

at enrolment, at the latest two weeks after lectures start, in paper form: Annahmeerklärung, proofs of all § 1 requirements, English C1 proof, Darstellung des bisherigen Studienverlaufs (Transcript of Records); translations by a translator sworn/authorised in Germany for documents not in German or English (AO § 3 Abs. 2-3)
applicants not yet graduated: at least 130 CP by the deadline; degree certificates by 31 December (winter start) (AO § 1 Abs. 3)
work experience cannot replace the academic requirements (programme FAQ)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 31 May (application period 01.04.-31.05.; FAQ: 'All deadlines apply equally to all applicants (EU and non-EU).')

admission_regulation.title: Fachstudien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Bachelor- und Masterstudiengang Data Science an der Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FPODataScience), § 55, together with the Allgemeine Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Masterstudiengänge an der Naturwissenschaftlichen Fakultät (ABMPO/NatFak) § 35 and Anlage
admission_regulation.version: FPODataScience vom 5. März 2026, in force 1 April 2026, for all students starting from SS 2026 (§ 61 Abs. 1); the 2020 FPO (i.d.F. 28.03.2022) expires for the master on 31.03.2030 (§ 61 Abs. 2). Binding German text read 18.10.2026 (supplied by Koushik; BLOCKED resolved) — § 55 matches the English translation except that § 55 Abs. 3 Satz 3 makes the overall grade (Gesamtnote) the measure for the interview route; the maths/CS-module average applies only before graduation (§ 35 Abs. 3 ABMPO/NatFak). General regulation: ABMPO/NatFak vom 22.08.2023, amended 07.08.2024 and 31.07.2025. § 55 Abs. 1 still cites '§ 35 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 ABMPOMathe/NatFak' while Abs. 3 cites ABMPO/NatFak (ABMPO/NatFak § 40 Abs. 3 replaces ABMPOMathe/NatFak).

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPO 2026 § 55 Abs. 1 (DE, binding): '... Mathematik, Technomathematik, Wirtschaftsmathematik Informatik, Data Science oder Physik an der FAU bzw. ein sonstiger hinsichtlich des im jeweiligen Abschluss vermittelten Kompetenzprofils nicht wesentlich unterschiedlicher gleichwertiger in- oder ausländischer Abschluss.' ABMPO/NatFak § 35 Abs. 1-2: subject-specific/related degree plus passing the qualification assessment (Anlage); degrees must not differ significantly in the competence profile. Programme page: 'your competence profile cannot be evaluated in advance, but only by the admission committee'. Other route (record manual_fau_ds_INTERVIEW): applicants whose average in the mathematics- and computer-science-related modules is worse than 2,5 but at least 2,8 are invited to an oral admission examination (FPO § 55 Abs. 3 sentence 3; 2020 FPO § 49 Abs. 3) and are admitted if the Zugangskommission accepts on the examiners' recommendation. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: FPO 2026 § 55 Abs. 3 Satz 1-2 (DE, binding): the Zugangskommission determines the qualification on the written documents if the 'Gesamtnote' of the relevant degree, or before graduation (§ 35 Abs. 3 ABMPO/NatFak) the average of achievements so far, is '2,5 (gut) oder besser'; the average is weighted by module ECTS. This route = direct qualification without interview. Foreign grades: ABMPO/NatFak Anlage Abs. 5 / § 13 Abs. 3 (modified Bavarian formula). Cross-check 19.10.2026: MyGermanUniversity (third-party) 'GPA of 2.5 or better'; GPA 2.6–2.8 → short online interview (calculus, linear algebra, algorithms and data structures); no maths/CS ECTS minimum — matches the binding FPO 2026 § 55 (no subject credit requirement; 'competence profile not significantly different', assessed by the admissions committee).

subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject ECTS minimum is stated for Master access. FPO § 55 and ABMPO/NatFak § 35 require a degree whose competence profile is not significantly different from the listed FAU degrees; R7 (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording): a 'comparable competence profile' rule without numbers is not converted into credit items. FPO § 43 Abs. 2 ('at least 80 ECTS credits ... to mathematics ... and 30 ECTS credits ... from computer science') defines which MASTER programmes count as related (for repeat/failure rules), not an access requirement. The oral examination (interview route) assesses 'analysis, linear algebra, algorithms and data structures' (35 %), two specialization subjects (35 %) and academic discussion in English (30 %) (FPO § 55 Abs. 4).

conditional_admission.mechanism: None in the programme's own rules: FPODataScience 2026 § 55 (and 2020 § 49) contain no conditions clause. ABMPO/NatFak § 35 Abs. 2 Satz 2 (faculty-wide framework, unchanged by the amendments of 07.08.2024 and 31.07.2025): 'kann die Zugangskommission den Zugang unter der Bedingung aussprechen, dass zusätzliche ... Leistungen im Umfang von bis zu maximal 20 ECTS-Punkten ... nachzuweisen sind' — a discretionary framework rule only; not stored as a condition (owner decision 16.10.2026: a framework 'kann' rule alone does not count). Shown to the student as information. Koushik review 19.10.2026: approved.

descriptive_notes: Qualification assessment (ABMPO/NatFak § 35 Abs. 1 Nr. 2, Anlage): with an overall grade of 2,5 or better the Zugangskommission decides on the documents; the competence profile of the degree is still checked by the committee.

Applicants with a worse grade are not covered by this route: an oral admission examination is possible only if the overall grade is worse than 2,5 but not worse than 2,8 (see record manual_fau_ds_INTERVIEW).

allowed_exemptions: at least six years of English lessons at a German secondary school (Gymnasium) (FPO § 55 Abs. 2)
university entrance qualification or first degree completed in English (FPO § 55 Abs. 2)
language_english.note: FPO 2026 § 55 Abs. 2 (DE): 'Nachweis über Sprachkenntnisse mindestens auf dem Niveau von „Englisch Level B 2 (CEFR) Vantage oder Upper intermediate“'; 'Für Bewerberinnen und Bewerber, die ihre Hochschulzugangsberechtigung bzw. ihren ersten berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschluss in englischer Sprache erworben haben, ist kein Nachweis der englischen Sprachkenntnisse erforderlich' — an English-taught Indian bachelor is exempt (proof of English-medium degree). Programme page adds 'not be older than 2 years'; no test scores in the regulation. No IELTS/TOEFL minimum published (FAU page 24.10.2026: B2 certificate; exempt if entrance qualification or first degree in English).

aps_certificate.note: FAU 'Supporting documents for applications for Master's degree programs/PhD programs at FAU' (last updated 10 February 2026): 'APS India: Applicants who completed their first degree in India also require an APS certificate.' 'From summer semester 2025, the APS certificate must be uploaded when applying'.

other_requirements: application only via the campo portal (FAU supporting-documents list)
proof of the university degree, or a transcript showing the minimum ECTS if the certificate is not yet available (ABMPO/NatFak Anlage Abs. 2)

applicants not yet graduated: admission conditional; minimum ECTS per FPO, not less than 135 ECTS (ABMPO/NatFak § 35 Abs. 3); proof of the Bachelor within one year (the FPO 2026 states no own minimum)
officially certified copies and translations for documents not in German, English or French (FAU supporting-documents list)
CV and records of education uploaded (FAU supporting-documents list, general section)
at most three applications to FAU study programmes at the same time (programme page)

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung der Otto-von-Guericke-Universität Magdeburg für die Masterstudiengänge Data and Knowledge Engineering, Digital Engineering und Visual Computing vom 23.04.2021 (§ 4), together with the Satzung zur Durchführung des hochschulinternen Verfahrens zur Eignungsfeststellung für die Masterstudiengänge Data and Knowledge Engineering und Digital Engineering vom 16.05.2023
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 22/2021, veröffentlicht am 06.05.2021; in force the day after publication (§ 36); applies to students enrolling from WS 2021/22 (§ 35). Read from the Faculty of Computer Science copy (SPO_Master_2021_04_08.pdf); the Amtliche Bekanntmachungen copy could not be fetched (URL too long for the fetch tool). No amendment of the SPO 2021 found (FIN regulations page lists none after 2021; bekanntmachungen search found only amendments of the old 2015 SPO). Not exhaustive: the Amtliche Bekanntmachungen listing itself was not browsed. Eignungsfeststellung Satzung of 16.05.2023 (veröffentlicht 31.05.2023; repeals the Satzung of 04.09.2019); the separately published 'Zweite Satzung zur Änderung' of 16 May 2023 (Amtliche Bekanntmachung 31/2023) was not opened.

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 4 Abs. 1 a: Bachelor 'mit mindestens 180 CP und einer Regelstudienzeit von mindestens 6 Semestern', a Hochschuldiplom or comparable degree 'mit guten bzw. sehr guten Leistungen'. § 4 Abs. 1 b (MDKE): 'ein Abschluss in der Informatik oder in einer der Informatik nahen Fachrichtung'; § 4 Abs. 2: 'Über die Zulassung aus einer fachnahen Fachrichtung (siehe Absatz 1) entscheidet der Prüfungsausschuss.' Programme page: 'Computer Science or a closely related field'. The subject requirement has two alternatives (§ 4 Abs. 1 b (bb) 1. oder 2.); route split (GPU-R, E9): this record is route A; the other is route B (manual_ovgu_mdke_B): database module + at least 40 further ECTS in Informatik + 20 ECTS in angewandter Statistik. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: SPO § 4 Abs. 3: special aptitude requires that the previous studies were completed 'für MDKE mindestens mit der Note 2,30' and in addition that the criteria of the Eignungsfeststellung are met. Programme page: 'a minimum grade point average of 2,30 on the German scale'. No conversion formula in the SPO (§ 13 covers recognition only: 'Bei vergleichbaren Notensystemen werden die Noten übernommen'). Pending degree (§ 4 Abs. 4): at least 150 CP of a six-semester Bachelor with an average of at least '2,30' for MDKE.

items.raw_label: § 4 Abs. 1 b (aa) 'mindestens ein Modul zu Datenbanken' (no CP stated)
§ 4 Abs. 1 b (bb) 1. 'mindestens 60 weitere ECTS in Informatik-Veranstaltungen' (keine Praktika bzw. reine Übungen)

subject_credit_requirements.note: SPO § 4 Abs. 1 b: '(aa) mindestens ein Modul zu Datenbanken und (bb) zusätzlich 1. mindestens 60 weitere ECTS in Informatik-Veranstaltungen oder 2. mindestens 40 weitere ECTS in Informatik-Veranstaltungen und 20 ECTS in angewandter Statistik.' 'Die nachzuweisenden CP bzw. Module dürfen keine Praktika bzw. reine Übungen sein.' (the engine cannot exclude labs/pure exercise courses; student must check). Programme page: 'the degree must contain one course on Databases' and 'either 10 courses (60 ECTS) in CS or 6 courses (40 ECTS) in CS and 4 courses (20 ECTS) in applied statistics'. admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 22/2021, veröffentlicht am 06.05.2021; in force the day after publication (§ 36); applies to students enrolling from WS 2021/22 (§ 35). Read from the Faculty of Computer Science copy (SPO_Master_2021_04_08.pdf); the Amtliche Bekanntmachungen copy could not be fetched (URL too long for the fetch tool). No amendment of the SPO 2021 found (FIN regulations page lists none after 2021; bekanntmachungen search found only amendments of the old 2015 SPO). Not exhaustive: the Amtliche Bekanntmachungen listing itself was not browsed. Eignungsfeststellung Ordnung Visual Computing: published version read 17.10.2026 — Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 23/2021 of 06.05.2021 (Ordnung vom 07.04.2021), https://www.bekanntmachungen.ovgu.de/media/23_2021+Eignungsfeststellung+f%C3%BCr+den+Masterstudiengang+Visual+Computing+vom+07_04_2021-p-16438.pdf; GRE score card mandatory (§ 2 Abs. 1), max 30 points, pass ≥16 (§ 4 Abs. 4, § 5 Abs. 2); matches the faculty copy. FIN VC regulations page (modified 30.05.2025) and programme page (modified 01.06.2026) list no amendment.

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 4 Abs. 1 a: Bachelor 'mit mindestens 180 CP und einer Regelstudienzeit von mindestens 6 Semestern', a Hochschuldiplom or comparable degree 'mit guten bzw. sehr guten Leistungen'. § 4 Abs. 1 d (VisComp): 'ein Abschluss in der Informatik oder in einer der Informatik nahen Fachrichtung'; fachnahe fields decided by the Prüfungsausschuss (§ 4 Abs. 2). Programme pages: Bachelor's degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related field (broader wording than the SPO; the regulation wins). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: SPO § 4 Abs. 3: previous studies completed 'für DigiEng und VisComp mindestens mit dem Gesamtprädikat „gut“ (Note 2,50)' plus the Eignungsfeststellung criteria. Programme page: 'Minimum average grade of 2.5 im B.Sc. (adjusted to German grading scheme)'; the programme website links to the Bavarian formula (Wikipedia) for conversion. No conversion formula in the SPO (§ 13 covers recognition only: 'Bei vergleichbaren Notensystemen werden die Noten übernommen'). Pending degree (§ 4 Abs. 4): at least 150 CP of a six-semester Bachelor with an average of at least 2,50 for VisComp.

subject_credit_requirements.note: SPO § 4 Abs. 1 d sets no credit requirement for Visual Computing beyond a degree in Informatik or a field close to Informatik. Programme website: applicants 'typically have completed several relevant courses' (no number).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No provision for admission with conditions (Auflagen) in SPO § 4 or the Eignungsfeststellung Ordnung Visual Computing; no subject credits are required.

descriptive_notes: Eignungsfeststellung Visual Computing (§ 4 Abs. 4, § 5): at least 16 of 30 points: GRE max 10 (average percentile of all GRE sections; >95 % = 10 down to <50 % = 0); letter of recommendation max 10 (subject knowledge and achievements 0-5, special abilities and potential 0-5); motivation letter max 10 (interest 0-4, career goals 0-2, knowledge of the programme 0-2, form and style 0-2).
Programme page: 'admission is determined based on the GRE score, a letter of recommendation as well as a motivation letter.'
Eignungsfeststellung result is announced with the admission notice and is valid for one year (§ 6).

allowed_exemptions: German Abitur (up to and including C1)
listed secondary school certificates (e.g. USA/Canada high school diploma, A-Levels, IB Diploma)
university degrees from Australia, Canada (excluding Quebec and New Brunswick), Ireland, Great Britain, New Zealand, USA and listed Caribbean countries/British Overseas Territories
language_english.note: SPO § 4 Abs. 7: for Visual Computing 'ausreichende Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache' by 'ein international anerkanntes Sprachzertifikat' at 'Niveaustufe C1' (GER). The SPO names no tests or scores. Scores stored from the OVGU 'framework of reference ENGLISH' (Senate decision 28.01.2026), to which the programme page links for accepted proofs (C1 row): IELTS Academic 7.0, TOEFL iBT 95 (5.0 scale; home edition accepted), PTE Academic 76, CAE grade B or C, telc C1, TOEIC L&R 945 + Speaking 180 + Writing 180, UNIcert III; faculties may recognise further proofs. University-wide table, not programme-specific.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: all applicants
standardized_test_requirements.details: Eignungsfeststellung Ordnung Visual Computing § 2 Abs. 1: 'Nachweis (Score Card) des Graduate Record Examination Test (GRE)'; scored by average percentile of all sections (>95 % = 10 points ... <50 % = 0). No minimum score; the 16/30 points threshold applies to the total.

aps_certificate.note: OVGU page 'Which documents do I need to send to uni-assist e.V.?': applicants from India, China and Vietnam 'must enclose a (digital) original certificate from the Academic Evaluation Centre (APS) in New Delhi, Beijing or Hanoi.' (https://www.ovgu.de/en/-p-107230)

other_requirements: international applicants apply via uni-assist
GRE score card
letter of recommendation from a university lecturer
motivation letter in English, 400-500 words (printed)
sworn translations of documents
application before graduation: at least 150 CP of a six-semester Bachelor with an average of at least 2,50 (SPO § 4 Abs. 4)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 May via uni-assist (programme page; Eignungsfeststellung Ordnung § 2 Abs. 2: documents by 15 May, Ausschlussfrist)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: no summer intake
