admission_regulation.title: Studiengangsspezifische Prüfungs- und Studienordnung für den Masterstudiengang Computer Science International der Universität Rostock vom 17. März 2025 (§ 2), with the Rahmenprüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Masterstudiengänge der Universität Rostock (RPO-Ba/Ma) vom 11. November 2022
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Bekanntmachungen Jahrgang 2025 Nr. 17 vom 25.03.2025 (Akademischer Senat 05.03.2025); applies first to the winter semester 2025/26 (§ 18) and to students enrolled from WS 2025/26 (§ 17); full new version replacing the SPSO of 06.12.2019 (AB 39/2020) as amended 15.04.2021 (AB 10/2021) — the 2025 version drops the GATE alternative to the grade. RPO-Ba/Ma: AB 2023 Nr. 5 of 21.02.2023, no amendment listed in that copy. Re-verified 17.10.2026: SPSO 2025 § 2 text re-read (matches record; § 2 Abs. 2 also allows 'Zulassung unter Vorbehalt' and a clarifying interview at the board's discretion). Faculty CSI SPSO 2025 page lists no amendment; 2026 bulletin search found only unrelated amendments (e.g. AB 2026 Nr. 22 = civil engineering).

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPSO 2025 § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'Es ist ein erster berufsqualifizierender Abschluss in einem Studium der Informatik mit mindestens 180 Leistungspunkten oder ein anderer gleichwertiger Abschluss nachzuweisen.' Programme page: 'a bachelor degree in computer science or an equivalent degree'; only degrees with 'at least 180 credit points are recognized.' primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: SPSO 2025 § 2: '85 % des CGPA' (at least 85 % of the maximum CGPA); no German grade given. GPU-R conversion (Koushik decision 19.10.2026): 85 % of the Indian 10-point scale = CGPA 8,5 → modified Bavarian 1 + 3 × (10 − 8,5)/(10 − 5) = 1,9 (Indian Nmin 5,0). Previous note: SPSO 2025 § 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 2: success is presumed not to be expected if 'das erste berufsqualifizierende Studium nicht mindestens mit 85% des CGPA (Cumulative Grade Point Average) oder bei einem anderen Notensystem mit einer vergleichbaren Note abgeschlossen wurde' and the applicant has provided no further evidence of subject-specific qualification from which a positive prognosis can be derived. No German grade and no conversion method are stated, so no numeric German limit is stored (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording; see DECISION in notes). The programme page still names a GATE alternative ('or a GATE score of at least 500 points'), which was in the 2021 version but is not in the SPSO 2025 (see CONFLICT in notes).

items.raw_label: § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3 'vertiefte Kenntnisse' Mathematik (mindestens 18 Leistungspunkte)
§ 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3 Theoretische Informatik, insbesondere Berechenbarkeit, Komplexität, Formale Sprache, Formale Semantik und Formale Modellierung (insgesamt mindestens 12 Leistungspunkte)

subject_credit_requirements.note: SPSO 2025 § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: 'Der Nachweis von vertieften Kenntnissen auf den folgenden Fachgebieten ist zu erbringen: Mathematik (mindestens 18 Leistungspunkte), Theoretische Informatik, insbesondere Berechenbarkeit, Komplexität, Formale Sprache, Formale Semantik und Formale Modellierung (insgesamt mindestens 12 Leistungspunkte).' The topics after 'insbesondere' are examples within one Theoretische Informatik total (one item).

conditional_admission.mechanism: SPSO 2025 § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: 'Maximal neun Leistungspunkte in Theoretischer Informatik können im Verlauf des ersten Jahres nachgeholt werden.' PER-AREA LIMIT: only Theoretische Informatik may be missing (max 9 LP); a gap in Mathematik (18 LP) cannot be made up (engine rule E8 still to do; until then the student must check this). The RPO-Ba/Ma § 3 Abs. 6 general 'kann ... unter Auflagen' rule sets no cap; the programme's own rule is stored. IMPORTANT (Koushik 19.10.2026): conditions cover at most 9 ECTS and ONLY theoretical computer science — missing mathematics cannot be made up. Engine to-do: per-item 'conditions allowed' flag; until then a maths gap may wrongly show as CONDITIONAL.

descriptive_notes: SPSO 2025 § 2 Abs. 2: if admission is not restricted, access can only be refused if successful completion is not to be expected; this is presumed if a criterion of Abs. 1 Nr. 1-3 is not met or the degree is below 85 % of the CGPA (or comparable grade), unless further evidence of subject-specific qualification gives a positive overall prognosis.
The Prüfungsausschuss may invite the applicant to a clarifying interview ('klärendes Gespräch') (§ 2 Abs. 2).
Admission 'unter Vorbehalt' is possible; under restricted admission subject to § 4 Hochschulzulassungsgesetz (§ 2 Abs. 2).

allowed_exemptions: native English speakers (programme pages)
language_english.note: SPSO 2025 § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'Gemäß § 3 Absatz 3 der Rahmenprüfungsordnung (Bachelor/Master) müssen englische Sprachkenntnisse auf dem Niveau eines TOEFL IBT mit mindestens 94 Punkten, eines IELTS mit mindestens 7,0 Punkten, welcher nicht älter ist als zwei Jahre, oder eines gleichwertigen Tests nachgewiesen werden.' Programme pages: native English speakers exempt; 'The proof must not be older than two years.'

other_requirements: application online via uni-assist; enrolment at the University of Rostock after the admission letter

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 April - 31 May (uni-assist)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 October - 30 November (uni-assist)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung über den Zugang und die Zulassung für den konsekutiven Masterstudiengang Data Science an der Technischen Universität Braunschweig (official English version: 'Regulations Governing Entry Requirements and Admission to the Data Science Master's Degree Programme at Technische Universität Braunschweig')
admission_regulation.version: TU-Verkündungsblatt Nr. 1576 (German binding text read 17.10.2026: https://www.tu-braunschweig.de/fileadmin/Redaktionsgruppen/Fakultaeten/FK1/Data_Science/nr-1576_Neufassung_der_ZO_des_Masterstudiengang_Data_Science_FK_1.pdf; Fakultätsrat 26.06.2024, published 30.07.2024; values match the English version); in force 01.08.2024, first applied to the admission procedure for the summer semester 2025; repeals Nr. 1354 of 18.05.2021 after the WS 2024/25 procedure. English version 2024_08 matches. General Entry and Admission Regulations for Master's Degree Programmes (Senate 14.02.2024) apply subsidiarily (programme rules take precedence, § 1 Abs. 2); not admission-relevant here. No later amendment found on the programme documents page.

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZO § 2 (1): Bachelor's degree or equivalent 'in a previous degree programme in data science, computer science, mathematics or a closely related field' (German 2021 text: 'Data Science, Informatik, Mathematik oder in einem fachlich eng verwandten Studiengang'); foreign degrees: equivalence per anabin (ZAB); 'The Admissions Committee will decide whether a previous degree programme is closely related.' Subject profile (§ 2 (2)) has two alternatives: (a) 25 credits basic mathematics + 60 credits basic computer science (stored here, the computer-science profile); (b) at least 75 credits in basic mathematics, of which up to 15 may relate to computer science, with linear algebra, analysis incl. multivariate, and programming (mathematics profile, not stored; see DECISION in notes). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade. The final mark or GPA gives 51 % of the selection score (points table § 4 (5): 1,0 = 31 ... 2,0 = 21 ... 4,0 = 1, 5,0 = 0). No conversion method for foreign grades stated.

items.raw_label: § 2 (2) a) 'at least 25 credits in basic mathematics' (German 2021 text: 'Grundlagen Mathematik')
§ 2 (2) a) 'at least 60 credits in basic computer science' (German 2021 text: 'Grundlagen der Informatik')
§ 2 (2) a) key area 'programming' (no credits stated; inside the 60 basic CS)
§ 2 (2) a) key area 'software engineering' (no credits stated; inside the 60 basic CS)
§ 2 (2) a) key area 'databases' (no credits stated; inside the 60 basic CS)

§ 2 (2) a) 'at least two topics from the areas of IT security, distributed systems and computer networks' — checked as computer networks (Koushik decision 19.10.2026; no credits stated; inside the 60 basic CS)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Official English version (2024_08) § 2 (2) a): 'earning at least 25 credits in basic mathematics and at least 60 credits in basic computer science' and knowledge in the key areas 'programming', 'software engineering', 'databases' and 'at least two topics from the areas of IT security, distributed systems and computer networks'. Proof: 'written overview of no more than one page (A4 size paper, Arial font, font size 10)' with copies. NESTED: the four presence-only key areas count inside the 60 basic CS (E2a). POOLED: the 'two of three topics' item (it_security + computer_engineering for distributed systems and networks; mapping is GPU-R policy, not regulation wording) — presence-only, so the engine cannot check 'at least two' (see DECISION). The 2021 regulation (Nr. 1354) required 15 LP mathematics; the 2024 regulation requires 25. Koushik decision 19.10.2026: the 'two of IT security / distributed systems / computer networks' rule is checked as one presence item for computer networks (taxonomy maps networks to computer_engineering); the second topic is not checked (student note). Option (b) (75 maths, up to 15 CS) intentionally not stored as a route. Conditions kept allowed, no cap (ZO § 2 (1) programme rule).

conditional_admission.mechanism: ZO § 2 (1) (programme's own rule): the finding of eligibility may carry an ancillary clause that 'outstanding modules, exam results or credits must be submitted within two semesters' (German 2021 text: 'Nebenbestimmung ..., noch fehlende Module, Prüfungsleistungen oder Studienleistungen innerhalb von zwei Semestern nachzuholen'); they 'may be waived at the applicant's request if the applicant undergoes an individual examination' in the first semester; proof 'before the end of their second semester (30 September or 31 January, respectively)', otherwise unenrolment. No cap stated.

descriptive_notes: Selection if there are more qualified applicants than places: final mark/GPA 51 %, selection interview 49 % of the total score; ties by lot (§ 4).
Pre-selection for interviews: up to twice the number of places, by Bachelor's grade (§ 4).

Selection interview (§ 7): about 15 minutes by videoconference; ability to work scientifically, systematically and method-oriented, sound knowledge of foundations in Computer Science, Mathematics or Data Science; scores 1 (very well suited) to 5 (poorly suited). Interview windows: WS 1 May-15 June for non-EU applicants requiring a visa; SS 1 November-15 December.
Quotas: 40 % of places for applicants under the foreign-student quota, 60 % for all others (§ 4 (7)).

allowed_exemptions: upon request: successful completion of a study programme of two years or longer taught entirely in English
language_english.note: ZO § 2 (3): TOEFL iBT '95 credits', CAE 'Grade B or higher', CPE 'Grade C or higher', IELTS 'Band 6.5 or higher', TU Language Centre report 'At least two skills at B2 level and two skills at C1 level'; 'must not date back more than three years from the date of application'. Proof of English is an application document (§ 3).

other_requirements: online application, printed, signed and submitted with documents (certified copies, translations if needed)
degree certificate or transcript with Diploma Supplement
one-page written overview (A4, Arial 10) of the subject requirements with supporting copies
CV
proof of English

application before graduation: at least 150 credits (83.3 %) of a 180-credit or 180 credits (85.7 %) of a 210-credit programme; Bachelor's certificate by 31 March / 30 September of the first semester (§ 2 (4))
selection interview by videoconference

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 March (applicants under the foreign-student quota; others 15 July)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 September (applicants under the foreign-student quota; others 15 January)

admission_regulation.title: Fachprüfungsordnung (FPO-M) für das Fach Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) im Masterstudium an der Universität Siegen vom 23. September 2019 (§ 4), with the Rahmenprüfungsordnung (RPO-M) für das Masterstudium an der Universität Siegen vom 28. Februar 2019
admission_regulation.version: FPO-M: Amtliche Mitteilungen Nr. 21/2019 vom 24.09.2019, applies to students enrolling from WS 2019/20; amended by the Ordnung zur Änderung der FPO-M vom 10. Juni 2020 (Amtliche Mitteilungen Nr. 22/2020 vom 16.06.2020; changes § 4 Abs. 3 language proofs: IELTS 6.5 in each category, Cambridge B2 First 180+ (Note A); no change to grade or subject credits). RPO-M: AM 5/2019, amended AM 73/2020 and AM 45/2022 (24.06.2022). No later HCI amendment found by search (Amtliche Mitteilungen 2021-2026 not browsed; not exhaustive).

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 1: 'Ergänzend zu § 4 RPO-M ist Voraussetzung für den Zugang zum Masterstudiengang Human-Computer Interaction der Nachweis eines abgeschlossenen Bachelorstudiengangs mit dem akademischen Grad eines Bachelors in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Design, Psychologie oder Soziologie an einer Hochschule im Geltungsbereich des Grundgesetzes oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss mit einem einschlägigen Anteil von mindestens 60 LP aus den Bereichen der oben genannten Fachstudiengänge.' Foreign degrees fall under 'vergleichbarer Abschluss' (GPU-R reading, not regulation wording). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 2: 'Der Abschluss nach Absatz 1 muss ein qualifizierter Abschluss im Sinne von § 4 Absatz 2 RPO-M sein. Dies ist der Fall, wenn der Abschluss mindestens mit der Note gut (2,5) nachgewiesen wurde.' Programme page: 'the bachelor's degree must be graded 2.5 or better (German grading system).' No conversion method stated (RPO-M § 4 Abs. 3 covers recognition only).

items.raw_label: § 4 Abs. 1 'einschlägiger Anteil von mindestens 60 LP aus den Bereichen' Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Design, Psychologie oder Soziologie (pooled; Design, Psychologie and Soziologie have no taxonomy category and count 0)

subject_credit_requirements.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 1: one pooled requirement of at least 60 LP from the areas of the six named Bachelor subjects. POOLED: general_cs (Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik; GPU-R mapping) + business_administration (Betriebswirtschaftslehre; Wirtschaftsinformatik business content). Design, Psychologie and Soziologie have no category in cs_taxonomy.json and no allowed GPU-R name; they count 0 for now (stricter; see DECISION). Applies to the 'vergleichbarer Abschluss' route; a Bachelor in one of the six subjects from a German university needs no LP proof (GPU-R reading). Koushik review 19.10.2026: approved as is (CS students meet the 60 LP with CS courses); Design/Psychologie/Soziologie categories noted for the taxonomy phase.

conditional_admission.mechanism: The FPO-M HCI has no own Auflagen rule. Only the university-wide RPO-M § 4 Abs. 4 framework rule: 'Die Zulassung zu einem fachwissenschaftlichen Masterstudiengang kann mit Auflagen verbunden werden' (Bachelor modules, max 30 LP, proof by registration of the Master's thesis). Per Koushik's rule (16-17.10.2026) a university-wide 'kann' rule alone is not stored as allowed.

descriptive_notes: No selection procedure or aptitude test in the FPO-M; enrolment is refused if the applicant has finally failed a required examination in a programme with considerable content proximity (§ 4 Abs. 4).

allowed_exemptions: Studienqualifikation acquired at an exclusively English-speaking institution
English as native language
language_english.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 3 as amended (AM 22/2020): TOEFL iBT at least 94; 'IELTS-Test mit einem Ergebnis von mindestens 6.5 in jeder Kategorie'; 'Cambridge B2 First mit mindestens 180+ Punkten (Note A)'; PTE Academic at least 58; a certificate at level B2 (GER). The programme page still shows the pre-2020 wording (IELTS 6.5+ overall, Cambridge B2 First 173+) and says 'The language certificate should not be older than 3 years!' (not in the FPO-M).

other_requirements: separate application via the programme's application page or the unisono portal

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 April - 30 April (programme page; no separate non-EU deadline stated)

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung (Satzung) für den Masterstudiengang Data Science am Fachbereich Medien der Fachhochschule Kiel, § 7 Zugang zum Masterstudium
admission_regulation.version: PO vom 26. März 2019 (NBl. HS MBWK Schl.-H. 2/2019 vom 11.04.2019 S. 16); § 7 replaced in full by the Satzung zur Änderung vom 30. März 2021 (NBl. 2/2021 vom 22.04.2021 S. 21; applies from WS 2021/22); Zweite Änderungssatzung vom 28. Februar 2023 (NBl. 2/2023 vom 20.04.2023 S. 16; title and § 1 only, no admission change); Dritte Änderungssatzung vom 21. März 2025 (NBl. 2/2025 vom 16.04.2025 S. 16; replaces § 7 Abs. 3: GRE 'Mindestperzentil von 65% in allen Teilen des Tests'; in force 1 April 2025; regulations page: 'Inkrafttreten ab WiSe 2025/2026'). No consolidated reading version found; § 7 Abs. 1, 2 and 4 are taken from the 2021 amendment, Abs. 3 from the 2025 amendment.

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 7 Abs. 1: access for anyone who 'mindestens mit der Note 2,5 einen Bachelorstudiengang abgeschlossen hat' and has the subject credits; no degree field is named. Programme page: 'A bachelor's degree with a grade of at least 2.5'.

grade_requirement.note: PO § 7 Abs. 1 (as amended 30.03.2021): 'mindestens mit der Note 2,5'. No conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: mindestens 30 Leistungspunkte (nach ECTS) kumulativ in den Fachgebieten „Mathematik/Statistik“ und „Informatik“ (PO § 7 Abs. 1 Satz 1)
Dabei müssen mindestens 10 Leistungspunkte (nach ECTS) in dem Fachgebiet „Mathematik/Statistik“ nachgewiesen werden (PO § 7 Abs. 1 Satz 2; within the 30)
und mindestens 10 Leistungspunkte (nach ECTS) im Fachgebiet „Informatik“ (PO § 7 Abs. 1 Satz 2; within the 30)

subject_credit_requirements.note: NESTED: a pooled total of 30 LP across Mathematik/Statistik and Informatik, of which at least 10 in each (the sub-minimums count inside the total, engine rule E2a). The 10 + 10 sub-items share categories with the 30 total only because they are nested in it; they do not share categories with each other. Programme page: '30 ECTS in total across mathematics/statistics and computer science, with at least 10 ECTS in each area'. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Mathematik/Statistik' -> general_mathematics (+ statistics_probability named explicitly), 'Informatik' -> general_cs. Koushik decision 19.10.2026: keep all three items; add-up rule (the 30 adds maths/statistics and CS courses together, each course counted once; the 10 + 10 count inside it).

conditional_admission.mechanism: PO § 7 Abs. 2: if the prior degree has fewer than 210 but at least 180 LP, 'sind die fehlenden Kompetenzen nachzuholen'; 'In der Regel soll ein Gesamtumfang von 300 LP erreicht werden'; the Prüfungsausschuss notifies the competences and deadline 'bei Studienbeginn als Auflage'. This only makes up TOTAL credits (180 -> 210), not missing subject credits (lesson 8). No Auflagen rule for the 30/10/10 LP subject requirement.

descriptive_notes: Admission restricted (programme page): after advance quotas (foreigners and hardship), 20% of places by waiting time and 80% by the grade of the university entrance qualification (as stated on the programme page).

allowed_exemptions: school certificates showing English for at least 5 years up to the university entrance qualification with final (or last-two-years average) grade at least German 4 (ausreichend) / 5 points
English as native language
a successfully completed English-taught university degree
language_english.note: PO § 7 Abs. 4 (as amended 30.03.2021): English 'mindestens der Niveaustufe B2' (GER); 'Der Nachweis kann zum Beispiel wie folgt erbracht werden' — school certificates (5 years), native language, 'ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes englischsprachiges Hochschulstudium', or an internationally recognised B2+ certificate: Cambridge FCE grade B or higher, CAE grade C or higher, CPE grade C or higher, BULATS B2 60 points, IELTS band 5.5, TOEFL PBT 515 / CBT 185 / iBT 70. Programme page: 'English at least at CEFR level B2'. Due date not stated.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants with a Bachelor's degree obtained outside the Bologna area (members of the European Higher Education Area)
standardized_test_requirements.details: PO § 7 Abs. 3 as amended by the Dritte Änderungssatzung of 21.03.2025 (in force 01.04.2025): 'GRE mit einem Mindestperzentil von 65% in allen Teilen des Tests' (previously 55th percentile in Quantitative Reasoning only, 2021 version). Programme page: 'at least 65% in each section'.

other_requirements: Bachelor's with 180-209 LP: missing competences notified as an Auflage at the start of studies; generally a total of 300 LP should be reached (PO § 7 Abs. 2)
application possible with at most 15 ECTS of the Bachelor's still outstanding, with a certificate from the university (programme page)
applicants with a foreign university entrance qualification apply via uni-assist (programme page)
compulsory semester fee and non-refundable enrolment administration charge (programme page)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 July (programme page general deadline, May to 15 July; international applicants are referred to a separate international-applications page, not read)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 January (programme page general deadline, November to 15 January; international page not read)

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung für die konsekutiven Masterstudiengänge „Artificial Intelligence“, „Computer Science“ und „Cyber Security“ der Mathematisch-Naturwissenschaftlichen Fakultät der Rheinischen Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn (§ 5 Zugangsvoraussetzungen zum Studium), as newly announced by the Zweite Ordnung zur Änderung und zugleich Neubekanntmachung vom 13. Juli 2026
admission_regulation.version: Zweite Ordnung zur Änderung und zugleich Neubekanntmachung vom 13. Juli 2026, Amtliche Bekanntmachungen 56. Jg., Nr. 32 vom 27. Juli 2026; in force 1 October 2026 (§ 32: 'Diese Prüfungsordnung tritt am 1. Oktober 2026 in Kraft'). Read from the Deutsche Nationalbibliothek deposit copy (d-nb.info); the university's own handle link (hdl.handle.net/20.500.11811/14311) could not be opened. Earlier versions: original PO for Computer Science and Cyber Security vom 18. Juli 2023 (Amtl. Bek. 53. Jg., Nr. 38, 10.08.2023: Cyber Security then IT-Sicherheit 24, Mathe 18, Algorithmen 9, Programmierung 18, thesis 10, English B2); first amendment and Neubekanntmachung adding Artificial Intelligence vom 21. Januar 2026 (Amtl. Bek. 56. Jg., Nr. 6, 02.02.2026: thesis 12, English C1; § 5 wording identical to the July 2026 version). The July 2026 version keeps the § 5 subject numbers of the January 2026 version. Anlage 4 (selection rules) is listed in both 2026 versions but was not in the readable text.

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 5 Abs. 1: the programmes 'richten sich an Bewerber*innen, die als Zugangsvoraussetzung einen ersten berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschluss in den Fächern Cyber Security oder Informatik oder in einem verwandten Fach nachweisen.' Application page: 'You must have a degree in Computer Science or a related subject that is recognized in Germany as at least equivalent to a bachelor's degree.' No minimum total ECTS stated.

grade_requirement.note: PO § 5 sets no minimum grade. Grades are used only in the selection ranking (application page: 'only good grades (better than 2,5 in the German system) bring in any points'). Grades are entered as on the transcript, without conversion; no conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: Module im Umfang von mindestens 24 ECTS-LP in Grundlagen der IT-Sicherheit (PO § 5 Abs. 4 Nr. 1)
Module im Umfang von mindestens 18 ECTS-LP in mathematischen Grundlagen der Informatik (PO § 5 Abs. 4 Nr. 2)
Module im Umfang von mindestens 9 ECTS-LP in Grundlagen der Algorithmentheorie, der Komplexitätstheorie oder formaler Sprachen (PO § 5 Abs. 4 Nr. 3)
Module im Umfang von mindestens 18 ECTS-LP in Programmierung, Softwaretechnologie oder Informationssysteme (PO § 5 Abs. 4 Nr. 4)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Programme page explanations (not in the PO): mathematics 'in modules on, for example, logic, discrete structures, linear algebra, analysis, numerics, stochastics or geometry'; algorithm theory: 'Exercises or labs that accompany lectures count towards this requirement, but practica, internships, theses, and graduation projects do not count'; programming/software technology/information systems: 'This category also includes modules on artificial intelligence and graphics, but it does not include modules that belong to the categories described above or that deal with hardware and operating systems'; thesis: should 'generally contain at least 750 lines of text' ('Program code, input, output, bullet point lists and tables do not count as text'); the topic may be outside computer science. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Algorithmentheorie, Komplexitätstheorie oder formale Sprachen' is one pooled item (algorithms_data_structures + theoretical_cs, engine adds up); 'Programmierung, Softwaretechnologie oder Informationssysteme' is one pooled item (programming_practical_cs + software_engineering + databases_systems for 'Informationssysteme'); the aggregate practical_cs is not used because it contains algorithms_data_structures, which belongs to the sibling algorithms item. The page's extension to AI and graphics modules is NOT stored (see DECISION in notes). Mathematics stays one general_mathematics total (no sub-minimums stated). Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: Eine wissenschaftliche Abschlussarbeit im Umfang von mindestens 12 ECTS-LP, die den Anforderungen an eine Bachelorarbeit in den Bachelorstud

conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen for missing subject credits. PO § 5 Abs. 8 only allows studies to start before the first degree is completed ('nicht mehr als 30 ECTS-LP fehlen' at application, all exams passed in the semester before the Master's; proof of the access requirements 'spätestens vier Monate nach Semesterbeginn', otherwise 'erlischt die Einschreibung'). This concerns finishing the degree, not subject gaps (lesson 8). FAQ: 'Conditional admission will not enable you to catch up on missing requirements after enrolling in our Master's programmes.'

descriptive_notes: Admission is restricted (PO § 5 Abs. 6-7: Numerus clausus; selection under the university's Ordnung für Auswahlverfahren together with Anlage 4 of the PO). Programme pages: 'Institution-specific admission restrictions (special selection procedure)'.

Ranking (application page): each criterion is scored 0-10 points and multiplied by a programme-specific weight; only grades better than 2,5 (German system) earn points, and only modules beyond the minimum requirements count.

Cyber Security weights (application page): GPA 3; additional advanced IT security modules 3; AI modules 2; additional advanced mathematics 2; advanced computer systems modules 2; professional software development 2; academic manuscripts 1; subject-related extracurricular activities 1; subject-related teaching experience 1.
Admission thresholds winter 2026/27 (application page): Cyber Security non-EEA 75 points; EEA without a German Master's 4 points; about 30% of eligible non-EEA applicants were admitted.

Admission rounds (application page): foreign applicants are offered places about four months before the semester; EU/EEA applicants and second-Master's applicants about two months before; remaining places go to further foreign applicants.

allowed_exemptions: at least three years of secondary or tertiary education in the education system of Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the United States of America (application page)
language_english.note: PO § 5 Abs. 5: English 'mindestens auf dem Niveau C1 des Gemeinsamen europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GeR)'; the PO does not say how it is proven. Application page: 'You must have a command of English at level C1 or higher'; IELTS Academic at least 7.0; TOEFL 'at least 5.0 (in the new scoring system) or at least 95 (in the old scoring system)'; PTE at least 76; also Cambridge Advanced (CAE) or higher, Oxford Test of English Advanced 141, LanguageCert Academic 75, TELC C1, UNIcert III, TOLIMO 620; IELTS, TOEFL, PTE and TOLIMO must be valid until the start of the semester. 'Note that a proof of the language of instruction in your Bachelor's programme does not suffice.' FAQ: 'We do not accept a proof that English was the language of instruction in your Bachelor's'.

aps_certificate.note: Application page: 'If you have completed your previous education in China, India or Vietnam, you will need a Certificate of Authenticity (Echtheitsbestätigung / APS certificate)'. Not in the PO.

other_requirements: application through the university application portal (application.uni-bonn.de); a separate application for each programme
scientific thesis uploaded with the application (a proposal or incomplete version is accepted if not finished and sole author); English summary if not in English, French or German
letter of motivation in the online form, at most 4000 characters
CV (reverse-chronological list of relevant activities; residence of more than six months in the past five years)
transcripts of all programmes enrolled in; grades entered as on the transcript, without conversion

application before graduation possible: proof of expected completion (at most half a year of full-time study left) and PO § 5 Abs. 8 (at most 30 ECTS missing, all exams in the semester before the Master's, proof within four months of semester start)
letters of recommendation not required (only useful as proof of employment)
GRE not required (FAQ)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: Not stated for WS 2027/28 (WS 2026/27 closed; deadlines page). Non-EU applicants without a German Bachelor's must generally apply in the first application period (FAQ).
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 November (SS 2027: non-EEA applicants first period only, 1 October - 1 November 2026; deadlines page)

admission_regulation.title: Ordnung über die Zugangsvoraussetzungen und über die Zulassung für den konsekutiven Master-Studiengang „Angewandte Data Science“ der Georg-August-Universität Göttingen
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Mitteilungen I Nr. 20 vom 14.04.2021 S. 372, Änd. AM I/15 v. 30.03.2022 S. 208 (first amendment); the online text is listed as 'Version AM I 15/30.03.2022' on the programme's regulations page and was read there (the page does not say explicitly whether the text already includes the amendment). Applies first to the Vergabeverfahren for WS 2021/22 (§ 11). No later amendment of this Ordnung is listed on the regulations page; AM I 31/2025 (07.10.2025) and 39/2025 (27.11.2025) contain no change to it (checked). The programme page announces the dMAT Data Science test 'replaces the online aptitude test' from SS 2027 — no amending Ordnung for this was found (see CONFLICT in notes).

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZZO § 2 Abs. 1: a relevant Bachelor's degree with a standard period of six semesters and 'mindestens 180 ECTS-Anrechnungspunkten' in Informatik, Data Science, Statistik, Mathematik or a closely related subject; the Auswahlkommission decides whether prior study is 'fachlich einschlägig' (§ 2 Abs. 3). Programme page: 'normally from a data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics, or closely related bachelor's'. § 2 Abs. 4: foreign nationals (non-EU/EEA, not equal to Germans) whose Bachelor's is not from a German or EU/EEA university must additionally prove relevance by passing an aptitude test (§ 3).

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade. The Bachelor's grade gives up to 51 selection points (ZZO § 6: e.g. '1,0 bis einschließlich 1,2 51 Punkte'; 4,0 = 0 points). No conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: wenigstens 60 Anrechnungspunkte in der Data Science, Informatik, Statistik oder Mathematik (ZZO § 2 Abs. 3 Satz 2)

subject_credit_requirements.note: ZZO § 2 Abs. 3: 'Voraussetzung der fachlichen Einschlägigkeit des Vorstudiums ist der Nachweis von wenigstens 60 Anrechnungspunkten in der Data Science, Informatik, Statistik oder Mathematik.' One pooled item (POOLED: the four subjects add up; engine rule E1). The Auswahlkommission may require missing credits to be made up within two semesters; relevance is excluded if more than 15 credits are missing (see conditional_admission). Programme page: 'At least 60 credits in foundational data science methods'. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): Data Science -> data_science.foundational_methods, Informatik -> general_cs, Statistik -> statistics_probability, Mathematik -> general_mathematics.

conditional_admission.mechanism: ZZO § 2 Abs. 3 Satz 3-4: 'Die Auswahlkommission kann die Feststellung der fachlichen Einschlägigkeit davon abhängig machen, Leistungen nach Satz 2, die bislang noch nicht erbracht wurden, innerhalb von zwei Semestern nachzuholen'; proof due within two semesters after enrolment (Ausschlussfrist); relevance is excluded if the missing amount 'mehr als 15 Anrechnungspunkte beträgt'. Programme page: 'you may make up up to 15 credits during your master's studies'. 'kann' = discretion of the Auswahlkommission.

descriptive_notes: Restricted admission. Selection (ZZO § 6) by points: Bachelor's grade (max. 51), special achievements (max. 5: e.g. scholarships, study abroad, internships) and an interview of about 15 minutes (max. 24: subject knowledge 12, reflection 6, motivation 6).

Pre-selection by grade ranking to twice the number of places; only shortlisted applicants are invited to the interview (video call, generally second half of June for winter and first half of December for summer; programme page).

Non-EU/EEA foreign applicants with a Bachelor's from outside Germany/EU/EEA: aptitude test (ZZO § 2 Abs. 4, § 3: in English, multiple choice, pass with at least 60% correct answers or within 10% of the average) and a special quota of 30% of places with the test result added to their ranking points (§ 10). Programme page: from SS 2027 the dMAT Data Science 'replaces the online aptitude test', is strongly recommended but not mandatory.

allowed_exemptions: native English speakers (ZZO § 2 Abs. 7)
C1 also shown by an at least two-year relevant stay in an English-speaking country within the last three years, or an at least two-year English-taught degree programme (ZZO § 2 Abs. 7)
alternative: English B2 plus German DSH-2 (ZZO § 2 Abs. 5-7; programme page)
language_english.note: ZZO § 2 Abs. 6: non-native speakers need English at least B2; Abs. 5: applicants whose native language is not German and who have neither a German HZB nor a German degree need German DSH-2 (or TestDaF 4x TDN 4); Abs. 7: the proofs of Abs. 5 and 6 'sind entbehrlich' for native English speakers or applicants with 'sehr gute Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache' (C1). So an applicant with C1 English needs no German; with B2 English, DSH-2 German is needed. C1 scores: IELTS Academic band 6.5, TOEFL iBT 95, 'Global Scale of English (Pearson Academic)' 76 (stored as pte_min), Cambridge English Scale 180, UNIcert III. B2 scores: IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 81, GSE 59, Cambridge 160. The test must not be older than two years at receipt of the application. Programme page: 'English language proficiency at CEFR C1' OR 'CEFR B2 and German language skills corresponding to DSH level 2'.

standardized_test_requirements.test: Aptitude test (Eignungstest, ZZO § 3) / dMAT Data Science (programme page, from SS 2027)
standardized_test_requirements.required_for: foreign nationals not equal to Germans and not EU/EEA citizens whose Bachelor's is not from a German or EU/EEA university
standardized_test_requirements.details: ZZO § 3: in English, multiple choice, held within two weeks after the application deadline; passed with at least 60% correct answers or a result within 10% of the average. Programme page: from SS 2027 the dMAT Data Science replaces the online aptitude test and is 'strongly recommended' but not mandatory (no amending Ordnung found).

other_requirements: application before graduation possible with at least 135 credits in a relevant Bachelor's (ZZO § 2 Abs. 2); degree proof by 15.11. (winter) or 15.05. (summer) (§ 2 Abs. 8)
online application with degree certificates, transcript of records, tabular CV, proof of English (and German if applicable), dMAT Data Science result (recommended for international applicants)
the APS-related dMAT General Academic Module must NOT be included in the application (programme page)
no individual eligibility checks offered (programme page)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 May (Ausschlussfrist, ZZO § 4; same for all applicants)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 November of the previous year (Ausschlussfrist, ZZO § 4)

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 3 (2): completed Bachelor's in Mathematik, Informatik, Physik or a related field, plus one of three profiles (Informatik, Mathematik or Physik); achievements must be comparable to the RWTH Bachelor's programmes Informatik, Mathematik or Physik. Only the Profil Informatik is stored as items. Profil Mathematik: Analysis I-III, Lineare Algebra I-II, Numerische Analysis, Stochastik (57 CP by own sum). Profil Physik: Experimentalphysik IV, Va, Vb, Vernetzung der Experimentalphysik, Theoretische Physik III, IV, Vernetzung in der Theoretischen Physik, Höhere Mathematik I-III, Fortgeschrittenenpraktikum (82 CP by own sum). The physics application subject requires the physics profile.

Praktische Informatik (28 CP): Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen 8 CP
Praktische Informatik (28 CP): Datenbanken und Informationssysteme 6 CP
Praktische Informatik (28 CP): Softwaretechnik 6 CP

subject_credit_requirements.note: Profil Informatik of SPO 2025/337 § 3 (2). The area headings carry no CP totals; each min_ects is the sum of the module CP listed under that heading (28 + 18 + 18 + 26 = 90 CP). The program page lists Data Structures and Algorithms as 7 CP; the SPO prints 8 CP (SPO wins). Content must be comparable to RWTH modules; the examination board decides. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording; Koushik's decision 15.10.2026, same as 3696/3728): the CS areas are checked module by module with the CP stated in the regulation, one item per taxonomy category (stricter than checking only the area totals); mathematics is checked as one 26 CP total. Einführung in die Technische Informatik and Datenkommunikation share the category computer_engineering (6 + 6 = 12 CP); Mathematische Logik I is counted under theoretical_cs (logic for computer science), so it cannot overlap with Diskrete Strukturen in mathematics.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflagen (SPO § 3 Abs. 5 i.V.m. § 3 Abs. 6 ÜPO): RWTH Bachelor modules, to be proven before registering the Master's thesis; admission not possible if Auflagen of more than 12 CP are necessary

descriptive_notes: Open admission (not restricted, no NC).
Course content must be comparable to the RWTH modules; the examination board decides.

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or degree from the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Canada or the United States
examination board may check English through an English-language seminar paper or Bachelor's thesis (SPO § 3 (6))
language_english.note: SPO § 3 (6): English per § 3 Abs. 9 ÜPO. admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Master-Studiengang Robotik/ Robotics an der Technischen Hochschule Deggendorf (§ 2 Qualifikationsvoraussetzungen, § 5, § 8 Eignungsprüfung)
admission_regulation.version: SPO vom 23. Juli 2025 (published by notice 24.07.2025), in force 1 October (2025), for students starting from WS 2025/26 (§ 13). Previous SPO vom 19. Februar 2025 (for students from SS 2025; same admission rules as far as visible). The university-law page lists no Änderungssatzung for this programme (checked 2026-10-17). Language proof refers to § 3 of the Rahmenprüfungsordnung für die Zusatzausbildung im Bereich der Fremdsprachen und Allgemeinwissenschaftlichen Wahlpflichtfächer vom 01.10.2018 (not opened).

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1: a first degree 'im Umfang von mindestens 210 ECTS-Punkten aus dem Bereich' Robotik, Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieur, Produktionsingenieur, Regelungstechnik, Informatik, Elektronik, Bioinformatik, Gesundheitsinformatik, Automatisierungstechnik or a related/equivalent degree; 'Über die Gleichwertigkeit der Abschlüsse entscheidet die Prüfungskommission.' Plus a passed aptitude test (§ 8) unless waived. Programme page: 'at least 210 ECTS credits in robotics or a closely related engineering discipline'. This computer_science record is one field copy of a multi-field programme (copies 9838_eee and a mechanical copy exist in other field files; not rebuilt here).

grade_requirement.note: No grade limit for access. SPO § 8 Abs. 2: the Prüfungskommission 'kann' waive the aptitude test for above-average qualifications: 'Als überdurchschnittlich gelten Abschlüsse mit der Note „gut” (<2,5) und besser' or grade 2,5 and better in Mathematik, Regelungstechnik, Physik, Informatik and Mechatronik or Robotik (or related subjects). No conversion method stated.

subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject credit requirements in the SPO. Subject knowledge is checked by the aptitude test (§ 8): 90-minute written or online exam on higher mathematics for engineers and fundamentals of robotics, computer science and programming, mechatronics, control engineering and electrical engineering.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen for missing subject competences. SPO § 5 only covers degrees with at least 180 but fewer than 210 ECTS: the missing ECTS (max. 30) must be proven by the start of the third semester (internship of at least 20 weeks or relevant undergraduate courses of the university) as a condition for passing the Masterprüfung — a total-credit rule, not a subject condition (lesson 8).

descriptive_notes: Aptitude test (SPO § 8) unless waived: written or online exam of 90 minutes on higher mathematics for engineers and fundamentals of robotics, computer science/programming, mechatronics, control engineering and electrical engineering; graded by two professors who must agree; passed 'mit Erfolg abgelegt'; held every semester; one retake at the next half-year date.

Waiver possible (Prüfungskommission 'kann'): degree grade 'gut' (<2,5) or better, or grade 2,5 or better in Mathematik, Regelungstechnik, Physik, Informatik and Mechatronik or Robotik (SPO § 8 Abs. 2).
Specialisation (Intelligent Robotics or Assistive Robotics) must be chosen in the application; no entitlement that a specialisation runs (SPO § 4).

language_english.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 2: 'Englische Sprachkenntnisse auf dem Sprachniveau B2 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen'; proof under § 3 of the Rahmenprüfungsordnung (not opened). THD language-requirements PDF: Robotics B2; only TOEFL iBT accepted; IELTS General and Academic accepted (not IELTS Indicator); certificates not older than 2 years; the score table could not be attributed reliably to tests, so no minimum scores are stored. MyGermanUniversity (checked 24.10.2026): B2 — IELTS 5.5 overall (5.5 in each section), TOEFL iBT 72.

language_german.due: by the end of studies

other_requirements: Bachelor's with 180-209 ECTS: missing ECTS (max. 30) by the start of the 3rd semester via a 20-week relevant internship or undergraduate courses after advising (SPO § 5)
choice of specialisation (Intelligent Robotics or Assistive Robotics) in the application (SPO § 4)
German A2 to be proven by the end of studies (SPO § 2 Abs. 2; THD language-requirements PDF)
GATE or GRE scores encouraged but not mandatory for degrees from non-signatory states of the Lisbon Recognition Convention; Home Editions not accepted (programme page)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 December (application period 15 October - 1 December; programme page)

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungs- und Studienordnung – Besondere Bestimmungen – für den Studiengang Data Science mit dem Abschluss „Master of Science“ der Technischen Universität Ilmenau (PStO-BB), § 3 and Anlage „Besondere Zugangsvoraussetzungen“, together with the Ordnung für den Zugang zu Masterstudiengängen an der Technischen Universität Ilmenau (MAZugO) vom 13. Juli 2020
admission_regulation.version: PStO-BB approved by the President on 17.07.2025 (faculty council 22.10.2024, Studienausschuss 12.11.2024); in force the day after publication in the Verkündungsblatt; applies to all students enrolled from SS 2026 (§ 16). The Verkündungsblatt issue number is not printed in the document and was not found (issues 271, 275 and 276/2025 checked: not contained). No amendment of the PStO-BB found in issues 281, 283 and 288/2026 (checked); the full Verkündungsblatt listing was not searched, so this is not exhaustive. MAZugO of 13.07.2020 (replaces the version of 25.03.2013, Verkündungsblatt 111/2013); its own Verkündungsblatt number is not printed; no amendment found by search. General PStO-AB (Verkündungsblatt 174/2019, amended 216/2021) has a new version in Verkündungsblatt 281/2026 (not admission-relevant; issue 286/2026 cited elsewhere, not opened).

accepted_degree_fields.note: This record applies ONLY to applicants with a degree 'im Studiengang Informatik' (PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 3 c, 20 points) — i.e. CS-related students, the only students matched against this computer_science file (Part A). Degrees in Data Science/Statistics (30 points) or Mathematics (25 points) reach 35 points by other combinations and are not covered here; other degrees 'sind ... nicht geeignet' (Ziff. 3 d). PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 3: the degree is rated with points: (a) 'in einem Studiengang der Fachrichtung Data Science, Statistik oder in einem inhaltlich vergleichbaren' programme = 30 points; (b) 'im Studiengang Mathematik' = 25 points; (c) 'im Studiengang Informatik' = 20 points; (d) applicants without a degree under (a) to (c) 'sind für den Studiengang Data Science mit dem Abschluss „Master of Science“ nicht geeignet'. Programme page: 'Bachelor's degree in a similar field'.

grade_requirement.note: Route A: no grade limit — with the full module set (a) a CS degree reaches 35 points at any grade (20 + 15). The grade only adds points (Anlage Ziff. 4: 1,5 or better 10, 2,0 or better 5). No conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: Analysis und lineare Algebra 15 LP (set a)
Mathematics of Data Science 5 LP (set a)
Optimierung und Numerik 15 LP (set a) — no taxonomy category, counts 0, checked by hand
Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie und Statistik 10 LP (set a)
Diskrete Mathematik 5 LP (set a)
Programmierung, Algorithmen und theoretische Informatik 15 LP (set a)
Datenbanken 5 LP (set a)
Software-Entwicklung 10 LP (set a)
Maschinelles Lernen 10 LP (set a)
Ethische und soziale Aspekte der Datenwissenschaften 5 LP (set a) — no taxonomy category yet (T3), counts 0, checked by hand

subject_credit_requirements.note: PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 5 a: 15 points 'sofern in allen folgenden Bereichen jeweils Module mindestens im angegebenen Umfang nachgewiesen werden': Analysis und lineare Algebra 15, Mathematics of Data Science 5, Optimierung und Numerik 15, Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie und Statistik 10, Diskrete Mathematik 5, Programmierung, Algorithmen und theoretische Informatik 15, Datenbanken 5, Software-Entwicklung 10, Maschinelles Lernen 10, Ethische und soziale Aspekte der Datenwissenschaften 5, Bachelorarbeit 10 LP. Points system (Anlage Ziff. 2-6): Informatik degree 20 + grade (1,5 or better 10; 2,0 or better 5) + module set (full set a 15; smaller set b 5). At least 35 points are needed; a CS degree reaches at most 45, so admission is never direct: 35-49 points lead to a file review (if needed a written test or interview) and admission only with a positive prognosis and with Auflagen of at most 30 LP (Ziff. 6 b). For a CS degree exactly two combinations reach 35: route A = full set (a) at any grade (20+15); route B = grade 1,5 or better + smaller set (b) (20+10+5). GPU-R stores them as two records (route split, E9); the programme is shown once with the student's best route. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Optimierung und/oder Numerik' has no taxonomy category and is stored as mathematics_statistics.optimization_numerics, which the engine does not measure (counts 0, checked by hand) — same treatment as KU 10360 (N-36); it is NOT mapped to analysis. 'Ethische und soziale Aspekte' is stored as society_law_ethics.ethics_law_society (T3 category, not yet measured: counts 0). Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: Bachelorarbeit 10 LP (set a)

conditional_admission.mechanism: PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 6 b: with 35 to under 50 points, a file review (if needed a written test or interview) checks whether missing qualifications can be obtained during the Master's; with a positive prognosis admission is with Auflagen: 'Die zu erbringenden Leistungen dürfen insgesamt nicht mehr als 30 Leistungspunkte umfassen.' (also MAZugO § 4 Abs. 4). MAZugO § 4 Abs. 6: if up to 60 LP are missing, admission may instead be conditional on prior successful participation in a university preparatory course, where the faculty offers one. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): stored as not allowed, because the Auflagen apply only to applicants who already reach 35 points; using a 30 ECTS cap on the stored items would show applicants below 35 points as eligible with conditions (see DECISION in notes).

descriptive_notes: Aptitude assessment by points (PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 2-6; MAZugO § 4): degree field (Data Science/Statistics or comparable 30, Mathematics 25, Computer Science 20 points) + final grade (1,5 or better 10, 2,0 or better 5 points) + subject modules (full module set 15, smaller module set 5 points).

50 points or more: special access requirements met. 35 to under 50 points: file review, if needed a written test (60-180 minutes) or an interview (15-45 minutes); admission only with a positive prognosis and with conditions of at most 30 credits. Under 35 points: not met.
In case of doubt the Prüfungsausschuss decides (Anlage Ziff. 7).

Route split (GPU-R): route A = full module set at any grade; route B = grade 1,5 or better + smaller module set. Both only reach 35 points, so admission always goes through the file review with Auflagen of at most 30 LP.

accepted_degree_fields.note: This record applies ONLY to applicants with a degree 'im Studiengang Informatik' (PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 3 c, 20 points) — i.e. CS-related students, the only students matched against this computer_science file (Part A). Degrees in Data Science/Statistics (30 points) or Mathematics (25 points) reach 35 points by other combinations and are not covered here; other degrees 'sind ... nicht geeignet' (Ziff. 3 d). PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 3: the degree is rated with points: (a) 'in einem Studiengang der Fachrichtung Data Science, Statistik oder in einem inhaltlich vergleichbaren' programme = 30 points; (b) 'im Studiengang Mathematik' = 25 points; (c) 'im Studiengang Informatik' = 20 points; (d) applicants without a degree under (a) to (c) 'sind für den Studiengang Data Science mit dem Abschluss „Master of Science“ nicht geeignet'. Programme page: 'Bachelor's degree in a similar field'.

grade_requirement.note: Route B: Anlage Ziff. 4 'sehr gut (Note 1,5 oder besser) mit 10 Punkten' — needed because 20 (CS degree) + 5 (set b) + 10 (grade) = 35; with grade 2,0 or better only 30. GPU-R arithmetic from the points table, not a cut-off stated as such. No conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: Analysis und lineare Algebra 15 LP (set b)
Optimierung und/oder Numerik 10 LP (set b) — no taxonomy category, counts 0, checked by hand
Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie und Statistik 10 LP (set b)
Programmierung, Algorithmen und/oder theoretische Informatik 10 LP (set b)
Datenbanken 5 LP (set b)
Maschinelles Lernen 5 LP (set b)

subject_credit_requirements.note: PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 5 b: 5 points 'sofern in allen folgenden Bereichen jeweils Module mindestens im angegebenen Umfang nachgewiesen werden' (wording re-read 16.10.2026, same condition as set a): Analysis und lineare Algebra 15, Optimierung und/oder Numerik 10, Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie und Statistik 10, Programmierung, Algorithmen und/oder theoretische Informatik 10, Datenbanken 5, Maschinelles Lernen 5, Bachelor- oder Projektarbeit 5 LP. Points system (Anlage Ziff. 2-6): Informatik degree 20 + grade (1,5 or better 10; 2,0 or better 5) + module set (full set a 15; smaller set b 5). At least 35 points are needed; a CS degree reaches at most 45, so admission is never direct: 35-49 points lead to a file review (if needed a written test or interview) and admission only with a positive prognosis and with Auflagen of at most 30 LP (Ziff. 6 b). For a CS degree exactly two combinations reach 35: route A = full set (a) at any grade (20+15); route B = grade 1,5 or better + smaller set (b) (20+10+5). GPU-R stores them as two records (route split, E9); the programme is shown once with the student's best route. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): 'Optimierung und/oder Numerik' has no taxonomy category and is stored as mathematics_statistics.optimization_numerics, which the engine does not measure (counts 0, checked by hand) — same treatment as KU 10360 (N-36); it is NOT mapped to analysis. Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: Bachelor- oder Projektarbeit 5 LP (set b)

conditional_admission.mechanism: PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 6 b: with 35 to under 50 points, a file review (if needed a written test or interview) checks whether missing qualifications can be obtained during the Master's; with a positive prognosis admission is with Auflagen: 'Die zu erbringenden Leistungen dürfen insgesamt nicht mehr als 30 Leistungspunkte umfassen.' (also MAZugO § 4 Abs. 4). MAZugO § 4 Abs. 6: if up to 60 LP are missing, admission may instead be conditional on prior successful participation in a university preparatory course, where the faculty offers one. GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): stored as not allowed, because the Auflagen apply only to applicants who already reach 35 points; using a 30 ECTS cap on the stored items would show applicants below 35 points as eligible with conditions (see DECISION in notes).

descriptive_notes: Aptitude assessment by points (PStO-BB Anlage Ziff. 2-6; MAZugO § 4): degree field (Data Science/Statistics or comparable 30, Mathematics 25, Computer Science 20 points) + final grade (1,5 or better 10, 2,0 or better 5 points) + subject modules (full module set 15, smaller module set 5 points).

50 points or more: special access requirements met. 35 to under 50 points: file review, if needed a written test (60-180 minutes) or an interview (15-45 minutes); admission only with a positive prognosis and with conditions of at most 30 credits. Under 35 points: not met.
In case of doubt the Prüfungsausschuss decides (Anlage Ziff. 7).

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung für die Studiengänge Digital Sciences mit dem Abschlussgrad Master of Science (Digital Sciences Campus Gummersbach / Digital Sciences Campus Südstadt), § 3 Zugangsvoraussetzungen
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Mitteilung Nr. 64/2021 of 22.11.2021 (published 30.11.2021, in force 01.09.2021, for students starting from WS 2021/22), as amended by the Erste Änderungssatzung of 14.03.2023 (Amtliche Mitteilung Nr. 12/2023, in force 01.03.2023), which replaces only § 24 (module examinations) and does not change admission. Binding German text read from the ULB Bonn deposit copy of the Amtliche Mitteilung; TH Köln's German regulations page (https://www.th-koeln.de/studium/digital-sciences-master--ordnungen-und-formulare_82998.php) links the German PO and the 2023 amendment; the English page links the English translation ('only the German version ... shall be considered binding'). No further amendment found by web search; the TH Köln Amtliche Mitteilungen listing was not opened.

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 3 Abs. 1: Bachelor's degree (at least) 'in einem einschlägigen Studiengang'; 'Einschlägig ist ein vorausgegangener Bachelorstudiengang, wenn er mindestens 80 ECTS Informatik- oder Informationswissenschaftsinhalte gemäß Absatz 2 enthält. Die Entscheidung über die Einschlägigkeit trifft der gemeinsame Prüfungsausschuss'. No degree names are listed; relevance is defined only by the 80 ECTS from the 19 topic areas of § 3 Abs. 2. Specializations: BIS, ITM, SAR (Campus Gummersbach) and DIS (Campus Südstadt), each with its own minimum credits per 'Handlungsfeld' (see subject note). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording. This record is specialization BIS (Business Information Systems, Campus Gummersbach); the other specializations are separate records 8353_BIS/_DIS/_ITM/_SAR (route split, shown once with the best route — E9).

grade_requirement.note: PO § 3 Abs. 1: 'mit der Mindestnote „gut“ (2,5)'; English translation: 'a final grade of at least "good" (2.5)) in the German grading system or its equivalent'. No conversion method stated. The how-to-apply page lists no minimum grade for first-semester admission (it uses the grade for ranking and states 2.5 only for advanced-semester admission).

items.raw_label: § 3 Abs. 1-2: mindestens 80 ECTS Informatik- oder Informationswissenschaftsinhalte aus den Themenfeldern: 1. Theoretische Informatik, Formale Sprachen, Automaten, Digitaltechnik; 2. Programmierung, Paradigmen der Programmierung, Algorithmen, Algorithmik, Mobile Computing, Softwaretechnik, Software Engineering; 3. Webentwicklung, Webtechnologien, Web-basierte Anwendungen; 4. Mensch-Computer-Interaktion, Entwicklung interaktiver Systeme; 5. Wissensorganisation; 6. Digitale Informationsgesellschaft, Informatik & Gesellschaft, Medieninformatik & Gesellschaft, Informationsethik; 7. Informationsvisualisierung, Informationserschließung; 8. Information in Unternehmen, Informationsmanagement, Prozessmanagement, Wissensmanagement; 9. Datenmodellierung; 10. Datenanalyse, Informationsanalyse, Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, Entscheidungsunterstützung; 11. Data Mining, Künstliche Intelligenz; 12. Informationsrecherche, Information Retrieval, Suchmaschinentechnologie; 13. Datenbanksysteme, Informationssysteme, ERP-Systeme, Anwendungssysteme; 14. Informationsrecht, Datenschutzrecht, Recht in der Informatik; 15. Medientechnik und -produktion, Audiovisuelle Medien, Computergrafik und Animation; 16. Kommunikationstechnik und Netze; 17. Betriebssysteme, verteilte Systeme Betriebssysteme, Rechnerarchitekturen; 18. IT-Betrieb, Identity Management, Servicemanagement, Virtualisierung, Dienstarchitekturen, IT-Sicherheit, IT-Architekturmanagement; 19. IT-Controlling
Handlungsfeld Acting Responsibly (AR): 'verantwortliches Handeln im gesellschaftlichen Kontext' — at least 5 ECTS prior credits for BIS (PO § 3 Abs. 6 table)

Handlungsfeld Architecting and Coding Software (ACS): 'Methoden und Werkzeugen, um Software sowie softwarebasierte digitale Systeme und Technologien zu konzipieren' — at least 10 ECTS prior credits for BIS (PO § 3 Abs. 6 table)
Handlungsfeld Empowering Business (EB): 'Entwickeln von Geschäftsfähigkeiten unter Nutzung digitaler Dienste' — at least 25 ECTS prior credits for BIS (PO § 3 Abs. 6 table)

Handlungsfeld Generating and Accessing Knowledge (GAK): 'umfasst den gesamten digitalen Erzeugungsprozess von Daten über Informationen zu Wissen' — at least 5 ECTS prior credits for BIS (PO § 3 Abs. 6 table)

Handlungsfeld Managing and Running IT (MRI): 'zielt auf umfassendes Expert*innenwissen für den Aufbau, den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung der IT' — at least 5 ECTS prior credits for BIS (PO § 3 Abs. 6 table)

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO 22.11.2021 (AM 64/2021) § 3 Abs. 1: 'mindestens 80 ECTS Informatik- oder Informationswissenschaftsinhalte gemäß Absatz 2' (19 Themenfelder) and, 'im Wege einer Eignungsprüfung', the minimum prior knowledge in the six Handlungsfelder of the § 3 Abs. 6 table for the chosen specialization (BIS: AR 5, ACS 10, EB 25, GAK 5, MRI 5; DIP not required; sum 50). GPU-R policy (not regulation wording; Koushik's decision 15.10.2026): Handlungsfelder mapped to taxonomy categories from TH Köln's own descriptions in the Digital Sciences module handbook (Kapitel 'Handlungsfelder'): ACS -> programming + software engineering + algorithms; EB -> business administration; GAK -> databases + data engineering + ML/AI + data-science foundations + statistics; MRI -> computer engineering + operating systems + IT security. AR (ethics, data protection, law, society) is stored as society_law_ethics.ethics_law_society, which has NO taxonomy category yet (taxonomy to-do T3): the engine counts it as 0, so every applicant is treated as missing the AR 5 ECTS (stricter; best result CONDITIONAL until T3). Handlungsfeld items are siblings: a course counts for only one of them (engine rule D13); the 80 ECTS item is a broader total and counts every course (E2a). POOLED: each Handlungsfeld item is added up across its categories (D3). 80 ECTS item (Koushik's decision N-53, 16.10.2026): main category general_cs (all CS categories: theory, programming/SE/algorithms, web, HCI, graphics/media, databases/information systems, ML/AI/data mining, data engineering, operating systems/architectures, networks, IT security), plus business_administration (Themenfelder 8 Information in Unternehmen / Informationsmanagement and 19 IT-Controlling) and data_science.foundational_methods (Themenfeld 10 Datenanalyse / Business Analytics) as covered categories, added up (D3). Themenfelder 6 Informationsgesellschaft/Informationsethik and 14 Informationsrecht/Datenschutzrecht are stored as covered category society_law_ethics.ethics_law_society, and Themenfeld 5 Wissensorganisation as information_science.knowledge_organisation; both categories are not yet in the taxonomy (T3/T5), so the engine counts them as 0 until Part 1 classifies courses into them (record complete, engine later).

conditional_admission.mechanism: PO § 3 Abs. 7: applicants whose degree meets § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 1 but lacks the Handlungsfeld credits of the Abs. 6 table for the chosen specialization can be admitted with conditions: additional work 'im Umfang von bis zu 15 ECTS-Punkten binnen sechs Monaten gerechnet ab dem Zeitpunkt der Einschreibung'; the Zulassungskommission decides. Application page: missing credits are added up across the fields; 'If the sum of missing credits exceeds 15, admission is not possible.' LIMIT: only Handlungsfeld gaps can be bridged — the 80 ECTS relevance and the grade 2,5 cannot (the engine does not yet separate this, E8).

descriptive_notes: Every applicant must show the minimum prior knowledge in the six 'Handlungsfelder' for the chosen specialization (50 ECTS in total, distributed differently for BIS, DIS, ITM and SAR) in an Eignungsprüfung, or make it up through conditions of up to 15 ECTS within six months of enrolment (PO § 3 Abs. 1, 6, 7). The how-to-apply page links an ECTS form for this.

If admission is restricted and there are more applicants than places: stage 1 ranking per programme by Bachelor's grade (50%) and degree of relevance (50%, measured by missing Handlungsfeld credits); the best-ranked applicants are invited to an interview (also possible by video conference); final ranking by Bachelor's grade 50%, degree of relevance 25%, interview 25% (PO § 3 Abs. 4-6).

How-to-apply page: the second stage is a motivation video ('Applicants upload a video') used to assess the likelihood of completing the programme; the regulation text describes this stage as interviews.

allowed_exemptions: B2 annotation on the secondary school diploma (how-to-apply page)
language_english.note: PO § 3 Abs. 3: 'Für alle Studienrichtungen müssen ausreichende Englischkenntnisse (Level B2 nach dem europäischen Referenzrahmen oder gleichwertig) vor der Einschreibung nachgewiesen werden.' Test scores from the how-to-apply page only: TOEFL paper-based 550, computer-based 213, internet-based 80 (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.0 (tests from 21 January 2026), IELTS 6.0; the Examination Board may accept other documents. MOI is not mentioned.

other_requirements: German DSH-2 or equivalent only for the specialization ITM (IT-Management) (PO § 3 Abs. 3)
motivation video (how-to-apply page, selection stage 2)
ECTS form for the Handlungsfelder (how-to-apply page / programme FAQ)
application via uni-assist for non-EU/EEA applicants with a degree from outside the EU/EEA
in exceptional cases studies may start before the admission requirements of § 3 Abs. 1 are obtained if they are proven within six months of enrolment (PO § 3 Abs. 8)
Bachelor's with 180 LP (6 semesters) leads to the 4-semester 120 LP Master's; Bachelor's with 210 LP (7 semesters) to the 3-semester 90 LP Master's (PO § 4 Abs. 1)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 31 October (summer semester 2027: early September 2026 – October 31, 2026, via uni-assist)
